title: Intermediate Software Engineer

Job Description

Aderant is a global industry leading software company providing comprehensive business management solutions for law firms and other professional services organizations with a mission to help them run a better business. We are motivated by a collective desire to drive the legal industry to the forefront of innovation. With over 2,500 clients around the world, including 95 of the top AmLaw 100 firms, we are changing the outside perception of the legal sphere; where there was once resistance to modernization, we are creating a culture that embraces new ideas and technology. At Aderant, the "A" is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the "A". We bring the "A" to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work - ideas, experience, and passion - to drive our mission forward. Our people are our strength.

We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work - ideas, experience, and passion - to drive our mission forward. Our people are our strength.

Key Responsibilities
  • Expert Web Application Development Design, build, and maintain web-based features within the Aderant Expert product suite, following established architecture and coding standards. Develop and maintain front-end components (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks) alongside server-side C#/.NET logic and APIs. Work with existing Expert data and services (including integration points with SQL Server-backed systems) to build reliable, performant features. Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews. Troubleshoot and resolve defects raised through QA, support escalations, or production monitoring, with clear root-cause analysis.
  • Office 365 Integration Delivery Build and support integrations between Aderant Expert and Microsoft 365 services, primarily Outlook and Teams, using the Microsoft Graph API. Implement authentication and authorization flows for Microsoft 365 integrations (OAuth 2.0 / Microsoft Entra ID / SSO patterns). Develop and maintain Outlook and/or Teams add-ins or connected experiences that surface Expert data and workflows inside Microsoft 365. Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to ensure integrations are secure, scalable, and aligned with Microsoft's evolving platform requirements and deprecation timelines. Document integration design decisions and configuration steps for support and future maintainability.
  • Collaboration & Delivery Practices Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to sprint commitments. Work with QA to define test scenarios and support automated and manual testing of new features. Partner with product management and support teams to translate requirements and client feedback into working software. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and release processes, ensuring changes are deployed safely and reliably.
Required Qualifications
  • 2-4 years of professional software development experience, including web application development.
  • Solid proficiency in C# and the .NET framework/.NET Core.
  • Working experience with front-end web technologies: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one modern framework (e.g., React, Angular, or similar).
  • Practical experience with, or strong working knowledge of, RESTful API design and consumption.
  • Exposure to Microsoft 365 / Office 365 integration work - e.g., Microsoft Graph API, Outlook or Teams add-in development, or SharePoint integrations.
  • Understanding of authentication/authorization concepts relevant to Microsoft 365 (OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO).
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server, including writing and troubleshooting queries and stored procedures.
  • Familiarity with source control (Git or TFS/Azure DevOps) and collaborative development workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous requirements.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work for non-developer audiences.

title: AI Engineering & Methodology Architect
location: Austin, Texas, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > CPU Engineering

General Summary:

Accelerating the Future of CPU Design

Why This Role Exists:

The complexity of modern CPU development is growing faster than engineering teams can scale. More RTL, more verification, more data, more tools, more design iterations—and increasingly, more opportunities for AI to fundamentally change how engineering is done.

Our success will not be determined solely by how many engineers we hire. It will be determined by how effectively every engineer can create, analyze, verify, debug, and innovate.

This role exists to remove the friction that slows world-class engineers down.

We believe that the next decade of engineering productivity will come from the combination of deep technical expertise and intelligent automation. AI is not replacing engineering judgment—it is amplifying it. The engineers in this role will help define how that amplification happens.

You will build the tools, workflows, infrastructure, and methodology that allow entire design and verification organizations to move faster, make better decisions, and spend more time solving meaningful technical problems instead of fighting inefficiencies.

The impact of your work won't be measured by a single block or feature. It will be measured by hundreds of engineers moving faster because of what you built.

What You'll Do:

You will operate at the intersection of:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • RTL Design
  • Design Verification
  • Engineering Methodology
  • Infrastructure and Automation

You'll identify inefficiencies that consume engineering time and eliminate them through innovation, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.

You'll develop solutions that:

  • Accelerate RTL development and review
  • Simplify verification environment creation
  • Reduce debug turnaround time
  • Surface actionable insights from massive engineering datasets
  • Improve methodology adoption and consistency
  • Increase engineering productivity at organizational scale

You will evaluate emerging technologies, experiment with bleeding-edge AI capabilities, and transform promising ideas into production-quality solutions used by teams across the company.

Who Thrives Here:

The best candidates for this role are builders.

They see a manual process and immediately start imagining how to automate it.

They encounter an engineering bottleneck and can't stop thinking about how to eliminate it.

They are energized by creating tools that hundreds of engineers use every day.

They enjoy taking emerging technologies—especially AI—and figuring out how to apply them to real engineering challenges.

They care deeply about engineering excellence and become frustrated when talented engineers waste time on repetitive work, fractured workflows, unnecessary complexity, or poorly integrated tools.

They are naturally curious, continuously learning, and excited to explore ideas that have never been tried before.

Areas of Impact:

AI-Powered Engineering

Develop intelligent workflows that augment design and verification engineers throughout the development cycle.

Leverage agentic systems, large language models, and advanced analytics to improve engineering productivity, design quality, and decision-making.

Methodology Innovation

Define the next generation of RTL and verification methodologies by integrating AI directly into established engineering practices.

Transform how teams write code, review designs, analyze results, debug failures, and learn from data.

Infrastructure & Automation

Build scalable systems, services, and frameworks that enable engineers to focus on solving technical problems instead of managing process overhead.

Create durable platforms that become foundational to how engineering is performed.

Organizational Multiplication

Drive solutions that scale across teams, programs, and geographies.

Success is not measured by what you accomplish alone, but by how much more effective everyone becomes because of your contributions.

The Opportunity:

We are entering an era where the most impactful engineering contributions may not be individual designs or verification environments, but the systems that enable thousands of those designs and verifications to happen faster and with higher quality.

If you're excited about AI, passionate about building tools, energized by solving hard productivity problems, and motivated by multiplying the impact of entire engineering organizations, this is the place to do it.

Help define how the next generation of CPUs are engineered—not just what gets built, but how engineering itself evolves.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

title: Leipuri Fazerin myymäläleipomoon, K-Citymarket Easton Helsinki
description:
Tuoretta, käsin leivottua leipää arvostetaan yhä enemmän ja artesaanileipää leivotaan yli 140 Fazerin myymäläleipomossa ympäri Suomen. Etsimme nyt iloiseen joukkoomme viikonloppuleipuria/leipuria (xx h/viikko) xx myymäläleipomoomme. Tehtävä on vakituinen/määräaikainen sijaisuus xx saakka.

Fazer Leipurit -myymäläleipomon leipurina työnkuvasi on monipuolinen ja tehtäviisi kuuluvat kaikki leivontaprosessin eri vaiheet taikinan teosta esille laittoon. Leipomomme sijaitsevat kaupan sisätiloissa lähellä asiakkaita, joten reipas asiakaspalveluasenne ja hyvä suomen kielen taito ovat tehtävässä tärkeitä. Työskentelet tiiviisti yhdessä myymäläleipomon muun tiimin kanssa ja työssäsi sinua tukee myymäläleipomoesihenkilö.

Myymäläleipomossamme leivotaan viikon jokaisena päivänä aikaisesta aamusta alkaen. Työvuorot sijoittuvat noin kello 6–18 välille.

Palkkaus

Tehtävä kuuluu Suomen Elintarviketyöläisten Liiton (SEL) leipomoalan työntekijöitä koskevan työehtosopimuksen piiriin. Peruspalkkasi määräytyy alan koulutuksen ja aiemman leipomoalan kokemuksen mukaan. Aloituspalkka tehtävässä on 2134 € - 2639 €/kk (KK-PALKKA, PK-SEUTU) / 13,34 €/h - 16,49 €/h (OSA-AIKAISEN TUNTIPALKKA, PK-SEUTU) / 2032 € - 2513 €/kk (KK-PALKKA, MUU SUOMI) / 12,70 €/h - 15,71 €/h (OSA-AIKAISEN TUNTIPALKKA, MUU SUOMI). Peruspalkan lisäksi maksamme erilaisia lisiä työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti, esimerkiksi iltavuorolisää 15 % ja yövuorolisää 100 %.

Tehtävässä on lisäksi mahdollisuus liiketoimintakohtaiseen tuotannon tulospalkkioon, jonka tavoitetaso on 74 senttiä / h (rakenne ja ehdot määritellään vuosittain).

Tarjoamme lisäksi monipuolisia etuja, kuten esimerkiksi alennuksia Fazerin tuotteista sekä etuja hyvinvointiin, kuten Epassin.

Mitä toivomme sinun tuovan tiimiin?

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sinulta leipurin koulutusta tai opintoja ja käsinleivontaosaamista. Lisäksi sinulta löytyy tekemisen meininkiä, oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta sekä tahtoa kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Aikaisemman kokemuksen alalta katsomme eduksesi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä.

Odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä joustavasti toimipisteen aukioloaikojen mukaisesti sekä tarvittaessa myös muissa lähialueen myymäläleipomoissa.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer

title: Säljare till Kronans Apotek i Gällivare, Malmheden
description:
Välkommen till vår värld! 👑 Vår vision är en värld som mår bra, och du kan hjälpa oss att göra den visionen verklig. Vi tror att meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter, starka teamrelationer och en generös dos skratt skapar en arbetsmiljö som inspirerar och stärker oss och alla våra kunder. Med fokus på både här och nu, samt på framtiden - bidrar vi tillsammans till en värld som mår bra! 🌍🧡🚀

Din roll som säljare/egenvårdsrådgivare för Kronans Apotek i Gällivare Malmheden

Vi söker en serviceinriktad och engagerad säljare till vårt apotek Kronans Apotek Gällivare Malmheden. Du kommer dagligen arbeta med att hjälpa våra kunder till bättre hälsa. Apoteket är beläget i Malmheden, ett handels- och verksamhetsområde i Gällivare, med god tillgänglighet och parkering i nära anslutning. I närområdet finns bland annat matbutik och annan service, vilket ger ett bra kundflöde och gör det enkelt för kunder att uträtta flera ärenden i samband med sitt apoteksbesök. Du arbetar tillsammans med ett kompetent och samarbetsinriktat team bestående av två farmaceuter, en egenvårdsspecialist samt två säljare som gemensamt tar ansvar för apoteket och bidrar till kundupplevelser av hög kvalitet.

Det dagliga arbetet är omväxlande och innefattar allt från att ge bästa möjliga kundservice till försäljning av egenvårdsprodukter. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar:

  • Kassahantering.
  • Påfyllning, skyltning och frontning av varor.
  • Främja delaktighet och samarbete inom apoteket och tillsammans med teamet skapa positiva kundupplevelser.
  • Beställning av varor och lagerhantering.

Apoteket är öppet 09-17 på vardagarna och har stängt under helgen. Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning på deltid och du kommer tillhöra apotekschef Jaana Kopparis team. Önskad start omgående/enligt överenskommelse.

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av service och försäljning. Om du utbildar dig till farmaceut just nu eller har tidigare erfarenhet från apoteksbranschen är det meriterande.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du brinner för att hjälpa kunder och ge professionell service. På apoteket stöttar vi varandra i det dagliga arbetet och tillsammans skapar vi en trivsam, hållbar och trygg arbetsmiljö där vi utvecklas, har roligt och gläds åt våra framgångar. Till stöd finns en stark region och serviceorganisation samt kollegor över hela landet.

Din ansökan
Om detta låter som rätt utmaning för dig tveka inte att skicka din ansökan till oss. Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV eller din LinkedInprofil. Personligt brev? Det kan du skippa! Vi är intresserade av din kompetens, lära känna dig gör vi vid en eventuell intervju.

I slutet av rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi en bakgrundskontroll på samtliga personer vi vill anställa, oavsett roll eller funktion. Då vi enbart tillämpar detta på slutkandidat informerar vi mer om det längre fram

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi bryr oss mer - och det är även något vi delar med våra fackliga parter och tillsammans arbetar vi för en värld som mår bra. För att komma i kontakt med våra fackliga representanter kan du maila Stephanie Nielsen på Unionen via stephanie.nielsen@kronansapotek.se eller Aisha Karimi på Sveriges Farmaceuter via af.kronan@sverigesfarmaceuter.se. Vill du fördjupa dig i vårt kollektivavtal? Du hittar hela avtalet här!

title: Customer Journey Analytics Lead
description:
Customer Journey Analytics & Experience Measurement Lead

Location: London

Contract Type: Contract

Hybrid Working: Hybrid - 2 Days on site


The Role

We are looking for an experienced Customer Journey Analytics & Experience Measurement professional to support the development of a Customer Journey Analytics dashboard and strengthen how digital customer experience is measured across the organisation.


You will work closely with Experience Managers, Product Owners, Digital Channel teams, and Data & Analytics stakeholders to define meaningful customer experience KPIs, identify gaps in data and tracking, and turn insight into prioritised improvement plans.


This is a highly collaborative role for someone who understands how to connect customer behaviour, digital analytics and performance reporting to tangible product and journey improvements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and develop a Customer Journey Analytics dashboard to provide clear visibility of digital customer journey performance.
  • Define customer experience KPIs, success metrics and measurement frameworks across key digital journeys.
  • Partner with Experience Managers, Product Owners, Data & Analytics teams and Digital Channel teams to understand requirements and align reporting to business priorities.
  • Identify gaps in available data, including data quality issues, tagging gaps, event classification and reporting limitations.
  • Work with analytics and technical teams to improve the quality, consistency and availability of customer journey data.
  • Create performance dashboards and reporting that provide clear, actionable insight for business and product stakeholders.
  • Translate customer journey and analytics insight into prioritised backlogs and improvement roadmaps.
  • Support journey mapping, customer insight and optimisation activity across enterprise-scale digital platforms.
  • Help establish a more consistent approach to measuring customer experience and digital journey success.


Essential Experience

  • Experience working in Customer Journey Analytics, digital analytics, product analytics or customer experience measurement initiatives.
  • Experience defining and measuring customer experience KPIs and digital success metrics.
  • Strong dashboard and reporting development experience.
  • Experience identifying data quality, tagging, classification and reporting gaps.
  • Strong requirements gathering and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience creating prioritised backlogs, improvement plans and delivery roadmaps.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Customer Experience, Digital and Data & Analytics teams.


Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of the Adobe analytics ecosystem, including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Experience Platform.
  • Experience working directly with Customer Experience or Experience Management teams.
  • Experience with experimentation, performance optimisation and conversion improvement.
  • Understanding of journey mapping, customer insight and behavioural analysis.
  • Experience supporting large-scale or enterprise digital platforms.
  • Exposure to wider analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Contentsquare, Amplitude or Mixpanel.


Ideal Background

You may currently be working as a Customer Journey Analytics Manager, Digital Analytics Manager, Product Analytics Lead, CX Insights Manager, Digital Experience Analyst, or Customer Experience Measurement Lead.


You will be comfortable operating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to turn complex customer and digital data into clear priorities that improve the end-to-end customer experience.

title: Cabinkeeper for Postcard Cabins in Wimberley, Texas
location: Postcard Hill Country, Wimberley, TX, US
description:
Hotel Equities, a multi-award-winning hotel development and hospitality management company, is currently searching for a remarkable Cabinkeeper for the Postcard Cabins in Wimberley, Texas.

Job Purpose:

Cleans and prepares Cabins and public areas by meeting established standards of cleanliness and propriety to assure guest satisfaction and maximize revenues. Warm, knowledgeable service and helpful guidance reassure guests they’ve made the right choice to stay with us.

  • Thouroughly cleans assigned cabins (and cabin patios), including wiping and cleaning windows, doors, walls, closets, floors, bathrooms, appliances, and fixtures cabins, public areas and hallways, often using ladders or stools to clean hard to reach areas, in order to maintain a clean, presentable and attractive facility at all times.
  • Washes shower walls and tub, cleans toilet(s) and stall walls if applicable, wipes exposed pipes, cleans mirrors, sink(s) and walls in order to have clean and sanitary guest and public restrooms.
  • Replaces linen, toiletries, and collateral in each cabin. Washes all hard floor areas (linoleum, tile, etc.) by hand to remove dirt and soiled areas. Vacuums all carpeted areas.
  • Inspects all room equipment (TV, lights/lamps, faucets, radios) to ensure proper working order and immediately reports all room status and room maintenance deficiencies, in writing, to direct supervisor for prompt repair/resolution.
  • Maintains a friendly, cheerful and courteous demeanor at all times.
  • Performs other duties as assigned, requested or deemed necessary by management.

Qualifications and Requirements:

High School diploma /Secondary qualification or equivalent.

Experience with Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Wyndham or cleaning standards.

This job requires the ability to perform the following:

  • Must have basic knowledge of general cleaning principles, use of cleaning products and operation of standard cleaning equipment.
  • Must have vision ability to see minute debris and dirt in poorly lit areas, and to read written instructions and computer print-outs.

title: Data Science Engineer for PDA (Photonics), IME
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Data Science and Test Automation Engineer to develop automated testing and data-analysis capabilities for silicon photonic devices within our Photonic Design Automation platform.


Key Responsibilities



  • Develop automated workflows for chip alignment, wavelength scanning, electrical and optical characterization, and multidimensional parameter sweeps.

  • Build reusable drivers and control interfaces for lasers, power meters, motion stages, source measure units, and other laboratory equipment.

  • Implement reliable instrument communication, calibration, monitoring, retry, recovery, and equipment-safety mechanisms.

  • Develop scalable data pipelines for cleaning, processing, organising, and analysing experimental and simulation data.

  • Extract device performance metrics, identify trends and anomalies, compare measurements with simulations or design targets, and implement automated pass/fail evaluation.

  • Apply statistical, machine-learning, or optimisation methods to alignment, calibration, anomaly detection, process monitoring, and measurement acceleration.

  • Create real-time visualisations, dashboards, reports, and traceable experiment records.

  • Integrate automation and data-analysis capabilities with databases, backend services, job schedulers, and user interfaces.

  • Establish modular architecture, automated testing, logging, configuration management, and maintainable software practices.


Required Qualifications



  • Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, or a related discipline.

  • Strong Python programming, scientific computing, data processing, and visualization skills.

  • Experience using libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, or equivalent tools.

  • Experience controlling instruments, hardware, embedded systems, or external devices through software.

  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as serial, TCP/IP, USB, GPIB, VISA, or SCPI.

  • Experience with photonic, semiconductor, optical, or precision test automation.

  • Experience controlling motion stages, tunable lasers, power meters, source measure units, or similar instruments.

  • Familiarity with PyVISA, automatic alignment, feedback control, optimisation, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

  • Experience with machine learning, time-series analysis, uncertainty analysis, predictive modelling, or statistical process control.

  • Knowledge of silicon photonic devices and common optical measurements.

  • Experience with GUI development, databases, asynchronous systems, Docker, Linux, or CI/CD.

  • Experience working with wafer-level test systems or large experimental datasets.

title: Medewerker Monsterontvangst Genoomdiagnostiek
description:
Functie

Als medewerker monsterontvangst ben een belangrijke spil in het primaire laboratorium proces van de genoomdiagnostiek. Ben jij op zoek naar een afwisselende baan? Vind je het leuk om zowel praktische als administratieve werkzaamheden uit te voeren? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als medewerker monsterontvangst werk je bij het Centrale Lab. Het soort monsters wat je bij het lab ontvangt is zeer gevarieerd, dit loopt van bloedmonsters tot urinemonsters. Deze monsters worden gebruikt voor genetisch onderzoek danwel biochemisch onderzoek.

Hieronder staan de werkzaamheden beschreven die worden uitgevoerd door medewerkers monsterontvangst. Samen met jouw collega’s zorg je er elke dag weer voor dat alle beschreven werkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd. Om er voor te zorgen dat dit soepel verloopt werken we met een rooster.

Werkzaamheden binnen de monsterontvangst zijn:

  • Mail en telefoon beantwoorden.
  • Monsterstromen in de gaten houden.
  • In ontvangst nemen en controleren van patiëntmateriaal.
  • Registreren van patiëntmateriaal en onderzoeken in patiënt registratiesystemen.
  • Voorbewerken patiëntmateriaal.
  • Verzenden patiëntmateriaal.

Jouw werkplek

De afdeling Genetica bestaat uit drie secties, naast Genoomdiagnostiek ook klinische genetica en Genoomonderzoek. De sectie klinische genetica voert onder andere poliklinische consulten en diagnostiek van erfelijke ziekten uit. De onderzoeksgroepen verrichten baanbrekend onderzoek naar de relatie tussen genen en ziekten, in het bijzonder kanker, doofheid, blindheid, verstandelijke beperking en aangeboren afwijkingen. De drie secties werken op allerlei niveaus samen om optimale patiëntenzorg te leveren.

Genoomdiagnostiek is een vakgebied dat sterk in ontwikkeling is. Dankzij het Humane Genoomproject is er steeds meer bekend over de oorzaak van erfelijke aandoeningen bij de mens.

Ons streven is om nieuwe diagnostische mogelijkheden snel te implementeren. Daarbij maken we steeds meer gebruik van geautomatiseerde laboratoriumsystemen. De patiëntenzorg die we bieden is van een hoog niveau. Kwaliteit en service staan voorop. Het laboratorium voor Genoomdiagnostiek is ISO15189 gecertificeerd.

Als medewerker monsterontvangst binnen de sectie Genoomdiagnostiek kom je te werken bij het Centrale Lab. Het Centrale Lab bestaat uit een diverse groep medewerkers. Medewerkers monsterontvangst dragen samen met analisten en een team automatisering de zorg voor alle monster van binnenkomst tot dataproductie.

Profiel

Jij bent een enthousiaste collega die klantgericht kan werken. Je werkt accuraat en hebt een flexibele instelling. Zowel het zelfstandig werken als het werken in teamverband gaat jou goed af. Ook ben je in staat om collega’s feedback te geven op werkzaamheden, houding en gedrag en dit ook te ontvangen.

Verder herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde mbo 4-niveau opleiding.
  • Affiniteit met werken in laboratorium omgeving.
  • Goede communicatieve eigenschappen.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Goed om te weten

  • De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats in week 41, vanaf 5 oktober. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Graphics (GPU) Hardware Project Engineer
location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > GPU ASICS Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. Our growth strategy includes core technology development of the Adreno GPU to satisfy an ever-growing breadth of markets and use cases, including Snapdragon application processors for mobile (Android), laptops (Windows), VR (headsets), AR, hand-held gaming, wearables and others (you can imagine…) We need extremely smart & engaged individuals to play key roles in this large & diverse team with one mission: make the best GPUs possible, for all markets.

Role

The Project Engineer (PE) is the overall technical lead for a core development project throughout a given phase (Architecture, Development, Productization, or all three). They partner with Product Managers (PdM) on product requirements, priorities, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer/competitive needs – including customer meetings; They partner with Program Managers (PM) on schedule, milestones, execution metrics, and processes; But mostly, the PE is focused on the technical (engineering) aspects across functional teams & domains such as system architecture & modeling, hardware design, verification, silicon implementation, validation, and ultimately, product launch of the SOC (System on Chip) to OEMs and consumers. Important decisions are made almost daily, and always for the “best” possible product (priorities depend on market/tier) within reasonable risk parameters, to ensure success. These products will determine the margin (profitability) & Qualcomm share of the corresponding markets – and you’ll see them being used by millions of people in the real world.

Responsibilities may include

  • Partner with all engineering teams (inside/outside GPU HW) on definition, execution and delivery (of GPUs to products)

  • Act as technical liaison between GPU HW engineering and PdM, understand the challenges on each side, and encourage communication, cooperation, collaboration & compromise

  • Participate in Product/Roadmap planning (PdM + Engineering) using cost/benefit analysis & trade-offs (e.g. NRE vs. AUC)

  • Contribute to strategic direction of GPU cores (research, architecture, feature set) for long-term success

  • Quickly learn new technical domains/topics that arise in GPU/AP products/methods/markets, from transistors to tools to competing ecosystem solutions

  • Ownership of technology development, execution, and communication across technology teams

  • Drive industry best practices for ASIC engineering incl. efficient development across large-scale worldwide teams

  • Resolve key technical issues across teams with end goals of efficiency & best product possible

  • Organize & drive technical mtgs for brainstorm/problem solving, tiger teams, summits & system high level design reviews

  • Ensure that new proposals are being vetted & filed for potential patent applications

  • Interact daily with many individuals on worldwide team (onsite/online) to ensure forward progress & issues are identified early

  • Drive resolution via technical (not political) priorities when there are conflicts and tradeoffs within & outside GPU team

  • Respond efficiently to Business Unit (BU), Chipset PE, Chipset/GPU PdM & Customer requests/queries

  • Represent the GPU eng team in SOC forums & upper mgmt. meetings/discussions (incl. written & verbal communication)

  • Communication of technical solution/options internally and externally (chipset/customer/counterparts) as needed

  • Availability in key meetings (online & on-site) pertinent to the technical discussions above

  • Engineering risk and impact analysis to make the best decisions

  • Drive and mandate quality goals in conjunction with PM

  • Ensure that the product meets/exceeds the market needs (as defined by PdM)

  • Take risks (wisely) when necessary to “compete strongly” in the given market

  • Define and deliver innovative ideas/initiatives and work on broadly defined self-guided opportunities

  • Follow defined processes but also drive process improvements (as needed) based on experience

  • Establish single points of truth/reference, but minimize single points of failure, in our processes

  • Contribute to “lessons learned” and project retrospectives from the technical mgmt perspective

  • Actively support diversity within our teams, and in the Company

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years combined Hardware/Software/System Engineering or related work experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer engineering, Computer Science, or related field

  • Master’s degree (in above fields) reduces the work experience requirement by 1 years

  • PhD (in above fields) reduces the work experience requirement by 1 years (in addition to above)

  • Qualcomm work experience in HW/SW engineering counts as 1.5x for above requirement

  • Strong communication skills over various forms/media (F2F, Teams chat/mtgs, PowerPoint, emails)

  • Comfortable in technical discussions spanning software, hardware, system, and productization domains

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years combined Hardware/Software/System Engineering or related work experience, with above adjustments

  • 5+ years Graphics HW (GPU) work experience or equivalent applicable knowledge

  • 2+ years as Project Engineer or System Architect for projects with >50 people contributing

  • Demonstrated ability to take business goals into technology requirements and product design to achieve those goals

  • Self-driven to identify issues & risks, then define & deploy action plans to address/mitigate those

  • High level of focus & engagement on ensuring successful projects, meeting/surpassing goals in the face of obstacles

  • Strong knowledge and experience on all aspects of ASIC design flow (Arch, uArch, RTL, model, verification, synthesis, physical design) in leading technology nodes

  • Depth of knowledge in at least one of the aspects of ASIC design listed above

  • Breadth of the role (ownership vs. support) will depend on candidate qualifications and business needs

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

title: Mechanical BIM Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres)
description:
Haskoning is a global leader in the design and engineering of Mission Critical Facilities, particularly in the data center industry. Our dedicated MCF Data Centre team collaborates with top data center providers across Europe, Africa, Asia, and the UK to create innovative and sustainable solutions. As digital technologies continue to drive global growth, we are expanding our team and offer exciting opportunities for experienced professionals to join us in key locations such as the Netherlands, Germany, the KSA, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, and the UK.

What you do as a Mechanical BIM Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres)

As a Mechanical Engineer with strong BIM expertise, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) projects. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams and under the guidance of the Lead Engineer, you will develop coordinated, data-rich BIM models and contribute to innovative, high-quality mechanical engineering solutions. You will help ensure designs are fully integrated, constructible, and compliant with client requirements and industry standards while driving efficient digital design workflows and supporting the successful delivery of complex projects.

Other Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Develop, coordinate and optimise mechanical BIM models and service installation drawings, translating engineering designs into accurate, data-rich models, ensuring initial space reservations, multidisciplinary integration, and supporting clash detection and model coordination using tools such as Revit and Revizto.
  • Coordinate mechanical building services design, integrating functionality, installation, maintenance and accessibility requirements into models to deliver practical, buildable solutions while working closely with Mechanical, Plumbing and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Drive BIM innovation and digital engineering, proposing and developing innovative BIM solutions, improving design automation and contributing to more efficient engineering workflows and internal processes.
  • Ensure quality and technical excellence, maintaining close collaboration with Project Engineers and BIM Coordinators, ensuring all deliverables meet Haskoning and client standards, and reviewing the work of junior Mechanical Engineers and BIM Modelers.
  • Support successful project delivery and knowledge sharing, collaborating across international teams, sharing best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, and travelling internationally when required.

Where you will work

Haskoning is a worldwide independent engineering, project management and consultancy firm which integrates 140 years of engineering expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,000 colleagues are working from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the world. As our new Junior Electrical BIM Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres) you will become part of the team Mission Critical Facilities Spain.

Our global Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team provides a multidisciplinary package of consultancy services for our datacenter clients. We provide strategic, tactical, and operational advice to our clients, including colocation datacentres, internet service providers, and telecom companies. Our team consists of colleagues with all kinds of different expertise. For example, mechanical engineering, construction, civil, structure, building, architecture, fire safety, controls engineering, and security technology. Together we use our knowledge and expertise to develop integrated designs for Data Centres.

Curious about our work? Here you will find examples of some our projects.

You will join a leading market and work with a dedicated and passionate team ranked as one of the best Data Centre design & engineering teams globally.

What you bring

You are a proactive and collaborative professional with a solution-oriented mindset and a passion for innovation. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, take ownership of your work, and communicate confidently with colleagues and clients to deliver high-quality engineering solutions.

Besides That, You Have

  • A bachelor's degree (Mid-level) or master's degree (Senior-level) in Mechanical Engineering, combined with at least 4 years of relevant consulting engineering experience, enabling you to contribute to the design and delivery of complex building projects.
  • Strong expertise in Mechanical, HVAC and Plumbing engineering, with experience in building projects; industrial or mission critical/data centre projects are an advantage, allowing you to develop practical and technically robust engineering solutions.
  • Proficiency in BIM and Revit (certifications are a plus), with experience using Common Data Environments such as Autodesk Forma to develop coordinated, high-quality BIM models and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with digital design and automation tools, such as Dynamo, Python and Rhino Inside Revit, to improve engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks and support innovative design solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (C1 minimum) to collaborate with international teams and represent Haskoning professionally. Spanish is preferred, while Dutch and/or German are considered an advantage.

title: Operatieassistent
description:
Maak het verschil op de OK – samen werken we als een geoliede machine!

Bij het Reinier Haga Orthopedisch Centrum (RHOC) draait alles om topzorg en teamwork. Elke dag werken we samen om succesvolle operaties te realiseren en onze patiënten tevreden te stellen. Wil jij onderdeel worden van dit hechte en professionele team? Lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen als operatieassistent?

Als operatieassistent op de OK ben jij onmisbaar in het reilen en zeilen van orthopedische ingrepen. Van hand, pols, knie, voet, schouder, enkel, elleboog- en heupoperaties tot complexe revisies en peri prothetische fracturen. Je ondersteunt de orthopeden met voorbereidende, assisterende en instrumenterende taken. Jij zorgt ervoor dat alles van A tot Z soepel verloopt: van de voorbereiding van de OK tot en met het begeleiden van stagiaires.

Samenwerken staat voorop! Je hebt dagelijks nauw overleg met je OK-collega’s, orthopeden en de AIOS’en. Di geldt vooral bij de complexere ingrepen.

En de sfeer? Die is relaxed en collegiaal – we werken hard, maar er is altijd tijd voor een lach of een persoonlijk gesprek. In ons kleine, betrokken team van onder andere 24 operatieassistenten voel je je meteen thuis!

Benieuwd naar de sfeer op de OK? Check ons op Instagram: @ok.rhoc

Wat maakt het werken bij het RHOC uniek?

Het RHOC is hét centrum voor orthopedische zorg in Zuid-Holland, en wij onderscheiden ons door:

  • Focus op orthopedie: Van routine tot complexe ingrepen.
  • Innovatie & onderzoek: We werken voortdurend aan de zorg van morgen.
  • Persoonlijke aandacht: Patiënt én medewerker staan centraal.
  • Opleiden van topchirurgen: Het RHOC is het grootste opleidingscentrum voor orthopedisch chirurgen in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Salaris: Inschaling in FWG 55 (CAO Ziekenhuizen) afhankelijk van ervaring.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding + fiscale fietsregeling (ook elektrisch).
  • Vakantiedagen: 144 uur + 57 PLB-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband.
  • Extra's: 8,33% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.
  • Werkrooster: Dagdiensten van 9 uur, met voldoende rust- en aflostijd.
  • Altijd vrij: Feestdagen en weekenden zijn gegarandeerd vrij!
  • Werken in een hecht team: In een gespecialiseerd ziekenhuis waar topzorg en teamwork centraal staan.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Een afgerond diploma operatieassistent.
  • Interesse in orthopedie.
  • Communicatief sterk en een echte teamspeler.
  • Flexibel en stressbestendig.
  • Een proactieve houding – je draait actief mee op de OK.

Enthousiast geworden?

Solliciteer snel via de sollicitatiebutton. Let op: de vacature sluit zodra we genoeg geschikte kandidaten hebben. Wil je eerst sfeer proeven? Kom dan gerust een keer langs. Je kunt meelopen of gezellig kennismaken met een kop!

Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op met:

  • Saskia Hamelinck-van Bemmelen (Teamleider operatieassistenten en logistiek medewerkers) via 079-2065778.
  • Nancy Hellwig-Toussain (Manager OK) via 079-2065730.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

title: Development Officer
description:
Development Officer

Location: Washington, D.C.

Status: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Bobby Mann

Like to talk on the phone? Prefer a coffee meeting to another Zoom call? Enjoy getting to know people—and hearing the stories behind why they care about animals?

About the St. Hubert's Animal Welfare Center

For over 80 years, St. Hubert’s Animal Welfare Center has been dedicated to helping animals in need and serving communities across New Jersey. With a people-focused, community-based approach, St. Hubert’s treats every animal as an individual and emphasizes specialized care for both animals and their families. Built on a foundation of rescue and adoption, St. Hubert’s operates extensive community programs, including access to veterinary care, pet food support, training services, and the nation’s leading pet transport initiative, WayStation. As part of the Humane Rescue Alliance, headquartered in Washington, D.C., St. Hubert’s is connected to the largest and most comprehensive animal services provider network in the region, impacting the lives of tens of thousands of animals each year.

Job Summary

As a Development Officer at the Humane Rescue Alliance, you’ll spend your days building genuine relationships with people who want to make a difference for animals and the people who love them. You might meet a longtime donor for coffee and hear about their dog’s latest vet visit, give a prospective donor a tour of our campus, call a supporter to thank them for a recent gift, meet with a company about sponsoring an HRA event, or sit down with a donor to talk about making a larger gift.


You’ll manage a portfolio of approximately 120–150 donors, corporate partners, and prospective supporters, getting to know what matters to them and finding meaningful ways for them to connect with HRA’s work. You’ll build relationships over time, make thoughtful asks, bring donors closer to our mission, and help turn their generosity into lifesaving care.


This is a hands-on, relationship-driven fundraising role for someone who is naturally curious, organized, comfortable picking up the phone, and genuinely enjoys talking with people. You don’t have to have every conversation figured out in advance—you just need to know how to listen, build trust, follow through, and recognize when it’s time to ask.


The Role: What You’ll Do

Individual Giving & Portfolio Management

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of approximately 120–150 individual donors, corporate partners, and qualified prospects.
  • Develop personalized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies based on donor interests, capacity, and engagement.
  • Conduct regular donor meetings, calls, campus tours, cultivation visits, and other meaningful relationship-building activities.
  • Solicit significant philanthropic gifts and prepare written proposals or donor materials in partnership with internal teams when needed.
  • Identify opportunities to retain, upgrade, and deepen relationships with existing donors.
  • Qualify new prospects and build a strong pipeline of donors with the potential to increase their philanthropic support.
  • Identify principal or transformational gift opportunities and partner with the Chief Advancement Officer and CEO on strategy and solicitation.
  • Recognize potential planned giving opportunities and connect donors with appropriate resources when needed.

Corporate Philanthropy

  • Manage and grow assigned corporate philanthropic relationships.
  • Build relationships with corporate decision-makers and solicit charitable gifts, sponsorships, matching gifts, and other philanthropic support.
  • Secure sponsorships for major fundraising events and organizational initiatives.
  • Partner with Public Affairs and other departments when volunteer activities or community engagement are part of a broader corporate relationship, while maintaining responsibility for the fundraising relationship.

Stewardship & Collaboration

  • Create personalized stewardship experiences that demonstrate the impact of donor support.
  • Connect donors and prospects with HRA programs, staff, leadership, animals, and mission.
  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for assigned donors participating in events and cultivation opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Development Operations, Marketing and Communications, Public Affairs, program teams, and organizational leadership to advance donor relationships.
  • Maintain accurate and timely donor records, strategies, contact reports, solicitations, and next steps in the fundraising database.
  • Participate in regular portfolio reviews and use moves-management practices to advance donor relationships.

About You: Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong relationship-building, listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate, solicit, and steward significant donor or client relationships.
  • Ability to confidently make philanthropic asks and develop individualized relationship strategies.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Understanding of portfolio management, stewardship, moves management, and pipeline development.
  • Ability to identify donor capacity, engagement, and readiness for solicitation.
  • Experience with corporate philanthropy, sponsorships, or corporate relationship management strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with planned giving concepts preferred.
  • Experience using fundraising databases or CRM systems such as Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce, DonorPerfect, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments.
  • Passion for Humane Rescue Alliance’s mission.

Qualifications – Education & Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in fundraising, development, donor relations, sales, or another relationship-based revenue role.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of donors, prospects, clients, or other high-value relationships.
  • Demonstrated success securing significant philanthropic gifts, preferably at the$5,000+ level.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Experience in animal welfare or another mission-driven nonprofit environment preferred.

Where You’ll Work: Physical Requirements & Work Environment

This position is based at Humane Rescue Alliance’s Washington, D.C. campus and is designed to build philanthropic relationships throughout the Washington metropolitan region.

This is a location-based, relationship-focused role. Regular onsite presence is required to host donor meetings and tours, participate in cultivation and stewardship opportunities, engage donors with programs and staff, and build a strong understanding of the organization’s work.

After successful onboarding, demonstrated performance, and development of a strong understanding of the organization and portfolio, a hybrid work arrangement may be available based on organizational policy and the needs of the role. Regular onsite availability will remain required.

  • Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.
  • Limited regional travel may be required.
  • Regular use of computer, phone, and office equipment.
  • Must be comfortable working in proximity to cats, dogs, small animals, reptiles, fish, and wildlife.
  • May be exposed to deceased, fractious, or aggressive animals; allergens; zoonotic diseases; unpleasant odors, noises, or sights.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Apply today and help build the philanthropic relationships that sustain HRA’s work for animals and the people who love them.

Multilingual candidates are encouraged to apply. A salary premium may be offered for multilingual candidates who demonstrate proficiency in written and oral testing.

HRA is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals requiring them.

title: Mobile DOT Inspection Technician (2131)
description:
Join Us as a DOT Inspection Technician!

About Kooner Fleet Management Solutions

Kooner Fleet Management Solutions is one of the fastest-growing national providers of on-site fleet maintenance, preventative service, and mobile repair solutions. With nearly a decade of industry experience, Kooner FMS helps fleets reduce downtime, extend vehicle life, and simplify operations through proactive maintenance programs and advanced technology.

Schedule(s):

Sunday-Thursday, 12:00AM - 9:00AM

Tuesday-Saturday, 9:00AM - 6:00PM

Why You’ll Love Joining Our Team

  • Earn What You Deserve: Competitive pay starting at $20-25/hr. based on experience.
  • Weekly Paydays: Get paid every Friday – no waiting around!
  • Take the Wheel: Enjoy a fully equipped company-provided service vehicle you can take home.
  • Geared Up and Ready: We provide the tools and equipment you need to get the job done right.
  • Fueled for Success: Enjoy a company-paid fuel card so you never pay out-of-pocket at the pump.
  • Stay Connected: Cell phone allowance included.
  • Invest in Your Future: 401(k) with company match.
  • Health Benefits that Kick in Fast: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage after just 30 Days!
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy paid vacation time, paid sick time, and paid holidays to rest, recharge, and take care of what matters most.
  • We’ve Got You Covered: Life & Disability Insurance for added peace of mind – because we take care of our team on and off the job.
  • We’re Here for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program for support when you need it most – we've got your back.
  • Bring a Friend, Get Rewarded: Refer great talent and earn $500 per successful hire – no limits on how many bonuses you can earn!
  • Grow With Us: Big Career Growth Opportunities in a rapidly expanding, forward-thinking organization.

About the DOT Inspection Technician Role

As a DOT Inspection Technician, you’ll be the trusted technician our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for entry-level technicians or recent tech school grads who are looking for an opportunity to launch their career in the fleet maintenance industry. In this role, you'll be responsible for performing DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, ensuring vehicles meet federal safety and compliance standards.

Geared up with a fully equipped, company-provided service vehicle and a supportive team that values your skill, drive and dedication, you'll take pride in delivering thorough, accurate, and reliable inspections that keep America moving.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

  • Perform onsite DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers in a mobile field environment.
  • Perform tire changes and replacements on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers as needed, including safely removing and installing tire and wheel assemblies.
  • Respond to dispatch requests for scheduled and unscheduled DOT inspections and tire replacements.
  • Use inspection tools and equipment — including tread depth gauges, brake stroke gauges, and other diagnostic aids — to accurately assess vehicle condition against DOT standards.
  • Clearly and accurately document inspection findings, flag out-of-service items, and recommend additional repairs to advanced technicians for follow-up as needed.
  • Stay productive and efficient, meeting or beating industry-standard inspection times.
  • Take ownership of a company-issued service vehicle, perform maintenance and pre- and post-trip inspections, and ensure safety compliance.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Diesel, automotive, or heavy-duty vehicle technical training (technical school, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on experience) preferred.
  • Familiarity with DOT inspection standards and out-of-service criteria, or willingness to learn.
  • Strong communication skills – you know how to connect and communicate with customers and drivers alike.
  • Comfortable using mobile apps, navigation systems and digital tools to stay organized and document repairs.
  • Ready for the outdoors – rain or shine at customer yards.
  • Independent, dependable, and self-motivated – you take pride in getting the job done right.
  • A positive attitude and safety-first mindset.
  • Must be at least 20 years old with a clean driving record and a valid driver’s license.

Work Environment

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.
  • Expect exposure to dust, diesel fumes, and noise typical of a shop or yard environment.
  • Safely handle chemicals, oils, and grease as part of repair work.
  • Be ready to lift, move, and position heavy equipment or components.

description:
Join Us as a DOT Inspection Technician!

About Kooner Fleet Management Solutions

Kooner Fleet Management Solutions is one of the fastest-growing national providers of on-site fleet maintenance, preventative service, and mobile repair solutions. With nearly a decade of industry experience, Kooner FMS helps fleets reduce downtime, extend vehicle life, and simplify operations through proactive maintenance programs and advanced technology.

As a family-founded and field-first company, we take pride in delivering trusted partnerships, exceptional service, and innovative fleet management solutions that keep America’s trucks and trailers road-ready.

About the DOT Inspection Technician Role

As a DOT Inspection Technician, you’ll be the trusted technician our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for entry-level technicians or recent tech school grads who are looking for an opportunity to launch their career in the fleet maintenance industry. In this role, you'll be responsible for performing DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, ensuring vehicles meet federal safety and compliance standards.

Geared up with a fully equipped, company-provided service vehicle and a supportive team that values your skill, drive and dedication, you'll take pride in delivering thorough, accurate, and reliable inspections that keep America moving.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

  • Perform onsite DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers in a mobile field environment.
  • Perform tire changes and replacements on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers as needed, including safely removing and installing tire and wheel assemblies.
  • Respond to dispatch requests for scheduled and unscheduled DOT inspections and tire replacements.
  • Use inspection tools and equipment — including tread depth gauges, brake stroke gauges, and other diagnostic aids — to accurately assess vehicle condition against DOT standards.
  • Clearly and accurately document inspection findings, flag out-of-service items, and recommend additional repairs to advanced technicians for follow-up as needed.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Familiarity with DOT inspection standards and out-of-service criteria, or willingness to learn.
  • Strong communication skills – you know how to connect and communicate with customers and drivers alike.
  • Comfortable using mobile apps, navigation systems and digital tools to stay organized and document repairs.
  • Ready for the outdoors – rain or shine at customer yards.
  • Independent, dependable, and self-motivated – you take pride in getting the job done right.
  • A positive attitude and safety-first mindset.
  • Must be at least 20 years old with a clean driving record and a valid driver’s license.

Work Environment

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.
  • Expect exposure to dust, diesel fumes, and noise typical of a shop or yard environment.
  • Safely handle chemicals, oils, and grease as part of repair work.
  • Be ready to lift, move, and position heavy equipment or components.
  • Stay active – you'll bend, kneel, crawl, and crouch to access vehicle components.
  • Work outdoors in all weather conditions – rain or shine, our team gets it done.

title: Psycholoog in opleiding tot GZ-psycholoog
description:
Functie

Wij bieden per 1 januari 2027 een uitdagende opleidingsplek voor een psycholoog in opleiding tot GZ-psycholoog (PIOG) binnen de afdeling Psychiatrie van het Radboudumc.

Binnen de dynamische omgeving van het Radboudumc werk je op de afdeling Psychiatrie binnen de zorg voor volwassenen en ouderen (18-95+ jaar), binnen de zorglijn Impulsregulatie (met name ASS, ADHD en verslaving) of binnen de zorglijn Stressregulatie (met name depressie). Daarnaast bestaat de mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen binnen andere onderdelen van de afdeling, zoals de Psychiatrische Universiteitskliniek (PUK), de consultatieve dienst en/of het Centrum voor Mindfulness.

Binnen de afdeling Psychiatrie neem je deel aan de ochtendoverdracht, het vakgroepoverleg en de Grand Round (wetenschap). Daarnaast neem je deel aan het multidisciplinair overleg en het beleidsoverleg binnen de zorglijn waarin je werkzaam bent. Naast patiëntenzorg kun je ook participeren in het verzorgen van onderwijs en in ontwikkel- en innovatietrajecten.

Een bijzonder onderdeel van deze opleidingsplek is een verwachte uitwisseling van één jaar naar een samenwerkingspartner binnen het regionale samenwerkingsverband, zoals Pro Persona. Door de onrust rondom de toewijzingsprocedure dit jaar is dit nog niet volledig zeker en is ook nog niet bekend op welke afdeling van Pro Persona je geplaatst zult worden. Mocht een uitwisseling binnen het samenwerkingsverband niet mogelijk blijken, dan vindt in het tweede opleidingsjaar een uitwisseling plaats naar de afdeling Medische Psychologie van het Radboudumc.

De afdeling Medische Psychologie biedt zorg aan mensen met complexe problematiek, waarbij lichamelijke klachten, medische behandelingen en psychologische factoren, gedachten, emoties en gedrag elkaar beïnvloeden. Vanuit de afdeling Medische Psychologie ben je werkzaam in de patiëntenzorg voor diverse klinische afdelingen. Een belangrijk deel van je werkzaamheden vindt plaats binnen de transgenderzorg, een dynamisch en groeiend zorggebied waarin je intensief samenwerkt met artsen en andere professionals om de best mogelijke persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden.

Als PIOG neem je deel aan multidisciplinaire overleggen. Binnen de afdeling Medische Psychologie neem je daarnaast deel aan patiëntbesprekingen, sectieoverleggen en afdelingsoverleggen.

Jouw werkplek

De afdeling Psychiatrie levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan patiëntenzorg, wetenschappelijk onderzoek, opleiding en onderwijs binnen de vakgebieden psychiatrie en psychologie. De afdeling heeft een sterke opleidingscultuur en verzorgt onder meer de opleidingen tot psychiater, verpleegkundig specialist en verschillende psychologische vervolgopleidingen, waaronder de opleiding tot GZ-psycholoog en klinisch (neuro)psycholoog.

De afdeling Psychiatrie richt zich op hoogspecialistische zorg, waarbij zowel aandacht is voor de mechanistische basis van psychiatrische aandoeningen gedurende de levensloop als voor de invloed van psychologische en psychosociale factoren. We behandelen complexe patiënten met moeilijk behandelbare depressieve stoornissen, ontwikkelingsstoornissen, impulsregulatieproblemen en verslavingsproblematiek, vaak in combinatie met psychiatrische en somatische comorbiditeit.

Je werkt samen met psychiaters, klinisch (neuro)psychologen, GZ-psychologen, verpleegkundig specialisten, verpleegkundigen, maatschappelijk werkers en vaktherapeuten aan diagnostiek en behandeling in verschillende zorgsettingen. De samenwerking is laagdrempelig, intensief en stimulerend en draagt bij aan de optimale ontwikkeling van onze patiënten, collega's, opleidelingen en het vakgebied.

Pro Persona biedt specialistische geestelijke gezondheidszorg en basis-ggz aan volwassenen en ouderen in de regio Gelderland-Midden en Gelderland-Zuid. Het gaat om patiënten met uiteenlopende psychische problematiek, zoals depressie, PTSS, angst- en persoonlijkheidsstoornissen, vaak na eerdere behandelingen die onvoldoende resultaat hebben opgeleverd. Daarnaast biedt Pro Persona forensische zorg via de behandelkliniek van de Pompestichting.

De afdeling Medische Psychologie is een academische afdeling met een belangrijke rol in patiëntenzorg, wetenschappelijk onderzoek, onderwijs en opleiding. De afdeling verleent psychologische zorg aan patiënten van diverse medische specialismen, verricht wetenschappelijk onderzoek binnen verschillende onderzoeksprogramma's, verzorgt onderwijs binnen de opleidingen Geneeskunde, Tandheelkunde, Biomedische Wetenschappen en verpleegkundige vervolgopleidingen en leidt gezondheidszorg- en klinisch (neuro)psychologen op.

De afdeling Medische Psychologie bestaat uit de secties Volwassenen en Ouderen en Kind en Jeugd. We richten ons op de ontwikkeling, toepassing en overdracht van medisch (neuro)psychologische kennis over het gedrag van patiënten met (chronische) lichamelijke aandoeningen en over de communicatie tussen behandelaar en patiënt.

Binnen de sectie Volwassenen en Ouderen werk je samen in een multidisciplinair team van klinisch (neuro)psychologen, GZ-psychologen, GZ-psychologen in opleiding, psychologisch medewerkers en medisch maatschappelijk werkers. De patiëntenzorg wordt geleverd aan meer dan 27 medische afdelingen en diverse centra binnen het Radboudumc.

Onze werkomgeving kenmerkt zich door een grote mate van zelfstandigheid, gecombineerd met intensieve samenwerking met andere professionals. Daarbij kun je altijd terugvallen op een deskundig en betrokken team. Twee keer per week vindt een patiëntbespreking plaats en maandelijks wordt een intervisiebijeenkomst georganiseerd. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is collegiaal en laagdrempelig; zo lunchen collega's dagelijks gezamenlijk.

Profiel

Wij zoeken een ambitieuze collega die goed kan samenwerken, flexibel is en stressbestendig te werk gaat. Je kiest bewust voor het academische werkveld en bent bereid nét dat stapje extra te zetten voor de patiënt.

Je hebt affiniteit met complexe diagnostiek en behandeling en bent geïnteresseerd in de verbinding tussen patiëntenzorg, onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek. Net als wij streef je naar de hoogste kwaliteit van zorg en onderwijs en werk je graag volgens de nieuwste academische inzichten.

Je beschikt over een goed reflectief vermogen, staat open voor feedback en bent gemotiveerd om jezelf zowel persoonlijk als professioneel verder te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast kun je zelfstandig werken, neem je initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen leerproces.

Goed om te weten

  • Volgens het tijdpad voor de toewijzing van GZ-opleidingsplaatsen 2027 zijn de praktijkopleidingsinstellingen op 28 augustus 2026 geïnformeerd over het definitieve toewijzingsvoorstel. Op verzoek van het ministerie van VWS is deze bekendmaking eerder uitgesteld totdat de definitieve instroomaantallen waren vastgesteld en de Tweede Kamer hierover was geïnformeerd. Hierdoor is onduidelijkheid ontstaan over de vraag of de toegewezen opleidingsplaatsen daadwerkelijk definitief zijn. Naar verwachting wordt hierover eind september meer duidelijkheid gegeven. Totdat de definitieve subsidietoewijzing bekend is, kan de selectie uitsluitend plaatsvinden onder voorbehoud van subsidietoekenning. Pas na de definitieve subsidietoewijzing wordt bovendien duidelijk of deze opleidingsplaats daadwerkelijk een uitwisselingsplaats met Pro Persona omvat.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 24 september 2026. De tweede sollicitatiegesprekken op 28 september 2026. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Data Analyst 12 Month FTC
description:
As a Data Analyst within the Business Development team, you will play a key role in turning data into meaningful commercial insight. You will be responsible for analysing and managing complex datasets, enhancing reporting processes and developing more efficient and automated ways of working to support informed strategic decision-making.


Working closely with stakeholders across Business Development, Operations and Planning, you will help identify trends, opportunities and efficiencies that can contribute to the firm’s wider growth objectives. You will also play an important role in translating business requirements into practical reporting solutions and ensuring that data is presented clearly and effectively.

This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical and commercially minded data professional who enjoys working with complex information, improving processes and using data to solve business challenges.


Key Responsibilities


  • Gather, consolidate and manage data from multiple sources, ensuring a high level of accuracy, consistency and reliability.
  • Work closely with Business Development, Operations and Planning teams to understand reporting, analytics and process requirements.
  • Analyse complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and efficiencies that support business and strategic decision-making.
  • Work with stakeholders to identify appropriate data sources and establish clear reporting requirements, workflows and processes.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, practical and user-friendly reporting solutions.
  • Develop and improve processes to automate reporting, reduce manual activity and increase efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Data Visualisation Designers and Analysts to define data requirements and ensure reporting solutions meet business needs.
  • Develop meaningful reports, dashboards and analysis that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insight.
  • Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Investigate data issues, inconsistencies and anomalies, undertaking detailed analysis or data forensics where required.
  • Support the development of efficient, repeatable and automated reporting processes across the function.
  • Maintain high standards of data quality, integrity and governance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality, efficiency and commercial value of data and reporting.
  • Keep up to date with developments in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting technologies and best practice.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, using data to enhance decision-making and operational effectiveness.


Skills & Experience


We are looking for a data-focused, analytical and commercially aware professional who can work confidently with complex datasets while understanding the wider business context behind the numbers.


You will ideally have:


  • Strong experience using data analysis and business intelligence tools such as Excel, SQL, Python, R, Power BI and/or Tableau.
  • Proven experience collecting, cleansing, analysing and managing data from multiple sources.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear and actionable insights.
  • Experience working with reporting processes, data workflows and process mapping.
  • Experience investigating data discrepancies, anomalies and quality issues.
  • The ability to work confidently with both structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Experience translating business requirements into reporting, analytics or data solutions.
  • Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • An understanding of data visualisation principles and experience working alongside dashboard developers or data visualisation specialists.


The Opportunity


  • This role would suit someone who enjoys being more than a reporting analyst. You will have the opportunity to influence how data is collected, managed, analysed and presented across the Business Development function, helping the firm make better decisions through accurate, accessible and commercially relevant insight.

title: CMM Inspector (Night Shift) - 3 Day Weekends!
description:
We're seeking a detail-driven CMM Quality Inspector to join our growing aerospace manufacturing team. In this role, you'll inspect precision-machined aerospace components using CMMs, vision systems, and manual inspection equipment to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, customer requirements, and industry quality standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with quality inspection experience who enjoys problem-solving, working independently, and contributing to a culture built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.


Shift: Night Shift, 3:00 PM - 1:30 AM (Monday - Thursday)

Overtime: Fridays & Saturdays as needed


Key Responsibilities


CMM & Inspection Activities

  • Set up and operate Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMMs) for in-process, first article, first piece, and final inspections

  • Perform dimensional and visual inspections on machined metal, plastic, and aerospace components

  • Utilize inspection equipment including:

    • CMMs

    • Vision Inspection Systems

    • Micrometers

    • Calipers

    • Height Gauges

    • Gauge Pins

    • Verniers

    • Fixtures and hand gauging equipment

  • Complete close-tolerance inspections using GD&T principles

  • Interpret customer drawings, 3D models, specifications, and engineering documentation


Quality Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain inspection records and quality documentation

  • Complete AS9102 First Article Inspection Reports (FAIRs) as required

  • Document inspection results, nonconformances, and corrective actions

  • Complete production routers, inspection methods sheets, and certification reviews

  • Ensure all documentation is accurate and audit-ready


Quality Assurance & Team Collaboration

  • Identify nonconforming products and support root cause investigations

  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to resolve issues

  • Assist with inspection planning, engineering markups, and inspection strategies

  • Ensure compliance with customer requirements and aerospace quality standards

  • Meet quality and productivity expectations while maintaining attention to detail



What You’ll Bring


Knowledge & Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in quality inspection, manufacturing inspection, metrology, or CMM inspection

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications

  • Experience using precision measuring instruments

  • Basic understanding of GD&T

  • Strong computer skills and comfort working with inspection software and electronic documentation

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to provide direct, respectful feedback

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently with minimal supervision


Preferred Qualifications

  • Aerospace manufacturing experience

  • AS9100 and/or AS9102 experience

  • Experience as a Quality Inspector, CMM Inspector, DQR, or Metrology Technician

  • CMM programming experience (PC-DMIS, Calypso, or similar software)

  • Experience inspecting complex, tight-tolerance machined components

  • Associate degree or technical training in manufacturing, engineering, quality, or related field

  • CNC machining or manufacturing support experience

  • Process improvement or continuous improvement experience


We're looking for someone who:


  • Listens and communicates effectively

  • Balances direct communication with professionalism and compassion

  • Takes notes and learns quickly

  • Picks up new processes with ease

  • Doesn't require micromanagement

  • Stays productive and engaged

  • Supports a positive team culture


If you're passionate about CMM inspection, quality control, precision measurement, GD&T, aerospace manufacturing, metrology, and continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply today.


Join a team where quality matters, your expertise is valued, and your work helps support critical aerospace programs. Apply now!

The company is also an active contributor to a variety of housing and education causes, and in 2023, Guardian was named the Top Philanthropic organization for medium-size companies in its headquarters region. CLASIFICATION: Annual full-time, exempt
