Position Summary


The Tony-Award winning Berkeley Repertory Theatre seeks a Head of Wardrobe and Wigs to be a key member of Berkeley Rep’s costumes department. The Head of Wardrobe and Wigs is responsible for the oversight of the wardrobe, wigs/hair and makeup crew before, during, and after the run of all seven mainstage productions and special events at Berkeley Rep. The Head of Wardrobe and Wigs is a key liaison between Costume designers, Wig Designers, the costume shop, and performers. The Head of Wardrobe and Wigs works closely with other production departments, visiting actors, designers, and artistic staff and must demonstrate exceptional interpersonal skills. Berkeley Rep’s Head of Wardrobe and Wigs is a leader and technician committed to the artistic vision and mission of Berkeley Rep and will help advance Berkeley Rep’s commitment to Antiracism, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, and Access.


Essential Duties

  • Provide leadership, supervision, coaching and mentorship for wardrobe, wig, and hair make up crews. Conduct annual performance reviews for these positions.
  • Hire wardrobe and wig, hair, and makeup crew for all shows during the season.
  • Supervise and train the Associate Wardrobe Supervisor, wardrobe and wig, hair, and makeup crews, helping choreograph quick changes as needed.
  • Hire, train, and supervise swings for wardrobe and wig, hair, and makeup crews
  • Inform Stage Management and Stage Operations of the need for quick change booths, booth locations, and collaborate to find solutions when space needs are a challenge between departments.
  • Assign tracks according to the needs of the costume plot and scene breakdown; run tracks as needed.
  • Partner with Stage Management and the Costume Director to create dressing lists, check-in sheets, run sheets, and preset lists.
  • Maintain the original costume and wig designs of the show from opening to closing.
  • Coach and model professional behavior in all areas of the theater, especially backstage and in dressing room areas.
  • Set weekly schedules for all wardrobe and wig, hair, and makeup crew in a timely manner and in compliance with California labor laws. Approve timesheets in Paylocity bi-weekly and track overhire labor lines against the budget. Communicate staffing needs and overages to the Costume Director.
  • In tech rehearsals, maintain a high level of active communication and coordination between the Costume Director, shop, design team, Stage Management, and run crew in relation to which pieces to pull for shop notes, and their return to tech.
  • Attend Meet and Greets and Designer Runs with wardrobe and wig, hair, and makeup crew.
  • Organize wardrobe prep for shows prior to tech.
  • Lead check-in and load-out of costume pieces from the costume shop to the theater with the help of the wardrobe crew.
  • Attend nightly production meetings during tech rehearsals.
  • Pull, inventory, and pack costumes for transport to the costume shop for notes during tech and previews.
  • Attend put-in and understudy rehearsals as needed.
  • Organize costumes for and attend all photo calls, as requested.
  • Follow equity guidelines regarding costumes, hair, and makeup. Maintain and organize wardrobe and wig supplies and spaces, including restocking and ordering supplies in a timely manner.
  • Supervise the daily care of costumes including repair, laundering, steaming, and ironing costume pieces. Schedule and coordinate dry-cleaning pickup and delivery when needed.
  • Supervise the daily care of shoes and accessories, including repairing and cleaning.
  • Schedule maintenance haircuts, hair care, and styling appointments for actors from opening to closing.
  • Reconcile the departmental company credit card monthly as directed by the finance department.
  • Ensure wardrobe areas, backstage changing areas, and dressing rooms are clean, organized, and safe.
  • Organize and supervise the strike of costumes and wigs, including packing costumes and wigs for shipment to other theaters, producers, and wig designers.
  • Actively participate in workshops and trainings, including company meetings, harassment prevention, bystander intervention, and all other antiracism, equity, diversity, inclusion, and access initiatives.
  • All other duties as assigned.

title: Associate Scientist/Scientist Cell-Based Assays & In Vivo Oncology (Temporary to direct)
description:
About Us

Aragen Bioscience is a leading contract research organization focused on accelerating product development. Aragen’s offerings include pre-clinical efficacy studies and cell-based assays as well as antibody discovery, recombinant protein production, and purification and stable cell line development. We offer clients high quality service and superior R&D partnerships.


Job Title

Associate Scientist – Cell-Based Assays & In Vivo Oncology (temporary to direct)

We are seeking an Associate Scientist/Scientist with strong hands-on proficiency in cell-based assay development and execution, together with demonstrated experience managing in vivo tumor models. The successful candidate will work under the direction of a director.

Essential Functions

The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, execution, and troubleshooting of cell-based assays and for the day-to-day management of in vivo tumor efficacy studies supporting preclinical oncology programs. The candidate will be an innovative, independent and motivated professional. Cell-based assay responsibilities include development, qualification, and routine execution of viability, proliferation, cytotoxicity, ADCC/CDC, reporter, and target-engagement assays; maintenance of primary and immortalized cell cultures and cell banks; ELISA/MSD, Western blot/JESS, flow cytometry, and quantitative PCR; and inventory and tracking of samples generated by preclinical projects.

In vivo responsibilities include tumor cell preparation, management of xenograft and syngeneic tumor models (including tumor measurement and body-weight monitoring, dosing by multiple routes [IP, IV, PO, SC], randomization and study scheduling, terminal procedures, and tissue and blood collection for downstream analysis). The candidate will maintain accurate study records, support IACUC protocol preparation and amendments, and work in full compliance with applicable animal welfare regulations. The candidate will have experience with troubleshooting assays and should be capable of data analysis, data presentation, managing multiple projects and interested in learning new areas of research. In vitro and cell-based assay responsibilities will constitute ~80% of effort, and in vivo pharmacology 20%.

title: Ondersteunend begeleider Spaarnevleugels (28-36 uur)
description:
Wil jij werken in een fijn team met een bijzondere doelgroep en bijdragen aan een veilige en herstelgerichte woonomgeving? Voor onze forensische 24-uurs woonvoorziening Spaarnevleugels in Hoofddorp zoeken wij een stevige en betrokken ondersteunend begeleider.

Jouw rol
Spaarnevleugels is een ontwikkelgerichte woonlocatie waar bewoners werken aan een zo zelfstandig mogelijk leven. Als begeleider ondersteun je hen stap voor stap bij het behalen van hun doelen.

Samen met een persoonlijk begeleider begeleid je een vaste groep bewoners. Met iedere bewoner stel je een begeleidingsplan op, waarbij je kijkt naar iemands wensen, mogelijkheden en krachten. Daarbij houd je ook rekening met de doelen en aandachtspunten uit de risicoanalyse van de reclassering.

Je ondersteunt bewoners bij hun dagelijkse activiteiten, helpt hen structuur aan te brengen en gaat waar nodig mee naar afspraken. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de locatie, bewaakt de rust, signaleert bijzonderheden en rapporteert hierover. Daarbij stimuleer je bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf de regie te nemen en zelfstandig keuzes te maken.

Op Spaarnevleugels werken we aan een positief woon- en werkklimaat. We geloven in de kracht en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van iedere bewoner, ook als iemand een justitiële achtergrond heeft of gedrag laat zien dat uitdagend kan zijn. We zorgen voor een omgeving waarin bewoners zich gezien, gehoord en veilig voelen en de ruimte krijgen om zich verder te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd creëren we voor medewerkers een veilige werkomgeving waarin vertrouwen, samenwerking en eigen verantwoordelijkheid centraal staan.

Locatie
Spaarnevleugels is een 24-uursvoorziening in de gemeente Haarlemmermeer. De locatie biedt plaats aan 35 bewoners met psychiatrische en forensische problematiek. Voor het merendeel van de bewoners is de zorg door de rechter opgelegd als onderdeel van een straf of maatregel. Op de locatie zijn harddrugs niet toegestaan. Het doel van de begeleiding is herstel en ontwikkeling richting een passende, zo zelfstandig mogelijke woonplek. Hiermee dragen we bij aan succesvolle resocialisatie en het voorkomen van terugval.

Je komt terecht in een betrokken team bestaande uit een teammanager, persoonlijk begeleiders, ondersteunend begeleiders, zorgcoördinatoren en een administratief medewerker. Je werkt volgens een 7-daags rooster dat in overleg met jou wordt gemaakt. Je werktijden liggen tussen 7.30 uur en 23.00 uur. (ook op feestdagen)

Wil je meer weten over de locatie? Bekijk de locatiepagina op onze website.

Jouw profiel
Je bent iemand die met frisse energie aan de slag gaat en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt! Je weet waar je kracht ligt én waar je hulp bij moet vragen. Je hebt een open houding, bent verantwoordelijk en maakt makkelijk contact. Je bent stressbestendig en staat stevig in je schoenen. Ook in crisissituaties blijf je rustig en handel je professioneel. Je zorgt voor een goede overdracht en rapporteert zorgvuldig, zodat jij en je collega’s altijd goed op elkaar kunnen aansluiten. Herken jij jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

  • Je hebt een opleiding afgerond op mbo-3 niveau in een agogische richting;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met de doelgroep of ervaringskennis die aansluit bij de doelgroep;
  • Je bezit een groot inlevingsvermogen en gebruikt dit als ingang bij het maken van contact met verschillende type mensen;
  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken en neemt graag initiatief;
  • Je bent flexibel en kunt meebewegen als dingen anders lopen dan gepland;
  • Ervaring binnen de forensische zorg of met forensische cliënten is een pre.

    Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

    • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
    • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
    • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 2.635,- en maximaal € 3.906,- bruto per maand (schaal 5, CAO Sociaal Werk) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Per 1 oktober 2026 worden de salarissen conform de CAO Sociaal Werk verhoogd met 2,1%. Dit is exclusief een arbeidsmarkttoeslag van 1,13%;
    • Een 2e klas mobiliteitskaart voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen met OV of gebruik van OV-fiets;
    • Je ontvangt bij een 36-urige werkweek minimaal 24 verlofdagen per jaar. Door feestdagencompensatie en vitaliteitsverlof kan dit oplopen tot ongeveer 30 verlofdagen. Daarnaast kun je via je IKB extra verlofuren kopen;
    • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO Sociaal Werk. Zo krijg je een individueel keuze budget van 17,07%. Hierin zitten onder andere vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering. Ook bouw je maandelijks een loopbaanbudget van 1,5% op.
    • We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van € 100,-;
    • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure. Tijdens de onboarding vragen we je om een online competentievragenlijst in te vullen;
    • Met een interactief onboardingprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

    HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

    Meer informatie?
    Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Xander Tak, zorgcoördinator via 06-23918365. Als je vragen hebt over de procedure, kun je bellen met junior recruiter Sana Pinto Silva via 06-15365021.

title: Tire Technician
description:
To be a team member of the Driven by Dobbs family, you must be dedicated to supporting the company’s mission, vision, and values.

OUR MISSION:

To be the leader in the automotive tire and service aftermarket industry in every market that we operate in providing premier service to our guests.

POSITION TITLE: Tire Technician

CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Driven by Dobbs, our family of brands brings together Dobbs Tire and Auto Centers—founded in 1976 in South St. Louis, MO as a family-owned complete auto care provider—and Conrad’s Tire Express & Total Car Care, founded in 1969 in Cleveland, OH. Together, we have grown into a rapidly expanding, multi-market automotive service organization that will operate across eight states in 2026, with continued growth on the horizon. Across all locations, customers can expect a full selection of quality tire brands and comprehensive automotive services, ranging from routine maintenance to advanced diagnostics and engine repair. Our investment in training, development, safety, and overall team wellbeing empowers our people to deliver exceptional service every day. Rooted in a culture that extends beyond the shop, we proudly support local organizations and charities in the communities where our teams live and work.

We are seeking a Tire Technician to handle everything from mounting, balancing, and rotating tires to repairing flats and performing minor vehicle maintenance. This position also helps with inventory, inspect tire casings, and keeping the shop clean and organized. The ideal candidate will be detailed driven, accountable, customer centric and a team player with a strong work ethic to contribute to the department goals and achieve results.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Mount and dismount tires; inspect damaged, defective, or flat tires to determine repair feasibility.
  • Perform tire repairs, balancing, and rotation on a variety of vehicles.
  • Conduct minor automotive maintenance including oil changes, lubrication, and accessory replacement.
  • Maintain cleanliness of work areas, tools, and equipment using approved methods and solvents.
  • Drive customer vehicles into and out of the service bay and provide shuttle service when needed.
  • Receive, inventory, and properly store tires based on size and type; stack and organize storage areas accordingly.
  • Inspect tire casings and accurately categorize them as reusable or scrap.
  • Deliver tires to other service locations as needed and complete additional tasks or assignments as directed.

SUCCESS FACTORS:

  • Strong work ethic with a commitment to results.
  • Strong team player with the ability to adapt to diverse team members.
  • Ability to perform in a fast paced/high volume environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A high level of time management, accountability, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to be organized, problem solve and be solution oriented.
  • Self-motivated, goal- oriented, and driven to accomplish department goals.
  • Strong critical thinker with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Highly-customer centric and master relationship builder.
  • Maintains a professional, can-do approach even in physically demanding or fast-paced situations.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Fast-paced automotive service environment.
  • Frequentexposure to varying temperatures due to the nature of the work and shop conditions.
  • Regular contact with automotive chemicals, including solvents, lubricants, and fluids used in vehicle maintenance and repair.
  • Extended periods of standing, bending, and lifting tires or equipment.
  • Requires adherence to all safety procedures and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Involves teamwork, reliability, and effective communication to maintain a safe and efficient workplace.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality service are essential for success.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Valid Drivers’ License Required.

title: Scientist / Sr Scientist
description:
About Aragen Bioscience

Aragen Bioscience is a leading contract research organization (CRO) dedicated to accelerating biologics discovery and development. Our capabilities span antibody discovery, protein engineering, cell line development, process development, and analytical characterization. We partner with emerging biotechnology companies and global pharmaceutical organizations to advance innovative therapies from concept to clinic.

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist/Senior Scientist, Protein Sciences & Biologics Development to lead client programs, mentor scientific staff, and drive the development of next-generation biologic therapeutics. This is a hands-on scientific leadership role combining technical excellence, client engagement, and people leadership in a fast-paced CRO environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Scientist will serve as a technical lead for client-sponsored biologics programs, overseeing activities from molecular design and protein engineering through expression, purification, characterization, and technology transfer. The successful candidate will provide scientific leadership to project teams, contribute to business growth through exceptional client delivery, and coach junior scientists while maintaining hands-on laboratory involvement.

This position requires extensive experience in protein sciences, molecular biology, protein engineering, and downstream process development, together with a demonstrated ability to lead multiple client programs simultaneously. Due to the time-sensitive nature of projects and critical experimental workflows, occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership & Client Delivery

  • Lead and manage client-sponsored biologics development programs from concept through deliverable completion.
  • Serve as the primary scientific contact for assigned clients, providing technical guidance, project updates, risk assessment, and strategic recommendations.
  • Present scientific data, project milestones, and development strategies to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor and develop scientists, research associates, and junior team members through technical coaching and career development support.
  • Drive project execution to ensure delivery of high-quality data packages, reports, and client deliverables within established timelines.
  • Author and review technical reports, SOPs, study protocols, technical transfer documentation, and regulatory-supporting data packages.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve complex scientific and operational challenges.
  • Contribute to department innovation, workflow improvements, and scientific best practices.

Biologics Discovery & Molecular Biology

  • Design and optimize expression constructs and mammalian expression vectors for recombinant protein production.
  • Utilize AI-enabled and computational tools to support protein engineering, sequence optimization, structural prediction, and developability assessments.
  • Perform and oversee molecular biology workflows including:
    • Gibson Assembly
    • Restriction enzyme cloning
    • Site-directed mutagenesis
    • Plasmid characterization
    • Sequence verification
  • Lead RNA and DNA analytical workflows, including qPCR and RT-qPCR applications.
  • Apply bioinformatics tools for sequence analysis, codon optimization, construct design, and genetic engineering strategies.

Protein Engineering & Developability

  • Lead protein engineering, sequence optimization, and developability assessments for therapeutic proteins.
  • Evaluate protein stability, aggregation propensity, solubility, manufacturability, and biophysical properties.
  • Support antibody engineering, Mult specific formats, fusion proteins, cytokines, protein scaffolds, and other next-generation biologic modalities.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop strategies for candidate optimization and risk mitigation.

Protein Expression & Purification

  • Design, execute, and optimize recombinant protein expression workflows.
  • Lead hands-on downstream purification activities utilizing automated FPLC systems such as ÄKTA Avant and ÄKTA Pure.
  • Develop and optimize purification processes using:
    • Affinity Chromatography
    • Ion Exchange Chromatography (IEX)
    • Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC)
    • Hydrophobic Interaction Chromatography (HIC)
  • Support process development and scale-up activities including:
    • Depth filtration
    • Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF)
    • Ultrafiltration/Diafiltration (UF/DF)
  • Troubleshoot complex purification and expression challenges independently.

title: AT - Director of Training & Quality Assurance
description:
Job Summary

The Director of Training & Quality Assurance is the subject matter expert on all matters related to the CDL program for Ancora Training. This person is responsible for quality control of a best-in-class CDL program that adheres to all Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) and state regulatory agency regulations and will develop and assist in the training of CDL Regional Program Directors, Area Managers, Program Directors, Lead Driver Trainers, and Driver Trainers on best practices and policies to run an efficient CDL program. This position will help drive fleet management to ensure profitable, safe programs system-wide. This person will work closely with the Admissions and Business Development teams, cross-functional support teams, and division senior leadership to set training standards and functional implementation. This role will address programs and/or staff identified as performing substandardly by implementing steps that lead to development and accountability to achieve sustained high outcomes that meet program objectives. The Director of Training & Quality Assurance applies expertise in sectors of transportation, training, regulations, and the market to identify growth opportunities and business risks to enhance company revenue.



Key Responsibilities

  • Work in conjunction with Regional Program Directors, Area managers, and program support teams to onboard and train new CDL instructional teams and directors on programs and curriculum.

  • Ensure all instructional staff and leaders across all CDL client platforms have completed the required onboarding course in the company’s Learning Management System, and assign additional courses as needed/applicable based on skills and abilities.

  • Ensure curriculum is consistent across all client platforms leveraging the resources that have been created and implemented to include the CDL SOP, QA SOP, training assessments, and testing and remediation protocols.

  • Train the field on compliance and operational best practices for all aspects of the CDL training program. Coordinate and schedule visits to work with the field to improve instructional capabilities, enhance performance, and create a culture of teamwork and collaboration.

  • Intervene and assist in student or staff Code of Conduct escalations, investigations, or related; assist Human Resources where applicable.

  • Analyze CDL Testing Results in all markets to identify areas for improvement. Leverage data to make decisions on training and development needs and any necessary progressive corrective actions and/or performance improvement plans.

  • Investigate and record state regulations in areas/markets of operation to ensure compliance with curriculum, program, and training staff.

  • Investigate and record each state's testing options: DMV, third-party testing, and reciprocity with other states. Pursue establishing third-party testing in any state that is allowed to include internal third-party testing in locations that are feasible for Ancora Training and have been approved by the Senior Director of Operations and Director of Operations.

  • Ensure training locations have the required supplies and resources to operate the training program. Ensure equipment and staff allocation and schedules are commensurate with student volume levels of training programs.

  • Work with the training staff on improving communication skills with peers, students, and clients.

  • Regularly review, understand, and make recommendations to improve efficiency across all aspects of the CDL business.

  • Coach and mentor exempt program leadership roles to develop direct reports and improve individual and team performance


Experience and Education Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Experience working with students, instructors, and clients

  • Holds an active CDL Class A License

  • 5 Years of work experience in CDL driving and training

  • At least 24 months experience as a CDL Program Director

  • Working knowledge of FMCSA regulations

  • Intermediate knowledge of CampusVue, Google Suite products, and Internet navigation

  • Detail-oriented and ability to analyze reports in multiple formats

  • Actively listens and responds appropriately

  • Maintains professionalism at all times

  • Time management skills with the ability to multitask

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate through verbal and non-verbal means with students, co-workers, and various levels of clients and external regulatory agencies

Experience and Education Preferred

  • Associate Degree or Higher

  • 1-3 years experience in customer service or training role dealing with corporate partners

title: HeVi- ja leipäosaston vastaava (35-37,5h/vko) K-Market Lahela, Tuusula
description:
Oletko jo kokenut kaupan tekijä ja valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen?

Etsimme K-Market Lahelaan kokoaikaista tekijää, joka ottaa vastuulleen kauppamme HeVi- ja leipäosastot ja toimii samalla yhtenä myymälämme vastuuhenkilöistä.

Tämä tehtävä sopii erityisen hyvin sinulle, jolla on jo kokemusta päivittäistavarakaupasta ja joka kaipaat työhösi enemmän vastuuta, itsenäisyyttä ja mahdollisuutta vaikuttaa omaan tekemiseesi.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis osastopäällikkö tai vuosia vastuutehtävissä toiminut konkari. Etsimme ennen kaikkea hyvää kaupan ammattilaista, joka tuntee myymälän arjen, näkee itse mitä pitää tehdä ja haluaa kehittyä seuraavaan rooliin.

Pääosin aamuvuoroja – ja oma vastuualue

Työsi painottuu myymälän avausvuoroihin. Aamulla olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, jotka laittavat päivän käyntiin: huolehdit siitä, että kauppa on valmis asiakkaille, päivän tärkeimmät työt on tunnistettu ja tekeminen lähtee sujuvasti liikkeelle.

Omana vastuualueenasi ovat HeVi- ja leipäosasto. Pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä osastot näyttävät, mitä niissä myydään ja miten niiden myynti kehittyy.

Käytännössä huolehdit muun muassa tilaamisesta, saatavuudesta, laadusta, esillepanoista ja hävikin hallinnasta. Seuraat oman alueesi tekemistä ja kehität sitä yhdessä kauppiaan ja muun tiimin kanssa.

Et kuitenkaan työskentele vain omalla osastollasi. Olet osa koko kaupan porukkaa ja tarvittaessa ohjaat myös muiden työntekijöiden tekemistä työvuoron aikana.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos

Sinulla on jo kokemusta päivittäistavarakaupasta ja tiedät, mitä hyvä kauppakunto tarkoittaa käytännössä. Olet oma-aloitteinen, ripeä ja luotettava, etkä tarvitse jatkuvasti vierellesi henkilöä kertomaan, mitä seuraavaksi tehdään.

Osaat priorisoida tekemistä kiireessäkin ja uskallat ottaa vastuuta. Asiakaspalvelu tulee sinulta luontevasti ja pystyt myös neuvomaan ja ohjaamaan muita rakentavasti.

Aikaisempi kokemus HeVi- tai leipäosastosta, tilaamisesta, vastuutehtävistä tai K-ryhmän järjestelmistä on ehdottomasti plussaa – mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Oikea asenne, vahva kaupan perusosaaminen ja halu ottaa vastuuta ratkaisevat.

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta .

Mitä saat meiltä?

Saat oman vastuualueen, jossa pääset oikeasti näkemään oman työsi jäljen ja vaikuttamaan siihen, miten osastot kehittyvät.

Työ on kokoaikainen, 35–37,5 tuntia viikossa, ja työvuorot painottuvat vahvasti aamuihin. Vastaavan roolissa tarvitsemme kuitenkin myös jonkin verran joustavuutta työaikoihin, joten satunnaiset ilta- ja viikonlopputyöt kuuluvat tehtävään.

Työsuhde on vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus vähintään toukokuuhun 2028 asti. Tavoitteenamme on löytää meille pitkäaikainen hyvä tekijä, ja työsuhteen jatkuminen myös tämän jälkeen on mahdollista.

Saat tehtävään perehdytyksen ja tuen, mutta myös vapautta tehdä ja kehittää omaa vastuualuettasi. Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan TES:n mukaan ja tehtävästä maksetaan lisäksi vastuulisä.

Jos olet jo näyttänyt osaamisesi kaupan arjessa ja miettinyt, että olisi aika saada enemmän vastuuta, tässä voisi olla sinun seuraava askeleesi.

Lähetä meille hakemuksesi oheisesta linkistä ja kerro erityisesti, millaista kokemusta sinulla on päivittäistavarakaupasta ja mistä asioista olet nykyisessä tai aikaisemmassa työssäsi kantanut vastuuta.

Hakuaika päättyy 21.9.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten laita hakemusta ripeästi!

Lisätietoja saat kauppiaalta, maria.polus@k-market.com.

Rekrytointiin liittyvän tietosuojaselosteen saat rekrytoivasta kaupasta.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Why CustomLinc?

This isn't another role where you'll spend months working on a tiny piece of a product - you'll see your work go live quickly, solve real customer problems, and have a direct impact on the success of our clients.

You'll also play an important role in one of our biggest initiatives: transforming our legacy desktop application into a modern web-based platform. Rather than building on top of a standard frontend framework like React or Angular, we've built our own approach to serving and rendering pages.

What you'll love:

  • Real ownership and influence over technical decisions
  • Flexible working with remote-friendly options
  • A close-knit, collaborative team where your ideas are heard
  • Exposure across front-end, back-end, integrations, and platform development
  • Opportunities to grow your technical depth
  • A product used daily by businesses delivering amazing tourism experiences

What you'll do:

As a Web Developer, you'll work across both modern web experiences and the underlying systems that power them.

You'll:

  • Build and enhance customer-facing booking widgets, portals, and web applications
  • Troubleshoot and improve online booking and checkout journeys
  • Develop object-oriented platform components within our proprietary framework
  • Integrate and support payment gateways and third-party APIs
  • Implement and maintain analytics and conversion tracking solutions
  • Investigate and resolve complex issues in production environments
  • Review code, share knowledge, and work closely with the wider development team

What you'll bring:

We're looking for someone with excellent attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a natural curiosity for learning new technologies. You'll be an effective communicator who can build positive working relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, working collaboratively to achieve the best outcomes. Someone who embraces innovation, you will be confident using AI tools to enhance productivity, improve development practices, and deliver better software solutions.

We're more interested in strong development fundamentals and learning agility than experience with a specific technology stack.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Experience building responsive, user-focused web applications
  • A solid understanding of client-side versus server-side application design
  • Experience with an object-oriented programming language such as: C#, Java, C++, Python, or similar
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • Experience working with APIs and third-party integrations

We’ll be especially interested if you have experience with:

  • IIS administration and web hosting environments
  • Web application security
  • Google Tag Manager or GA4
  • Third party integrations
  • Tourism, travel, ticketing, or booking platforms
  • Modernization projects involving legacy applications

What success looks like, you'll thrive here if you enjoy:

  • Thinking beyond just writing code
  • Understanding how systems work end-to-end
  • Owning problems from investigation through to resolution
  • Working in a small, agile team where everyone contributes
  • Continuously improving your craft and learning new technologies

Location

We're based in Christchurch Technology Park and would prefer someone who can spend time in the office, particularly during onboarding and relationship-building.

After that, we offer flexibility, including primarily remote working arrangements. For an exceptional candidate, we would also consider a fully remote setup.

title: Leder Fleet og Servicetjenester
description:
Leder Fleet og Servicetjenester – MEKO Norway

Vil du sette retning for en kommersiell satsing – og være med på å skape resultatene?

MEKO søker en kommersiell og operativ leder som kan utvikle selskapets satsing på fleet og servicetjenester.

Vi ser etter deg som forstår markedet, kundene og beslutningslandskapet. Du skal kartlegge mulighetene, prioritere hvor MEKO skal satse og omsette dette i en tydelig salgsplan. Sammen med to KAM-er skal du skape aktivitet, vinne kunder og sørge for at avtalene fungerer i praksis. Du trenger ikke være ekspert på verksteddrift. Den kompetansen finnes allerede i MEKO. Det viktigste er at du kjenner kundene, forstår markedet og kan omsette mulighetene i salg og lønnsom verkstedtrafikk.

En satsing i utvikling

Fleet og servicetjenester er et område i oppstarts- og utviklingsfasen i MEKO. Samtidig er flere viktige forutsetninger allerede etablert.

MEKO har et landsdekkende verkstednettverk, eksisterende avtaler med store private og offentlige kunder og en egen fleetportal som gir kundene oversikt over bestillinger, avtalepriser, servicehistorikk, kostnader og fakturering.

Dette får du ansvar for

  • Utarbeide mål, strategi og salgsplan for fleet og servicetjenester
  • Drive eget nysalg og lede større kundeprosesser og forhandlinger
  • Kartlegge markedet og prioritere kundesegmentene MEKO skal arbeide aktivt mot
  • Lede, samle og utvikle et team med to KAM-er
  • Skape struktur, aktivitet og fremdrift i salgsarbeidet
  • Utvikle lønnsomme, avtaler og tjenestemodeller
  • Sikre at nye kundeavtaler blir implementert i portalen og verkstednettverket
  • Skape lønnsom vekst og trafikk til verksteder i MEKOs nettverk

Rollen rapporterer til kommersiell direktør i MEKO Norway.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har relevant erfaring fra fleet, leasing, bil, mobilitet eller servicetjenester. Du kjenner markedet og forstår hvem som påvirker og tar beslutninger hos større kunder.

Du har dokumenterte resultater fra komplekst B2B-salg og større kundeavtaler. Du trives med oppsøkende salg, kan lede krevende salgsprosesser og er trygg i forhandlinger om pris og betingelser.

Vi tror du også har erfaring med flere av disse områdene:

  • Kartlegging og prioritering av markeder og kundesegmenter
  • Utvikling av nye kunder og kommersielle samarbeid
  • Pris, lønnsomhet og avtalestrukturer
  • Ledelse eller utvikling av selgere og KAM-er
  • Implementering på tvers av flere fagmiljøer
  • Digitale kundeplattformer og databasert salgsoppfølging

Du er analytisk nok til å prioritere, kommersiell nok til å skape salg og handlekraftig nok til å få planene gjennomført. Som leder skaper du tydelighet, engasjement og fremdrift – både i teamet og resten av organisasjonen.

Hvorfor MEKO?

Hos MEKO får du muligheten til å forme og utvikle et kommersielt satsingsområde med et sterkt konsern i ryggen.

Du får tilgang til kjente merkevarer, et landsdekkende verkstednettverk, en moderne fleetportal og kompetanse i både Norge og resten av konsernet. Samtidig er satsingen fortsatt i utvikling, og du får stor innflytelse på retningen og hvordan potensialet skal realiseres.

MEKO Norway er en ledende aktør i servicemarkedet for person- og nyttekjøretøy. Gjennom blant annet Mekonomen og MECA betjener selskapet bileiere og verksteder over hele Norge.

Arbeidssted er MEKO Norways hovedkontor på Helsfyr i Oslo. Det må påregnes noe reisevirksomhet.

title: Wellness Coach
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The YMCA of the East Valley is committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility.

Under the direction of the Program Director, the Wellness Coach is responsible for supporting YMCA operations through effective delivery of programs, services, and member engagement. This position contributes to the achievement of Association goals by promoting the YMCA mission, values, and strategic priorities while providing high-quality service to members, participants, staff, and the community.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed below are representative of the duties and responsibilities performed by this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list.

Core Responsibilities

  • Perform duties in alignment with YMCA mission, policies, procedures, and operational standards.
  • Deliver high-quality customer/member service to participants, families, staff, volunteers, and community partners.
  • Support departmental and Association goals through effective communication, teamwork, and accountability.
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and documentation as required.
  • Participate in staff meetings, trainings, and required professional development activities.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
  • Support risk management and safety procedures.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to support operational needs.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Position-Specific Responsibilities

  • Maintains a safe and clean Wellness Center environment by engaging members, enforcing policies, and positively reacting to any situations that arise.
  • Conducts member orientations and equipment introductions.
  • Monitors wellness floor activities and enforces wellness center policies.
  • Performs routine cleaning and sanitation of fitness equipment and wellness areas.
  • Provides basic exercise guidance within YMCA scope of practice.
  • Promotes YMCA wellness programs, group exercise classes, and personal training services.
  • Completes wellness floor rounds and equipment inspections.
  • Answers questions from members to support them in achieving their goals related to healthy living. Maintains working knowledge of wellness and trends to provide effective information and support to members.
  • Builds effective, authentic relationships with members; helps members connect with each other and the YMCA.
  • Introduce new members to group exercise communities based their health and well-being goals.
  • Utilizes tools and information for the purpose of increasing member knowledge of wellness as well as wellness programs provided through the YMCA (handouts, schedules, etc.).
  • Maintains and cleans equipment according to the schedule or as requested by supervisor.
  • Follows YMCA policies and procedures.
  • Respond to emergency situations following the appropriate Emergency Action Plan.
  • Attends all staff meetings.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Mission Advancement

Demonstrates and models the YMCA’s values of caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility. Supports the YMCA mission and promotes community engagement and service.

Collaboration

Builds positive relationships with staff, members, volunteers, and community stakeholders. Works effectively with individuals of diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Operational Effectiveness

Maintains quality work standards, accountability, sound judgment, and effective time management. Supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Personal Growth

Demonstrates self-awareness, adaptability, professionalism, and commitment to ongoing learning and development.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications

  • Conducts member orientations and equipment introductions.
  • Monitors wellness floor activities and enforces wellness center policies.
  • Performs routine cleaning and sanitation of fitness equipment and wellness areas.
  • Provides basic exercise guidance within YMCA scope of practice.
  • Promotes YMCA wellness programs, group exercise classes, and personal training services.
  • Completes wellness floor rounds and equipment inspections.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nationally recognized fitness certification (ACE, NASM, ACSM, ISSA, etc.)
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish)
  • Experience working with diverse populations and older adults

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency in applicable technology, software, and systems.
  • Commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and the YMCA mission.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

Depending on assignment, duties may include:

  • Sitting, standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting.
  • Operating office equipment and technology.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in indoor and/or outdoor environments.
  • Ability to travel between branch locations, if applicable.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

DRIVING REQUIREMENTS (IF APPLICABLE)

Employees assigned driving responsibilities must:

  • Possess and maintain a valid California Driver’s License.
  • Maintain acceptable driving record in accordance with YMCA policy.
  • Maintain required automobile insurance coverage.
  • Use reliable transportation for Association business.

BACKGROUND SCREENING & PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of YMCA pre-employment requirements, which may include:

  • Employment verification

WORK SCHEDULE

Work schedules may vary based on operational needs and may include mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.

DISCLAIMER

title: Data Engineer – AWS Native Data Platforms, Vice President
description:
About this role

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join BlackRock’s Information Security organization, supporting the design, build, and operation of our Cloud‑native data platform that power critical technology, security, and operational use cases across the firm.

This role sits within a team responsible for building reliable, secure, and observable data pipelines in a highly regulated environment. You will work closely with technology, operations, and information security partners to deliver data products that enable transparency, automation, and risk‑informed decision making at scale.

The ideal candidate is an engineer at heart—comfortable working end‑to‑end across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and governance—who values clean design, strong documentation, and operational excellence.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain AWS‑native data pipelines for batch and event‑driven workloads, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and security.

  • Develop and operate data workflows using Apache Airflow for orchestration and Python and SQL for transformation and data quality logic.

  • Implement data transformations and models using modern analytics engineering practices (e.g., dbt‑style patterns, tested transformations, incremental processing).

  • Integrate data from a variety of enterprise sources, including cloud services, internal platforms, APIs, and security/operational telemetry.

  • Partner with Information Security, Risk, and Operations teams to translate business and control requirements into durable data solutions.

  • Embed data quality, lineage, and observability into pipelines using testing frameworks and monitoring standards.

  • Operate within BlackRock’s cloud security and governance standards, including IAM, encryption, logging, and secrets management.

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure‑as‑code patterns, and standardized platform tooling.

  • Document data products, pipelines, and operating procedures to support transparency and long‑term maintainability.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and incident/post‑incident analysis to continuously improve platform resilience.

Core Technologies You’ll Work With

  • AWS: S3, IAM, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, OpenSearch, and related native services

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data Modeling & Transformation: Analytics‑engineering patterns (e.g., dbt‑like workflows)

  • Data Quality & Testing: Schema and data validation frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations‑style approaches)

  • Infrastructure & Delivery: CI/CD, Git‑based workflows, infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform or equivalent)

  • Security & Governance: Encryption, access controls, audit logging, platform security baselines

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar role building production data pipelines.

  • Strong hands‑on experience with AWS‑native data services in a regulated or enterprise environment.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with an emphasis on readable, testable, and maintainable code.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling, incremental processing, and performance optimization.

  • Familiarity with data quality, monitoring, and operational support for production data systems.

  • Experience collaborating with cross‑functional partners (e.g., security, operations, product, or risk teams).

  • A disciplined approach to documentation, change management, and incident response.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting security, risk, or compliance data domains.

  • Exposure to OpenSearch / Elasticsearch, metrics pipelines, or log‑analytics platforms.

  • Familiarity with cloud security controls, IAM design, and secrets management.

  • Experience building data platforms that support executive‑level reporting or regulatory oversight.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidanceon when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Technician

To be a team member of the Driven by Dobbs family, you must be dedicated to supporting the company’s mission, vision, and values.

OUR MISSION:

To be the leader in the automotive tire and service aftermarket industry in every market that we operate in providing premier service to our guests.

POSITION TITLE: Technician

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Driven by Dobbs, our family of brands brings together Dobbs Tire and Auto Centers—founded in 1976 in South St. Louis, MO as a family-owned complete auto care provider—and Conrad’s Tire Express & Total Car Care, founded in 1969 in Cleveland, OH. Together, we have grown into a rapidly expanding, multi-market automotive service organization that will operate across eight states in 2026, with continued growth on the horizon. Across all locations, customers can expect a full selection of quality tire brands and comprehensive automotive services, ranging from routine maintenance to advanced diagnostics and engine repair. Our investment in training, development, safety, and overall team wellbeing empowers our people to deliver exceptional service every day. Rooted in a culture that extends beyond the shop, we proudly support local organizations and charities in the communities where our teams live and work.

We are seeking an experienced Technician. The Automotive Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining vehicles to ensure safe and reliable operation. This includes performing inspections, alignment adjustments, tire services, and general vehicle maintenance using specialized automotive tools and equipment. The technician works closely with team members to maintain efficiency, quality, and safety standards in the shop. Attention to detail, mechanical aptitude, and problem-solving skills are essential to accurately identify issues and complete repairs. The ideal candidate will be detailed driven, accountable, customer centric and a team player with a strong work ethic to contribute to the department goals and achieve results.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inspect, diagnose, and repair vehicles to ensure safe and reliable operation.
  • Perform wheel alignments, tire services, and other suspension or steering adjustments as needed.
  • Conduct general vehicle maintenance, including oil changes, brake service, fluid checks, and tune-ups.
  • Utilize specialized automotive tools and diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Maintain accurate service records and document completed work in accordance with company policies.
  • Work collaboratively with team members to maintain efficiency, quality, and safety standards in the shop.
  • Adhere to all safety procedures and ensure a clean, organized work environment.
  • Provide professional and courteous service to customers, explaining findings and recommended repairs clearly.

SUCCESS FACTORS:

  • A strong belief in safety- Being Safe 100% of the time is the expectation.
  • Alignment with company mission, vision, and values.
  • Strong work ethic with a commitment to results.
  • Strong team player with the ability to adapt to diverse team members.
  • Ability to perform in a fast paced/high volume environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A high level of time management, accountability, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to be organized, problem solve and be solution oriented.
  • Self-motivated, goal- oriented, and driven to accomplish department goals.
  • Strong critical thinker with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Highly-customer centric and master relationship builder.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of automotive systems and uses diagnostic equipment with accuracy.
  • Maintains a professional, can-do approach even in physically demanding or fast-paced situations.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Fast-paced automotive service environment.
  • Frequent exposure to varying temperatures due to the nature of the work and shop conditions.
  • Regular contact with automotive chemicals, including solvents, lubricants, and fluids used in vehicle maintenance and repair.
  • Extended periods of standing, bending, and lifting tires or equipment.
  • Requires adherence to all safety procedures and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Involves teamwork, reliability, and effective communication to maintain a safe and efficient workplace.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality service are essential for success.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in automotive repair or 2–4 years of hands-on training in automotive maintenance.
  • 1+ year of experience as an alignment technician or completion of a post-secondary vocational program in automotive technology.
  • Extensive knowledge of tire installation, wheel balancing, and diagnosing ride disturbances.
  • Growing knowledge of steering, suspension, and general vehicle maintenance.
  • Proficient in the use of standard automotive diagnostic tools and repair equipment.
  • Solid understanding of automotive systems and repair procedures.
  • Valid Drivers’ License Required.

title: DevOps Support Engineer (Kubernetes)
company: THE EDGE CONTRACTING SERVICES PTE. LTD.
description:
Is it the application? A failed pod? The deployment? The database? The network? Or something sitting underneath the Kubernetes environment?

You're the engineer expected to help figure that out.

We're looking for a DevOps Support Engineer to support business-critical applications running across modern cloud and containerised environments.

This isn't a traditional helpdesk or ticket-routing support position. You'll be working closer to the engineering layer — investigating production incidents, analysing logs, troubleshooting Kubernetes workloads and working across application, infrastructure, network and database teams to restore services.

You don't necessarily need to be the person who designed the Kubernetes platform from scratch. But you should be comfortable getting hands‑on when something isn't behaving as expected.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide hands‑on L2 technical support for production applications and take ownership of incidents through investigation and resolution.
  • Troubleshoot Kubernetes environments, including pods, deployments, services, container logs and application health.
  • Investigate issues across the application, cloud/infrastructure, network and database layers to isolate the source of production problems.
  • Support application deployments, releases and upgrades and investigate deployment failures.
  • Analyse application and system logs, monitoring alerts and performance metrics to identify root causes.
  • Work with Microsoft Azure environments, with exposure to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) highly advantageous.
  • Perform SQL/database investigation where required to diagnose application or data‑related issues.
  • Work closely with Development, DevOps, Infrastructure and external vendors while retaining ownership of the initial technical investigation.
  • Participate in incident management, RCA and continuous improvement of application stability and support processes.
  • Support production environments that may require after-hours or 24/7 operational coverage.

What we're looking for

  • Hands‑on experience supporting production applications in Kubernetes environments.
  • Practical troubleshooting experience with pods, deployments, services and container/application logs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure; hands‑on AKS experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of Linux, application troubleshooting and production support.
  • Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Elasticsearch, Datadog or similar.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Exposure to CI/CD, application deployments and release processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot beyond the application itself and investigate potential network, infrastructure, database and configuration issues.
  • Comfortable owning technical investigations before escalating to the appropriate engineering team.

The kind of engineer we're looking for

We're less concerned about whether your current title says Application Support, DevOps, Production Support, Cloud Engineer or Systems Engineer.

What matters is what you actually do when production breaks.

If you're comfortable opening the logs, checking the pods, looking at the deployment, testing connectivity, checking the database and narrowing down the problem before saying “this belongs to another team” — we'd like to speak with you.

title: FY26 Intern - Deep Learning Researcher Internship - 4 months, Amsterdam
description:

Job Area:

General Summary:

At Qualcomm AI Research, we are advancing AI to make its core capabilities – perception, reasoning, and action – ubiquitous across devices. Our mission is to make breakthroughs in fundamental AI research and scale them across industries. By bringing together some of the best minds in the field, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and shaping the future of AI.

We have multiple positions available for our 4-month Deep Learning Research internship program.
As a Deep Learning Research Intern, you will develop, prototype, and implement new fundamental and impactful methods in one of our research areas. The internship program gives you a unique opportunity to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence and publish at scientific conferences. You will join a team of talented and experienced researchers and engineers and become part of our collaborative and interdisciplinary environment.

Our research areas include:

  • Model Efficiency: Advancing efficiency of generative models and architectures with innovations in, e.g., model quantization, compression, sparsity, conditional computation (e.g., mixture of experts), application to LLMs/LVMs/multi-modal models.
  • Generative Vision: Research on efficient generative modeling of visual and multimodal data using diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive methods, Gaussian Splatting, VLMs, and MLLMs.
  • Agentic AI & Reasoning: Research on agentic AI system and algorithms, long horizon planning, inference time compute, RL training of reasoning LLMs, generative reward models and LLM sampling techniques.
  • Embodied AI: Research on manipulation (Vision-Language-Action models, diffusion), loco-manipulation on humanoid robots, learning-from-human-videos, and reinforcement learning applied to these topics.
  • Robustness & Alignment: Research on robust & efficient methods to align models for safe, reliable, and resource-constrained edge, emphasizing controllable generation, uncertainty quantification, guardrails and on-device adaptation techniques.

Requirements

We welcome applications from motivated PhD candidates. Applicants must be enrolled in their PhD degree program for the duration of the internship. Ideal applicants are currently pursuing a PhD with focus on machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer vision, or foundation models (LLMs/LVMs) and have proven research ability, e.g., having published at relevant academic conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.).

Why join us

At Qualcomm AI Research, you will be part of a team with a wide range of backgrounds that values innovation and creativity. You will be part of a global company (headquartered in San Diego) and work closely with exceptional researchers and engineers that publish at major conferences.
You will work on-site at our office located at the campus of the University of Amsterdam and live in a scenic, vibrant city with high living standards, numerous cultural activities, and plenty of green spaces.
Qualcomm offers interns flexible start dates between November 2025 and July 2026, a competitive salary, relocation assistance, and holiday & sick pay.

title: Security AI Engineer
description:
Challenge yourself and us


At AdvanceWorks, we learn, grow, and have fun together. And we do all this while creating great software solutions for clients across many industries and geographies.

We are constantly challenging ourselves and each other to use the latest technologies and the best methodologies and make sure we walk the talk.


Exciting as it may sound, we also have our red lines: each of us is a unique person, with unique opinions, beliefs, options, interests, hopes, and fears. With the right to speak its mind, be mindful of the common goals, and always be constructive.


The way we respect each other, discuss different points of view, and challenge ourselves and each other while tackling our common challenges makes us strong. United. Brave. And sure that there will be a better tomorrow, even when we do mistakes. Because we learn from our failures and successes.



What will be your role


We are looking for an experienced AI Security Engineer to support the cybersecurity infrastructure of a client in the regulatory compliance sector, through the implementation of robust security controls, the deployment of innovative security solutions, and the investigation of security incidents. A key focus of this role is the security of AI/ML systems and pipelines, the assessment of risks introduced by large language models and generative AI tools, and the definition of security standards for AI adoption across the organization.


This role is critical to maintaining a strong security posture through meticulous incident analysis and effective mitigation strategies. Beyond the technical responsibilities, the position requires excellent collaboration and communication with multiple departments to align security policies and procedures with overall business objectives and compliance regulations. You will work closely with the AI, Application Engineering, and Cloud Platform teams to embed security throughout the entire software development lifecycle and across cloud infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will provide guidance on secure design patterns, conduct comprehensive security reviews of application code, cloud architectures, and managed AI services, and support the responsible development, deployment, and operation of AI-powered features and products.



Key Responsibilities:


  • Define, implement, and govern security standards, policies, and frameworks for AI/ML adoption across all business units.
  • Act as the lead security partner for the Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams, supporting the responsible development and deployment of AI-powered features.
  • Foster a strong security culture by coordinating activities with Tech Leads, Engineering Managers, and the Security Champions network, providing guidance on secure design patterns for AI workloads.
  • Architect and ensure the integration of advanced security controls, automated testing, and vulnerability management into CI/CD pipelines and into DevSecOps and MLSecOps workflows.
  • Conduct comprehensive security architecture reviews and risk assessments focused on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI, mitigating risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model supply chain vulnerabilities (OWASP LLM Top 10).
  • Lead investigation, mitigation, and recovery efforts for complex security incidents, with a specialized focus on threats targeting AI infrastructure, inference endpoints, and managed cloud AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Monitor emerging cybersecurity trends, adversarial ML tactics, and global compliance regulations to proactively evolve the security infrastructure against future threat vectors.



Who will work by your side?


You will work as part of a team on a project and also with the AdvanceWorks team, a team of experts, and thus become part of a team of people who care about each other. Amazing people and professionals who are proud of their technology and leadership skills yet eager to learn from you and be challenged.


You'll also work side by side with our clients, spanning a wide range of industries and countries. And that means working with more bright minds, being empathetic about each other, and always keeping in mind that every brilliant piece of software we produce has two objectives: to achieve a specific business goal, and to make the people who built it as successful as you want to be.



What should you bring to the team?


  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field, or professional cybersecurity certifications in lieu of a formal degree.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a cybersecurity professional, with at least 1 year in AI/ML security, LLM security, or security for AI-driven systems.
  • Application Security (AppSec) and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC): familiarity with integrating security practices into CI/CD pipelines, code review processes, and DevSecOps/MLSecOps workflows.
  • OWASP Top 10 and OWASP LLM Top 10: solid understanding of common web application vulnerabilities and their AI/LLM-specific equivalents (e.g., prompt injection, insecure output handling, model supply chain risks).
  • AI/ML security: understanding of threat vectors specific to AI systems, including adversarial attacks, data poisoning, model inversion, and inference endpoint security.
  • Networking knowledge (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN): solid understanding of network fundamentals, including TCP/IP protocols and the configuration and operation of Local Area Networks (LAN) and Wide Area Networks (WAN), and their security implications.
  • Basic familiarity with the OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) model, including its seven layers and how they support network communications and cybersecurity practices.
  • Security protocols, such as HTTPS, DNS, SMTP, FTP, and SSH.
  • Firewalls (IDS/IPS): familiarity with the concepts and purposes of these tools.
  • Understanding of information security principles such as confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
  • Familiarity with operating systems, especially Windows, Linux or Unix, and MacOS.
  • Knowledge and familiarity with incident investigation and response processes.
  • Specific technical knowledge, such as programming languages (Python, PowerShell), and familiarity with API security testing and secure coding best practices across web application stacks.
  • Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), including experience securing AI/ML workloads and managed AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI).
  • Familiarity with concepts such as IAM (Identity and Access Management), encryption in transit and at rest, and shared responsibility models.
  • Understanding of virtual machine and containerized environment security.
  • Fluency in English. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
  • Creativity, dynamism, and the ability to work independently, yet transparently with colleagues, to thrive in a collaborative, international environment.



What is in it for you?


  • Work with an international team;
  • An amazing informal culture of smart hardworking and friendly people that support and care about each other;
  • A mentorship program since day 1;
  • Be involved in strategic and operational initiatives beyond the scope of your main mission;
  • Formal training and certifications in technology, methodology, and relational skills;
  • Challenging projects with exciting clients and state-of-the-art technology;
  • A dynamic company where you can make a difference and where talent and results matter (and politics do not);
  • Flexibility with responsibility;
  • Happy hours and after-hours feel-good actions.


Don't hold off any longer and apply now! If you have any questions, drop us a line at people@advanceworks.ai.

title: Remote Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Our client is seeking a seasoned Remote Senior DevOps Engineer to join their distributed team. title: Data Engineer
description:
Let’s Write Africa’s Story Together! Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our technology team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining and optimising data platforms, pipelines and integrations that support business intelligence, analytics, reporting and operational processes. You will play an important role in building scalable, reliable and future‑fit data solutions, working closely with business stakeholders, software engineers and data consumers to turn business needs into effective technical solutions.

What You’ll Be Trusted With

Data Engineering & Solution Delivery

Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. Build and optimise data models, databases and data integration solutions. Develop data solutions that support reporting, analytics, machine learning and operational requirements. Contribute to the design and architecture of cloud‑based data platforms.

Data Quality & Reliability

Implement data quality, validation and monitoring frameworks to ensure data integrity and reliability. Optimise database performance and troubleshoot data‑related issues. Take ownership of the quality, stability and performance of data solutions.

Stakeholder Partnership

Work closely with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into practical, buildable technical solutions. Partner with software engineers and data consumers to ensure solutions meet business needs and deliver meaningful value. Communicate openly and clearly, building trusted relationships across technical and business teams.

Technology & Continuous Improvement

Support deployment, testing and maintenance through CI/CD and DevOps practices. Identify opportunities to improve data platforms, processes and ways of working. Stay curious about emerging technologies and continuously build your technical capability. Document technical solutions, standards and processes to support consistency and knowledge sharing.

Team Contribution

Mentor junior team members and contribute to building technical capability within the engineering team. Share knowledge and collaborate with colleagues to solve problems and achieve shared outcomes. Contribute to a culture of constructive challenge, learning and continuous improvement.

Who you are

You are a technically strong and curious Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building reliable solutions. You are comfortable working across technical and business environments and take ownership of delivering quality outcomes. You bring:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.

The Strengths You’ll Bring

Scan the Horizon: You stay curious about emerging technologies and look for opportunities to strengthen our data capabilities. Innovate to Grow: You challenge existing ways of working and find smarter, scalable solutions to complex problems. Learn and Adapt: You embrace change, continuously develop your technical capability and apply new thinking to your work. Partner with Intent: You build effective relationships with business and technology stakeholders, understanding their needs and working towards shared outcomes. Communicate Candidly: You communicate clearly, constructively and openly, particularly when navigating complex technical challenges. Foster Trust: You are dependable, transparent and consistent in delivering on your commitments. Focus on What Matters: You prioritise work that creates meaningful value for the business and its stakeholders. Own It: You take accountability for your deliverables, data quality and the solutions you build. Deliver Excellence: You hold yourself to high standards and take pride in delivering reliable, sustainable and high-quality solutions.

Let’s Succeed Together At OMIG, how you work matters as much as what you deliver.

We shape a bold future by staying curious and finding better ways to work, wow our clients by focusing on what matters and delivering excellence, and succeed together by partnering with intent, communicating candidly and fostering trust.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Multiverse Computing

Multiverse is a well-funded, fast-growing deep-tech company founded in 2019. We are the largest quantum software company in the EU and have been recognized by CB Insights (2023 and 2025) as one of the 100 most promising AI companies in the world.
With 180+ employees and growing, our team is fully multicultural and international. We deliver hyper-efficient software for companies seeking a competitive edge through quantum computing and artificial intelligence.
Our flagship products, CompactifAI and Singularity, address critical needs across various industries:

  • CompactifAI is a groundbreaking compression tool for foundational AI models based on Tensor Networks. It enables the compression of large AI systems—such as language models—to make them significantly more efficient and portable.
  • Singularity is a quantum- and quantum-inspired optimization platform used by blue-chip companies to solve complex problems in finance, energy, manufacturing, and beyond. It integrates seamlessly with existing systems and delivers immediate performance gains on classical and quantum hardware.

You’ll be working alongside world-leading experts to develop solutions that tackle real-world challenges. We’re looking for passionate individuals eager to grow in an ethics-driven environment that values sustainability and diversity.
We’re committed to building a truly inclusive culture—come and join us.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design and delivery of data platform architectures — lakehouse, data catalog, and governance — from initial scoping through production release
  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration to ensure data is clean, accurate, versioned, and accessible
  • Define data modeling, partitioning, schema evolution, and versioning conventions so datasets remain queryable, interoperable, and reproducible at scale
  • Establish and maintain authoritative data catalogs, including schemas, metadata, lineage, sensitivity labels, and access policies
  • Validate released datasets against their sources for completeness, correctness, schema consistency, and query performance, defining objective acceptance criteria
  • Work closely with Machine Learning and AI Engineers to make data products directly consumable by analytics, APIs, and AI/agent workflows
  • Collaborate with clients and cross-functional teams to scope requirements, lead technical sessions, and document architectures for knowledge transfer and internal ownership
  • Mentor and support other data engineers, reviewing designs and code and raising the team's engineering standards
  • Stay up to date with emerging trends in data engineering — open table formats, data catalogs, orchestration — and drive their adoption where they add value

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelors or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
  • 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, including ownership of production data platforms or pipelines
  • Expert programming skills in Python and strong command of SQL
  • Expertise in data modeling, ETL development, and database management, with both SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Hands-on experience with lakehouse architectures and columnar / open table formats (e.g., Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake)
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark, and with workflow orchestrators such as Airflow or Argo Workflows
  • Strong experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including object storage, containers, and Kubernetes
  • Solid grounding in data governance: catalogs, metadata, lineage, access control, and dataset versioning
  • Comfortable with Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code working models
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; able to lead technical discussions with clients and stakeholders in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience with scientific or geospatial data formats and tooling (e.g., Zarr, NetCDF, GRIB2, xarray, H3 spatial indexing)
  • Experience preparing and serving data for LLM, RAG, or agent-based applications
  • Previous experience in consulting or client-facing delivery teams
