title: Site Lead
description:
Visit.org is looking for a passionate, high-velocity Site Lead to own and scale our fulfillment and logistics operations. In this role, you will be the operational engine powering regional social impact events. The Site Lead will take full accountability for facility operations, inventory accuracy, vendor management, and team leadership, translating our mission into seamless, data-driven execution. We are looking for a true builder with an entrepreneurial spirit, an extreme passion for social impact, and the grit to thrive in a fast-paced startup tech environment. If you love optimizing KPIs, building high-performing teams, and turning complex logistics into a science, we want to hear from you.

Please note: This is an on-location, full-time role based in Northvale, New Jersey, with a competitive salary and health benefits.

What Motivates Us

There is room for everyone! We empower each other to innovate and create processes that use technology to generate meaningful, lasting change. We enjoy the challenge of finding solutions to problems that are not a way around it but through it. We’re driven by the opportunity to help enterprises and their employees around the world to contribute to their communities.

When You Join the Team

  • You’ll join a movement from the ground floor and a team of purpose-driven people with a strong sense of responsibility, ownership, and pride that we’re building this thing together.
  • You’ll combine passion, purpose, and a paycheck Visit.org team members get out of bed every day knowing their work is meaningful and has a tangible impact on individuals and communities around the world.

About Visit.org:

Visit.org is a women-led Certified B Corporation that designs and delivers full-scale volunteering programs for global companies, with volunteering experiences built with vetted nonprofit partners and rooted in real community needs in 100+ countries and 40+ languages. Trusted by teams at companies like Amazon, Colgate, Paramount, and Cisco, Visit.org acts as an extension of lean CSR teams to run global volunteering that employees love and nonprofits trust.

Responsibilities:

  • Full accountability for end-to-end regional warehouse ownership receiving, inbound QC, staging, kitting & assembly, pick & pack, outbound QC, palletization, and outbound shipping, plus returns processing for reusable assets (e.g., Event Tool Kits) coming back into stock.
  • Build and scale operating processes, designing and managing a scalable warehouse/operations workflow in alignment with the above, document SOPs, train the team on them, deploy, audit adherence, and continuously improve.
  • Lead from the floor and step into any station receiving, kitting, pick/pack, or outbound when volume or staffing requires it. This is a working lead, not a supervisor who only directs.
  • Daily prep & prioritization using shipment deadline visibility to decide what the floor works on first each day and keep events on schedule.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop staff; set day-to-day direction and give ongoing performance feedback in an agile, startup-minded culture.
  • Own the packing standards box selection, cushioning, void-fill that gets kits to clients intact, and avoid packing & damage prevention, and audit packing quality and run down root cause on any damage or complaint.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, and system reconciliation across kit components, raw materials, and finished kits.
  • Manage and coordinate the day-to-day 3PL/carrier vendor relationship at the site level; track performance and escalate issues.
  • Manage warehouse layout, slotting, and peak-capacity planning across 30+ kit types.
  • Track and actively improve KPIs for on-time ship rate, damage/defect rate, inventory accuracy, kit cycle time, labor cost per kit, and dock-to-stock time.
  • Control labor costs budget, keep accountable to site expenses aligned to budget, and support cost tracking and reporting.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal teams on event supply needs, ensuring logistics timelines match event schedules.
  • Physical Demands:
  • Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
  • Stand/walk during the entire span of the workday
  • Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
  • Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
  • Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Requirements

  • Bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in warehouse operations, fulfillment, logistics, inventory management, picking, packing, and shipping, ideally in a fast-paced, high-volume, or startup environment.
  • Lead, coach, and develop warehouse or fulfillment teams, with at least 2 years of supervisory experience and a demonstrated ability to lead from the floor while stepping into operational roles when needed.
  • Build and document SOPs from the ground up, train teams on new processes, audit adherence, and continuously improve workflows to increase efficiency, quality, and scalability.
  • Maintain accurate inventory through cycle counts, reconciliation, receiving, staging, kitting, and fulfillment while working effectively with inventory management systems or Warehouse Management System WMS platforms.
  • Coordinate parcel, LTL, and FTL shipments and apply strong knowledge of palletization, freight preparation, receiving, and outbound shipping requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with 3PLs, carriers, freight providers, and other logistics vendors while monitoring performance and resolving operational issues.
  • Track and improve KPIs, including on-time shipment rate, inventory accuracy, damage and defect rates, kit cycle time, labor productivity, and cost per kit using Excel, Google Sheets, Monday.com, or similar tools.
  • Plan labor, capacity, workflow, and daily priorities effectively to meet competing shipment deadlines and keep regional events on schedule.
  • Work directly on the warehouse floor, including lifting up to 50 pounds, standing and walking for extended periods, and frequently pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching.
  • Take extreme ownership, solve problems independently, and build structure and scalable processes in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to align logistics execution with business and event requirements.
  • Bring a genuine passion for Visit.org’s mission and a desire to use operational excellence to create meaningful social impact.

What we offer:

This is an on-location, full-time role based in Northvale, New Jersey, with a competitive salary and health benefits.

Benefits

How we care

  • Health, Dental, and Vision
  • Unlimited PTO + Holiday + Birthday off!
  • Unlimited Social Impact Time Off (SITO)!
  • A company-wide annual paid holiday break between Christmas and New Year’s Eve to rest and recharge
  • Competitive salary
  • Mission-aligned company events/volunteering
  • Inclusive, exciting start-up culture
  • Accelerated career & personal growth
  • Culture Club and more!

Salary range from $60,000 to $85,000 DOE; however, base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A range of benefits may include bonuses, equity, healthcare benefits, and paid time off, which may be provided as part of the compensation package.

title: UX designer
description:
Tribia vokser, og vi søker nå en engasjert UX Designer som vil være med på å forme brukeropplevelsen i våre produkter. Dette er en unik mulighet til å bli en sentral del av produktavdelingen vår i en periode preget av sterk vekst, utvikling og spennende prosjekter. Hvis du trives i tverrfaglige team og ønsker å jobbe med moderne designverktøy og AI, er dette jobben for deg.

OM ROLLEN

Som UX Designer i Tribia blir du en viktig del av vår produktavdeling, der du vil bidra til utviklingen av prosjekthotellet Interaxo, samt relaterte løsninger og funksjoner. Du vil ha CPO som nærmeste leder og samarbeide tett med andre designere, produktledere, produkteiere og utviklere for å skape gode og intuitive brukeropplevelser. Du får ansvar for brukeropplevelsen på tvers av hele Interaxo-porteføljen, med eierskap fra dag én.

DINE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

  • Designe og videreutvikle brukervennlige og intuitive grensesnitt for våre produkter
  • Innhente innsikt for å forbedre brukeropplevelsen
  • Utarbeide wireframes, prototyper og designkonsepter i tett samarbeid med produktledere og utviklere
  • Samarbeide tett med utviklingsteam, inkludert globale team, for å sikre at design implementeres riktig
  • Ta i bruk og eksperimentere med AI-verktøy for å effektivisere designprosesser

HVA VI TILBYR

  • Mulighet til å være en del av en virksomhet i sterk vekst
  • Spennende prosjekter og varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Tilgang til moderne, AI-drevne designverktøy
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og faglig sterke kolleger
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

HVA VI SER ETTER

  • Høyere relevant utdannelse
  • 3–5 års relevant erfaring som UX Designer eller tilsvarende
  • Erfaring med design av B2B-produkter
  • God erfaring med Figma, Miro og Atlassian
  • Erfaring med eller interesse for bruk av AI-verktøy i designarbeid
  • God forståelse for brukersentrert design og designprosesser
  • Evne til å samarbeide tverrfaglig med produktledere, utviklere og andre interessenter
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Selvstendig, strukturert og løsningsorientert arbeidsstil

OM TRIBIA

Tribia er et norsk teknologiselskap som utvikler innovative, skybaserte SaaS-løsninger for digital samhandling og effektiv prosjektgjennomføring. Siden 2001 har vi vært en ledende leverandør til nordiske bygge- og anleggsprosjekter, og i dag består vi av rundt 80 ansatte med hovedkontor på Skøyen i Oslo og kontorer i Stockholm og Malmö.

Våre løsninger – Interaxo Project, Interaxo Capture, Interaxo BIM Data, Interaxo Insights og Interaxo Field – brukes av både offentlige og private virksomheter innen bygg og anlegg, kritisk infrastruktur og fornybar energi. Vi utvikler teknologi som forenkler komplekse prosesser og bidrar til bedre samhandling, informasjonsflyt og prosjektstyring gjennom hele prosjektets livsløp.

Hos Tribia blir du en del av en innovativ, inkluderende og samarbeidsorientert kultur, hvor vi jobber tett på tvers av fagområder og lokasjoner. Vi er opptatt av å skape gode resultater, samtidig som vi skal ha det hyggelig på jobb og legge til rette for en god balanse mellom jobb og privatliv.

Vår visjon er enkel: «Å utvikle teknologi som forenkler det komplekse for dem som bygger samfunnet vårt.»

title: Financial AI Product Manager
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Financial AI Product Manager to design, iterate and optimize AI-powered financial product solutions. Integrating AI and big data with corporate financial scenarios (including accounting, expense management, financial analysis, risk control and intelligent audit), you will oversee full-lifecycle product management, drive financial system digital upgrading and efficiency improvement, and deliver high-value intelligent financial products for enterprise users.

You need solid financial business knowledge and practical AI application capabilities to identify user demands and pain points, translate business requirements into feasible product solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product launch and scaled iteration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Planning: Formulate product roadmaps and iterative strategies by tracking fintech and financial AI industry trends, analyzing market competitors and user demands.
  • Full Lifecycle Management: Take charge of the complete product development process, including demand research, prototype design, PRD drafting, project coordination, development follow-up, testing, launch and post-operation iteration.
  • AI Scenario Implementation: Design and deliver AI-driven financial scenarios based on LLM, data analysis and intelligent algorithms, covering intelligent bookkeeping, automated reimbursement, financial reconciliation, risk early warning, intelligent financial reporting and audit inspection.
  • Demand Management: Communicate with internal teams and enterprise clients to mine core demands, establish standardized demand libraries, and prioritize requirements to improve iteration efficiency and user value.
  • Cross-team Collaboration: Cooperate with algorithm, development, test and business teams to clarify product requirements, solve project issues, coordinate resources and ensure high-quality product delivery on schedule.
  • Data-driven Iteration: Build product operation indicator systems, monitor product usage, user satisfaction and algorithm performance, and continuously optimize product functions, models and user experience.
  • Compliance Control: Ensure all product functions and data processing comply with financial industry supervision, data security and enterprise financial management norms to avoid compliance risks.
  • Value Operation: Support product promotion and client delivery, sort out value cases, and promote commercialization and scaled application of financial AI products to reduce corporate financial costs and improve operational efficiency.

Job Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science or related majors; 2+ years of product experience in financial AI, fintech or enterprise financial SaaS with mature product landing cases.
  • Business Capability: Proficient in full-link enterprise financial processes (expense management, accounting, reconciliation, settlement, analysis, audit and risk control), able to independently mine demands and design business scenarios.
  • AI Product Competency: Familiar with underlying AI technologies including LLM and machine learning; capable of designing financial AI solutions and cooperating with algorithm teams for model optimization.
  • Professional Skills: Skilled in product tools (Axure, Xmind, Visio) and standardized PRD writing; familiar with agile development workflow.
  • Comprehensive Quality: Strong data sensitivity and logical thinking; excellent cross-team communication, project management and problem-solving skills; rigorous, responsible and able to work under pressure.
  • Language: Proficient in English reading and writing is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in well-known fintech companies, enterprise SaaS platforms or financial AI digital transformation projects.
  • Possess CPA, ACCA, CMA or other professional financial certificates, with financial audit or management experience.
  • Practical experience in large model application in finance, such as document parsing, financial text analysis, intelligent Q&A and automated report generation.
  • Independent experience in full-lifecycle delivery of core financial AI products with verifiable business results.

title: Solutions Architect

title: Databricks Engineer
description:

Location – Remote

Working Hours - 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST

About Fluidata

Fluidata Analytics is an AI-native data and analytics firm. We design and run data systems for clients across 8 industries and 5 continents, turning messy operational data into insights leaders can act on — spanning data engineering, analytics, automation, and AI.

Our team is made up of people who learn fast, build with intention, and work directly on challenges that shape how organizations operate and make decisions.


About the Role

We're looking for a Databricks Engineer to build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, Python, and SQL. Because we work across multiple clients, you'll work with different cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP depending on the engagement) and different orchestration tools — so adaptability across environments matters as much as depth in any one stack. The role covers large datasets, cloud data platforms, and end-to-end data engineering workflows.


Job Description

  • Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models using Databricks and PySpark.
  • Develop data transformations and processing workflows using Python and SQL.
  • Work with Delta Lake and lakehouse architecture.
  • Design and maintain data models and data marts for analytics.
  • Optimize Spark jobs and SQL queries for performance and scalability.
  • Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Work across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) depending on the client engagement.
  • Use Databricks Workflows, Airflow, or similar tools for orchestration, depending on the client's stack.
  • Manage pipeline code through Git-based version control and CI/CD workflows.
  • Collaborate with analytics, BI, and engineering teams — and directly with international clients — to deliver end-to-end data solutions.


Required Skills

Must-have

  • 3–5 years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
  • Proficiency in PySpark, Python, and SQL.
  • Professional services client-facing experience and strong communication skills
  • Experience with lakehouses
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data modelling.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — comfort picking up a second is a plus given our multi-client environment.
  • Experience with Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or similar orchestration tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with international (primarily US) clients and adapting to a partial evening-hours overlap.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or similar data governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD for data pipelines (e.g., Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform).
  • Exposure to Structured Streaming or real-time data pipelines.
  • Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional).


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote work setup.
  • Daily collaboration and guidance from the management team.
  • Competitive compensation packages that reward high performance.
  • Exciting career growth paths and a supportive culture that facilitates continuous learning.
  • Collaborative team-based environment.
  • Prominent client base and existing high-value relationships.
  • Best-in-class team of consultants to work alongside you.

title: Data Center Regional Engineer - Electrical, Colo Regional Engineering at Sourceo
description:
Apply for Data Center Regional Engineer - Electrical, Colo Regional Engineering at Sourceo in Auckland City, N, NZ.

This Full time on site position offers great opportunities for career growth. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We have an immediate opening for an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer in Auckland. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

As an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams. Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

As an ideal candidate you:

  • Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty
  • Are detail and data oriented
  • Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
  • Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction and Design)
  • Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

Key job responsibilities

  • Work with colo vendors to review the design for new Data Centers in your region, including design input, submittal review and incorporating AWS products to ensure the design is meeting AWS expectations.
  • Act as resident engineer during new colo construction projects.
  • Support construction, commissioning, and handover.
  • Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
  • Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including essential equipment, and event support.
  • Provide technical support to the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
  • Supporting operating partners to lead, review, and approve designs for existing co-location (colo) data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
  • Interface with operating partners, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered by operating partners.
  • Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
  • Initiate and lead engineering site audits within leased or colo data centers.
  • Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation's.

A day in the life

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • NETA or ASHRAE certification or commissioning specific education courses
  • Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
  • Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

title: Coördinator medische instrumentatie
description:
Ben jij technisch onderlegd, organisatorisch sterk en krijg je energie van het verbeteren van processen? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige en betrouwbare medische technologie én meebouwen aan de zorg van de toekomst? Lees dan verder!

Als coördinator Medische Instrumentatie zorg je dat de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen het team goed verlopen en medische apparatuur veilig en betrouwbaar wordt ingezet. Je geeft operationeel leiding, stemt werkzaamheden af en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor collega’s bij vragen en problemen.

Daarnaast kijk je continu waar het beter of slimmer kan. Je optimaliseert werkprocessen en systemen, bijvoorbeeld rondom patiëntbewaking en DORA, ondersteunt bij VIM-meldingen, aanschafdossiers en voert veiligheidsrondes in het ziekenhuis uit. Ook houd je procesdocumentatie op orde, draag je bij aan ziekenhuisbrede procedures en de implementatie van de Leidraad Medische Technologie. Ad-hocvragen en vraagstukken rondom medische apparatuur pak je vanzelfsprekend ook op.

Je komt terecht in het team Medische Instrumentatie met 10 collega’s. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat medische apparatuur beschikbaar, veilig en betrouwbaar is voor patiënten en zorgprofessionals. Je hebt veel contact met collega’s binnen en buiten de afdeling en hebt korte lijnen met het team Klinische Fysica, bestaande uit 2 klinische fysici, 1 biomedisch technoloog en 3 klinisch fysisch medewerkers.

Bovendien kom je op een interessant moment binnen. Een deel van onze medische apparatuur is de komende jaren aan vervanging toe. Dat brengt volop nieuwe vraagstukken en projecten met zich mee. Van patiëntbewaking tot robotica: je krijgt de kans om mee te denken over technologie die de zorg mogelijk maakt.

Reinier de Graaf heeft een duidelijke ambitie op het gebied van innovatie. Zo werken we met operatierobots en ontwikkelen we binnen Kliniek van de Toekomst nieuwe manieren om de zorg slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren. Ook werken we nauw samen met onder andere de TU Delft om technologie en zorg met elkaar te verbinden.

Kortom: een veelzijdige rol waarin je zorgt dat de techniek vandaag goed werkt én meebouwt aan de medische technologie van morgen.

Wij vragen

    • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een technische of zorg gerelateerde richting zoals gezondheidszorg technologie;
    • Enige werkervaring is een pre, maar niet vereist;
    • Je hebt aantoonbare affiniteit met techniek en zorg.

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van coördinator medische instrumentatie? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Margo Terhorst-de Roos, recruiter.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Anna Arnout, Teamleider Medische Instrumentatie & Proces Management Team [015 260 44 98] helpt je graag.

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Margo via 06 - 22 208 962.

Solliciteren kan tot en met 4 oktober. Wacht echter niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum: je sollicitatie wordt direct in behandeling genomen. Mochten we voor het bereiken van de sluitingsdatum een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden, dan sluiten we de vacature voortijdig.

title: Sr Engineer, IT Cybersecurity Data Protection [T500-29246]
description:
ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.

About American Airlines:

To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.

American Airlines is transforming the way it delivers technology to its customers and team members worldwide.

American’s Tech Hub in Hyderabad, India, is our latest technology office location and home to team members who drive technical innovation and engineer unrivalled digital products to best serve American’s customers and team members. With U.S. tech hubs in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas and Phoenix, Arizona, our new team in Hyderabad, India enables better support of our 24/7 operation and positions American to deliver industry-leading technology solutions that create a world-class customer experience.


INTRO:

Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise, and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop onboard!


WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB:

As one diverse, high performing team committed to technical excellence, you’ll help shape the modern cybersecurity capabilities that drive a more reliable, safe, and profitable airline. The Cybersecurity Technology Services product group delivers comprehensive solutions, processes, and platforms that embed and monitor security across Cloud, Application, Endpoint / End User, Data, and AI domains. In this portfolio, you’ll help strengthen the safeguards that protect our systems, data, and people through consistent, scalable practices and deliver solutions that secure one of the world’s most complex global operations.

The Sr. Engineer - Data Protection plays a key role in delivering, engineering, and enhancing American Airlines’ data protection and privacy technology capabilities. In this role, you’ll design, build, and support core components of our data protection ecosystem including data security engineering and protection, privacy engineering and assurance, data discovery and classification, retention/ROT data minimization, and access governance. You’ll work closely with Cybersecurity, Privacy Office, Enterprise Data, Legal, and product and platform teams to implement scalable, modern controls that safeguard American Airlines’ critical information assets and enable secure, innovative business solutions. As a hands-on engineer, you will solve complex data protection challenges, automate controls, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our enterprise privacy and data protection program.

This list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non-essential job functions) that are not referenced. Management will modify the job or require other tasks be performed whenever it is deemed appropriate to do so, observing, of course, any legal obligations including any collective bargaining obligations.

  • Operationalize automated data discovery, classification, and inventory; apply sensitivity labels and consistent taxonomy across data stores, pipelines, and collaboration systems.
  • Engineer DSPM capabilities with tools (e.g., Securiti, BigID) to surface data posture risks (overexposure, shadow data, stale sensitive data) and drive remediation workflows.
  • Implement and support encryption, tokenization, masking, anonymization/pseudonymization for data at rest and in transit; integrate with cloud key management systems and enforce approved cryptographic standards; define crypto baselines and policy-as-code guardrails.
  • Configure and govern access controls with RBAC/ABAC and purpose-based authorization; perform least-privilege and fine-grained access reviews across data platforms.
  • Deploy, tune, and operate DLP and DAM solutions (e.g., Microsoft Purview DLP, Imperva/Guardium); build detections for PII/PCI/PHI and reduce false positives with policy and context improvements.
  • Integrate and tune UEBA and Insider Risk signals to detect anomalous data access and exfiltration, partner on response workflows and preventive control changes.
  • Integrate data protection telemetry with SIEM/SOAR; build detections, correlation rules, and automated response playbooks for data-related threats and policy violations.
  • Implement data minimization and retention/ROT enforcement patterns; automate monitoring of lifecycle actions (archive, delete, redact) aligned to policy and legal holds.
  • Implement DSAR (data subject access request) orchestration and fulfillment with SLA monitoring; automate data collection, redaction, and secure delivery with audit trails.
  • Contribute to cookie/tag governance and catalog assurance; validate consent signals, storage durations, and vendor script behavior against policy.
  • Support privacy platform capabilities and integrate with identity, ticketing, data catalogs/lineage, and evidence repositories.
  • Embed data protection and privacy-by-design controls into services and CI/CD (pre-commit/CI privacy code scanning, secret scanning, schema checks for sensitive fields, data egress policies).
  • Produce compliance evidence and reports for GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and internal audits; maintain controls health dashboards, regulatory tracking, and program KPIs.
  • Investigate data-related incidents and privacy events in partnership with IR/SOC/Privacy Office. Collect artifacts, support forensics, document findings, and drive preventive engineering fixes.
  • Conduct platform hardening and vulnerability remediation for data control tooling (misconfigurations, exposed buckets, weak crypto, excessive permissions).
  • Participate in red teaming/tabletop exercises for data scenarios (insider misuse, public link exposures, unintended AI training data); translate findings into control improvements.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity, Privacy Office, Enterprise Data, Legal, and product/platform teams to align designs and deliver privacy- and data protection-by-design outcomes.


ALL YOU’LL NEED FOR SUCCESS:

Minimum Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in data protection, privacy engineering, security engineering, or platform engineering roles.
  • Hands on experience implementing and operating data protection capabilities such as encryption at rest and in transit, cloud key management, data classification, DLP, DAM, or DSPM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access control patterns (RBAC/ABAC, least privilege access, access reviews) and secure data handling practices including classification, labeling, and retention/ROT.
  • Experience using scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) and working with APIs, logs, and CI/CD pipelines to integrate, operate, or enhance security controls.
  • Ability to analyze security signals and alerts, follow and improve runbooks, document findings clearly, and collaborate with cross functional teams to implement remediation and continuous improvements.

Preferred Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Assurance, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview (Information Protection & DLP), Securiti.ai, BigID, OneTrust, and DAM (Imperva/Guardium).
  • Exposure to Azure, AWS, or GCP security services and cloud data platforms (e.g., storage, databases, messaging/streaming).
  • Experience with Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, secrets scanning, and code scanning tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL, regex, and data transformation basics (e.g., dbt, Spark, ETL) for building detections and data handling checks.


Skills, Licenses & Certifications:

  • Programming / Scripting: Python, PowerShell (nice to have: Bash); strong facility with REST/JSON, YAML, and regex; specific to Privacy Portal - Java, Springboot, Angular/React.
  • Data / Querying: SQL (and exposure to data pipelines—dbt/Spark/ETL concepts helpful).
  • CI/CD & DevOps: Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps; artifact/versioning; secret scanning; pre-commit hooks; policy checks in pipelines.
  • Infrastructure / Policy as Code: Terraform or Bicep; OPA/Rego or equivalent for policy-as-code preferred.
  • Cloud & Crypto: Azure/AWS/GCP basics; Azure Key Vault, AWS KMS, GCP KMS; TLS/mTLS; tokenization; HSM fundamentals.
  • Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta; RBAC/ABAC; JIT/PAM concepts; purpose-based authorization patterns.
  • Data Protection Platforms: Microsoft Purview (Information Protection & DLP), Securiti.ai, BigID, OneTrust (consent/DSAR), Imperva or IBM Guardium (DAM).
  • Monitoring & Response: SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk), SOAR (Logic Apps, Splunk SOAR), ITSM/ticketing (ServiceNow/Jira); building detections and playbooks.
  • Insider Risk / UEBA & Collaboration: Microsoft Insider Risk, M365 collaboration safeguards (external sharing governance, link expiration, watermarking).
  • Web/App Privacy: CMP/consent signals, cookie/tag governance, data egress controls, redaction/watermarking where applicable.
  • Clear, well-structured documentation of engineering patterns, runbooks, and technical decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate requirements into maintainable controls, automations, and repeatable engineering patterns.
  • Privacy and security certifications such as CIPT, CDPSE, CIPP/US, CIPP/E, Security+, CCSP, or CISSP (CISSP relevant for Sr. Engineer).
  • Cloud certifications for Azure, AWS, or GCP at the associate or professional level.

title: Fleet Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

Under the direction of the Director of Clinical Logistics, the Fleet Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day management, maintenance coordination, readiness, and lifecycle support of Boston MedFlight’s ground vehicle fleet, including ambulances, support vehicles, and other assigned fleet assets.

The Fleet Specialist ensures that vehicles are safe, reliable, compliant, appropriately maintained, and available to support Boston MedFlight’s critical care transport mission. The position serves as the organization’s primary technical resource for ground fleet maintenance and works collaboratively with Clinical Logistics, Ground Operations, Safety, Facilities, Finance, Purchasing, and outside vendors.

The Fleet Specialist coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, vehicle inspections and repairs, fleet records, vendor services, parts and equipment inventories, vehicle acquisition and replacement activities, and fleet performance monitoring. The position utilizes fleet management systems, telematics, maintenance data, and operational feedback to identify trends, reduce vehicle downtime, control costs, and improve fleet reliability.

This is a hands-on position requiring independent judgment, technical problem-solving, field response, and occasional work outside normal business hours.

Essential Responsibilities:

A. Fleet Readiness and Maintenance

  1. Maintains operational readiness of Boston MedFlight ground ambulances, support vehicles, and other assigned fleet assets.
  2. Develops, coordinates, and monitors preventive maintenance schedules based on manufacturer recommendations, regulatory requirements, mileage, engine hours, vehicle utilization, and organizational experience.
  3. Coordinates routine and non-routine vehicle maintenance and repairs with internal stakeholders and outside service providers while minimizing operational downtime.
  4. Evaluates reported vehicle discrepancies and determines appropriate corrective action, including repair priority, vendor referral, removal from service, or return to service.
  5. Performs or coordinates vehicle inspections and minor maintenance, troubleshooting, adjustments, and repairs within the individual’s training, qualifications, and available resources.
  6. Coordinates response to urgent vehicle maintenance needs and breakdowns, including after-hours support when required.
  7. Works closely with Ground Operations and Clinical Logistics to ensure an appropriate number and distribution of vehicles are available to support scheduled and unscheduled operations.
  8. Reviews completed repairs and maintenance activities to verify that identified deficiencies have been appropriately addressed before vehicles are returned to service.

B. Fleet Management Systems, Records, and Data

  1. Maintains accurate and complete electronic maintenance records for each vehicle, including preventive maintenance, inspections, repairs, recalls, parts, tires, fuel, outside services, and associated costs.
  2. Routinely audits fleet maintenance records for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  3. Maintains and utilizes the organization’s Fleet Management Information System and other applicable fleet technology.
  4. Utilizes telematics, GPS, mileage, engine-hour, fuel, maintenance, and other available fleet data to monitor vehicle utilization and performance.
  5. Analyzes fleet data to identify maintenance trends, recurring mechanical issues, excessive idle time, abnormal operating costs, and opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency.
  6. Develops periodic fleet reports and provides performance, maintenance, cost, and vehicle availability information to the Director of Clinical Logistics and other organizational stakeholders.
  7. Ensures ground vehicle maintenance discrepancies reported through organizational safety or reporting systems are investigated, appropriately addressed, documented, and closed in a timely manner.

C. Vehicle Acquisition and Lifecycle Management

  1. Assists the Director of Clinical Logistics with short- and long-term fleet planning, including vehicle acquisition, replacement, refurbishment, reassignment, and disposal.
  2. Monitors vehicle age, mileage, maintenance history, reliability, operating costs, utilization, and condition to support evidence-based replacement recommendations.
  3. Assists in developing technical specifications for new ambulances and support vehicles based upon operational requirements, safety, reliability, maintainability, lifecycle cost, and regulatory requirements.
  4. Participates in vehicle selection, specification development, vendor meetings, pre-build planning, inspections, acceptance, commissioning, and deployment of new vehicles.
  5. Evaluates new vehicle technologies, products, equipment, and maintenance practices that may improve safety, reliability, efficiency, sustainability, or lifecycle cost.
  6. Maintains appropriate documentation regarding warranties, recalls, service campaigns, vehicle titles/registrations, and other fleet-related records as assigned.

D. Regulatory Compliance and Safety

  1. Ensures Boston MedFlight ground vehicles remain compliant with applicable federal and state requirements governing ground medical transportation and motor vehicle operations.
  2. Ensures fleet vehicles and associated maintenance practices support applicable organizational certification and accreditation requirements.
  3. Works collaboratively with the Safety Department to ensure vehicle maintenance activities, work areas, equipment, and practices comply with applicable OSHA and organizational safety requirements.
  4. Maintains awareness of applicable DOT, environmental, occupational safety, and other regulations affecting fleet operations.
  5. Monitors manufacturer recalls, technical service bulletins, safety notices, and other vehicle-related advisories and coordinates appropriate corrective actions.
  6. Identifies fleet-related safety risks and assists in developing corrective actions, policies, procedures, or equipment modifications to reduce risk.
  7. Participates in the review of vehicle incidents or mechanical failures when requested and assists with identifying contributing mechanical or maintenance factors.

E. Vendors, Parts, Inventory, and Cost Control

  1. Serves as the primary day-to-day liaison with vehicle dealerships, repair facilities, ambulance manufacturers, parts suppliers, towing providers, tire vendors, and other fleet-related service providers.
  2. Obtains and evaluates estimates and repair recommendations and assists with determining the most appropriate and cost-effective repair strategy.
  3. Monitors vendor performance, repair quality, turnaround time, warranty coverage, and service costs.
  4. Maintains appropriate inventories of commonly required vehicle parts, fluids, tires, tools, and maintenance supplies necessary to support fleet operations.
  5. Tracks fleet expenditures including maintenance, repairs, parts, tires, fuel, towing, and outside services.
  6. Assists the Director of Clinical Logistics with development of the annual fleet operating and capital budget.
  7. Monitors expenditures against approved budgets and identifies significant variances, emerging repair trends, or anticipated capital needs.
  8. Identifies opportunities to reduce operating costs without compromising vehicle safety, reliability, or operational readiness.

F. Fuel, Utilization, and Fleet Efficiency

  1. Monitors vehicle fuel consumption and related expenses and identifies unusual consumption patterns or opportunities for improved efficiency.
  2. Reviews vehicle utilization to identify underutilized or overutilized assets and supports appropriate fleet distribution.
  3. Utilizes available fleet data to evaluate idle time, mileage, maintenance cost per vehicle, downtime, and other key fleet performance indicators.
  4. Supports organizational sustainability initiatives by evaluating fuel-efficient practices, alternative-fuel technologies, electrification, and other emerging fleet technologies when operationally appropriate.

G. Departmental and Organizational Support

  1. Functions as the primary fleet subject-matter resource within the Clinical Logistics Department.
  2. Works collaboratively with other Clinical Logistics personnel to coordinate vehicle availability with equipment, supply, and operational requirements.
  3. Provides technical guidance to staff regarding vehicle condition, maintenance needs, vehicle equipment, and appropriate reporting of mechanical concerns.
  4. Assists with development and revision of fleet-related policies, procedures, inspection processes, and maintenance standards.
  5. Participates in departmental and organizational meetings and provides fleet-related updates as requested.
  6. Supports special projects involving vehicle configuration, equipment mounting, storage solutions, vehicle modifications, and other operational improvements.
  7. Maintains professional relationships with internal customers, external vendors, regulatory agencies, and other organizational partners.
  8. Models compliance with Boston MedFlight safety and operational policies and adheres to the Boston MedFlight Code of Conduct.
  9. Performs other duties and Clinical Logistics projects as assigned by the Director of Clinical Logistics.

IV. SKILLS AND ABILITIES

A. Working knowledge of automotive maintenance principles and the mechanical, electrical, electronic, and related systems found in modern light-, medium-, and/or heavy-duty vehicles.

B. Knowledge of preventive maintenance principles, vehicle inspection practices, repair processes, and fleet lifecycle management.

C. Experience with computerized Fleet Management Information Systems or similar maintenance-management software.

D. Ability to utilize telematics, maintenance records, fuel information, and other fleet data to identify trends and support operational decisions.

E. Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to evaluate vehicle problems and communicate effectively with technicians, vendors, and operational personnel.

F. Ability to independently prioritize multiple maintenance issues and projects based upon safety, operational need, cost, and vehicle availability.

G. Strong organizational, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

H. Ability to maintain accurate technical, maintenance, inventory, regulatory, and financial records.

I. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, and ability to prepare reports and analyze fleet-related data.

J. Strong oral and written communication skills and ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

K. Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with employees, vendors, manufacturers, repair facilities, and other organizational partners.

L. Ability to work independently with limited supervision while functioning effectively as part of the Clinical Logistics team.

M. Ability to exercise sound independent judgment in situations affecting vehicle safety and operational readiness.

N. Must be available for occasional after-hours response or consultation for urgent fleet maintenance issues.

O. Must possess predictable weekday availability and be able to travel between Boston MedFlight locations and outside service facilities as required.

V. QUALIFICATIONS

Required

A. High school diploma or equivalent.

B. Demonstrated experience in automotive, truck, emergency vehicle, fleet maintenance, transportation operations, or a closely related field.

C. Working knowledge of gasoline and/or diesel vehicle systems and automotive electrical and mechanical systems.

D. Experience coordinating vehicle preventive maintenance, repair, or fleet operations.

E. Valid driver’s license with driving record acceptable to Boston MedFlight’s insurance requirements.

F. Demonstrated ability to use computerized maintenance, fleet, inventory, or related information systems.

Preferred:

A. Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in automotive technology, fleet management, transportation, logistics, mechanical/automotive engineering, business, or a related field.

B. Five or more years of progressively responsible experience involving fleet maintenance, vehicle repair, emergency vehicles, or related operations.

C. Experience with ambulance, emergency vehicle, commercial truck, or specialty vehicle maintenance.

D. ASE, emergency vehicle technician (EVT), Certified Automotive Fleet Manager (CAFM), or comparable professional certification.

E. EMT certification or previous EMS/public-safety experience.

F. Experience with fleet telematics, GPS systems, vehicle data systems, or fleet performance analytics.

G. Experience participating in vehicle specification, procurement, upfitting, commissioning, or replacement projects.

H. Certified Emergency Vehicle Operator Instructor, preferable.

VI. WORKING CONDITIONS / PHYSICAL DEMANDS

A. Ability to lift and carry at least 50 pounds using proper body mechanics.

B. Ability to bend, stoop, crouch, kneel, climb, reach, and work in and around vehicles as necessary to perform inspections and maintenance-related activities.

C. Ability to safely work from ladders, approved maintenance stands, or elevated work surfaces when required.

D. Work may occur indoors and outdoors and may involve exposure to temperature extremes, precipitation, vehicle exhaust, fumes, oils, grease, fuels, cleaning agents, and other materials associated with vehicle maintenance.

E. Works in and around EMS vehicles and may be exposed to noise, vibration, non-conventional motion, and patient-care environments.

F. Appropriate personal protective equipment must be utilized as required by the task and organizational policy.

G. Position may require sitting, standing, driving, or working at a computer for extended periods.

H. Position requires travel between Boston MedFlight bases, vendor locations, repair facilities, and other operational sites.

I. Position is subject to occasional call-out or consultation outside normal working hours for urgent fleet-related operational needs.


VII. PHYSICAL EXAM / CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

A. Boston MedFlight employment physical and required periodic examinations.

B. Massachusetts CORI and FBI background checks will be performed prior to employment.

C. Driving record must meet applicable Boston MedFlight requirements for operation of organizational vehicles.

title: #PE Software Engineer
location: Santa Clara, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

***This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.***

Are you excited about developing advanced GNSS and positioning technologies that power billions of devices worldwide?

Qualcomm's Location Technology Team is looking for highly motivated software engineers to design and deliver next-generation positioning solutions for future wireless platforms. Qualcomm's advanced GNSS and location technologies are deeply integrated into our chipsets and enable accurate, reliable, and power-efficient positioning across mobile, wearable, automotive, IoT, and other connected platforms.

As a GNSS Positioning Engine Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, testing, and optimization of Qualcomm's core GNSS Positioning Engine. The Positioning Engine is responsible for transforming GNSS measurements and sensor inputs into high-accuracy Position, Velocity, and Time (PVT) solutions used across Qualcomm platforms.

You will work closely with GNSS systems, measurement engine, sensor, hardware, software, and test teams to develop and commercialize state-of-the-art positioning technologies that deliver industry-leading location performance. The role also leverages modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, including large language models (LLMs) and coding assistants such as Claude, Codex, and similar technologies, to improve software development productivity, code quality, debugging efficiency, data analysis, and system performance optimization.

Role Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and optimization of real-time embedded GNSS positioning software.

Key responsibilities include:

Design, develop, review, and maintain production-quality GNSS Positioning Engine software in C/C++. Implement and optimize GNSS positioning algorithms, including Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filtering (KF/EKF), and Position/Velocity/Time (PVT) estimation. Develop algorithms and software for processing GNSS measurements, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier-phase, satellite ephemeris, clock, atmospheric, and other measurement corrections. Develop and optimize GNSS/INS and multi-sensor fusion algorithms using inertial sensors and other positioning technologies.
Contribute to advanced positioning technologies including multi-frequency GNSS, hybrid positioning, sensor-assisted navigation, AI/ML-enhanced positioning solutions and emerging XR use cases.
Work closely with GNSS systems engineers to translate positioning algorithms and system concepts into efficient, robust, production-quality embedded software. Collaborate with the GNSS Measurement Engine team to consume and process GNSS observables and optimize end-to-end positioning performance. Develop robust algorithms for satellite selection, measurement weighting, outlier detection and rejection, fault detection, integrity monitoring, and positioning error mitigation. Analyze and improve positioning accuracy, availability, robustness, convergence time, and reliability under challenging GNSS environments including urban canyons, indoor, and high-dynamic scenarios. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level positioning and performance issues using GNSS measurements, logs, simulations, and field-test data. Develop software within a real-time, multi-threaded embedded architecture, including inter-process communication and multiple software and firmware interfaces. Contribute to software architecture, interface design, design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, and development methodology. Optimize positioning software for CPU/MIPS utilization, memory footprint, latency, and power efficiency.
Work closely with systems, software, firmware, hardware, validation, and product teams to commercialize positioning technologies across Qualcomm platforms.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of GNSS positioning fundamentals, navigation algorithms, and PVT estimation.
  • Experience with Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filters (KF/EKF), estimation theory, statistical signal processing, or optimization techniques.
  • Experience implementing GNSS positioning and navigation algorithms in embedded or real-time software systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, or similar technologies) for coding, debugging, performance analysis, test automation, and engineering productivity is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier phase, satellite clock and orbit errors, ionosphere, troposphere, multipath, and receiver measurement errors.
  • Experience with GNSS/INS integration and multi-sensor fusion.
  • Familiarity with GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, and multi-frequency GNSS.
  • Experience with robust estimation, measurement weighting, outlier rejection, integrity monitoring, and fault detection techniques.
  • Knowledge of RTK, PPP, carrier-phase positioning, or other precise positioning technologies.
  • Understanding of navigation filter tuning, covariance modeling, uncertainty estimation, and performance characterization.
  • Experience analyzing GNSS logs, measurement data, simulation outputs, and large-scale field-test datasets.
  • Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), multi-threaded software architectures, and ARM-based development/debugging.
  • Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as TRACE32.
  • Experience using MATLAB, Python, or Perl for algorithm development, simulation, automation, and data analysis.
  • Experience optimizing embedded software for computational complexity, memory usage, latency, and power consumption.
  • Ability to understand the end-to-end GNSS receiver and positioning architecture, from measurement generation through the final position solution.
  • Familiarity with Android location architecture, mobile positioning systems, or connected-device location technologies.
  • Experience applying AI/ML techniques to positioning, navigation, or sensor fusion problems is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across software, systems, and test teams.

Why Join Qualcomm Location Technology?

Qualcomm's GNSS and positioning technologies power devices used by billions of consumers worldwide. Our innovations enable navigation, fitness tracking, emergency services, automotive applications, wearables, and emerging location-based experiences across a wide range of connected platforms.

As part of the Location Technology Team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge positioning solutions, collaborate with leading experts in GNSS and navigation technologies, and help shape the future of location experiences for next-generation wireless products.

title: Lead Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

Interim housing sites run 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The quality of each shift depends a lot on who is leading it. The Lead Client Services Monitor (LCSM)holds the floor. Acting as a leader, collaborator, and an important voice into continuous process improvement.

Reporting to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager, the LCSM is the on-shift leader for Client Service Monitors across assigned Hope the Mission interim housing sites. This role makes sure that safety protocols, wellness checks, documentation, and site procedures are followed consistently every single shift — and is the first to respond when they aren't. The LCSM leads by example and acts as a bridge between non-management, management, and site operations. When an incident happens, when a participant escalates, when a staff member needs guidance in the moment, the LCSM handles it until a manager arrives or the situation is resolved.

The persons in our interim housing communities deserve consistency at every hour of the day. This role is how that consistency gets delivered.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Shift Leadership & Site Operations

  • Serve as the on-shift lead for all Client Service Monitors; provide real-time direction, guidance, and support throughout the shift

  • Complete required wellness checks, site walk-throughs, and safety protocols every shift without exception

  • Monitor site activity and address safety concerns, policy violations, and operational issues as they arise

  • Maintain heightened attention in high-traffic or high-risk areas of the site during assigned shifts

  • Conduct pass-down huddles at shift transitions to ensure clear communication and operational continuity

  • Communicate shift updates, incidents, and follow-up needs to site leadership and incoming shift staff

Incident Response & Emergency Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incidents, participant escalations, and emergencies during the shift

  • Manage emergency situations — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive and assume command

  • Ensure all incidents are documented accurately, completely, and submitted on time in accordance with agency protocols

Documentation & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of Daily Activity Reports (DARs) and all other required shift documentation

  • Enforce compliance with agency policies including incident reporting, contraband control, and infection control protocols

Staff Development & Support

  • Model trauma-informed, harm-reduction, and professional conduct at all times

  • Assist with onboarding, training, and coaching of new Client Service Monitors

  • Support schedule coverage, shift coordination, and staff accountability as directed by management

  • Collaborate with case management and leadership staff to support participant safety and stability

Other General Duties

  • Provide leadership coverage during evenings, weekends, and holidays as scheduled

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Skills

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills

  • Excellent situational awareness and crisis response abilities

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation skills

  • Ability to coach, guide, and support frontline staff

  • Strong organizational and documentation skills

  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-stress situations

  • Proficiency with basic computer systems and documentation tools

  • Ability to lead with integrity; upholding organizational mission and values.

  • Working knowledge of evidence-based service delivery models, including Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, Housing First, and Trauma-Informed Care.

  • Strong Emotional Intelligence, Emotional Resilience, and sensitivity towards individuals experiencing hardship.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Minimum of one (1) year experience as a Client Service Monitor or similar role preferred

  • Prior lead, supervisory, or shift-lead experience strongly preferred

  • Knowledge of interim housing operations, safety protocols, and trauma-informed care

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Must maintain proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

title: Artificial Intelligence Researcher Engineer
description:
AI Research Engineer (PhD)


MITO AI · United Kingdom (Remote) · Open to Europe


AI Research Engineer (PhD) — Generative & Multimodal AI for Creative Production

Location: Remote (UK) — open to Europe, especially Madrid | Experience Level: Mid-Senior (PhD graduate or experienced Research Engineer)


About MITO AI


MITO AI is a collaborative, AI-native platform reinventing how films, commercials, and music videos are made. We are building the operating system for a $300B+ global video production industry shifting to AI-native workflows.


MITO brings together state-of-the-art AI models for image, video, and audio with professional-grade agentic editing tools in a multiplayer, browser-based canvas. Director, MITO's AI agent, helps brands, agencies, and creators plan, generate, organise, and refine work across a whole project.


MITO was founded by Iñaki Berenguer (MIT, PhD Cambridge, 5x founder — Pixable acquired by SingTel, CoverWallet $300M exit, iPronics $50M raised), Danny Saltaren (product designer at 2 unicorns, National Design Award), and Arantxa Barcia (award-winning filmmaker).

We are backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Bessemer Venture Partners, and other investors including Kibo Ventures, Kfund, Sequoia and a16z scouts, LifeX, Everywhere, 5 unicorn founders, and execs from GitHub and Roblox.


The Role:


This is MITO's first AI Research Engineer hire. You will have responsibility for both the idea and its implementation — investigating recent advances in AI, designing rigorous experiments, developing new approaches when existing methods fall short, and building the systems that bring successful results into the product.


The role combines real research with real engineering. You will prototype new approaches, evaluate whether they work, and ship the ones that do. You will work closely with MITO's VP of AI with meaningful autonomy and genuine input into what we work on — shaped by product priorities and by what we learn from the filmmakers and creators using MITO every day.


We welcome candidates at different career stages, from recent PhD graduates with strong engineering skills to experienced Research Engineers. We will adjust the scope and level of the role to match the right person.


Key Responsibilities:


Research & Engineering Ownership

  • Own research and engineering projects that improve the quality, capability, control, and reliability of MITO's AI systems.
  • Develop and test new approaches, then turn successful results into working product improvements.
  • Assess new models and methods against real creative needs and integrate the ones that provide clear value.


Evaluation & Infrastructure

  • Design experiments and benchmarks to understand system behaviour — and build the evaluation infrastructure, datasets, tests, and human-review processes that make AI behaviour measurable and failures reproducible.
  • Use product behaviour, user feedback, and recurring failures to identify the most impactful areas for improvement.
  • Build data and experimentation systems that support faster, more reliable iteration.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with engineers, product teams, filmmakers, designers, and users to define success and deliver improvements.
  • Communicate results clearly — in writing and in conversation — so that research findings translate into product decisions.


About You:


IMPORTANT: This is not a role for ML engineers who have run training jobs but haven't done research. We need someone who can design experiments, interpret results carefully, and know the difference between a result that holds and one that doesn't.

  • Research foundation: A PhD in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer vision, or a related field.
  • Engineering depth: Strong ability to turn research ideas into working, scalable systems — not just notebooks.
  • Experimental rigour: Evaluation design, ablations, error analysis, and careful interpretation of results are how you work, not afterthoughts.
  • Production experience: You have shipped and operated AI or machine learning systems in production, not just in research settings.
  • Technical fluency: Python and at least one of PyTorch or JAX. Good software engineering practices: testing, version control, reproducibility, maintainable code.
  • Independence: You can drive a project from problem definition to deployed improvement, and you know when to ask for input.


The role spans several areas. We do not expect depth in all of them — but you should bring real depth in at least one, and the curiosity and ability to learn the others: video generation, video understanding, or computer vision; diffusion models, flow-matching models, or multimodal transformers; multimodal representation learning, cross-modal retrieval, or personalisation in generative AI systems; evaluating image, video, and audio outputs where quality depends on human judgement; fine-tuning, post-training, or training generative, multimodal, reward, or evaluation models; distributed training, model serving, or inference optimisation.


Also useful: experience building AI products or creative tools for filmmakers or designers; Java or TypeScript (our product stack).


Compensation & Perks:


  • Work on hard AI problems that arise from real creative production — not synthetic benchmarks.
  • Take ideas from experiment through to implementation and see how they perform with professional filmmakers using the product.
  • Broad exposure to generative and multimodal models, methods, and tools at the frontier.
  • Substantial ownership from day one — this is the first research hire, and what you build shapes the function.
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • Remote from the UK or Europe — we have a strong presence in Madrid and welcome candidates based there.


How to Apply:

Send us your CV alongside examples of your research and engineering work: publications, research projects, open-source contributions, prototypes, or deployed systems. We want to understand what you have built and how you think — not just where you have worked.


MITO AI — www.mito.ai

title: Myyjä (15 h/vko) K-Citymarket Helsinki Columbus
description:
Olet sitten kokenut asiakkaiden hurmaaja tai hyvällä palveluasenteella varustettu tulevaisuuden osaaja - Tervetuloa tekijöiden taloon!

Haemme nyt myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen K-Citymarket Helsinki Columbuksen kassaosastolle.

Tutustu tavarataloomme!

Asiakaskuntamme on laaja ja meidän valikoimastamme löytyy jokaiselle jotain. Täällä tehdään töitä yhteen hiileen puhaltaen ja ollaan aina valmiita auttamaan toisiamme.

Tiimimme on monipuolinen ja meillä sinut otetaan vastaan juuri sellaisena kuin olet. Täällä sinua odottaa reilun 20 työkaverin tuki.

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä on työporukka, jossa viihdytään oikeasti – ei vaan puheen tasolla vaan se myös näkyy arjessa ja henkilöstötutkimus osoittaa, että meillä on hyvä tehdä töitä. Yhdessä tuumin jaetaan onnistumiset ja ratkotaan haasteet. Me huolehdimme, että pääset porukkaan ja sujuvasti alkuun. Sinä tuot asenteen ja me perehdytämme. Esihenkilösi onkin aidosti arjessa läsnä. Hän sparraa, kuuntelee ja tukee kehittymistäsi. Palkitsemme myös säännöllisesti tekijöitämme ja tiimejämme.

Olet avainasemassa kaupan menestyksessä.

Työssäsi kassalla usein juuri sinä olet viimeinen, jonka asiakas kohtaa. Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että mukaan tarttuu hyvä fiilis ja ilahduttava muistijälki - siksi juuri sinun roolisi on erityisen merkityksellinen ja pääset vaikuttamaan asiakkaidemme arkeen. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asiakkaiden huomiointi ja tervehtiminen, sekä ostosten ja maksutapahtumien käsittely sujuvasti ja huolellisesti linja- tai itsepalvelukassalla. Huolehdit, että asiakas saa kaikki edut, tuotteet ovat siististi esillä ja kaupassa on viihtyisää.

Meille on tärkeää, että teemme kaupassa tiivistä yhteistyötä yli osastorajojen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että osastotyöstä riennetään apuun kassalle ruuhka-aikana ja kassalta autetaan taas osastotyötä tekeviä, jotta saamme pikaisesti upeat uutuudet esiin kuormasta ilahduttamaan asiakkaitamme.

Nämä taidot tukevat onnistumistasi

  • Sydämesi sykkii asiakaspalvelulle -haluat tarjota parhaan mahdollisen asiointikokemuksen jokaiselle asiakkaalle
  • Asiakasmäärämme ovat ajoittain suuria, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, huolellisuutta ja reipasta työotetta
  • Olet valmis käärimään hihat ja oppimaan uutta. Aiempi kokemus samankaltaisista tehtävistä on plussaa
  • Pystyt työskentelemään kaupan aukioloaikoina ja olet vähintään 18 vuotta
  • Kykenet työskentelemään suomeksi

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta .

Mitä saat meiltä?

  • Mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön, joka auttaa ja tukee arjessa
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä oman kummi KAMU:n, joka auttaa sinua ja huolehtii, että pääset osaksi porukkaamme ja työssäsi hyvin alkuun
  • Monipuolisia kaupan eri tehtäviä. Meillä voit rakentaa pitkänkin uran ja tuemme sinua osaamisesi kehittämisessä
  • Kaupan TES:n mukaisen palkan + ilta- ja viikonloppulisät
  • Sinulla on mahdollisuus vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon sekä palkitsemme säännöllisesti erilaisista hyvistä suorituksista pienemmillä palkinnoilla
  • Suomen Aktiivisimpana työpaikkana tarjoamme HeiaHeia-hyvinvointiapin ja erilaisia liikuntahaasteita
  • Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten henkilökunnan ostoedun K-ryhmän ketjuihin, ePassin, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Kattava työterveys pitää sinusta huolta.

Täytä hakemus järjestelmässämme hae tästä -painikkeen kautta ◾ Toivomme, että vastaat jo hakemusvaiheessa videokysymykseen ◾ Mahdollinen haastattelu tai rekrytointipäivä tavaratalossa ◾ Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin valintojen ja prosessin edetessä.

Huomioithan, että palkka määräytyy toimittamiesi työ- ja opintotodistusten perusteella. Varaudu toimittamaan ne prosessin aikana. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana ja voimme täyttää paikan ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä.
