title: AVP, Data Engineer (Information Security & Digital Risk Management)
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why Join

Join OCBC’s Group Information Security & Digital Risk Management team and contribute directly to strengthening the Bank’s information risk monitoring, analytics and control capabilities. This full-time Data Engineer role is hands-on and delivery-focused: you will build secure, reliable data pipelines and data products that enable actionable risk insights across the Group.

You will work with business, risk and technology stakeholders to transform structured and unstructured data into trusted, production-grade datasets and analytics solutions, while applying sound engineering practices in a regulated banking environment.

How You Succeed

You succeed by being a hands-on data engineering practitioner who can independently translate business and information risk requirements into robust, production-grade data engineering solutions.

Success in this role requires:

  • Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and near-real-time data ingestion, transformation and delivery.

  • Apply strong SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop and data modelling skills to solve practical information risk and analytics problems.

  • Use orchestration, scheduling and monitoring tools to ensure pipeline reliability, operational resilience and timely issue resolution.

  • Collaborate clearly with risk, business, technology, production support and platform teams across requirements, UAT, deployment and warranty support.

What You Do

Data Engineering Delivery

  • Responsible for developing and enhancing data pipelines and system architecture.

  • Create and maintain the optimal data pipeline to enable ingestion from a wide variety of structured and unstructured data sources via Talend.

  • Define and understand business requirements to develop and implement solutions.

  • Support development and deployment of applications utilising the data pipelines to provide actionable insights.

  • Involve in UAT execution with a focus on strategic testing processes and procedures to ensure that business standards and specifications are met.

  • Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery and cleansing/transformation.

  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders independently to drive key initiatives and projects.

Solutioning, Testing & Production Support

  • Translate business and information risk requirements into technical specifications, data models, pipeline design and implementation plans.

  • Support SIT, UAT, OAT and production verification, ensuring business standards, acceptance criteria and control expectations are met.

  • Own technical delivery through deployment, production onboarding, warranty support and issue resolution.

  • Maintain documentation for data lineage, transformation rules, operational procedures and support handover.

Information Security & Digital Risk Management

  • Support data-driven information risk initiatives, including staff abnormal activity monitoring, control analytics, risk indicators and management dashboards.

  • Embed secure-by-design and data governance practices into pipeline development, including access control, data handling, auditability and monitoring considerations.

  • Contribute to risk governance, control enhancements and regulatory-aligned reporting through reliable data engineering outputs.

  • Help convert information risk use cases into repeatable analytics assets, reusable data marts and sustainable operating processes.

Who You Are

Experience

  • Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, large-scale distributed data platforms, data warehousing, and analytics engineering.

  • Experience in risk management and project management will be advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in traditional structured database environments such as Teradata / Oracle, SQL and PL/SQL.

  • Fluent in the management of structured and unstructured data, as well as modern data transformation methodologies and tools such as DBT.

  • Proficient in Hadoop ecosystem components, including HIVE, Impala, HDFS, Spark, Scala and HBase.

  • Hands-on experience working on real-time data and streaming applications using Kafka or other similar tools.

  • Hands-on experience in automation process, including building procedures, ETL and automated job scheduling using data integration tools such as Talend.

Information Risk Knowledge

  • Good understanding of technology, information and data risk concepts.

  • Awareness of data security controls, including access control, encryption, data handling, auditability and data governance.

  • Familiarity with regulatory-aligned technology risk management, information security or operational risk reporting will be advantageous.

Competencies

  • Hands-on, analytical and comfortable solving complex data problems independently.

  • Strong attention to detail, with a reliability mindset for production-grade delivery.

  • Able to communicate technical topics clearly to business, risk and technology stakeholders.

  • Collaborative team player who can also take ownership and drive assigned deliverables end-to-end.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle.
  • Community initiatives.
  • Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:

Approaches challenges as opportunities to learn, improve, and help others grow.

title: Software Engineer - Data - Data Mesh & Lakehouse - barcelona
description:
Software Engineer - Data | Data Mesh & Lakehouse

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer - Data to join a central Data Delivery team building the foundation of a global Data Mesh platform based on a Lakehouse architecture.

You will work on the engineering layer responsible for ingesting, processing and provisioning source-aligned data products into central data catalogs, enabling teams across the organisation to consume trusted data for analytics, reporting, machine learning and other data-driven applications.

A key part of the platform is enabling scalable data consumption through zero-copy data sharing, while maintaining strong governance, security and data quality standards.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Design and build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines.
  • Develop ingestion solutions for source-aligned data products.
  • Work with Apache Spark and Databricks within a modern Lakehouse environment.
  • Implement data ingestion strategies including Full Loads, Delta Loads and Change Data Capture (CDC).
  • Build and maintain streaming pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Flink or Confluent.
  • Manage datasets stored across Google Cloud Storage and Azure Blob Storage.
  • Enable secure zero-copy data sharing through technologies such as Databricks Unity Catalog and BigQuery.
  • Implement data governance and access-control models including RBAC and attribute-based access control.
  • Design solutions capable of handling complex schema evolution, including backward and forward compatibility.

Tech Environment

Data & Processing: Apache Spark, Databricks, BigQuery

Streaming & Ingestion: Kafka, Flink, Confluent, Airbyte

Cloud & Storage: GCP, Google Cloud Storage, Azure, Azure Blob Storage

Orchestration & Platform: Airflow, Kubernetes

Governance: Databricks Unity Catalog, RBAC, ABAC/CBAC, Data Contracts

CI/CD: GitLab, Azure DevOps, JFrog Artifactory

Quality & Security: SonarQube, Snyk

What We're Looking For

  • Strong professional experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering focused on data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
  • Experience designing distributed data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Strong understanding of Lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience or strong knowledge of Data Mesh principles and Data Products.
  • Experience with batch and streaming ingestion patterns.
  • Knowledge of CDC and incremental data processing strategies.
  • Experience dealing with schema evolution in production data pipelines.
  • Understanding of modern data governance and access-control models.
  • Experience with Airflow, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively through code reviews and technical design discussions.

title: Skadereglerare Bygg & Företag
description:
Som skadereglerare inom Bygg & Företagsskador gör du skillnad för våra halländska kunder genom att hjälpa till när olyckan har varit framme. Du arbetar främst med skador som drabbat våra kunder inom företag och lantbruksverksamheten, men även med privatkunder.

Du är tryggheten som hjälper och stöttar våra halläningar som råkat ut för exempelvis en brand, vattenskada, stöld/inbrott eller maskinhaveri. Nu söker vi dig som vill förstärka vårt team.

Arbetsuppgifter
I arbetsuppgifterna ingår skadehantering, reglering och även besiktning av olika typer av bygg och företagsskador.Huvuddelen av arbetet sker inne på kontor och innebär mycket kundkontakt, via telefon och digitala kanaler, samt administrativt skaderegleringsarbete. Du kommer att driva skadorna från mottagande av anmälan till utbetalning och avslut.

Vid behov fungerar du som resurs inom övrig skadereglering på avdelningen

Vi ser att du har teknisk kunskap inom bygg och fastighetsbranschen, och har förståelse för hur företag/lantbruksverksamhet fungerar. Du har jobbat med försäkringsskador tidigare, gärna komplexa eller stora skador. Om du har kunskaper inom ekonomi, att kunna tolka bokslut och resultatrapporter är det meriterande.

Det är av stor vikt att du är lyhörd och har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift. Behärskar du något språk utöver svenska och engelska så är det meriterande.

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga! Som skadereglerare inom bygg och företagsskador ansvarar du för att driva dina skador framåt, du ingår i ett sammansvetsat team som tillsammans jobbar för att nå gruppens och bolagets övergripande mål. Det är viktigt att du är stresstålig och trygg i dig själv för att kunna fatta beslut och agera på ett positivt och kundvänligt sätt, i ett högt arbetstempo. För att trivas tycker du om förändring, har ett starkt självledarskap och förmågan att fatta genomtänkta beslut. Då rollen ställer stora krav på samarbetsförmåga och bra kommunikation är detta något som faller naturligt för dig. Vi förväntar oss att du har ett nyfiket och positivt förhållningssätt till nya arbetssätt liksom du förstår vikten av att löpande öka din digitala kompetens. Du är engagerad och har såväl kundens som LF Hallands intresse i fokus.

Du behöver vara engagerad, proaktiv och ta ansvar för att driva både din egen och gruppens utveckling framåt. Då rollen ställer stora krav på samarbetsförmåga och bra kommunikation är detta något som faller naturligt för dig. Vi förväntar oss att du har ett nyfiket och positivt förhållningssätt till förändringar och nya arbetssätt liksom du förstår vikten av att löpande öka din digitala kompetens.

Du driver ärenden självständigt så som person är du självgående, har ett strukturerat och systematiskt arbetssätt samt förmågan att ta egna initiativ.

Mer information

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning och är placerad på kontoret i Halmstad men innebär skaderegleringsarbete i hela länet.

Länsförsäkringar värdesätter de kvalitéer som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.

Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Fredrik Andersson, Chef Bygg- och Företagsskador, 035-15 04 28.
Facklig representant är Elin Westh, 035-15 10 54.

Vi vill ha din ansökan med CV samt personligt brev senast den 30 september.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

Location: London, UK

Department: DCS Delivery

Reports To: Senior Project Manager / Delivery Lead


Mission


The Project Manager is responsible for delivering allocated construction projects and project workstreams safely, efficiently, and in accordance with scope, programme, quality, and budget requirements while ensuring a positive customer experience.


As part of the DCS Delivery Team, the Project Manager supports the successful delivery of new-build data centre developments across Colt DCS's London Estate. Working alongside Senior Project Managers and cross-functional stakeholders, the role contributes to the execution of construction and infrastructure programmes through effective planning, coordination, governance, and risk management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day delivery of allocated projects, project phases, or workstreams from initiation through to handover and close-out.
  • Support Senior Project Managers in the delivery of large-scale data centre developments and infrastructure projects.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved safely, on time, and within budget.
  • Monitor project progress against programme, scope, cost, quality, and risk objectives.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of project execution plans, schedules, reporting, and governance requirements.
  • Identify project risks, issues, and opportunities and escalate where appropriate.
  • Support the management of contractors, consultants, suppliers, and vendors to ensure agreed deliverables are achieved.
  • Ensure compliance with Colt DCS policies, contractual obligations, and industry health and safety standards.
  • Review project documentation and support change management processes.
  • Contribute to cost management activities, including forecasting, budget tracking, and reporting.
  • Coordinate project meetings, maintain action trackers, and ensure timely resolution of project matters.
  • Support customer engagement activities, including fit-out coordination and project communications where required.
  • Contribute to project lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Build strong working relationships across the business to support successful project delivery.


Key Relationships


Internal

  • Cost Management & Commercial
  • DCS Procurement
  • DCS Design & Engineering
  • DCS Operations
  • Senior Project Managers


External

  • Design Consultants
  • Cost Management Consultants
  • Main Contractors
  • Suppliers and Vendors
  • Customers and Customer Representatives


Skills & Experience Required


  • Experience delivering construction projects, work packages, or major project phases, ideally within the data centre, mission-critical, or wider construction sector.
  • Good understanding of health and safety best practice within a construction environment.
  • Technical understanding of CSA, Mechanical and Electrical systems.
  • Experience working within Design & Build delivery models.
  • Understanding of project management principles across scope, cost, schedule, quality, and risk management.
  • Experience supporting project governance and project control processes.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
  • Experience preparing project reports, schedules, and progress updates.
  • Good commercial awareness, including budget monitoring and change management.
  • Experience working with contractors, consultants, and supply-chain partners.
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify risks and issues and support mitigation planning.
  • Experience working within technically complex engineering or infrastructure projects.
  • Knowledge of procurement and contract administration processes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within larger project teams.
  • Strong IT literacy, including Microsoft Excel, Project, Word, and PowerPoint.


Qualifications

  • Academic qualification in a relevant construction, engineering, project management, or built environment discipline.
  • Additional professional accreditation desirable but not required.


What We Offer


We provide development pathways, accreditation opportunities, and continuous learning to support employees in performing at their best. In addition to competitive salaries and incentive plans, Colt DCS offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to promote well-being and work-life balance.

title: Regional Planner
description:
Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods cost less for our customers, and less for the planet.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers.

At Einride Logistics, we aren’t just moving goods; we are re-engineering the very fabric of the supply chain. As a Regional Planner, you won't just be "dispatching" you will be the architect of a high-performance regional network. You will leverage Einride’s proprietary VRP (Vehicle Routing Problem) platform, AI-driven agents, and advanced data modeling to transform massive datasets into high-revenue, high-efficiency movements. We are looking for a tech-forward self-starter who thrives where data science meets operational executio

Core Responsibilities

1. Intelligent Network Orchestration
● AI-Driven Load Matching: Use our internal VRP platform and AI agents to manipulate large shipment datasets, identifying the most profitable loads and tenders for multiple ELI hubs.
● Revenue Chasing: Proactively hunt for high-yield freight to maximize the "yield per mile" across the regional network.
● Optimization: Balance "asset-based" capacity with brokerage opportunities, ensuring every mile driven contributes to the bottom line.

2. Tactical Forecasting & Balance
● Trend Prediction: Utilize historical data to forecast volume spikes and seasonal surges (e.g., retail peaks or harvest seasons).
● Network Equilibrium: Identify regional imbalances (truck surpluses vs. load deficits) and collaborate with the sales team to secure backhaul freight that repositions assets toward high-demand zones.

3. Execution & Driver Success
● Precision Planning: Assign loads based on real-time constraints, including Hours of Service (HOS), driver proximity, and home-time requirements.
● Deadhead Elimination: Relentlessly reduce "empty miles" through strategic routing and backhaul integration.
● Crisis Management: Act as the primary "re-planner" when variables change,
navigating equipment breakdowns, weather events, or port strikes with agile rerouting.

4. Carrier Procurement & Relations
● Strategic Sourcing: Identify and vet high-performance third-party carriers to
supplement our internal fleet.
● Negotiation: Master the spot market and contract rates to ensure brokered loads maintain healthy margins.
● Performance Analytics: Use data-driven scorecards to monitor carrier safety and on-time performance.

5. Systems & Data Integrity
● TMS Mastery: Maintain real-time accuracy within our TMS (Qargo), ensuring truck locations, driver status, and load updates are flawless.
● KPI Ownership: Monitor and report on critical health metrics, including Operating Ratio, Revenue per Mile, and Tender Acceptance Rates.

What You Bring to the Table:

The Mindset: A self-starter who treats their region like their own business. You are as comfortable talking to a driver as you are analyzing a spreadsheet.
The Tech Stack: Experience with modern TMS (Qargo preferred) and a high level of comfort using AI tools and algorithmic routing platforms.
The Skills: Strong understanding of logistics operations, HOS regulations, and freight pricing.
-Analytical prowess: The ability to see the "story" in the data and act on it.
-Negotiation chops: You know how to secure the best rates in a volatile market.
The Experience: 6+ years in regional planning, freight brokerage, or carrier operations optimization.

This is a onsite position on ELI Hubs, in Houston, Texas. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

This is a full-time onsite position based in Houston, Texas on the Eli Hubs. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

This is a hands-on position responsible for preparing and maintaining breakfast service, keeping food and beverage areas clean and organized, managing Treats inventory and merchandising, placing orders, receiving product, and providing friendly guest service.

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. System Engineer

  • Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to ensure the consistency and quality of the models and their alignment with the specifications and requirements

  • Contribute to the improvement of the modelling and simulation processes and tools and propose new solutions and best practices

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

  • 8-12 years of experience in SystemC/C++/C modelling and simulation

  • SystemC simulation tools and frameworks, such as TLM2.0, and SCV etc

  • Knowledge of hardware and software design and verification methodologies and standards

  • Experience in modelling and simulating complex systems, such as embedded systems, SoCs, or ASICs

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

title: Architectural Technologist & Project Coordinator
description:
Food Folk Nordic Development

Food Folk Nordic Development is looking for an Architectural Technologist & Project Coordinator to join our growing Nordic Development team.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with one of the world's most recognized brands, supporting restaurant development, remodeling projects, operational improvements, and sustainability initiatives across the Nordic region.

This is not a traditional architecture role focused on iconic buildings or conceptual design.

Instead, you will play a key role in helping us continuously improve and develop our restaurant portfolio by creating technical drawings, optimizing layouts, coordinating projects, and supporting the implementation of practical solutions that improve restaurant operations.

Success in this role is about understanding how restaurants function and translating operational requirements into efficient, buildable, and cost-effective solutions.

You will work closely with Development Managers, Construction Managers, Operations teams, Franchisees, Consultants, and Suppliers across the Nordic markets.

The role combines technical drawing, restaurant development, and project coordination, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both technical work and stakeholder management.

Architectural & Technical Design

  • Develop layout proposals for remodels, conversions, and operational improvement projects.
  • Translate operational requirements into optimal spatial and functional solutions.
  • Evaluate and improve existing layouts to support operational efficiency, customer flow, and restaurant performance.
  • Support feasibility studies and preliminary site planning.
  • Ensure compliance with McDonald's standards and local requirements.
  • Coordinate drawing packages with external consultants, architects, and contractors.

Restaurant Development & Optimization

  • Partner with Operations and Development teams to identify opportunities for improving restaurant layouts and functionality.
  • Solve complex planning and space utilization challenges within existing buildings.
  • Support restaurant modernization and reinvestment projects.
  • Balance operational, technical, financial, and construction-related requirements to achieve the best overall solution.

Project Coordination & Sustainability Initiatives

  • Coordinate development and improvement projects across the Nordic markets.
  • Support sustainability, energy, and equipment-related initiatives.
  • Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external stakeholders.
  • Obtain and compare quotations and support commercial negotiations.
  • Monitor project timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Drive projects from concept through implementation and follow-up.

Qualifications

Required

  • Degree in Architectural Technology, Building Design, Architecture, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong proficiency in ArchiCAD.
  • Experience producing technical drawings and documentation packages.
  • Strong coordination and organizational skills.
  • Practical problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred

  • Experience from restaurant, retail, hospitality, or commercial development projects.
  • Experience working with renovations, remodels, and existing buildings.
  • Understanding of sustainability and energy improvement initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating consultants, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Previous experience with McDonald's restaurant development is considered a strong advantage.

Who You Are

You are a practical and solution-oriented professional who enjoys finding the optimal solution within real-world constraints.

You understand that successful development projects require balancing operational needs, customer experience, technical requirements, timelines, and costs.

You enjoy working at the intersection of design, operations, and project coordination, and you thrive when collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders to deliver results.

Most importantly, you are motivated by improving how restaurants function rather than creating architectural statements.

What We Offer

  • A unique opportunity to work with one of the world's most recognized brands.
  • A broad and varied role combining technical design, restaurant development, and project coordination.
  • International collaboration across the Nordic region.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

title: Contractmanager beheer en onderhoud
description:
Maak impact als contractmanager: verbind belangen, houd regie en stuur complexe contracten naar het beste resultaat.

Werk om trots op te zijn

HHFM is dé landelijke dienstverlener van en voor ProRail op de gebieden facilitair management, huisvesting en vastgoed. Onze afdeling bestaat uit de teams Dienstverlening, Regie, Vastgoed & Huisvesting en Beleid & Kwaliteit.
De afdeling Human Facility Management is verantwoordelijk voor 40 locaties waar onze mensen werken op zowel kantoor als in 24/7 locaties. Daarin zijn een drietal principes leidend

  • HFM stelt de ‘gebruikers’ centraal en organiseert de dienstverlening in de nabijheid.
  • HFM zorgt voor borging, integraliteit en continuïteit.
  • HFM voert regie op uitbestede diensten.

Ben jij klaar om impact te maken en je kennis in te zetten om een veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige werkomgeving te creëren? Als contractmanager bij ProRail speel jij een sleutelrol in onze aanbestedingsteams, waarin je technische, juridische en administratieve contractstukken opstelt, onderhandelt en zorgt dat alles tot in de puntjes geregeld is.

Met jouw oog voor detail bewaak je de uitvoering van contractafspraken en streef je ernaar om processen voortdurend te verbeteren. Jouw werk is essentieel voor de continuïteit en kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening op locaties door heel Nederland. In deze rol ligt de nadruk op technische contracten (beheer en onderhoud), waarbij jouw kennis van techniek een stevige basis vormt.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Verantwoordelijk voor je eigen contractportfolio: Je zorgt voor een correcte uitvoering van contractafspraken, bewaakt de prestaties en stuurt bij waar nodig.
  • Ondersteuning en groei: Samen met de contracteigenaren werk je toe naar de realisatie van onze doelstellingen. Jij krijgt de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om je talenten optimaal te benutten.
  • Verbetering en innovatie: Door contracten te analyseren en verbetermogelijkheden te signaleren, speel jij een actieve rol in het verbeteren van processen.

Jouw werk maakt echt het verschil, niet alleen voor ProRail, maar ook voor je collega’s die elke dag profiteren van jouw nauwkeurigheid en toewijding.

Noot: vanuit het cluster HFM is er een voorkeurs kandidaat.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als contractmanager is er plek binnen het team Regie op de afdeling HFM. In dit team werk je samen met de contractbeheerders en de product- en projectmanagers aan de continuïteit en verbetering van onze dienstverlening.

Het Team Regie is professioneel en energiek. De nadruk ligt op samenwerking en we vinden het belangrijk om als team samen te zorgen voor goede sfeer.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.091,- en € 7.262,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 9.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel KeuzeBudget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen.
    Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel
  • Een NS-Business Card met TreinVrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.
  • 170 vakantie-uren én de optie om tot 185 extra vakantie-uren bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in contractmanagement. Je weet complexe contracten, belangen, risico’s en prestaties goed met elkaar te verbinden.
  • Je hebt ervaring met contractmanagement in een complexe omgeving en werkt vanuit een professionele en gestructureerde aanpak, zoals CATS CM. Je stuurt actief op verplichtingen, risico’s, wijzigingen, kansen en resultaten.
  • Je kijkt verder dan het contract en houdt oog voor organisatiedoelstellingen. Je bewaakt de balans tussen tijd, geld, kwaliteit, risico’s en belangen en stuurt bij waar nodig.
  • Je behoudt overzicht, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau. Daarbij houd je de lange termijn doelen voor ogen.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk en neemt van nature de regie. Je verbindt interne stakeholders en leveranciers, spreekt partijen aan op afspraken en zorgt dat acties tijdig worden opgevolgd.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als contractmanager beheer en onderhoud werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer vóór donderdag 17 september a.s. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Roos Bleijenburg via roos.bleijenburg@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Kawita Kanhai-Roopram via kawita.kanhai@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

You will work remotely in a hybrid team model (Local Hong Kong coordination + remote execution), contributing to daily ops,incident resolution, upgrades, testing, and 24x7 rotation (with on-call premiums).

Key Responsibilities

  • Daily System Support & Multi-Cloud Monitoring
  • Perform daily health checks (post-6pm HKT scripts for non-business hours) across on-prem VMware and cloud environments.Evaluate/optimize monitoring triggers, alerts, and scripts (vSphere alarms, Horizon dashboards, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch,Alibaba Cloud Monitor).
  • Triage alerts: initial diagnosis, escalation, and resolution support.
  • Incident & Problem Management
  • Handle incidents (S1/S2 priority) with impact analysis and root-cause resolution within SLAs.Participate in on-call rotation (Airport 24x7; premium for standby/nights/holidays).
  • Document and improve processes for different scenarios
  • Upgrades, Patching & Multi-Cloud Operations
  • Assess and apply patches/updates for VMware stack + cloud services (Azure VMs, AWS EC2, Alibaba ECS or servers).Execute after-hours upgrades/standby (snapshots, rollbacks, verification).Support hybrid setups if needed (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Alibaba hybrid cloud). (Not a must)
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation
  • Implement/maintain IaC for infrastructure provisioning and configuration.Automate repetitive tasks (deployments, backups, Horizon pool management, cloud resource scaling).
  • Regression Testing & CI/CD Support
  • Execute and maintain regression test scripts .Create/modify tests for platform/software changes across on-prem and cloud.
  • Security, Compliance & Platform Awareness
  • Monitor vendor/security advisories for VMware, Azure, AWS, Alibaba Cloud.Recommend/implement patches, IAM best practices, and security configurations.Assist with account/user management and compliance (PDPO alignment).
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
  • Work with local HK team and software vendors.
  • Maintain runbooks, knowledge base, and change request impact analysis.

Required Skills & Experience

Must-Have

  • 3+ years hands-on DevOps/infra ops experience.
  • Strong VMware expertise: vSphere/vCenter/ESXi administration, Horizon VDI (pool provisioning, golden images, troubleshooting for 20–50 users), PowerCLI scripting.
  • Multi-cloud experience: Azure (VMs, Monitor, Arc, IaC with ARM/Bicep), AWS (EC2, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, IAM), Alibaba Cloud (ECS, Monitor, ROS, hybrid capabilities).
  • IaC proficiency: Terraform, plus familiarity with Azure ARM/Bicep, AWS CloudFormation, Alibaba ROS or other tools.
  • Scripting/automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible.
  • Monitoring & logging: Cloud-native tools (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Alibaba Cloud Monitor) + general (Prometheus/Grafana or similar).
  • Incident response, troubleshooting, and on-call experience in production environments.

Preferred

  • Cloud Certifications: For AWS and/or Azure
  • CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Backup/DR: Veeam, Azure Backup, AWS Backup, Alibaba snapshots.
  • Security tools: Azure Sentinel, AWS GuardDuty, Alibaba Security Center.
  • Experience in government/critical infrastructure (transport/aviation preferred).

description:

Our Commitment to Diversity

Open to all doesn’t just apply to our customers, it applies to our hiring practices as well. We put respect at the top of our values and that’s how we treat our candidates and employees. Comprehensive overview of our benefits:

About the Position:

As an Information Services Specialist, you will answer customer questions, organize and lead programs and services for adults and assist with overall customer service under the guidance of the Manager or Librarian. You may perform collection management activities and/or serve as the location liaison for Life Skills services (e.g. job search assistance, digital inclusion support and other social services.).

Position Schedule

  • Monday - 10am-2pm
  • Tuesday - 11am-3pm
  • Thursday - 11am-3pm
  • Alternating Friday/Saturday - 9am-6pm
  • 1 in 5 Sundays - 1pm-5pm

What You’ll Do:

  • Proactively provides a high level of customer service and assists customers through various aspects of utilizing the Library.
  • Interviews, researches and answers customer questions by locating appropriate sources of information using a variety of tools and resources.
  • Plans, promotes, presents or coordinates programs for adults at the location and off-site, focusing on the needs of customers.
  • Performs collection management activities following the direction of the Collection Lead and Collection Programs Leads.
  • Creates displays and merchandises materials.
  • Ensures that the location is neat, orderly, appealing and inviting to customers and staff.
  • May be the location liaison for Life Skills, working with the Library’s Life Skills Program Leader and community members to understand and meet the needs of adult customers, particularly in the areas of social services and job help.
  • Maintains personal skills to assure quality of service in areas of library collections, technology, readers’ advisory and reference, social services, job and career help resources and knowledge of community resources.
  • Establishes and maintains relationships and communication with local community organizations and resources to bring information, programming and services to the library location.
  • Assumes responsibility for the operation of the location in the absence of a manager.
  • Coordinates volunteer activities including orienting, training and scheduling.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 1-3 years’ customer service experience required.

  • Ability to express self effectively and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands:

The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts that require normal safety precautions typical of such places as offices, meeting and training rooms, libraries, and residences or commercial vehicles (e.g., use of safe workplace practices with office equipment, avoidance of trips and falls, observance of fire regulations and traffic signals, and/or working in moderate outdoor weather conditions).

Work requires occasional lifting or pushing of up to 50 lbs. and the frequent lifting or pushing of up to 20 lbs.

title: Store Market Leader
description:

Department: Stores

Status: Full-time (Exempt)

Location:

Related Job Titles: District Manager, Regional Store Leader, Multi-Store District Manager, District Leader, Area Manager, Retail District Manager- Multi-Location Oversight, Retail Market Leader, Territory Manager – Retail Stores, Retail Operations District Manager


Job Summary:

Store Market Leaders manage a home store and lead a group of SSG stores with the Regional Sales Director. Market Leaders drive revenue growth by developing high-performing teams, executing sales strategies, and ensuring operational excellence across their market. They develop and maintain an exceptionally trained home store team that can operate autonomously, allowing them to build and maintain strong partnerships and consistently communicate with the Regional Sales Director and the team of Store Managers. A strong emphasis is placed on leading by example, accompanied by a servant leadership mentality.

Working for SSG will provide you with:

  • An organization which is built on its people, where every person truly matters.
  • Competitive compensation package with additional earning opportunities through incentives and initiatives.
  • Excellent benefits package for full-time employees including vacation pay, sick time, health, dental, vision, 401k retirement plan with a company match, and great discounts on exclusive haircare products.
  • Partnership with a dynamic team of leaders in a fun, exciting industry.
  • Opportunity for personal growth and career advancement.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Lead and Develop Store Team
    • Effectively manage time to remain focused on supporting the Store Manager Team.
    • Attract, hire, retain, develop, and lead a team of driven, goal-oriented Store Managers.
    • Mentor Store Managers through regular coaching.
    • Provide ongoing development opportunities that strengthen leadership skills for the Store Manager team.
    • Foster a fun, challenging, and rewarding culture.
  • Drive Sales Performance
    • Encourage consistent focus on sales growth, customer service, merchandising, and operation through regular communication.
    • Analyze sales performance and initiate strategies to motivate and achieve success.
    • Support the Regional Sales Director to grow revenue through strong partnerships and communication with the outside sales team.

Maintain Standards of Excellence

  • Reinforce exceptional store experiences, built on strong partnerships through purposeful conversations.
  • Maintain a high visual standard of merchandising display techniques and well-kept store environments.
  • Regularly visit stores and identify/report areas for improvement.
  • Manage and execute regular store inventories.
  • Lead by example, serving as the role model in all aspects and functions of the business including personal conduct, appearance, and attendance.


Requirements:

You have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of industry supervisory experience or applicable retail supervisory experience.

  • Previous multi-unit experience is strongly preferred
  • You have a background in the beauty industry
  • You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and clear-thinking skills
  • You’re a confident leader and decision-maker
  • You possess solid financial analysis skills
  • You’re organized and enjoy managing multiple projects
  • You’re willing to be “hands on” when necessary and lead by example
  • You have a proven track record of job stability/tenure
  • You’re successful at building and maintaining relationships
  • You present a professional appearance

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma
  • Management/leadership experience preferred
  • Retail and/or customer service experience a plus

Physical/Other Requirements:

  • Lift up to 30 pounds
  • Stand/walk up to 8 hours
  • This position will require regular market travel by car and can include overnight visits up to 50% of the time.

SSG Benefits:

  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D Insurance available
  • Health Savings Account or Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Discounts on exclusive hair products

Candidates are considered for employment with SSG without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military status, veteran status, or other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Senior Python Developer
company: Xbox Media Solutions (Formerly Activision Blizzard Media)
description:
Craft:

Technology & Development

Job Description:

King operates games at a massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of players around the world. Behind every player experience is a large ecosystem of services, data platforms, forecasting systems, and internal tools that help our teams make better decisions, move faster, and deliver exceptional experiences.

We are looking for a Developer (Python) to help design, build, and operate backend services, internal applications, and data-driven platforms that support critical business and product decisions across King. You will work on systems that process large volumes of data, run forecasting and analytical workloads, and provide reliable APIs and services consumed by teams across the company.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, analysts, product managers, and business stakeholders to build scalable solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights. This role combines backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native development, and data-intensive applications. While the primary focus of the role is backend engineering, you will also contribute to user-facing internal applications, helping deliver end-to-end solutions that enable teams across King to work more effectively.

An important part of the role will be integrating our platforms and tools with the broader King and Microsoft ecosystem, enabling seamless collaboration,authentication, data exchange, and workflow automation across multiple services and platforms.

King is a place where we build collaboratively and value diverse perspectives. We encourage experimentation, continuous learning, and ownership. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, solve challenging technical problems, and work alongside experienced engineers in a supportive environment.

Your Role Within the Kingdom

You will enjoy a creative, challenging, and collaborative environment where your ideas will be valued as much as your technical expertise.

Some of your responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python
  • Build scalable and reliable applications that support forecasting, analytics, and decision-making processes across the business
  • Develop distributed processing pipelines and asynchronous workloads
  • Design and optimize relational OLTP databases, data models, and query performance
  • Build and maintain data processing, analytical, and forecasting workflows
  • Design, develop, and maintain internal web applications when required
  • Build intuitive interfaces and workflows that enable technical and non-technical users to interact with backend systems and business tools
  • Integrate services with the King and Microsoft ecosystems, including identity, collaboration, communication, and productivity platforms
  • Develop and maintain APIs and connectors that enable interoperability between internal and external systems
  • Deploy, monitor, and operate containerized applications in cloud-native environments
  • Contribute to technical designs, architectural discussions, and engineering best practices
  • Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence
  • Deliver high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives across teams
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and automation practices throughout the software development lifecycle

Skills to Create Thrills

You are a software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building reliable systems that operate at scale. You are curious, pragmatic, and motivated by creating high-quality solutions that deliver measurable impact.

  • Strong Python development experience in production environments
  • Experience building backend services and APIs
  • Understanding of modern web application development and the ability to contribute across the stack when needed
  • Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, and distributed systems
  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases
  • Experience building data-intensive applications and processing large datasets
  • Experience with background processing, job orchestration, or distributed workloads
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized and cloud-native environments
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and automation pipelines
  • Strong testing, debugging, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
  • High sense of code quality and the desire to build and maintain robust, reliable software
  • Curiosity and adaptability when learning new technologies and domains

Technologies We Use

Our technology stack evolves over time, but currently includes:

  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • Django
  • HTMX
  • TypeScript
  • PostgreSQL
  • Pandas
  • NumPy
  • SciPy
  • Celery
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Drone CI

Experience with all technologies is not required. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new tools and technologies as needed.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building forecasting, optimization, simulation, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform or other major cloud providers
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft technologies and services such as Microsoft
  • Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, or related enterprise platforms
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, business applications, or workflow automation solutions
  • Experience working with large-scale data processing systems
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana or Sentry
  • Experience improving application performance and scalability in production environments

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. title: Ondersteunend begeleider Zuid-Oost Utrecht
description:
Ben jij een betrokken doener met oog voor mensen en gevoel voor wat er nodig is? Dan hebben wij dé plek voor jou. Bij De Tussenvoorziening in Zeist is er plek voor een Ondersteunend begeleider die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een veilige, warme omgeving voor mensen in een kwetsbare situatie. In deze veelzijdige functie zorg jij voor een prettige woonomgeving, biedt een luisterend oor en draagt bij aan een plek waar mensen zich welkom en veilig voelen. Daardoor draag je bij aan het herstel en de zelfstandigheid van onze cliënten.

Wat ga je doen

Je start je werkdag op één van onze locaties in Zeist. Je hebt contact met bewoners en ambulante cliënten, ondersteunt bij dagelijkse zaken en overlegt met collega’s over wat er speelt op de locatie. Soms begeleid je een groepsactiviteit, soms denk je mee over een verbetering op de werkvloer of help je een nieuwe bewoner zich thuis te voelen. De doelgroep cliënten is zeer divers. Soms ga je met een cliënt mee naar belangrijke afspraken, zoals een doktersafspraak of een afspraak bij de sociale dienst. Je bent er om de cliënt te ondersteunen, uitleg te geven en te helpen als dat nodig is. In de kern hou jij je bezig met:

  • Ondersteunen: Je biedt praktische ondersteuning in het dagelijks leven en bent een toegankelijk aanspreekpunt voor bewoners en ambulante cliënten.
  • Bijdragen aan een fijne leefomgeving: Je helpt bij activiteiten, creëert een prettige sfeer en zorgt dat bewoners en cliënten zich gezien en welkom voelen.
  • Samenwerken en meedenken: Je signaleert wat er speelt op de locatie of cliënt, deelt je ideeën met collega’s en helpt bij verbeteringen in het dagelijks werk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

We vinden dat iedereen moet kunnen meedoen. Elk idee, elke wens of behoefte is belangrijk. Daarom staan we open voor jouw ideeën en suggesties. Met een open mind werken we effectief samen. Zo laten we je groeien vanuit je eigen kracht en investeren we in je ontwikkeling en gezondheid op de werkvloer.

Verder krijg je:

    • Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week met een brutosalaris van € 2.666 tot maximaal € 4.426, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring bij een fulltime dienstverband (schaal 5/6 cao Sociaal Werk). Zijn jij en wij tevreden over de samenwerking? Dan kijken we graag naar een vast contract.
    • Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 17% van jouw salaris (IKB is opgebouwd uit o.a. 8% vakantietoeslag en de eindejaarsuitkering) én een individueel loopbaanbudget van 1,5% dat je kunt inzetten voor je loopbaanontwikkeling of vitaliteit. Het is mogelijk het IKB maandelijks uit te laten keren.
    • De kans om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onze TV-academie.
    • Reiskostenvergoeding en een pensioenregeling (PFZW-pensioenverzekering) en opleidingsmogelijkheden.

Wat neem je mee?

Je bent een sociaal en betrokken persoon met een open houding en een warm hart voor mensen. Je maakt makkelijk contact, voelt goed aan wat iemand nodig heeft en weet een fijne, veilige sfeer te creëren. Je signaleert wat er speelt op de locatie en durft daarin initiatief te nemen. Of het nu gaat om het begeleiden van een groepsactiviteit, het bedenken van iets nieuws samen met collega’s of het samenstellen van een mooi welkomstpakket voor een nieuwe bewoner: jij doet het met aandacht en enthousiasme. Daarbij ben je leergierig, sta je open voor nieuwe taken en wil je jezelf graag blijven ontwikkelen binnen het vak.

Verder heb je:

    • Een afgeronde mbo4 opleiding in Social Work of een vergelijkbare opleiding in de zorg of welzijn;
    • Een oplossingsgerichte en proactieve werkhouding;
    • Je kunt zelfstandig aan de slag gaan, neemt initiatief en durft verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor jouw werkzaamheden;
    • Je legt makkelijk contact, luistert goed en stemt je communicatie af op bewoners, cliënten, collega’s en andere betrokkenen.

Over het team

De Regio ZOU bestaat uit meerdere gemeenten en kernen (o.a. ). In deze regio speelt momenteel het vraagstuk van de decentralisatie en het inzetten op het zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig en in de eigen omgeving laten wonen van cliënten (ambulantisering). In dit veranderingsproces werken we actief samen met andere zorg- en welzijnspartners, verschillende woningcorporaties, sociale teams, de Regionale Sociale Dienst (RSD) en gemeenten. De wijze waarop cliënten wonen en de begeleiding is vormgegeven is divers. Denk aan gemengd wonen, groepspanden, Living Lab, Eerst een Thuis, Springplank, etc. Vanuit een compact team waar de verschillende disciplines van de Tussenvoorziening in vertegenwoordigd zijn, wordt regionaal gewerkt om onze expertise in deze regio te laten zien en verder te benutten. Dit maakt het een dynamische regio waarin jij als ondersteunend begeleider een belangrijke rol speelt in verdere ontwikkeling en samenwerking.

title: AT - Program Director - CDL
description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Area Manager/Regional Program Director, the CDL Program Director is responsible for providing leadership for the CDL Program. The CDL Program Director provides subject matter expertise and actively participates in curriculum development, revision, and implementation process. As the subject matter expert in a particular program, the CDL Program Director provides product knowledge training to the Account management group, utilizing materials generated via the centralized curriculum development process. This position is responsive to the Account management staff when asked to engage with potential students and actively participates in new student orientation. The CDL Program Director is responsible for hiring, assigning, orienting, developing, evaluating, and recognizing Driver Trainers within the program(s) of study. The CDL Program Director will convene meetings with faculty on a regular basis. The CDL Program Director is also responsible for monitoring and supporting the student population within his/her program of study. The CDL Program Director plays an active role in the student advising process, including advising students during the provisional period, meeting with students who initiate a complaint, advising students who have career-oriented questions, and consulting with students whose engagement and/or academic progress is in question. The CDL Program Director analyzes student population data, working with faculty and staff to identify students who may be at risk, and contacting students to identify barriers to success and to provide support and information concerning student services. Finally, the CDL Program Director is responsible for continuous improvement of the program. Actively engaged in the development and maintenance of the campus effectiveness plan, the CDL Program Director collects data for purposes of analyzing program performance.

Key Responsibilities

I. Provides Services to Students

  • Supplements Driver Trainer advising for students receiving failing assessments.

  • Provides academic advising as needed to students. Provides referrals to outside resources when counseling needs go beyond the scope of the school. Provides or arranges for student tutoring when needed.

  • Leads student retention initiatives for students in the program who experience barriers to success.

  • Maintains regular contact with all students within the program area and responds to their questions and/or concerns in a timely manner. Posts office hours for students.

  • Refers students to appropriate staff for non-academic problem resolution.

  • Contacts students who miss days from class or whose absence during the week results in more than four absences during the course.

  • Maintains records of interactions and correspondence with students (i.e. phone calls, emails, mail).

  • Monitors contact, and results of contact, from Driver Trainers to students in assigned program area(s). Makes calls weekly to students who (a) were not called or could not be reached; (b) did not return as promised; or (c) did not offer plans to return by a specific date. Offers appropriate academic advice and demonstrates genuine interest in students.

  • Identifies students needing tutoring.

II. Oversees Status of Quality of Curriculum, Instructional Materials, Equipment, and Facilities

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding academic curriculum for program area.

  • Actively participates in the curriculum development/revision process led by the Home Office Executive team.

  • Provides leadership in the implementation of new and revised curriculum.

  • Provides input into creating the master schedule regarding course sequencing, offerings, room assignments, and Driver Trainer teaching assignments.

III. Oversees Faculty Performance and Development

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in the recruitment, interviewing, and hiring of faculty for program of study.

  • Orients, monitors, supervises, mentors, and assists new Driver Trainers.

  • Ensures that all program area Driver Trainers adhere to required administrative and classroom delivery duties and requirements as outlined in the job description for CDL Driver Driver Trainer.

  • Ensures completeness of faculty files and documentation of official transcripts, professional development, observations, and performance reviews.

  • Provides leadership and supports all Driver Trainers and supervises their instructional and program needs.

  • Observes classes within the program area and coaches Driver Trainers to continually improve instructional presentation and classroom management skills.

  • Conducts performance appraisals of department faculty members, including areas of strength and recommendations for improvement and future skillset development.

  • Conducts regular weekly day and evening faculty meetings. Meeting topics may include improvement of course offerings, methods of instructional delivery, selection of texts, and such other purposes which serve to improve the quality of the instructional program. Documents all meetings.

  • Provides departmental product knowledge training to Account management and Career Services personnel as requested.

  • Provides information to all departments as trends and changes in program specialty areas occur.

  • Assists account management personnel with student recruitment as requested.

  • Promotes faculty participation and provides leadership in the professional development activities of program faculty members and the documentation of those activities.

  • Participates actively in a minimum of one professional organization within the community.

  • Attends faculty meetings and in-service programs. Maintains a record of professional development activities.

  • Maintains current personal knowledge of federal and state institutional regulations, and accreditation standards related to program area.

  • Participates in preparation of government and accreditation reports and ensures their timely submission and accuracy.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in evaluating data collected from student questionnaires and conducts faculty conferences when necessary to discuss the results and provides recommendations for improvement.

  • Maintains regular office hours each week to ensure consistency between day and evening policies, procedures and instruction.

  • Collaborates with peers and associates to ensure coordination of interdepartmental activities.

  • Intervenes in and works to resolve any personnel issues that arise among program area Driver Trainers.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in planning program budgetary needs if and when applicable.

  • Performs all duties of a full-time Driver Trainer.

IV. Leads and Develops Others

  • Provides clearly defined roles and objectives for driver trainers, monitors performance, provides feedback, and meets regularly to discuss priorities.

  • Resolves individual and group performance opportunities in a timely manner to motivate and foster teamwork.

  • Identifies opportunities to involve others in new and challenging work assignments that advance the skills and capabilities of individuals and the organization.

Experience and Education Required

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Industry certification in the field of instruction if required by industry, or demonstrated knowledge equivalent to the certification.

  • 3 years of experience in academic instruction in a post-secondary environment.

  • 5 years of industry experience in the field of instruction.

  • 2 years of experience in a management or supervisory role.

  • Ability to qualify as a CDL Driver /Driver Trainer.

  • Knowledge regarding faculty development, including requirements, delivery methods, and reporting.

  • Motivation, dedication, professionalism, integrity, and enthusiasm for teaching.

  • Ability to show sensitivity to the needs and requirements of adult learners.

  • Ability and desire to embrace the school’s mission.

  • Ability to inspire students to the highest level of achievement in preparation for meeting employer expectations.

  • Knowledge of industry standards and requirements within the field of instruction.

  • Knowledge of and ability to facilitate learning on course content within the field of instruction.

  • Excellent organizational skills.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office programs and database programs (CampusVue preferred).

  • Ability to develop and use collaborative relationships for the purpose of accomplishing work objectives; developing relationships with other individuals by listening, sharing ideas, and appreciating others' efforts.

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills.

  • Interpersonal relationship skills necessary for positive interactions with students, alumni, faculty, and employers.

  • Excellent creative and problem solving skills in dealing with students, alumni, employers, faculty, and staff.

  • Ability to meet and/or exceed defined goals.

  • Excellent presentation skills and ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups in a formal setting.

  • Management skills in planning, organizing, controlling and evaluating programs and policies in a dynamic and changing environment.

  • Knowledge of the federal FMCSA and state Department of Motor Vehicle standards.

Experience and Education Preferred

  • Associate’s Degree or higher, documented specialized competency within the field of instruction, or equivalent work experience in the field of instruction.

  • 5 years of experience in academic instruction in a post-secondary environment.

  • 10 years of experience in the field of instruction.

  • Working knowledge of federal/state government education regulations.

  • 3 years of experience in a management or supervisory role.

  • Previous experience as an academic program director.

  • Experience in student guidance, or related fields.

  • Working knowledge of federal/state government regulations.


Physical Demands

  • Mobility & Balance: Ability to frequently climb in/out of the cab, bend, squat, kneel, twist and reach to perform pre/post-trip inspections and navigate tight spaces.

  • Strength: Ability to crank trailer landing gear (often 100+ lbs), handle training and safety equipment, and potentially assist with loading/unloading (if applicable).

  • Endurance: Ability to sustain physical activity and be alert during extending driving and instructional periods, including exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, wind, rain, ice or snow.

  • Sensory Acuity and Overall Health: Must possess and maintain a valid DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate and meet DOT physical qualifications required to hold a CDL, with or without reasonable accommodations, as required by Federal regulations.

Specific Tasks & Considerations:

  • Demonstrating Skills: Physically showing students how to couple/uncouple trailers, perform inspections, and maneuver the large vehicle.

  • Environmental Exposure: Working outdoors in various conditions including extreme heat, cold, rain, or snow while training.


Work Environment

Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually not exposed to weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.


Note

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, or requirements associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change.

A Telematics Systems Performance Engineer for Qualcomm SoCs (Snapdragon Automotive Platforms) must bridge embedded software, hardware architecture, and wireless technologies. The role focuses on profiling, analyzing, and optimizing SoC Performance, power, thermal, and KPI efficiency for connected vehicles and IoT.

Skillset Required:

  • Auto Use cases: Familiarity with telematics and automotive use cases such as C-V2X (Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything), eCall, IMS, GNSS/location subsystems, PCIe, WLAN etc.

  • System Profiling: Ability to correlate hardware counters (e.g., Coresight-PMU) with software behavior

  • Debugging Tools: Proficiency with profiling and tracing tools such as Ftrace, Perf, Qualcomm Snapdragon Platforms etc.

  • Workload Analysis: Ability to analyze complex use cases (e.g., simultaneous 5G data streaming, navigation, and AI inferencing) and pinpoint performance or thermal bottlenecks.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with global hardware, software, and product management teams to define hardware architecture trade-offs.

  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python and Bash for data parsing, test automation, and building performance analysis workflows

  • Operating Systems: Good knowledge of Embedded Linux (kernel internals, scheduling, locking mechanisms) and Android (AOSP, Binder, surface flinger)

  • Lab Equipment: Hand-on experience in handling Evaluation boards, lab equipment like Modem Network simulators (Keysight, R&S, TBS etc.), Power measurement setup, oscilloscope etc.

Etsimme nyt Vehmaan biokaasulaitokselle operaattoria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toivomme, että pääset aloittamaan tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian, aloitusaika on kuitenkin sovittavissa yhdessä.

Gasum on Pohjoismaiden johtava biokaasun tuottaja ja toimittaja, jolla on biokaasun tuotantolaitoksia Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Tanskassa. title: Operations - Senior Associate
description:
At Laundryheap, we make laundry a little easier. We’re a fast-growing, on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning service operating across 17+ markets, with a simple promise: laundry collected, cleaned and returned within 24 hours.

Our driver partners are a huge part of making that possible. They connect our customers, laundry partners and operations every day.

We’re looking for an Operations Specialist to help us strengthen, grow and continuously improve our UK delivery network.

This is a hands-on role covering the full driver journey — from attracting and onboarding new driver partners to improving engagement, retention and operational performance. You’ll also work with external vendors, support fleet capacity and play an important role in growing our London e-bike operations.

You’ll be working across people, logistics and data. One day you could be analysing driver retention or delivery performance; the next day, onboarding new drivers, resolving an operational issue or working with a vendor to increase capacity.

What You’ll Be Doing

Driver Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of driver partners across the UK.
  • Publish and refresh driver opportunities across relevant channels and work towards weekly supply targets.
  • Manage driver applications through our ATS, Fountain, ensuring candidates move smoothly through the onboarding process.
  • Conduct welcome and onboarding calls with new driver partners.
  • Verify and maintain required documentation, including Right to Work, driving licences, insurance, MOT and vehicle documents.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready driver records.

Driver Performance, Engagement & Retention

  • Monitor driver performance, quality, engagement and retention across the network.
  • Use operational data to identify trends, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Work directly with drivers who require additional support and provide clear, constructive guidance.
  • Support engagement and incentive initiatives designed to improve driver retention and performance.
  • Manage driver offboarding where compliance, conduct or service standards are not being met.
  • Identify opportunities to continuously improve the driver experience.

Logistics Capacity & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with van, bike and other logistics vendors.
  • Source and coordinate additional delivery capacity when required, particularly for B2B projects and contracts.
  • Support vendor negotiations around rates and SLAs.
  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards.
  • Ensure vehicles are safe, available and appropriately documented.
  • Track operational costs and invoices, investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities to improve utilisation and value.

London E-bike Operations

  • Support the continued growth of Laundryheap’s London e-bike network.
  • Work with vendors and driver partners to encourage adoption and coordinate training.
  • Manage operational requirements including insurance, charging and battery logistics, maintenance, health & safety and utilisation.
  • Monitor e-bike performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Help develop repeatable processes that can support expansion into other urban locations.

Day-to-Day Logistics Operations

  • Work closely with Operations, Customer Service, Product and Finance teams to keep delivery operations running smoothly.
  • Help resolve driver-related incidents and escalations, including accidents, vehicle damage, no-shows and customer-facing issues.
  • Support driver payment and operational queries.
  • Share recurring driver feedback and operational challenges with Product and Technology teams.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and scale existing logistics processes.

Using Data to Improve Operations

You’ll use operational data to understand what’s happening across the network and turn those insights into practical improvements.

Some of the areas you’ll monitor include:

  • Active driver supply vs. demand
  • Demand fulfilment
  • Driver retention and churn
  • Time to onboard
  • Driver ratings and CSAT
  • Delays and reschedules
  • Failures and cancellations
  • Shift acceptance and fill rates
  • Driver performance and benchmarking
  • Asset utilisation
  • Cost per task
  • Fleet utilisation and cost

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, gig economy, driver operations or similar operational environments.
  • Experience working with a self-employed, contractor or gig workforce.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using Excel, Google Sheets and operational dashboards.
  • Experience working with external vendors and supporting negotiations around rates or SLAs.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Good organisational skills with the ability to independently own work from start to finish.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Practical, proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • Right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using an ATS, particularly Fountain.
  • Understanding of UK self-employment and worker-status considerations.
  • Experience with e-bikes, e-cargo bikes or other micromobility operations.
  • Familiarity with London and its last-mile delivery landscape.
  • Experience supporting B2B or enterprise logistics operations.

What Success Could Look Like in Your First 6 Months

By six months, we’d love to see you having made a measurable difference across our UK logistics network, including:

  • Driver supply consistently meeting demand across key zones and shifts.
  • Improved driver retention, engagement and quality.
  • Faster and more consistent driver onboarding.
  • Accurate and up-to-date driver documentation and compliance records.
  • Stronger vendor performance and clearer SLA tracking.
  • Better visibility and control of operational and fleet costs.
  • A growing, safe and well-utilised London e-bike operation.
  • More efficient and scalable driver and logistics processes.

Why Join Laundryheap?

This is a role where you’ll have real ownership and visible operational impact.

You’ll work closely with the people and partners who keep Laundryheap moving while having the opportunity to improve how our logistics network operates as we continue to scale.

If you enjoy solving operational problems, working with people, using data to make decisions and building better logistics processes, we’d love to hear from you.
