title: Product Manager - B2B
description:
About the job

Laundryheap picks up dirty laundry and drops off clean laundry, usually within 24 hours, in 18+ cities across Europe, Asia, and North America. Simple promise, surprisingly hard to deliver at scale - which is exactly the kind of problem we like.

We're a team of 200+, scattered across the globe, trying to make "doing laundry" disappear from people's to-do lists entirely. Alongside our consumer business, we're building out a B2B vertical - contracted enterprise clients and platform partnerships - and it's still early: a lot of what exists today is manual and stitched together, and we're now building the product infrastructure to let it scale properly.

That's the job - turn B2B from a set of manual patches into a product with the infrastructure to grow on.

What you'll actually do

  1. Help define the B2B service models for client needs that fall outside what core Laundryheap already offers, then build the product that actually supports each model in practice.
  2. Build a partner API and order management capability for service-provider and platform partners, designed to be reusable so onboarding the next partner doesn't mean rebuilding the integration.
  3. Support B2B operational reporting - visibility into performance across customers, facilities, and logistics that ops can act on before an SLA slips.

How we'll know you're doing this well

The north star is B2B revenue growth, but day to day you'll be judged on the things that get us there: successful partner integrations, order error rates, and how fast enterprise accounts move off manual workarounds and onto real product.

You're a good fit if

  1. You've spent 5+ years as a PM, analyst, or similar on tech-powered products - not just shipping features, but discovering and validating what to build, then measuring the impact so you know it works.
  2. You're comfortable pulling your own insights from data: SQL, BigQuery, Claude.
  3. You can take a genuinely messy problem with no clean answer and write a clear, data-backed argument for what to do about it.
  4. You work well with engineers, designers, AI and commercial/ops leadership without needing anyone to referee - this role sits between Product, Operations, and the B2B commercial team daily.
  5. You've picked up new areas of a business before without waiting for a manual.
  6. Bonus: you've worked on a delivery app before. Not required, just a shortcut.

This probably isn't for you if

  1. You want a fully-scoped roadmap handed to you on day one, pressed and folded. Most of B2B product is currently unbuilt - a lot of this role is figuring out what the roadmap should even be.

What you get

  1. Real ownership and one of the first dedicated product hires on a vertical the company is investing in scaling significantly.
  2. Direct influence on metrics that matter: B2B revenue, contract renewal rate, partner integration success.
  3. A seat on a multi-market consumer and B2B business spanning Europe and beyond.
  4. Above-average pay for the Slovenian market, scoped to experience.
  5. Whatever equipment the job needs.

How we work

  1. Remote, occasional in-person time in Ljubljana - we like faces (and beers), not just Slack avatars.
  2. Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9-5pm Ljubljana time.
  3. 6-month trial period.

How we hire

1. We read your application.

2. Screening call with HR.

3. Conversation with the CPO.

4. A practical assignment, time-boxed to 90 minutes.

5. We review it together with the Product team

6. Final chat with HR, then an offer.

title: Data Engineer - QuantumBlack
description:
Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? You’ve come to the right place.

YOUR IMPACT

You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures. You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries. You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities. Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact. You’ll be based in Monterrey as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist. You will have a unique opportunity to grow at the front‑line of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some leading AI and data experts in the industry.

YOUR GROWTH

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

  • Continuous learning:Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters:From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community:With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits:On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years’ experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects)
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL
  • Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch)
  • Familiarity with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and engineering tools (Pandas, Spark, dbt, LangChain, etc.)
  • Exposure to modern software development practices, including version control (Git) and foundational concepts in DevOps and MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD principles
  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
  • Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to different project situations and tech stacks
  • Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and Spanish

title: Staff Vision Rehabilitation Therapist
description:
At CNS, we believe that every moment counts, especially when it comes to helping individuals with traumatic brain injuries reclaim their lives. CNS clinicians own and drive patient progress and are the best of the best!

As a Staff Vision Rehabilitation Therapist, you will be at the heart of this mission, providing essential evaluations and therapies that pave the way for hope, independence, and a meaningful life. Whether you're working full-time, part-time, or on a per diem basis, you'll be part of a dedicated team that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth. Join us in making a real difference, one patient at a time. As one of our team members puts it, "With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together".

Pay Range is $70,000 - $85,000


Responsibilities:

As a Staff Vision Rehabilitation Therapist at CNS, you will play a pivotal role in transforming lives. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Patient Evaluations: Conduct comprehensive initial evaluations to identify visual, perceptual, cognitive, and functional impairments. Assess strengths, limitations, and rehabilitation needs to develop individualized treatment plans. Perform interim evaluations and reassessments to monitor progress and update treatment goals.Conduct on-site home, vocational, community, power tool, and height evaluations when clinically appropriate.
  • Vision Rehabilitation Treatment: Develop and implement individualized vision rehabilitation programs designed to improve functional performance and independence.Provide oculomotor rehabilitation and visual perceptual training. Teach compensatory strategies and adaptive techniques for visual impairments.Recommend and train patients in the use of assistive devices and adaptive equipment. Address visual processing, visual-motor integration, scanning, tracking, and visual attention deficits. Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans as necessary to achieve optimal outcomes.
  • Reporting and Communication: Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely patient documentation. Complete evaluations, treatment notes, progress reports, home programs, and discharge summaries.Communicate patient progress and treatment recommendations to patients, families, referral sources, and insurance representatives. Collaborate with physicians, neuro-optometrists, neurologists, physiatrists, orthopedists, and other healthcare professionals as needed.
  • Program Management: Maintain knowledge of all assigned patient treatment programs within the department. Ensure continuity and consistency of care throughout the rehabilitation process. Instruct and supervise rehabilitation aides, support staff, and students as appropriate. Provide ongoing consultation regarding treatment implementation and patient progress.
  • Therapeutic Interventions: Implement a variety of therapeutic interventions tailored to each patient's needs. This includes sensory integration, neuromuscular and neurodevelopmental techniques, oculomotor and visual perceptual therapies, and other specialized therapies to enhance patient outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Work closely with a multidisciplinary team to ensure a holistic approach to patient care. Participate in team meetings and contribute to the development of innovative individualized treatment strategies.
  • Professional Development: Engage in continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Take advantage of mentorship programs and professional development paths that reward learning and skill-building with compensation boosts.

Qualifications:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree required. Master's Degree in Vision Rehabilitation Therapy, Rehabilitation Services, Occupational Therapy, Education, Special Education, or a related field preferred.

  • Licensing: Current state licensure, certification, or eligibility as required by applicable state regulations.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience working with individuals with traumatic brain injury, neurological impairments, low vision, or visual deficits preferred. Experience providing vision rehabilitation services, visual skills training, and adaptive techniques preferred.

description:

Shape your career with Citi in Dublin. By joining Citi, you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.

Citi has had a presence in Ireland since 1965, it was one of the first foreign banks to open an office in the country and is the Citibank Europe Plc Headquarters.

The Lead Full Stack Engineer is a senior level position in Issuer Services Technology at Citi responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Klaar om impact te maken met automatisering en cloudtechnologie?

Als DevOps Engineer bij Team EIFFEL bouw je aan slimme CI/CD pipelines, automatiseer je infrastructuur en adviseer je klanten over moderne DevOps strategieën. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in verschillende sectoren, waar je continu verbetert en vernieuwt. Of je je wilt verdiepen in cloudtechnologie of juist jouw brede DevOps expertise verder wilt uitbouwen: bij ons bepaal jij je route.

Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met development en operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met development en operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.

Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.

Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo’n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren, daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.

Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.

Deze skills komen van pas
  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: AVP - Operational Finance
description:
AQUA Dermatology is the largest and fastest growing full-service skin care provider in the Southeast, offering medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery, vein care and radiation oncology throughout Florida, Georgia and Alabama.

We're looking for a driven Assistant Vice President of Operational Finance to help us strengthen financial performance, drive strategic decision-making, and support our continued growth. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, operational reporting, and financial strategy while partnering closely with executive and operational leaders across the organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the company's financial planning and analysis (FP&A) function and oversee operational finance activities.

  • Develop and maintain accurate financial statements, reports, forecasts, and performance dashboards in accordance with GAAP.

  • Direct the annual budgeting process and collaborate with operational leaders to support strategic initiatives and organizational goals.

  • Manage rolling forecasts and analyze financial performance to identify opportunities and risks.

  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive accountability and operational excellence.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Finance team while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Conduct financial modeling, business analysis, and ad hoc reporting to support executive decision-making.

  • Analyze complex healthcare-related datasets and create meaningful reports that improve business performance and operational effectiveness.

  • Support mergers, acquisitions, and partnership evaluations through financial due diligence and analysis.

  • Identify process improvements and implement enhancements that increase departmental efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Support year-end audit activities and ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures.

Our Benefits Include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision are available after 30 days of hire
  • Short-term disability and life insurance, and many ancillary options.
  • 10 days of PTO with an increase to 15 days upon completing 1st year
  • 401 (k) available after 90 days of hire
  • Excellent growth and advancement opportunities
  • Discounts on products and services

Schedule/Location

  • Full-time

  • Hybrid work environment

  • Standard business hours, Monday through Friday

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required

  • 10+ years of progressive finance, accounting, FP&A, or operational finance experience

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing finance teams

  • Strong knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications

  • Experience with Adaptive Planning is a plus

  • MBA, CPA, and/or CMA preferred

  • Healthcare industry experience preferred

  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, communication, and problem-solving skills

    Founded in 1998, AQUA Dermatology is the Southeast’s premier dermatology practice with over 110 locations throughout Florida, Georgia, and Alabama. Our established practices and experienced physicians offer patients the most quality outcomes and exceptional patience. From common rashes to skin cancer treatments, plastic surgery procedures to an array of vein treatments, no case is beyond our experience and expertise!

    Apply today and help us continue delivering exceptional patient care through operational and financial excellence.

title: HR AI Transformation Lead
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa tulevaisuuden työelämää merkityksellistä työtä tekevällä toimialalla? Haluatko olla suunnannäyttäjä organisaation tekoälymurroksessa? Etsimme nyt osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoomme HR AI Transformation Leadia rakentamaan Terveystalon AI-transformaatiota. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät organisaation AI-osaamisen kehittäminen ja käytännön transformaatiotyö liiketoimintatiimien kanssa.

Mitä työ HR AI Transformation Lead-tehtävässä pitää sisällään?

Etsimme joukkoomme HR AI Transformation Leadia vahvistamaan People Development & Transformation -tiimiämme. Tässä uudessa roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten tekoäly muuttaa työn tekemisen tapoja, johtamista ja osaamisen kehittämistä koko organisaatiossa. Roolilla on kaksi toisiaan tukevaa vastuualuetta.

Noin puolet työstäsi keskityt organisaation AI-osaamisen ja käyttöönottokyvyn vahvistamiseen. Luot organisaatiolle selkeän AI-oppimisen ja osaamisen kehittämisen tiekartan sekä rooli- ja tehtäväkohtaisia oppimispolkuja. Kehität champion-verkostoa, jonka kautta osaaminen ja toimivat käyttötavat leviävät organisaatiossa, ja tuet johtoa ja esihenkilöitä työn, roolien ja osaamistarpeiden muutoksessa. Olet mukana rakentamassa kulttuuria, jossa uusia teknologioita omaksutaan rohkeasti ja liiketoiminnan tavoitteita tukevalla tavalla, ja varmistat yhteistyössä HR:n, lakiasioiden ja tietoturvan kanssa, että tekoälyä hyödynnetään vastuullisesti, turvallisesti ja eettisesti.

Toisen puolen työajastasi työskentelet tiiviisti Terveystalon liiketoimintatiimien arjessa. Autat tiimejä tunnistamaan, missä tekoäly voi aidosti helpottaa ja parantaa työtä, sekä rakennat tiimien kanssa uutta tapaa tehdä työtä olemassa olevien AI-työkalujen ja ydinjärjestelmien ympärille. Et jää suunnitelmien tasolle: olet mukana, kun uusi toimintatapa otetaan käyttöön, tuet tiimiä ja esihenkilöitä muutoksessa ja varmistat, että tekoälystä tulee pysyvä osa tiimin arkea. Sitoutat organisaatiota johtamaan tekoälyn käyttöönottoon liittyviä muutosprosesseja ja rakennat niihin osallistavia toimintamalleja sekä kehität käytännön työkaluja muutoksen onnistumisen tueksi. Seuraat yhdessä tiimin ja liiketoiminnan kanssa, miten työ muuttuu ja mitä hyötyjä muutoksesta syntyy.

Käytännön transformaatiot tuottavat organisaatiolle toimivia käyttötapauksia ja oppimissisältöjä, ja oppimispolut sekä champion-verkosto monistavat onnistuneet toimintamallit eri puolille Terveystaloa. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät strateginen kehittäminen, käytännön toteutus ja laaja yhteistyö johdon, liiketoiminnan, digikehityksen, talouden ja HR:n kanssa.

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde. Työskentelemme joustavalla hybridityömallilla, jossa odotamme sinun työskentelevän noin puolet työajasta lähityönä toimistolla Helsingissä.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden olla keskeisessä roolissa rakentamassa Terveystalon AI-transformaatiota henkilöstöjohtamisen näkökulmasta. Pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten tekoäly muuttaa työn tekemistä, osaamisen kehittämistä ja johtamista sekä luomaan uudenlaisia toimintamalleja yhdessä Suomen suurimmista asiantuntijaorganisaatioista.

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

  • Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö ja joustavuus tukevat arjen työtämme.
  • Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
  • Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
  • Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Etsimme tehtävään henkilöä, jolla on

  • Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto
  • Vähintään 5 vuoden työkokemusta HR:n, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen ja konsultoinnin, prosessikehityksen tai digitaalisten transformaatioiden parista
  • Näyttöjä muutoksista, jotka on viety suunnittelusta tiimien päivittäiseen työhön asti
  • Kokemusta työnkulkujen tai toimintatapojen käytännön uudistamisesta ja kykyä sanoa, mikä muuttui ja miten sen tietää
  • Vahva ymmärrys osaamisen kehittämisestä, henkilöstön sitouttamisesta ja muutoksen läpiviennistä organisaatiossa
  • Ymmärrystä tekoälyn mahdollisuuksista työelämässä sekä kokemusta teknologian hyödyntämisestä toimintatapojen kehittämisessä
  • Kyky yhdistää liiketoiminnan tavoitteet, ihmiset ja teknologian mahdollisuudet käytännön ratkaisuiksi
  • Erinomaiset yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja vaikuttamistaidot sekä kyky liikkua sujuvasti johdon ja käytännön työtä tekevien tiimien välillä
  • Analyyttinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja tavoitteellinen työskentelyote

  • Establishing strong MLOps practices covering model versioning, automated testing, deployment pipelines, monitoring, observability and model lifecycle management.

You’ll need demonstrable experience delivering AI and machine learning solutions into production within a professional environment, alongside the technical credibility to lead experienced Data Scientists and AI Engineers.

Key experience includes:

  • Cloud experience, ideally within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.

  • Experience leading technical delivery teams while remaining actively involved in engineering and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering practices including Git, code review, documentation and the transition from experimentation to production-grade code.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.
  • Strong delivery and project management capabilities, including resource estimation, progress tracking and managing competing priorities.


We’re particularly interested in people who combine technical depth with leadership ability – someone comfortable discussing strategy with senior stakeholders one moment and reviewing Python code or AI architecture with engineers the next.

title: Säljare till 3Butiken Torp, Uddevalla, timanställning

Vi tror att du är serviceinriktad och intresserad av försäljning. Som person är du relationsskapande och kommunikativ, och drivs av att arbeta mot mål. Varmt välkommen till oss på Tre!

title: AT - Regional Program Director - CDL

description:
Job Summary

The CDL Regional Program Director is a subject matter expert and recognized leader on all matters related to the CDL programs for Ancora Training. This person is responsible for the administration of a best-in-class CDL program that adheres to all Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMSCA) and state regulatory agency regulations, develops and trains CDL program directors and instructors on best practices and policies to run an efficient CDL program, and drives fleet management and scheduling to ensure profitable, safe programs system-wide. He/She will work closely with the leadership team to set standards and training, and roll them out to the locations under their purview as applicable for implementation. This person will work closely with regional and campus leadership, where applicable, to problem-solve issues in the CDL program and prescribe solutions for implementation. The CDL Regional Program Director assists account management in meeting and/or exceeding its CDL student start goals and profitability goals, fleet management, instructor, and scheduling goals while ensuring adherence to institutional, state, and federal guidelines, and is respected by the field for their program knowledge. The Regional Program Director-CDL applies expertise in driving, training, regulations, and knowledge of the market to identify growth opportunities and business risks to enhance this company's revenue stream.



Key Responsibilities

  1. Develop, organize, and administer Program Director and Instructor training programs.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on all aspects of running a successful, high-quality, compliant, and safe CDL program.

  • Visit, understand, and direct program directors and instructors on compliance and operational best practices for all aspects of CDL.

  • Develop and administer program director and instructor training programs; work with other corporate CDL staff to scale training efforts.

  • Assist with recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of new CDL staff.

  • Reviews daily/weekly/monthly reports and tailors training and discussions with CDL teams on results.



  1. Manage operational compliance for the CDL program.

  • Oversee and operationalize safety and compliance programs mandated by FMCSA, State and Local Regulatory and Law Enforcement Agencies.

  • Ensure compliance to drug and alcohol, road safety, administrative and all other relevant regulations and laws by identifying best practices, training teams, escalating and documenting issues.

  • Review and maintain accident policy and develop safety initiatives such as defensive driving courses.

  • Administer audit process and scorecard system and Report on compliance at each location.

  • Implement remediation plans as a result of testing in conjunction with leadership and CDL program director.


  1. Manage fleet activities, including acquisition, maintenance, and disposal of vehicles.

  • Work with the CDL corporate team to understand all fleet-related metrics and implement plans to maximize truck efficiency.

  • Train CDL program directors and instructors on how best to maintain their trucks and ensure efficient truck operations; ensure program directors understand fleet efficiency drivers to ensure optimized fleet management


  1. Develop, recommend, and implement cost-saving measures through labor, equipment, fuel programs.

  • Regularly review, understand, and make recommendations to improve efficiency across all aspects of the CDL business. Balance CDL schedule demands with businesses' cost drivers.


  1. Leads and Develops Others.

  • Recognized and respected as the subject matter expert on all operational and compliance aspects of CDL.

  • Demonstrates ability to take regulatory concepts and apply them in a compliant, practical way.

  • Holds others accountable to established performance levels to achieve individual and group goals.

  • Conducts regular check-ins with CDL program staff to review performance versus goal, discuss and resolve issues, and provide the overall support needed to ensure success.

  • Manages resources and people processes (e.g., Performance Management, Career Development, Training, Staffing, etc.) to ensure optimal performance.

  • Identifies individual and team skill gaps and developmental opportunities (e.g., training, special assignments, conferences, projects, etc.) to facilitate individual and team development.

  • Coaches and mentors staff to develop the careers of others and improve individual and team performance.

  • Resolves individual and group performance issues in a timely manner to motivate and foster teamwork.

  • Identifies opportunities to involve others in new and challenging work assignments that advance the skills and capabilities of individuals and the organization.

  • Recommends employees for lateral rotations and promotions to provide them with opportunities to develop new skills and take on more responsibility.

Experience and Education Required

  • High school diploma

  • 5 years of work experience in CDL driving and training

  • Multi-site oversight experience

  • Management experience

  • Working knowledge of FMCSA regulations


Experience and Education Preferred

  • Bachelors degree

  • 15 years of progressive work experience in CDL driving and training

  • Knowledge of multi-state regulations for CDL

  • Experience with CDL employers, specifically trucking companies

  • Track record of growing leaders and independent thinkers


Physical Demands

  • Mobility & Balance: Ability to frequently climb in/out of the cab, bend, squat, kneel, twist and reach to perform pre/post-trip inspections and navigate tight spaces.

  • Strength: Ability to crank trailer landing gear (often 100+ lbs), handle training and safety equipment, and potentially assist with loading/unloading (if applicable).

  • Endurance: Ability to sustain physical activity and be alert during extending driving and instructional periods, including exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, wind, rain, ice or snow.

  • Sensory Acuity and Overall Health: Must possess and maintain a valid DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate and meet DOT physical qualifications required to hold a CDL, with or without reasonable accommodations, as required by Federal regulations.

Specific Tasks & Considerations:

  • Demonstrating Skills: Physically showing students how to couple/uncouple trailers, perform inspections, and maneuver the large vehicle.

  • Environmental Exposure: Working outdoors in various conditions including extreme heat, cold, rain, or snow while training.


Work Environment

Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually not exposed to weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.


Note

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, or requirements associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change.

title: Project Manager Alzheimer’s Research
description:
Job description

We are seeking a project manager to support our research on genomics, brain ageing and Alzheimer’s disease. The project manager will work closely with the project principal investigator, Dr. Sourena Soheili-Nezhad, and will be embedded within the research group of Dr. Emma Sprooten in the Medical Neuroscience Department at Radboudumc.

Our team collaborates with the Department of Human Genetics and academic partners in Groningen (ERIBA), London (UCL), Leiden (LUMC), and other global organisations. The programme begins in November 2026 under the scheme of the Dementia Frontiers Fund for a duration of two years, subject to successful annual assessments.

Responsibilities include:

  • Monitoring key milestones and progress, and identifying and tackling procedural and administrative bottlenecks.
  • Supporting the team in preparing deliverables and annual reports.
  • Coordinating research service requests from third parties, overseeing correct payments, and liaising with the department’s budget control team for budget oversight.
  • Preparing project paperwork, such as Material Transfer Agreements (MTAs), contracts, and coordinating material and data transfer across participating study centres.
  • Coordinating annual Patient and Public Involvement and Engagement (PPIE) activities in collaboration with Radboudumc Alzheimer Centrum.
  • Ensuring adherence to the award’s requirements and communicating with our funders — Alzheimer’s Research UK.

Place of work

This is an opportunity to work at the Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behaviour in Nijmegen, a leading neuroscience research centre in Europe. Nijmegen is a vibrant city with a unique combination of historic character and a green environment.

Profile

This role would suit a highly organised and proactive project manager who is interested in joining a fast-paced and ambitious research team. Previous experience with human resource management, project administration, wet-lab, neuroscience, immunology or genetics is desirable.

This role requires a Master’s degree related to any of the above fields, as well as a good command of both English and Dutch. For an interested candidate there will also be ample opportunities to gain knowledge on brain ageing mechanisms and human genetics research.

Good to know

  • This position requires a Certificate of Conduct (VOG).

We are recruiting for this position ourselves. Unsolicited marketing is not appreciated, but do feel free to share the vacancy in your network!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We deploy and host open-source large language models on EU-sovereign infrastructure across Europe, providing private, zero-retention inference for regulated industries including finance, healthcare and government. Our platform offers drop-in OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling developers and enterprises alike to adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance.

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers at various levels to join our growing engineering team. You will take ownership of features across the entire product surface, from our customer-facing dashboard and billing systems through to our backend API services and infrastructure tooling. This is a hands‑on, high-impact role in a fast-moving scaleup where your work will directly shape the platform our customers rely on.

You will work across multiple projects, primarily in TypeScript, spanning a React/Next.js frontend and a Node.js/Express API layer backed by PostgreSQL and Redis/Valkey. Frontend development is a key part of this role, and you will be responsible for building the interfaces our customers and their agents interact with daily. We are an AI‑native team and tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our standard workflow, not an experiment. We value engineers who can deliver polished, accessible user experiences while also contributing to robust backend services.

Responsibilities

  • Feature Delivery - Design, build and ship end‑to‑end features spanning the frontend dashboard, REST API and database layers, taking work from specification through to production deployment.

  • Frontend Development - Build responsive, accessible and performant interfaces using React and Next.js with server‑side rendering, middleware and modern routing patterns. Implement design systems using headless component primitives and utility‑first CSS.

  • Backend & API Development - Develop and maintain RESTful API services in Node.js/Express with full TypeScript type safety. Design relational database schemas and write performant SQL. Implement caching, rate limiting and background job processing.

  • Testing & Reliability - Write and maintain automated tests across the stack, including unit, integration and end‑to‑end tests. Champion testing best practices and help build a culture of confidence in deployments.

  • Authentication & Security - Own and evolve our authentication and authorisation systems, including JWT‑based auth flows, role‑based access control and security hardening throughout the platform.

  • Payments & Integrations - Build and maintain third‑party integrations including payment processing, cryptocurrency payment flows, transactional email, bot protection and customer messaging.

  • Infrastructure & DevOps - Manage containerised development and deployment workflows using Docker within a cloud‑native environment. Maintain CI/CD pipelines and contribute to platform reliability.

  • Code Quality & Collaboration - Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural decisions and help establish best practices. Share knowledge and support your teammates across the engineering team.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience building full‑stack web applications

  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript across frontend and backend codebases

  • Strong frontend skills with React and Next.js (SSR, App Router, middleware), headless component libraries (e.g. Radix UI, shadcn/ui) and utility‑first CSS frameworks

  • Solid backend experience with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (schema design, raw SQL) and Redis/Valkey

  • Practical experience with authentication systems, role‑based access control and web security practices

  • Familiarity with payment platform integration (e.g. Stripe). Experience with cryptocurrency payment protocols is desirable

  • Experience with Docker and containerised deployment workflows

  • Comfortable using AI‑assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflow

  • A clear and concise communicator who thrives in ambiguity and can articulate technical decisions to both technical and non‑technical audiences

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with large language models, including areas such as prompt engineering, context engineering, fine‑tuning, RAG, evaluation and model deployment

  • Experience with AWS and related services (e.g. EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront)

  • Exposure to Python and Golang

Education & Qualifications

  • BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline OR equivalent practical experience

Remuneration

  • Highly competitive package, dependent on experience

  • 25 days paid annual leave

  • Hybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office

  • Free inference tokens!

title: VP Product Development - Furniture Division
description:
VP, Product Development – Furniture Division


Role Overview

Surya Inc. is seeking a proven product leader to help drive the next phase of growth for our furniture division. This role will lead product development across case goods and upholstery (indoor and outdoor), with responsibility for turning ideas into commercially successful products that reflect our brand, meet market demand, and support long-term category expansion.

This leader must bring strong product instincts, deep furniture expertise, and the ability to move decisively from concept to execution. They should be highly entrepreneurial, comfortable making decisions, and excited to build. The ideal candidate knows how to balance design, quality, speed, and cost while creating products that win in the market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the product development strategy for the furniture division across case goods and upholstery, aligning product direction with company goals, customer insights, market opportunities, and financial targets.
  • Own the full product life cycle from concept through launch, including design intent, materials, construction, engineering, specifications, testing, costing, sample review, and final execution.
  • Help define and strengthen the product point of view for the furniture business, ensuring assortments feel relevant, differentiated, and aligned with the brand.
  • Drive line development and long-term category planning, balancing core business, newness, innovation, and white-space opportunities.
  • Partner closely with merchandising, sourcing, and sales to identify opportunities, sharpen product direction, and bring strong ideas to market efficiently.
  • Translate trend, competitive, and customer insights into actionable product strategies that lead to commercially successful launches.
  • Continuously refine the product development process to improve speed to market, sample quality, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Work directly with sourcing teams and factory partners to evaluate capabilities, solve challenges, strengthen execution, and align resources with business needs.
  • Ensure products are developed with the right balance of design, quality, manufacturability, margin, and price point.
  • Collaborate with marketing, creative, and digital teams to support strong launches, product storytelling, and readiness of all product data and assets for sales and web presentation.
  • Track key performance indicators across development, costing, quality, timing, and launch success, acting quickly when improvements are needed.
  • Travel domestically and internationally to review development, evaluate factories and suppliers, attend market, identify new opportunities, and stay closely connected to the product.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a strong, high-accountability product development team that thrives in a fast-moving, growth-oriented environment.
  • Set a high standard for speed, quality, ownership, and follow-through.
  • Coach and develop team members, strengthen technical expertise, decision-making, and leadership capability.
  • Create clarity around priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes, ensuring focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration while maintaining high momentum and accountability.
  • Lead with an entrepreneurial mindset — willing to challenge old ways, solve problems quickly, and build better processes as the business scales.
  • Manage company resources responsibly with a disciplined approach to investment and return.


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 12+ years of experience in furniture product development, with strong experience in both case goods and upholstery.
  • Proven success building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of furniture construction, materials, finishes, comfort, engineering, and quality standards.
  • Strong understanding of global sourcing, factory capabilities, raw materials, and supplier development.
  • Excellent commercial instincts with a track record of developing product that is not only well designed but also sells.
  • Experience balancing design, innovation, speed, cost, margin, and operational execution.
  • Highly organized and decisive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and keep teams moving.
  • Strong communicator who works effectively across functions, cultures, and international partnerships.
  • Thrives in a hands-on environment where building, improving, and scaling are all part of the job.


What Success Looks Like

  • Stronger and more differentiated furniture assortments
  • Faster, more disciplined product development execution
  • Improved product quality and higher sample approval rates
  • Better alignment between design, sourcing, merchandising, and sales
  • Product launches that drive growth, margin, and brand elevation
  • A team and process built to scale with the business



Surya, Inc. includes an exquisite portfolio of high-quality home furnishing brands, including Surya, Mitchell Gold + Bob Williams, Global Views, and Livabliss. We are known for our commitment to quality, sustainability, and timeless design, providing our clients with stylish solutions that elevate interiors across the globe. Surya Inc. has been named to the Inc. 5000 annual list of America's fastest growing privately held companies ten times.

title: Mobile DOT Inspection Technician (2133)
description:
Join Us as a DOT Inspection Technician!

About Kooner Fleet Management Solutions

Kooner Fleet Management Solutions is one of the fastest-growing national providers of on-site fleet maintenance, preventative service, and mobile repair solutions. With nearly a decade of industry experience, Kooner FMS helps fleets reduce downtime, extend vehicle life, and simplify operations through proactive maintenance programs and advanced technology.

As a family-founded and field-first company, we take pride in delivering trusted partnerships, exceptional service, and innovative fleet management solutions that keep America’s trucks and trailers road-ready.

Schedule: Sunday-Thursday, 7:00AM - 4:00PM

Why You’ll Love Joining Our Team

  • Earn What You Deserve: Competitive pay starting at $20-25/hr. based on experience.
  • Weekly Paydays: Get paid every Friday – no waiting around!
  • Take the Wheel: Enjoy a fully equipped company-provided service vehicle you can take home.
  • Geared Up and Ready: We provide the tools and equipment you need to get the job done right.
  • Fueled for Success: Enjoy a company-paid fuel card so you never pay out-of-pocket at the pump.
  • Stay Connected: Cell phone allowance included.
  • Invest in Your Future: 401(k) with company match.
  • Health Benefits that Kick in Fast: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage after just 30 Days!
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy paid vacation time, paid sick time, and paid holidays to rest, recharge, and take care of what matters most.
  • We’ve Got You Covered: Life & Disability Insurance for added peace of mind – because we take care of our team on and off the job.
  • We’re Here for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program for support when you need it most – we've got your back.
  • Bring a Friend, Get Rewarded: Refer great talent and earn $500 per successful hire – no limits on how many bonuses you can earn!
  • Grow With Us: Big Career Growth Opportunities in a rapidly expanding, forward-thinking organization.

About the DOT Inspection Technician Role

As a DOT Inspection Technician, you’ll be the trusted technician our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for entry-level technicians or recent tech school grads who are looking for an opportunity to launch their career in the fleet maintenance industry. In this role, you'll be responsible for performing DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, ensuring vehicles meet federal safety and compliance standards.

Geared up with a fully equipped, company-provided service vehicle and a supportive team that values your skill, drive and dedication, you'll take pride in delivering thorough, accurate, and reliable inspections that keep America moving.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

  • Perform onsite DOT inspections on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers in a mobile field environment.
  • Perform tire changes and replacements on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers as needed, including safely removing and installing tire and wheel assemblies.
  • Respond to dispatch requests for scheduled and unscheduled DOT inspections and tire replacements.
  • Use inspection tools and equipment — including tread depth gauges, brake stroke gauges, and other diagnostic aids — to accurately assess vehicle condition against DOT standards.
  • Clearly and accurately document inspection findings, flag out-of-service items, and recommend additional repairs to advanced technicians for follow-up as needed.
  • Stay productive and efficient, meeting or beating industry-standard inspection times.
  • Take ownership of a company-issued service vehicle, perform maintenance and pre- and post-trip inspections, and ensure safety compliance.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Diesel, automotive, or heavy-duty vehicle technical training (technical school, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on experience) preferred.
  • Familiarity with DOT inspection standards and out-of-service criteria, or willingness to learn.
  • Strong communication skills – you know how to connect and communicate with customers and drivers alike.
  • Comfortable using mobile apps, navigation systems and digital tools to stay organized and document repairs.
  • Ready for the outdoors – rain or shine at customer yards.
  • Independent, dependable, and self-motivated – you take pride in getting the job done right.
  • A positive attitude and safety-first mindset.
  • Must be at least 20 years old with a clean driving record and a valid driver’s license.

Work Environment

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.
  • Expect exposure to dust, diesel fumes, and noise typical of a shop or yard environment.
  • Safely handle chemicals, oils, and grease as part of repair work.
  • Be ready to lift, move, and position heavy equipment or components.
  • Stay active – you'll bend, kneel, crawl, and crouch to access vehicle components.
  • Work outdoors in all weather conditions – rain or shine, our team gets it done.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where every team member can thrive.

title: Staff CPU Power Management Firmware Developer - Limits Management
description:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

As a CPU Power Management FW Developer, you are responsible for working with a team on the enablement of the power management solution for Qualcomm's custom CPUs. You will collaborate internally to help define and implement embedded firmware to manage operation of the CPU subsystem within the allocated power and thermal budgets. You will also be responsible for helping characterize and tune this solution for all Qualcomm SoCs utilizing Qualcomm custom CPUs.

In CPU Power Management FW developer role, with focus on limits management, you will be working closely both with the hardware power management and firmware development teams. You will have an opportunity to engage with third parties on enablement of new platforms, as well as providing input to our SoC and platform architects on future designs.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Drive the firmware design, implementation and verification, in pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.

  • Assist in the definition Limits management solutions for future generation of Qualcomm CPUs.

  • Actively engage with open source communities to contribute support for processor architectures, device drivers, and firmware features

  • Assist in identifying skills requirements and in hiring engineers, collaborating with other teams on platform bring-up/debug/diags, firmware lifecycle, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science (or equivalent professional experience) with 8 to 12 years experience in embedded firmware development

  • Self-starter who takes initiative and brings technical leadership

  • Proficient writing and debugging C and assembly

  • Driver development experience in RTOS or OS Kernel environments

  • Demonstrated development experience with embedded OSes such as Zephyr, eCos, uC/OS or FreeRTOS

  • Experience developing for pre-silicon environments including simulators and FPGA emulation

  • Experience developing, characterizing and tuning solutions for power limiting, thermal limiting for an SoC subsystem will be a considerable plus.

  • Familiarity with ARM v8 architecture. Development experience for a ARMV8 platform is a plus.

title: Salgsassistent til Q8 København S, Vejlands Alle, 37 timer
description:
Er du interesseret i en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her hos os. Seriøst!

Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse – og det er præcis det, vi brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8‑familien.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på – men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service.

Det praktiske

  • Ansættelsesform: timelønnet
  • Omfang: Ca. 37 timer pr. uge
  • Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil ligge både i hverdagene og weekenden, typisk i dagtimerne mellem kl. 8-17. Der vil forekomme enkelte morgenvagter i ny og næ. Man har arbejdsweekend hver tredje weekend.
  • Start: Efter aftale
  • Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.
  • Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år – med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start.

OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag
  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt
  • En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter
  • En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start – understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer

Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på karrierestationen.

Hvem passer jobbet til?

Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement.

OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet.

Klar på at blive en del af Q8?

I ansøgningen har du flere muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen.

Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig!

Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste ansøgning - seriøst.

title: Founding Textile Engineer (Equity + EXIST Funding)
description:
INTRO

NexTex AI is building machine-level intelligence for textile manufacturing.

Our platform combines industrial cameras, retrofit sensors, machine data, and AI models to detect textile defects, identify production anomalies, and generate sustainability intelligence across knitting, dyeing, finishing, and quality control operations.

We are looking for a Founding Textile Engineer who understands both the technical realities of textile manufacturing and the challenges that arise across the production process. You will work directly with our AI team, pilot factories, and machine partners to help translate textile expertise into scalable industrial AI solutions.

A strong understanding of knitted fabrics is essential. Our initial focus includes circular knitting production, dyeing, finishing, and fabric inspection processes. Key manufacturing challenges include needle-related defects, needle breaks, vertical needle lines, elastane and Lycra-related distortions, oil stains, stitch irregularities, holes, line defects, machine start-stop anomalies, and other quality deviations that impact fabric performance and production efficiency.

On the dyeing and finishing side, NexTex AI focuses on detecting and understanding shade deviations (ΔE), color consistency issues, process instabilities, re-dye risks, and quality variations that can lead to increased water consumption, energy usage, chemical consumption, reprocessing costs, and fabric waste.

NexTex AI is currently preparing its EXIST startup funding application and collaborates with industrial partners including Terrot Textilmaschinen GmbH in Germany, as well as Ribana Tekstil and Nuryıldız Tekstil in Turkey. These partnerships provide direct access to real production environments, industrial machine fleets, knitting machines, dyeing facilities, finishing operations, textile defect scenarios, and pilot deployment opportunities from day one.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about textile manufacturing, innovation, and helping build the next generation of AI-powered production intelligence for one of the world's largest manufacturing industries.

Tasks

TASKS

• Work directly with knitting, dyeing, finishing, and quality control operations in industrial textile manufacturing environments

• Identify, classify, and document textile defects including needle-related defects, needle breaks, elastane and Lycra failures, vertical needle lines, oil stains, stitch irregularities, holes, line defects, and machine-process anomalies

• Analyze root causes of production issues and support the development of corrective and preventive actions

• Support the creation and validation of textile defect datasets used for AI model training

• Collaborate with AI engineers to translate textile production challenges into machine learning and computer vision applications

• Define textile-specific defect taxonomies, quality standards, and production workflows

• Support the development of machine-level quality and sustainability KPIs

• Analyze dyeing and finishing processes, including shade deviations (ΔE), color consistency issues, re-dye risks, and process instabilities

• Participate in pilot deployments and industrial validation projects at partner factories

• Work closely with textile manufacturers, machine manufacturers, operators, production managers, and the NexTex AI team

• Help shape the textile knowledge foundation and product strategy of NexTex AI

BENEFITS

• Founding team position from day one

• Equity participation of up to 15%, depending on experience, commitment, and long-term involvement

• Monthly compensation of approximately €2,500 through the German EXIST Startup Grant program

• Full health insurance coverage through the EXIST funding program

• Opportunity for increased compensation following successful completion of the EXIST funding phase and future financing milestones

• Opportunity to grow into a future Head of Textile Technology or senior leadership role

• Access to the Berlin startup ecosystem through the EXIST and PRO FIT funding programs

• Direct access to pilot factories, industrial production environments, and machine manufacturers from day one

• Collaboration with leading textile manufacturers and machine technology partners

• Gym membership support

• Flexible working arrangements, with Berlin preferred and Europe considered for exceptional candidates

• High ownership and direct impact on company strategy and product development

• Opportunity to help build a category-defining Industrial AI company for textile manufacturing

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Textile Management, or a related field

• Strong understanding of knitted fabric production and circular knitting processes

• Knowledge of fabric structures including Single Jersey, Rib, Interlock, French Terry, and elastane-containing fabrics

• Understanding of textile quality control and defect analysis

• Knowledge of dyeing, finishing, and fabric inspection processes

• Experience identifying and troubleshooting textile defects and production issues

• Understanding of shade deviations (ΔE), color consistency, and dyehouse quality challenges

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and communicate with technical and production teams

• Fluent English

Nice to Have

• Experience working in knitting, dyeing, finishing, or fabric production facilities

• Experience with quality assurance and textile testing

• Knowledge of GOTS, OCS, OEKO-TEX, or sustainability-related textile standards

• Interest in AI, Industry 4.0, Smart Manufacturing, and digital transformation

• Previous startup experience

Benefits

BENEFITS

• Founding team position from day one

• Equity participation of up to 15%, depending on experience, commitment, and long-term involvement

• Monthly compensation of approximately €2,500 through the German EXIST Startup Grant program

• Full health insurance coverage through the EXIST funding program

• Opportunity for increased compensation following successful completion of the EXIST funding phase and future financing milestones

• Opportunity to grow into a future Head of Textile Technology or senior leadership role

• Access to the Berlin startup ecosystem through the EXIST and PRO FIT funding programs

• Direct access to pilot factories, industrial production environments, and machine manufacturers from day one

• Collaboration with leading textile manufacturers and machine technology partners

• Gym membership support

• Flexible working arrangements, with Berlin preferred and Europe considered for exceptional candidates

• High ownership and direct impact on company strategy and product development

• Opportunity to help build a category-defining Industrial AI company for textile manufacturing

CLOSING

If you are passionate about textile manufacturing, production excellence, and the future of intelligent factories, we would love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with textile manufacturers, machine producers, and AI engineers while helping build the next generation of AI-powered manufacturing intelligence.

Please include your CV or LinkedIn profile, a short introduction about yourself, and any relevant experience in knitting, dyeing, finishing, quality control, or textile production.

We are particularly interested in people who enjoy solving real production challenges, taking ownership, and helping shape the future of textile manufacturing through technology and innovation.

title: Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician
description:
Join Us as a Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician!

Kooner Fleet Management Solutions is one of the fastest-growing national providers of on-site fleet maintenance, preventative service, and mobile repair solutions. With nearly a decade of industry experience, Kooner FMS helps fleets reduce downtime, extend vehicle life, and simplify operations through proactive maintenance programs and advanced technology.

As a family-founded and field-first company, we take pride in delivering trusted partnerships, exceptional service, and innovative fleet management solutions that keep America’s trucks and trailers road-ready.

About the Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician Role

As a Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician, you’ll be the expert our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for skilled technicians who enjoy independence and variety in their work. You’ll be responsible for performing preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, including emergency roadside service when needed.

Geared up with your own, fully equipped company service truck, top-tier tools, and a supportive team that values your skill, drive and dedication, you’ll tackle new challenges every day and take pride in delivering safe, reliable and efficient service that keeps America moving.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

  • Handle emergency road service calls with confidence and urgency.
  • Respond to dispatch requests for scheduled and unscheduled service or maintenance.
  • Diagnose and repair electrical, brake, cooling, and air systems - everything that keeps a fleet running strong.
  • Use advanced diagnostic tools, including handheld computers and precision instruments, to identify and fix issues fast.
  • Put your expertise to work using hand tools, power tools, and welding equipment to get the job done right.
  • Road test vehicles to ensure every repair meets top-quality standards.
  • Stay productive and efficient, meeting or beating industry-standard repair times.
  • Work with trusted vendors to source parts and keep operations moving.
  • Take ownership of a company-issued service truck, perform maintenance and pre- and post-trip inspections, and ensuring safety compliance.
  • Jump in wherever needed – we're a team that supports each other.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • At least 3 years of hands-on diesel tech experience working on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers.
  • DOT inspection and air brake repair expertise that keeps fleets rolling safely.
  • Strong communication skills – you know how to connect and communicate with customers and drivers alike.
  • Comfortable using mobile apps, navigation systems and digital tools to stay organized and document repairs.
  • Ready for the outdoors – rain or shine at customer yards.
  • Independent, dependable, and self-motivated – you take pride in getting the job done right.
  • A positive attitude and safety-first mindset.
  • Must be 23+ with a clean driving record and a valid driver’s license.
  • Bring your own hand tools and we’ll supply everything else.

Work Environment

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.
  • Expect exposure to dust, diesel fumes, and noise typical of a shop or yard environment.
  • Safely handle chemicals, oils, and grease as part of repair work.
  • Be ready to lift, move, and position heavy equipment or components.
  • Stay active – you'll bend, kneel, crawl, and crouch to access vehicle components.
  • Work outdoors in all weather conditions – rain or shine, our team gets it done.

title: Gruppledare till avdelning Lycke som vill bidra till förändring
description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Nereby har verksamhet i Harestad och i Bergsjön. Vi bedriver differentierad och högkvalitativ skol-, vård- och behandlingsarbete. Verksamheten inbegriper en mängd professioner, såsom lärare, behandlingspedagog, psykolog, sjuksköterska med flera. SiS ungdomshem Nereby tar emot såväl skolpliktiga som icke skolpliktiga pojkar och flickor med psykosocial problematik samt kriminalitet och missbruk.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Motiveras du av att hjälpa ungdomar/klienter i en utsatt livssituation? Gillar du dessutom att organisera, leda och planera? Sök jobbet som gruppledare på SiS! Som gruppledare bidrar du till en trygg och säker miljö för såväl placerade barn och ungdomar/klienter som medarbetare. I rollen arbetar du aktivt i det operativa vård- och behandlingsarbetet ute på avdelningen. Du ansvarar för att planera, operativt leda och fördela det dagliga arbetet. Du agerar förebild och främjar att arbetet bedrivs rättssäkert och i enlighet med gällande styrdokument, metoder och uppsatta mål. Du håller löpande enhetschefen på din avdelning uppdaterad i frågor som kan påverka arbetsmiljön, vård- och behandlingsmiljön eller brister i verksamheten. Introduktion och handledning av nya medarbetare ingår också i ditt arbete. Du ingår i ett team med enhetschef och behandlingssekreterare och ni kommer att ha ett nära samarbete för att tillsammans skapa goda resultat.

Kvalifikationer

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen som gruppledare motiveras du av att arbeta med och hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation. Det operativa arbetet och mötet med ungdomar/klienter är ditt största fokus. Du är bra på att planera, organisera och prioritera arbetet på ett effektivt sätt och är tydlig i din kommunikation med andra. Samtidigt är du inlyssnande och bekräftande i ditt bemötande med ungdomar/klienter och medarbetare samt bra på att bygga relationer. Du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt och en god förmåga att samarbeta samt att sätta dig in i andras perspektiv. Arbetet är ibland utmanande och kräver att du är stabil och behåller lugnet även i stressade situationer.

Du ska också ha:

  • Högskoleutbildning om minst 180 högskolepoäng med inriktning mot samhälls, - vård- eller beteendevetenskap
  • Flerårig meriterad arbetslivserfarenhet av arbete inom SiS eller annan verksamhet med fokus på vård, behandling och säkerhet, såsom exempelvis socialtjänst, vård och behandling, kriminalvård eller annan relevant verksamhet.
  • God förmåga att uttrycka dig i svenska språket, såväl skriftligt som muntligt.

På SiS månar vi om ett gott ledarskap. Det innebär att du som ledare tar ansvar för helheten, agerar som en god förebild, driver utveckling, främjar ett gott samarbete och är tydlig i din kommunikation. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/

Vi vill att du ska växa och utvecklas i din yrkesroll! Som gruppledare kommer du att få en gedigen ledarskapsutveckling och värdefulla kunskaper och erfarenheter för att fortsätta att utvecklas i ditt ledarskap inom SiS.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning under sex månader och kan komma att förlängas. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Beredskapstjänstgöring kan komma att ingå i tjänsten.

Med staten som arbetsgivare ingår en rad förmåner, läs mer om dessa här: https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/formaner/

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.
