title: Director Health and Safety Management
description:
Sphere Entertainment Co. is a leader in immersive experiences, technology and media. The Company includes Sphere, an experiential medium powered by advanced technologies. The first Sphere opened in Las Vegas, with a second venue planned for Abu Dhabi. In addition, the Company includes MSG Networks, which operates two regional sports and entertainment networks, MSG Network and MSG Sportsnet, as well as a direct-to-consumer and authenticated streaming product, MSG+, delivering a wide range of live sports content and other programming. More information is available at www.sphereentertainmentco.com.

Who are we hiring?

The Director Health & Safety Management leads health and safety programs across development and construction projects, with a strong focus on maintaining safe, compliant, and productive active job sites. This role will serve as a hands-on safety leader in the field, partnering closely with Project Directors, construction management teams, contractors, and vendors to identify risks, establish controls, and drive continuous improvement. The Director brings strong construction safety expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence a diverse workforce while maintaining a consistent focus on accountability and operational excellence. This role will be regularly present on active construction sites and will play a critical role in ensuring safety is integrated into project planning and day-to-day execution.

What will you do?

  • Lead job-site safety programs: Establish, implement, and continuously improve health and safety practices across active construction sites, ensuring alignment with company standards, project requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Conduct field safety oversight: Maintain a consistent presence on construction sites, conducting inspections, observations, audits, and job hazard analyses to identify unsafe conditions, behaviors, and emerging risks and ensure corrective actions are addressed promptly.
  • Partner with project leadership: Work closely with Project Directors, construction managers, superintendents, contractors, and subcontractors to embed safety into project planning, scheduling, site logistics, and daily operations.
  • Manage incident prevention and response: Lead investigations of incidents, near misses, and safety concerns; identify root causes; develop corrective and preventive actions; and monitor follow-through to reduce recurrence.
  • Drive contractor and subcontractor accountability: Evaluate safety performance, monitor compliance with site-specific safety requirements, and hold contractors and subcontractors accountable for maintaining appropriate safety standards and practices.
  • Lead training and safety communications: Develop and deliver site-specific safety training, orientations, toolbox talks, and other communications that promote awareness, reinforce expectations, and build a strong safety culture across the project workforce.
  • Monitor compliance and reporting: Maintain accurate safety records, metrics, inspections, incident reports, and regulatory documentation; analyze trends and provide clear, actionable reporting to project and Development & Construction leadership.
  • Champion a proactive safety culture: Serve as a visible and trusted safety leader who encourages employees and project partners to identify hazards, speak up about concerns, and take ownership of safe work practices.
  • Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health & Safety, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; relevant equivalent experience will be considered. OSHA 30-hour certification required; Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or equivalent professional certification strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive health and safety experience, including significant experience supporting active construction sites and large-scale or complex projects. Experience managing safety across multiple projects or a portfolio is preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations and construction safety standards, as well as applicable federal, state, and local requirements and industry best practices.
  • Comfortable working in an active construction environment and regularly navigating job sites, including uneven surfaces, stairs, elevated work areas, construction equipment, noise, dust, and changing site conditions. Ability to wear required PPE and comply with all site safety requirements.
  • Strong ability to identify hazards, assess risk, determine appropriate controls, investigate incidents, and develop practical solutions that protect people while supporting project execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence project leadership, contractors, subcontractors, and frontline workers without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish clear expectations, hold project partners accountable, address unsafe behaviors or conditions decisively, and build a culture where safety is treated as a shared responsibility.
  • Able to communicate safety risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, exercise sound judgment in high-pressure situations, and balance immediate project demands with long-term safety and business objectives.

Special Requirements

  • This role will start remotely and will eventually be based on-site in Maryland with regular travel to business locations and other project sites.
  • International travel may be required at various stages of project delivery.
  • Expectation to work across international time zones which will require a flexible approach to working hours.
  • Regular presence at active construction and project sites and the ability to work safely and effectively in a dynamic field environment while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Must be comfortable walking and navigating active job sites, including uneven or unfinished surfaces, stairs, and areas with construction activity, equipment, noise, dust, fluctuating temperatures and changing site conditions.

title: Kassa-myyjä, Helsinki Kontula (määräaikainen 15 h/vko)
description:
Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä.

Tehtävä on 2 kuukauden mittainen määräaikaisuus. Työ alkaa 2.11.2026 ja työaika on 15 h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

  • Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
  • Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
  • Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
  • Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
  • Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen
  • Kyky palvella asiakkaitamme suomenkielellä; hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Technician
description:
To be a team member of the Driven by Dobbs family, you must be dedicated to supporting the company’s mission, vision, and values.

OUR MISSION:

To be the leader in the automotive tire and service aftermarket industry in every market that we operate in providing premier service to our guests.

POSITION TITLE: Technician

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Driven by Dobbs, our family of brands brings together Dobbs Tire and Auto Centers—founded in 1976 in South St. Louis, MO as a family-owned complete auto care provider—and Conrad’s Tire Express & Total Car Care, founded in 1969 in Cleveland, OH. Together, we have grown into a rapidly expanding, multi-market automotive service organization that will operate across eight states in 2026, with continued growth on the horizon. Across all locations, customers can expect a full selection of quality tire brands and comprehensive automotive services, ranging from routine maintenance to advanced diagnostics and engine repair. Our investment in training, development, safety, and overall team wellbeing empowers our people to deliver exceptional service every day. Rooted in a culture that extends beyond the shop, we proudly support local organizations and charities in the communities where our teams live and work.

We are seeking an experienced Technician. The Automotive Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining vehicles to ensure safe and reliable operation. This includes performing inspections, alignment adjustments, tire services, and general vehicle maintenance using specialized automotive tools and equipment. The technician works closely with team members to maintain efficiency, quality, and safety standards in the shop. Attention to detail, mechanical aptitude, and problem-solving skills are essential to accurately identify issues and complete repairs. The ideal candidate will be detailed driven, accountable, customer centric and a team player with a strong work ethic to contribute to the department goals and achieve results.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inspect, diagnose, and repair vehicles to ensure safe and reliable operation.
  • Perform wheel alignments, tire services, and other suspension or steering adjustments as needed.
  • Conduct general vehicle maintenance, including oil changes, brake service, fluid checks, and tune-ups.
  • Utilize specialized automotive tools and diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Maintain accurate service records and document completed work in accordance with company policies.
  • Work collaboratively with team members to maintain efficiency, quality, and safety standards in the shop.
  • Adhere to all safety procedures and ensure a clean, organized work environment.
  • Provide professional and courteous service to customers, explaining findings and recommended repairs clearly.

SUCCESS FACTORS:

  • A strong belief in safety- Being Safe 100% of the time is the expectation.
  • Alignment with company mission, vision, and values.
  • Strong work ethic with a commitment to results.
  • Strong team player with the ability to adapt to diverse team members.
  • Ability to perform in a fast paced/high volume environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A high level of time management, accountability, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to be organized, problem solve and be solution oriented.
  • Self-motivated, goal- oriented, and driven to accomplish department goals.
  • Strong critical thinker with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Highly-customer centric and master relationship builder.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of automotive systems and uses diagnostic equipment with accuracy.
  • Maintains a professional, can-do approach even in physically demanding or fast-paced situations.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Fast-paced automotive service environment.
  • Frequent exposure to varying temperatures due to the nature of the work and shop conditions.
  • Regular contact with automotive chemicals, including solvents, lubricants, and fluids used in vehicle maintenance and repair.
  • Extended periods of standing, bending, and lifting tires or equipment.
  • Requires adherence to all safety procedures and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Involves teamwork, reliability, and effective communication to maintain a safe and efficient workplace.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality service are essential for success.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in automotive repair or 2–4 years of hands-on training in automotive maintenance.
  • 1+ year of experience as an alignment technician or completion of a post-secondary vocational program in automotive technology.
  • Extensive knowledge of tire installation, wheel balancing, and diagnosing ride disturbances.
  • Growing knowledge of steering, suspension, and general vehicle maintenance.
  • Proficient in the use of standard automotive diagnostic tools and repair equipment.
  • Solid understanding of automotive systems and repair procedures.
  • Valid Drivers’ License Required.

Driven by Dobbs is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates agree to complete a selection assessment and pre-employment screenings.

title: Senior Product Analyst - ReCommerce
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A curious, hands-on analyst who turns complex marketplace data into product decisions and scalable measurement foundations.

Role? Senior Product Analyst in our ReCommerce vertical, driving experimentation and marketplace product development across the Nordics. If you don't check every single 'senior' box yet but have strong core analyst experience, we still want to hear from you. We value potential and offer plenty of room to grow.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it's a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Location? Join us in our central and modern Oslo office with the flexibility to work 3 days remotely per week: your choice, your balance.

Why us? ReCommerce is building the next generation of sustainable marketplaces across four countries, and analytics is at the center of how we learn and grow. You'll work with a small, skilled team that combines deep product collaboration with the opportunity to shape how we use AI, semantic layers, and modern data tooling to fundamentally change how analysts work. This is a role where you help build things that last, not just answer the next question.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with tools like Tableau, Amplitude, or similar.
  • Fluent SQL skills to explore, analyze, and build your datasets. We use dbt, Snowflake, and Tableau to power our insights. Experience with Python for analysis or automation is a plus. Already built your first Streamlit app? Even better!
  • A track record of working across the product lifecycle from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with PMs, UXers, developers, marketers, and fellow analysts.
  • A collaborative mindset; you understand that great products are built through shared goals. You value collective success and holistic product growth over solo stardom.
  • Excellent communication skills, not only in presenting clear, actionable insights but also in shaping the right questions and defining what data is needed to get to the answers.
  • Problem-solver with a hands-on mindset, ready to dive into experiments, impact analyses, or marketplace KPIs. You habitually dive into the deep end to extract new insights proactively.
  • A natural curiosity that fuels learning loops. You actively test hypotheses, measure impact, and help teams make smarter, faster decisions. You're excited about where analytics is heading - including AI-augmented workflows and modern data tooling.
  • A driven and pragmatic personality: you're not just here to observe, but to build. You're prepared to question assumptions (including ours), challenge, and push for better outcomes.

WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE? Day-to-day work & projects cooking

As a Senior Product Analyst in ReCommerce, you help our product teams build the right features faster and learn from them reliably.

You work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Developers, and fellow Analysts to:

  • Design and interpret experiments that connect product changes to commercial outcomes - including revenue, liquidity, and marketplace health.
  • Build reusable measurement foundations: cohort models, segmentation frameworks, and KPI definitions that the broader team can draw on repeatedly.
  • Run deep-dive analyses into category dynamics, user behavior, and competitive positioning across our Nordic marketplaces.
  • Define success metrics and guardrails for product initiatives, including AI-driven features where measurement discipline is crucial.
  • Create clear dashboards and reports that inform both day-to-day decisions and strategic direction.

Our ReCommerce Insights & Analytics team spans Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. We combine deep product work with cross-team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and increasingly, AI-augmented tooling.

Success after 6 months? You've built strong relationships with your product teams, contributed to experimentation and measurement for key initiatives, and delivered analyses that moved decisions forward.

Success after 1 year? You're a trusted analytical partner for marketplace performance and experimentation, with reusable models and frameworks that increase the leverage of the entire team.

The challenge to turn into an opportunity!

ReCommerce is fresh out of a transformation: we unified four brands onto a common platform while simultaneously raising the bar on analytical maturity. This means we’re now gearing up to ship more product improvements, evolve definitions, and build new measurement capabilities from the ground up. It also means real impact: your work shapes how we learn, decide, and grow across millions of users and multiple countries. And with our investment in AI-augmented analytics, you'll help define what the analyst role looks like in the future.

A few words from Hans Erik Hallheim, Director of Insight, Analytics & Pricing

"Hi, I'm Hans Erik! Our team is small but ambitious - we cover product analytics and business analysis across the full ReCommerce vertical. What makes us different is that we don't just answer questions: we build the analytical infrastructure and measurement foundations that let the entire organization learn faster. We're deep into AI-augmented workflows, semantic modelling, and experimentation design, and we're looking for someone who wants to help shape that direction, not just execute within it. If you're the kind of analyst who builds things others can reuse, and who gets excited about changing how analytics works, I'd love to hear from you."

title: Principal Cloud Architect (AWS)
location: Bucharest, Bucharest, Romania; Dublin, Ireland; London, England, United Kingdom
description:
About us:

Amach is an industry-leading technology driven company with headquarters located in Dublin and remote teams in UK and Europe.

Our blended teams of local and nearshore talent are optimised to deliver high quality and collaborative solutions.

Founded in 2013, Amach was created to solve a specific problem in aviation: too much complexity, too little usable intelligence. We help airlines modernise their operating model using cloud, data and Al-delivered by teams with deep aviation domain expertise.

Our goal is to maximize airlines' operational efficiency by optimizing resource use, reduce costs and increase customer experience and satisfaction.

If you own a Golden Jacket, we want to talk to you. Very few people have passed every active AWS certification and earned the jacket. If you are one of them, you didn't do it for the blazer. You did it because you wanted to understand the whole platform, not just the corner of it your last project happened to touch. That breadth is exactly what this role needs and it is rarer than the certifications suggest. Amach designs and delivers cloud programs where the hard part is never one service, it's the seams between networking, security, data, cost and the people who have to run it on Monday morning. You don't need the jacket to apply. If you are three exams short and still climbing, or if you have the equivalent depth without the badges, we would still like to hear from you. We say this up front because we would rather read your application than have you rule yourself out.

Key responsibilities & duties include:

  • Own the architecture for major AWS engagements, from first assessment through to live running
  • Set the technical direction clients trust, and defend it honestly when the easy answer is wrong
  • Lead migration and modernization programs across compute, data, networking, and security
  • Build cost into the design from day one, so FinOps is a habit rather than a rescue mission
  • Mentor engineers and architects across the practice and raise the standard of what "good" looks like here
  • Work with sales and delivery leads to shape proposals you would be happy to deliver yourself

Required Experience:

  • Deep, current AWS expertise across multiple domains, evidenced by certification, delivery history, or both
  • A track record of architecting and landing large-scale cloud migrations or platform builds
  • Fluency in infrastructure as code, containers and modern CI/CD
  • Strong security and networking judgment in regulated or high-availability environments
  • The ability to explain a complex design to a CTO and to a delivery team in the same afternoon
  • Comfort being the most senior technical voice in a client room

Desirable skills:

  • AWS Golden Jacket, or a live run at it
  • Aviation or travel experience
  • AWS Ambassador, Community Builder, Hero, or a record of speaking and writing in public
  • Azure or multi-cloud exposure alongside AWS

What’s in it for you:

  • An opportunity to join a fast-growing company
  • Options for career advancement
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Flexible working environment
  • Competitive salaries based on experience

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Amach is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This job description is intended to convey essential responsibilities and qualifications for this role, but it is not an exhaustive list of tasks that an employee may be required to perform.

If you are passionate about driving customer success, advising on strategic solutions, and contributing to product innovation, we would love to hear from you!

Not for you?

Check out all of our open positions in our careers page and follow us on LinkedIn for future opportunities.

P.S. Share this with friends and co-workers! Don't be afraid they'll steal it from you, if you're amazing and smart we'll find a role for you. We are growing fast and we are always looking for talented people.

At Amach, we strive to be an inclusive community of open-minded individuals with different backgrounds and we are committed to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. We strongly believe that a diversity of experience and background is essential to create a fulfilling environment and better solutions for our people and our customers. All Amach employees and contractors are expected to honour this policy and act to ensure that every individual is respected in the workplace.

Your personal data

Amach will process your personal information in accordance with the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We will comply with data protection law and principles, which means that your data will be:

  • Used lawfully, fairly and in a transparent way
  • Collected only for valid purposes and not used in any way that is incompatible with those purposes
  • Relevant to the purposes we have told you about and limited only to those purposes
  • Accurate and kept up to date
  • Kept only as long as necessary for the purposes we have told you about
  • Kept securely

If you would like to contact us about your data, please use the following address: info@amach.com

title: Remote Quantitative Analyst Work From Home
description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join our team and turn data into useful insights. You will work with large datasets, create quantitative models, test strategies, and collaborate with analysts, researchers, and technology experts. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys using math, statistics, programming, and financial research in a flexible remote setting.


What You'll Do:


- Develop and improve quantitative models for forecasting, pricing, risk, and investment analysis.

- Analyze large financial and alternative datasets to find meaningful patterns and opportunities.

- Build and maintain backtesting frameworks to evaluate quantitative strategies.

- Perform statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and time-series modeling.

- Use Python and SQL to clean, analyze, and transform data.

- Apply machine learning techniques where appropriate.

- Monitor how models perform and investigate unexpected results.

- Document your research, assumptions, methods, and results.

- Present your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

- Collaborate with research, engineering, investment, and risk teams.

- Continuously explore new quantitative techniques, datasets, and technologies.


What We're Looking For:


We welcome candidates with experience or strong academic/project work in quantitative analysis.


Required:


- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Proficiency in Python.

- Working knowledge of SQL.

- Understanding of probability, statistics, and quantitative modeling.

- Familiarity with regression, time-series analysis, or machine learning.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.


Nice to Have:


- Experience in quantitative finance, trading, portfolio analytics, risk, or pricing.

- Experience building or evaluating backtests.

- Knowledge of financial markets and asset classes.

- Experience with tools like NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, or statsmodels.

- Experience with R, C++, MATLAB, or similar languages.

- Experience with large datasets or cloud platforms.

- Knowledge of factor models, portfolio optimization, derivatives, or market dynamics.


If you don’t meet every requirement, apply anyway. We value strong quantitative thinking, curiosity, and the ability to learn. Candidates from mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, engineering, economics, and related fields are encouraged to apply.


Why Join Us?


- 100% remote work.

- Flexible working environment.

- Competitive pay.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Professional development and learning support.

- Opportunity to work with sophisticated quantitative models and real-world datasets.

- Collaborative team with exposure to research, technology, and financial markets.

- Meaningful opportunity to see your research turn into practical results.


Who Will Succeed Here?


You might be a great fit if you:


- Love solving tough problems with data.

- Enjoy asking, “Why does this model work — and when might it fail?”

- Can turn ideas into analyses, models, or experiments.

- Are comfortable working independently while cooperating with a remote team.

- Care about accuracy, reproducibility, and thorough research.

- Are curious about financial markets and new quantitative technologies.

title: Van Data Analist naar Data Engineer
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega’s.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project

Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.

Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.


Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo’n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Het mooie van Technology? We werken niet sectorgebonden. IT en data raken elke sector, daardoor vind je bij ons altijd een project waar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie perfect tot hun recht komen.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht een opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van 3.000+ experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en actief bij 600+ opdrachtgevers. Groot in schaal, maar persoonlijk in aanpak. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die zichzelf wil blijven ontwikkelen en voor wil blijven.



#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas
  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en vindt het leuk om dingen te automatiseren. Nieuwsgierigheid en eigenaarschap helpen je om snel meters te maken als Data Engineer.

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
Operations Supervisor

Do you enjoy creating structure, keeping priorities moving, and connecting the dots across a complex operational environment? As Operations Supervisor at GlobalConnect, you will work closely with our Customer Operations leadership team to strengthen operational follow-up and turn priorities into action.

This is a broad coordination role where daily operations meet continuous improvement and transformation. You will have visibility across Customer Operations in the Nordics and work with colleagues, leaders, specialists, and customers across functions and countries.

To succeed in this role, you likely have:

• Experience from a coordination, cross-functional, or business-facing role in a larger organisation preferably from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment.

• Experience with operational follow-up combined with improvement initiatives, transformation, or project execution.

• A good understanding of customer delivery, service management, KPI follow-up, and management reporting, including experience preparing presentations and decision-support material for management.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Scandinavian language.

About the role and the team

Customer Operations is responsible for the operational delivery of services to GlobalConnect customers across the Nordics. The department includes Customer Support, Service Desk functions across several countries, the Advanced Solutions Service Desk, and Operations Management.

Based in our Stockholm office, you will support structure, coordination, and progress across operational and strategic priorities. You will work closely with the Senior Director, Customer Operations, who is based in Fornebu, Norway, while reporting to the Head of Operations Management.

The role brings you close to both daily operations and longer-term development. Over time, the scope may also develop to include people management responsibilities, depending on organisational development and business needs.

What you’ll be working on

• Coordinate and follow up operational priorities, actions, decisions, and deliverables across Customer Operations.

• Drive structured follow-up of transformation initiatives, improvement activities, and priority deliverables.

• Monitor KPIs, trends, and risk areas and coordinate relevant follow-up actions across the department.

• Prepare management presentations, status updates, reporting, and decision-support material.

• Support strategic customer follow-up, critical cases, and escalations, including participation in relevant customer meetings.

• Coordinate across Customer Support, Service Desk, Advanced Solutions Service Desk, Operations Management, and other relevant functions to support progress and execution.

Who we are looking for

You work in a structured way and are comfortable balancing immediate operational needs with longer-term priorities. You can identify what matters, create clarity across several activities, and keep follow-up moving when priorities change.

The role involves frequent interaction with leaders, customers, specialists, and colleagues across countries, so clear communication and the ability to build effective working relationships are important. You are motivated by improving how things work and by turning plans, decisions, and improvement initiatives into progress.

Relevant higher education in management, administration, technology, finance, or a related field is beneficial, but relevant experience can compensate for formal education. Experience from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment is also an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

  1. Talent Acquisition Screening interview
  2. Hiring Manager interview
  3. Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition
  4. Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder
  5. Final alignment meeting
  6. References

Practical information

• Workplace: GlobalConnect's office in Stockholm.

• The role requires regular travel to Fornebu, Norway and the other locations where Customer Operations colleagues are based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Customer Operations coordinates priorities, follows up performance, and progresses operational improvements across the Nordics.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

title: Myyjä, Pori Satasairaala Sairaalantie 3
description:
ETHÄN HAE TÄTÄ PAIKKAA, JOS ET OLE AIDOSTI KIINNOSTUNUT, KIITOS!

Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava ärrän myyjämme.

Ärrällä asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte myymälässä yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin/ärrän yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme uuteen Porin Satasairaalan ärrälle myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 15 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Joustavuutta ja sitoutumista ärrä-myymälän työhön

• Suvujaa suomen kielen taitoa

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

• Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

• Tarkastamme luottotiedot osana rekrytointiprosessia

title: AT - Program Director - CDL
description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Area Manager/Regional Program Director, the CDL Program Director is responsible for providing leadership for the CDL Program. The CDL Program Director provides subject matter expertise and actively participates in curriculum development, revision, and implementation process. As the subject matter expert in a particular program, the CDL Program Director provides product knowledge training to the Account management group, utilizing materials generated via the centralized curriculum development process. This position is responsive to the Account management staff when asked to engage with potential students and actively participates in new student orientation. The CDL Program Director is responsible for hiring, assigning, orienting, developing, evaluating, and recognizing Driver Trainers within the program(s) of study. The CDL Program Director will convene meetings with faculty on a regular basis. The CDL Program Director is also responsible for monitoring and supporting the student population within his/her program of study. The CDL Program Director plays an active role in the student advising process, including advising students during the provisional period, meeting with students who initiate a complaint, advising students who have career-oriented questions, and consulting with students whose engagement and/or academic progress is in question. The CDL Program Director analyzes student population data, working with faculty and staff to identify students who may be at risk, and contacting students to identify barriers to success and to provide support and information concerning student services. Finally, the CDL Program Director is responsible for continuous improvement of the program. Actively engaged in the development and maintenance of the campus effectiveness plan, the CDL Program Director collects data for purposes of analyzing program performance.

Key Responsibilities

I. Provides Services to Students

  • Supplements Driver Trainer advising for students receiving failing assessments.

  • Provides academic advising as needed to students. Provides referrals to outside resources when counseling needs go beyond the scope of the school. Provides or arranges for student tutoring when needed.

  • Leads student retention initiatives for students in the program who experience barriers to success.

  • Maintains regular contact with all students within the program area and responds to their questions and/or concerns in a timely manner. Posts office hours for students.

  • Refers students to appropriate staff for non-academic problem resolution.

  • Contacts students who miss days from class or whose absence during the week results in more than four absences during the course.

  • Maintains records of interactions and correspondence with students (i.e. phone calls, emails, mail).

  • Monitors contact, and results of contact, from Driver Trainers to students in assigned program area(s). Makes calls weekly to students who (a) were not called or could not be reached; (b) did not return as promised; or (c) did not offer plans to return by a specific date. Offers appropriate academic advice and demonstrates genuine interest in students.

  • Identifies students needing tutoring.

II. Oversees Status of Quality of Curriculum, Instructional Materials, Equipment, and Facilities

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding academic curriculum for program area.

  • Actively participates in the curriculum development/revision process led by the Home Office Executive team.

  • Provides leadership in the implementation of new and revised curriculum.

  • Provides input into creating the master schedule regarding course sequencing, offerings, room assignments, and Driver Trainer teaching assignments.

III. Oversees Faculty Performance and Development

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in the recruitment, interviewing, and hiring of faculty for program of study.

  • Orients, monitors, supervises, mentors, and assists new Driver Trainers.

  • Ensures that all program area Driver Trainers adhere to required administrative and classroom delivery duties and requirements as outlined in the job description for CDL Driver Driver Trainer.

  • Ensures completeness of faculty files and documentation of official transcripts, professional development, observations, and performance reviews.

  • Provides leadership and supports all Driver Trainers and supervises their instructional and program needs.

  • Observes classes within the program area and coaches Driver Trainers to continually improve instructional presentation and classroom management skills.

  • Conducts performance appraisals of department faculty members, including areas of strength and recommendations for improvement and future skillset development.

  • Conducts regular weekly day and evening faculty meetings. Meeting topics may include improvement of course offerings, methods of instructional delivery, selection of texts, and such other purposes which serve to improve the quality of the instructional program. Documents all meetings.

  • Provides departmental product knowledge training to Account management and Career Services personnel as requested.

  • Provides information to all departments as trends and changes in program specialty areas occur.

  • Assists account management personnel with student recruitment as requested.

  • Promotes faculty participation and provides leadership in the professional development activities of program faculty members and the documentation of those activities.

  • Participates actively in a minimum of one professional organization within the community.

  • Attends faculty meetings and in-service programs. Maintains a record of professional development activities.

  • Maintains current personal knowledge of federal and state institutional regulations, and accreditation standards related to program area.

  • Participates in preparation of government and accreditation reports and ensures their timely submission and accuracy.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in evaluating data collected from student questionnaires and conducts faculty conferences when necessary to discuss the results and provides recommendations for improvement.

  • Maintains regular office hours each week to ensure consistency between day and evening policies, procedures and instruction.

  • Collaborates with peers and associates to ensure coordination of interdepartmental activities.

  • Intervenes in and works to resolve any personnel issues that arise among program area Driver Trainers.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in planning program budgetary needs if and when applicable.

  • Performs all duties of a full-time Driver Trainer.

IV. Leads and Develops Others

  • Provides clearly defined roles and objectives for driver trainers, monitors performance, provides feedback, and meets regularly to discuss priorities.

  • Resolves individual and group performance opportunities in a timely manner to motivate and foster teamwork.

  • Identifies opportunities to involve others in new and challenging work assignments that advance the skills and capabilities of individuals and the organization.

Experience and Education Required

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Industry certification in the field of instruction if required by industry, or demonstrated knowledge equivalent to the certification.

  • CDL Class A with at least 2 years driving experience.

  • 5 years of industry experience in the field of instruction.

  • 2 years of experience in a management or supervisory role.

  • Knowledge regarding faculty development, including requirements, delivery methods, and reporting.

  • Ability to show sensitivity to the needs and requirements of adult learners.

  • Knowledge of industry standards and requirements within the field of instruction.

  • Knowledge of and ability to facilitate learning on course content within the field of instruction.

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills.

  • Interpersonal relationship skills necessary for positive interactions with students, alumni, faculty, and employers.

  • Excellent creative and problem solving skills in dealing with students, alumni, employers, faculty, and staff.

  • Excellent presentation skills and ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups in a formal setting.

  • Management skills in planning, organizing, controlling and evaluating programs and policies in a dynamic and changing environment.

  • Knowledge of the federal FMCSA and state Department of Motor Vehicle standards.

Experience and Education Preferred

  • Associate’s Degree or higher, documented specialized competency within the field of instruction, or equivalent work experience in the field of instruction.

  • 5 years of experience in academic instruction in a post-secondary environment.

  • 10 years of experience in the field of instruction.

  • Working knowledge of federal/state government education regulations.

  • 3 years of experience in a management or supervisory role.

  • Previous experience as an academic program director.

  • Experience in student guidance, or related fields.

  • Working knowledge of federal/state government regulations.


Physical Demands

  • Mobility & Balance: Ability to frequently climb in/out of the cab, bend, squat, kneel, twist and reach to perform pre/post-trip inspections and navigate tight spaces.

  • Strength: Ability to crank trailer landing gear (often 100+ lbs), handle training and safety equipment, and potentially assist with loading/unloading (if applicable).

  • Endurance: Ability to sustain physical activity and be alert during extending driving and instructional periods, including exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, wind, rain, ice or snow.

  • Sensory Acuity and Overall Health: Must possess and maintain a valid DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate and meet DOT physical qualifications required to hold a CDL, with or without reasonable accommodations, as required by Federal regulations.

Specific Tasks & Considerations:

  • Demonstrating Skills: Physically showing students how to couple/uncouple trailers, perform inspections, and maneuver the large vehicle.

  • Environmental Exposure: Working outdoors in various conditions including extreme heat, cold, rain, or snow while training.


Work Environment

Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually not exposed to weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.


Note

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, or requirements associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change.

title: Intern, Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Engineering Intern
Location: Piper Products, Wausau WI

POSITION OBJECTIVE

Piper Products, a division of CFS Brands, is seeking an entry-level Manufacturing Engineer to support industrial engineering and continuous improvement projects at our Wausau, Wisconsin facility. This position will use engineering methods and Lean Manufacturing principles to improve productivity, quality, safety, standard work, and operational efficiency across our production processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Conduct time studies, motion studies, and process observations within manufacturing operations.

Analyze and support production line balancing initiatives to improve efficiency and productivity.

Support production layout optimization, equipment moves, and facility modification projects.

Assist with the design and improvement of workstations, incorporating ergonomics, safety, quality, and productivity principles.

Develop, document, and maintain standardized work for manufacturing operations.

Prepare and update work instructions, visual aids, process maps, and other technical documentation.

Collect and analyze shop-floor data to identify improvement opportunities and support fact-based decisions.

Analyze production data and key performance indicators (KPIs) and communicate findings to leadership and cross-functional teams.

Participate in continuous improvement projects using Lean Manufacturing tools and problem-solving methods.

Monitor action plans and follow up on assigned improvement activities to ensure timely implementation and sustainability.

Collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Safety, and Engineering to execute improvement projects effectively.

Support a safe, organized, and respectful work environment and perform other related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering field is required.

Recent graduate or early-career engineer; relevant co-op, internship, project, or manufacturing experience is preferred.

Ability to work on-site at Piper Products in Wausau, Wisconsin.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

Ability to work collaboratively with employees and leaders at all levels, including on the production floor.

Ability to understand, communicate, and document technical information in English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, 5S, value-stream mapping, or structured problem solving.

Experience with time studies, line balancing, standardized work, ergonomics, or process improvement.

Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience with AutoCAD or another layout/design software.

Experience in a manufacturing or industrial production environment.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Analytical thinking | Proactive mindset | Teamwork and collaboration | Organization and planning | Effective communication | Results orientation | Attention to detail | Problem solving | Adaptability | Continuous improvement mindset

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Completion of assigned time studies and process analyses.

Processes standardized and work instructions developed or updated.

Improvement opportunities identified and implemented.

Cycle-time reduction and productivity improvement.

On-time completion of assigned activities and project deliverables.

Sustained improvements in quality, safety, efficiency, and standard work adherence.

PHYSICAL AND WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Regularly work in an active manufacturing environment and on the production floor.

Ability to stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the facility for extended periods.

Ability to occasionally lift or move materials and equipment within safe-work guidelines.

Ability to wear required personal protective equipment, including safety glasses and protective footwear, as applicable.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Piper Products and CFS Brands are equal opportunity employers. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Piper Products | 300 S. 84th Avenue, Wausau, WI 54401

title: Backend Developer
description:
We're looking for a motivated Backend Developer to join our UGC Platform Team in Barcelona.

Flowbox was founded in 2016 and is a fast-growing tech scale-up with large ambitions and broad visions. We provide a SaaS platform that helps brands improve their marketing, social media and e-commerce strategies. Our technology helps our clients to better collect, manage, and distribute their own customers' content, aka user generated content (UGC).

Earlier this year, Flowbox acquired the Danish company Dreaminfluence, a leading influencer marketing platform. Post-acquisition, Flowbox now serves more than 1,000 customers, reports close to €9M in ARR, and employs over 70 people across offices in Stockholm, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Copenhagen.

Tech Stack

We work with a modern, cloud-native stack built for scalability and performance:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python (Flask, FastAPI), Celery
  • Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Amazon S3
  • Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, Kinesis, Athena, EKS), Docker, Kubernetes
  • Architecture & Tooling: Microservices, Event-driven systems, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, NewRelic

About The Team

  • The UGC Platform Team (Barcelona): Responsible for the heart of our UGC platform, including integrations, back-office tools, content collection, moderation, and distribution. We also manage event streams, analytics, and data infrastructure, ensuring our systems are efficient, reliable, and scalable.
  • The Influencer Platform Team (Copenhagen): The team behind the influencer marketing part of the Flowbox platform, developing and maintaining a platform for influencer collaboration, campaign management, and performance tracking. We handle everything from influencer payments and reporting to analytics and insights, making it simple for brands and influencers to connect, collaborate, and generate results.

We work cross-functionally in a hybrid environment, collaborating across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions. In this team, you’ll find a balance of challenge, creativity, and ownership, with plenty of opportunities to make a real impact on Flowbox’s core product.

We believe in pair programming, regular code reviews, and open feedback, helping each other grow while maintaining high-quality standards across everything we build.

Your mission

As a UGC Platform Backend Developer at Flowbox, you’ll play a vital role in shaping the core infrastructure that powers our product, a platform used by hundreds of leading brands around the world. You’ll be part of an autonomous, cross-functional, agile team that designs, builds, and maintains backend services that are highly available, low-latency, and scalable. Your work will directly impact how we collect, process, and deliver user-generated content at scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design and develop robust APIs, microservices, and backend systems that power our UGC platform.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to bring new features to life and improve existing functionality.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues across multiple services, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, infrastructure improvements, and process enhancements to help our platform grow efficiently.
  • Work with a modern tech stack including Python, Docker, AWS (S3, Athena, Lambdas), Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
  • Participate actively in Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Product Reviews, and Retrospectives, continuously improving how we build, deliver, and learn together.

About You

You’re a backend developer with 3-4+ years of hands-on experience building reliable, scalable systems. You have strong, practical experience with Python, and you take pride in writing clean, maintainable code that powers products millions of users rely on every day.

You’re comfortable working with Celery, Flask, Docker, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes, and you understand how to design and maintain microservice architectures. You have hands-on experience with AWS services like CloudWatch, Kinesis, EKS, Lambdas and DynamoDB, and you’re confident in navigating modern cloud environments.

You thrive in collaborative, open environments where ideas are shared freely and feedback is valued. You’re curious about how systems perform in production and motivated by delivering solutions that create real business value. Above all, you’re passionate about continuous learning, improving your craft, and contributing to great products that make a difference.

Why join Flowbox?

Flowbox offers a fast-moving and, at the same time, relaxed work environment in modern premises in the heart of Barcelona.

You will have large responsibilities and great career opportunities. You will work with a wide and modern tech stack; as one of our teammates says: “if you work at Flowbox, you will be able to work anywhere”. We want to accomplish our goals, but we need your help to do so.

More About Our Perks

  • A startup spirit with the stability of a growing international company
  • Hybrid work model (3+2), enjoy a flexible balance with three days in the office and two days working from home
  • Modern, central offices with free snacks and drinks
  • Half-days before holidays, more time to enjoy life outside work
  • Health and wellbeing benefits, including Gympass/Wellhub and private health insurance
  • Cobee for flexible benefit management
  • Fun afterworks and company events across our teams
  • The freedom to work from any of our four locations, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Amsterdam, or Stockholm
  • Amazing teammates to learn from, collaborate with, and have fun alongside across four countries

Apply today! We can\'t wait to meet you!

Flowbox equality

Flowbox is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at Flowbox is based solely on a person\'s merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Flowbox does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, pregnancy or related condition or any other basis protected by law.

Note: our corporate language is English, so we would really appreciate if you send your CV and a cover letter in English

title: Commercial Co-founder
description:
Unearth is building Europe's open system for climate data. We provide the finance sector with high-quality information on how companies affect – and are affected by – climate change. The data on the market today is flawed, which increases risk in financial decisions. With correct climate data, we can accelerate transition and reach the Paris Agreement.

Unearth is only a few months old, but we already have several customers, a high-class proprietary AI platform, interest from investors, and a part of Sting Core, one of the world's leading accelerator programs for early-stage tech startups with high growth potential.

Our next step is making Unearth a scalable business. Therefore, we are looking for a commercial co-founder who wants to develop our product, increase sales and build the company with us.

You will own the question:

How do we best transform our data into attractive products that banks and other financial actors internationally want to buy, use, and scale?

This is not a traditional CCO role where the commercial model is already finished and a sales organization is in place. You will be part of shaping the product and business.

Start as soon as possible, preferably based in Stockholm, preferably full time.

If you are the right person and everything clicks, we see you as a co-founder with ownership.

What you will build

  • Find the right positioning and go-to-market
  • Develop and package the product commercially
  • Develop the business and pricing model
  • Drive product-market fit
  • Work hands-on with sales

In the long run, the mission is to build a scalable commercial model for growth. At start, it’s just as much about doing the job from scratch yourself – sleeves rolled up, in other words.

Why Unearth?

Unearth was started by the team behind the NGO Klimatkollen: Frida Berry Eklund, Ola Spännar, Kayla Woodward, and Elvira Boman – a group of senior leaders in climate, AI, communication, and technology. Together, we have built an open data platform that handles and presents data about municipalities, regions, countries, and companies. With the support of Google.org, we have created a first-class AI platform, media reach of 800+ million, and secured 30+ partnerships, both in Sweden and internationally.

We know climate and AI. Unearth builds on the open data and technology developed in Klimatkollen to ensure that banking and finance gain access to the system for climate data, today via our API. We already have several large customers, including internationally.

The market for in-depth climate data is large (€153M) and growing fast (+29%). We are a niche climate data actor that knows the issues in depth and bases our product on research.

Our ambition is to serve Europe's banking and finance market with data and analysis that accelerates the green transition and achieves the Paris Agreement.

Do you want to do it with us?

We believe you have experience in enterprise sales and are used to selling products where the customer needs to understand data, business value, and risk before a purchase is made.

Experience from banking & finance as well as financial products and/or data sales.

If you have worked with sustainability or have a strong desire to contribute to green transition, it is a big plus.

Above all, we think you:

  • want to build a company, not just lead a finished commercial function
  • thrive when all the answers aren't there yet
  • master both strategy and execution
  • would rather talk to five customers before making fifty slides
  • understand data and tech development and make it understandable and relevant
  • are comfortable in meetings with senior decision-makers
  • like to test hypotheses, get input, and change direction quickly
  • want to take long-term responsibility for the company's development
  • are kind and fair and want to have fun at work

title: Software/Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Software cum Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain backend applications, APIs, data integration services, and data pipelines. The role requires strong software engineering capabilities, particularly in Node.js and RESTful API development, combined with practical experience in databases and data engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js.
  • Develop reusable microservices and integration components to support application and data requirements.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT) for ingestion, transformation, processing, and movement of structured and unstructured data.
  • Integrate applications with databases, external systems, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design API specifications, data models, schemas, and interface contracts.
  • Implement API authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, and role-based access controls.
  • Develop solutions using relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, or Elasticsearch.
  • Perform data transformation, cleansing, validation, and optimisation to ensure data quality and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot application, API, integration, and data-processing issues across different environments.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, exception handling, audit trails, and performance optimisation.
  • Develop automated unit, integration, and API tests.
  • Work closely with solution architects, data engineers, software developers, DevOps engineers, and business analysts.
  • Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Ensure solutions comply with organisational cybersecurity, secure coding, and data governance requirements.

Technical Requirements

Essential

  • Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Strong hands-on development experience with Node.js and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
  • Good knowledge of SQL and database design.
  • Experience integrating multiple systems and data sources.
  • Understanding of JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth 2.0 and JWT.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Good understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, and secure coding.

Good to Have

  • Python for data engineering and automation.
  • Event/message streaming technologies.
  • Elasticsearch
  • API gateways
  • Docker and Kubernetes.

Preferred Experience

  • 3-6 years of relevant software development/data engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to independently develop backend services and APIs and work across both application and data layers.

title: Ställföreträdande varuhuschef till Karlstad
description:
Gillar du pulsen i ett varuhus och får energi av att se hur både människor och resultat växer? Kom och utvecklas i din roll som ledare hos oss på Rusta!

Just nu letar vi efter en Ställföreträdande Varuhuschef till vårt varuhus i Karlstad.

Hos Rusta får du vara med och göra verklig skillnad – varje dag. I denna roll är du på den plats där allt händer, där vi möter våra kunder. Din allra viktigaste uppgift blir att vara varuhuschefen närmast, både när det gäller ansvar och det dagliga arbetet. Tillsammans ser ni till att vardagen flyter på smidigt, och när varuhuschefen inte är på plats är det du som tar rodret. Som team skapar ni ett välskött och inbjudande varuhus där både kunder och medarbetare trivs.

Om dig

Du inspirerar och stöttar dina kollegor, skapar struktur och ser till att rätt saker händer i rätt tid – med både helheten och detaljerna i fokus. Du är en trygg förebild för teamet, och du säkerställer att ni tillsammans jobbar mot varuhusets uppsatta mål. Som person är du bra på att skapa ordning och reda både i kassan och på lagret, samtidigt som du alltid har kunden i fokus och gör det där lilla extra för att skapa en välkomnande och positiv upplevelse i butik.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – vi lär dig! Men vi tror att du:

  • Har några års erfarenhet av att leda inom detaljhandeln, gärna från en verksamhet som hanterar stora volymer
  • Gillar att tänka långsiktigt och inspirera andra till detsamma

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a Systems Integration & Test Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead with comprehensive knowledge in Electronic Warfare systems and a solid understanding of project management. This role is responsible for leading a multi-disciplinary team in the integration and test of system hardware, software, and supporting facilities, ensuring electrical and physical compatibility while meeting program technical, schedule, and cost objectives.

The IPT Lead will support system design and development efforts from early design through integration, test, installation, and customer acceptance. This individual will work closely with Program Management, Chief Systems Engineering, and customers to plan and execute system-level integration, verification, and test activities.

**Essential Functions:**

- Lead integration and test efforts for complex Electronic Warfare systems across the full program lifecycle.

- Lead or support test readiness reviews, test working groups, anomaly investigations, and program status reviews.
- Troubleshoot test failures and drive resolution in collaboration with systems, design, and test teams.
- Identify and manage integration and test risks, opportunities, and mitigation plans.

- Oversee implementation and checkout of test equipment, software, and analysis tools.
- Support test execution planning, including coordination of personnel and shift coverage as needed.

- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

- Direct experience serving as an IPT Lead for integration, test, or development programs.
- Experience supporting flight test, environmental qualification, and customer verification activities.
- Familiarity with discrepancy reporting, root cause investigation, and corrective action processes.
- Experience supporting both development and production environments.
- Familiarity with systems engineering, requirements management, and configuration management tools.
- Experience presenting technical status, risks, and issue resolution plans to customers and senior leadership.
- Experience managing subcontractor technical performance and coordination.
- Experience with risk management and cost account management.
- Familiarity with LabVIEW, MATLAB, Boundary Scan, or similar test automation and instrument control tools.
- Familiarity with military environmental and electromagnetic qualification standards, including MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-461.
- Knowledge of OSHA requirements and ESD control best practices.
- Familiarity with RF and high-speed digital test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

  - 5+ years of experience in Electronic Warfare (EW), avionics, aerospace and defense systems, or related mission systems.
