title: Gift Administration Coordinator
description:
Gift Administration Coordinator

The UND Alumni Association & Foundation is seeking a Gift Administration Coordinator to play a key role in ensuring our donors' contributions are efficiently and accurately recorded, acknowledged, and aligned with their philanthropic intent.

In this position, you'll focus on the gift entry process, maintain the accuracy of our Salesforce CRM, adhere to gift entry policies, and uphold donor satisfaction through timely acknowledgments. You'll work with resolving data issues, performing donor research, and supporting seamless communication to enhance the donor experience.

We’re looking for someone who thrives on precision and embraces challenges. If you're adaptable, committed to excellence, and excited to contribute to a culture of gratitude and generosity, we want to hear from you!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Gift Administration Coordinator is responsible for recording and acknowledging gifts to the UND Alumni Association & Foundation to ensure that charitable contributions are efficiently and accurately processed. This individual ensures efficiency and timeliness in processing donor information and donations using best practices to maintain optimal data integrity as well as performs other financial responsibilities. This position plays a key role in maintaining Salesforce integrity and in maintaining donor communication and satisfaction through timely donor acknowledgement. This position exercises independent judgment in applying organizational policies, charitable giving regulations, and gift administration standards to ensure gifts are recorded accurately and in accordance with donor intent and regulatory requirements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

GIFTS

  1. Responsible for recording gifts to ensure compliance with gift policy and coding protocols for each gift to be credited in a manner that enables the fulfillment of the donor’s intent, and the donor is properly acknowledged.
  2. Develop and maintain a working knowledge of IRS charitable giving regulations, gift administration best practices, organizational policies, and reporting standards to ensure gifts are processed accurately and compliantly.
  3. Perform gift adjustments and write offs of donors pledges as needed.
  4. Coordinates matching gift program and ensuring that matching gift payments are properly entered into the system.
  5. Perform detailed research on wide-ranging, ad hoc requests for information regarding gifts, including but not limited to, providing clarity on donor intent.
  6. Respond to department gift questions.
  7. Ensure the integrity of financial information, maintenance of gift, donor, and other financial data in compliance with applicable regulations and reporting guidelines.
  8. Other projects assigned through supervisor.

EVENTS

  1. Process event registrations and related payments, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and documented.
  2. Prepare sponsorship invoices, process related payments, and monitor outstanding sponsorship commitments to support timely collection of event revenue.
  3. Apply organizational policies and charitable giving regulations to event registrations and sponsorships, including determining and recording charitable and non-charitable portions of payments and ensuring appropriate donor receipting and acknowledgements.
  4. Respond to event registration, sponsorship, and payment inquiries and assist in resolving related issues.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Education: Associate degree in a Business-related field. Technical training and/or work experience can be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience: Minimum of three years relevant work experience preferred


PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIREMENTS

Ability to operate computers, telephones, and other standard office equipment. Ability to focus and complete work in a timely manner. Ability to occasionally bend, stoop, squat, and lift or move objects up to 10 pounds.

COMPETENCIES

  • Ability to interpret and apply gift administration policies, charitable giving regulations, and reporting standards to complex gift situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proactive, self-starter, results focused.
  • Proven ability to prioritize projects and workflow, and to use independent judgment to make decisions regarding daily operations.
  • Resourceful, dependable, and willing to take initiative.
  • Experience in exercising discretion and judgment and in maintaining the security of confidential and sensitive information and materials.
  • Regularly produces accurate, thorough, professional work.
  • Exercises a professional approach with others using appropriate tools of communication, demonstrated ability to compose business correspondence.
  • Strong keyboarding skills: proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) functionality as well as general office equipment knowledge.


Benefits:

The UND Alumni Association & Foundation supports employees through a highly competitive total compensation package that includes competitive pay and an excellent benefits package, along with career growth opportunities, and supports work-life blend for our employees.

Benefits at UNDAAF includes health insurance with employer contributions towards premium, retirement plan with generous employer contributions, employer paid life and long-term disability insurance, paid holidays, generous paid time off policy, paid volunteer opportunities, EAP, UND tuition waiver, summer hours. Other elective benefits available: flexible benefits plans, dental, vision, STD, cancer care, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, voluntary life insurance for spouse and dependents.

The UND Alumni Association & Foundation recognizes that work-life blend is an important component of a larger picture of life responsibilities, obligations, goals and interests. We will make every effort in creating a work-life blend model that reflects life situations while also ensuring maximum productivity.

As a Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician, you’ll be the expert our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for skilled technicians who enjoy independence and variety in their work. You’ll be responsible for performing preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, including emergency roadside service when needed.

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.

  • Work outdoors in all weather conditions – rain or shine, our team gets it done.

title: Data Analyst / Engineer
description:
Join Collo in building the intelligence layer for liquid processes.

Collo, a Finnish deep-tech company, is looking for a Data Analyst or an Engineer to produce insightful analytics for well-known customers. This is a fixed-term parental leave cover, with the possibility to discuss continuing in the role after the fixed-term contract ends.

About Collo:

Collo builds liquid process intelligence for the global food and beverage industry. The company’s ambition is simple: help manufacturers understand what is happening inside their liquid processes in real time and turn that intelligence into better decisions and automated action.

Collo’s technology combines a unique RF-based measurement technology with science-led AI and analytics. A single inline analyzer reads the liquid’s unique fingerprint as it flows through the process, revealing changes that conventional factory systems often cannot see.

That intelligence helps some of the world’s leading food and beverage manufacturers reduce product losses, optimise cleaning, improve process control and ultimately make every drop matter.

Born from research at Tampere University and already deployed in 16 countries, Collo is now scaling internationally. This is your chance to join a small, highly skilled team working at the intersection of deep tech, data, industrial AI and real-world manufacturing.

What will you be doing?

In this role, you will join Collo’s Service team in a role that combines customer-facing analytics with hands-on development of the tools, pipelines, and automated workflows that make analytics more scalable and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include direct customer data analysis, visualisation, and reporting, as well as improving existing analysis pipelines, developing automated data processing, and designing scalable analysis workflows. You will work with industrial measurement and time-series data, turning it into actionable insights for Collo’s customers.

Your work will include participating in customer meetings, identifying analytics needs and problems in customers’ processes as well as developing solutions to these problems. You will conduct hands-on data analysis and communicate your findings to the customers. At the same time, you will develop and improve the underlying data processing and analysis solutions to reduce manual work. Python will be your main tool for data processing, analysis, and development. You will also use tools such as PowerPoint and Power BI to visualise and communicate insights.

In addition to customer-facing analytics, you will work closely with Collo’s Data & AI team. This collaboration may include preparing industrial measurement data for machine learning and AI applications, working with industrial IoT data, and contributing to shared data development topics across the organisation.

What kind of person thrives in this role?

This role is a combination of data analysis and engineering, offering independent responsibility, technical problem-solving, and collaboration with both customers and internal experts. It is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys not only analysing data but also developing better ways to process, automate, and utilise it.

We are looking for a data professional with a few years of relevant experience who is comfortable working independently with data and wants to deepen their expertise in data engineering and analytics. You enjoy solving technical problems but are equally comfortable discussing data and its implications with customers and other stakeholders.

We require you to have:

  • A relevant degree in information technology, computer science, data analytics, or a related field
  • A few years of professional experience in data processing, ideally in data analytics
  • Strong Python skills
  • Experience working with time-series data
  • Experience with MS Office tools; experience with Power BI is preferred
  • Experience using AI-centred tools, such as Claude Code and Codex, as part of your daily work
  • Professional working proficiency in English

We consider as an asset:

  • Experience working with databases
  • Experience with Azure or other cloud environments
  • Experience with measurement devices, process automation and/or the food and beverage industry
  • Finnish language skills

Collo offers you:

  • An opportunity to join a company in a strong international growth phase and contribute to scaling its data and analytics capabilities
  • A mission-driven team shaping a sustainable future in manufacturing
  • Cutting-edge product with strong demand and industrial impact
  • A chance to develop tools, pipelines, and workflows that have a direct impact on how efficiently analytics can be delivered to customers
  • A low-hierarchy organisation, knowledgeable colleagues, and an efficient working environment enabled by a small but highly skilled team
  • Well-known customers whose products you may recognise from supermarket shelves
  • Hybrid work and flexible hours to support performance over presence

Practicalities:

This is a full-time, fixed-term parental leave cover, currently estimated to run from November 2026 until October 2027, and you will be employed directly by Collo. There may be an opportunity to discuss continuing at Collo after the fixed-term contract, depending on the company’s needs and available opportunities at that time.

Collo’s office is located in Tampere, and most of the team works regularly from the office. We therefore hope you are able to work on-site as agreed and depending on your responsibilities, while flexible remote work is also possible.

The salary range for the position is approximately 3500-4500 € / month, depending on your experience. If you are a more experienced candidate and feel that your salary expectations fall outside the indicated range, we would still be happy to hear from you and discuss your expectations.

Would you like to become part of Collo’s growth journey?

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF format by the end of Wednesday 23rd September through aTalent’s application system.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not process applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Collo at: https://www.collo.fi/

For questions regarding the recruitment process and schedule, please contact aTalent’s Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlström (kiira.dahlstrom(at)atalent.fi, 0449020238)

title: Rådgiver marked og medlemspleie
description:
Vil du utvikle møteplassene og relasjonene som gjør næringslivet i Innlandet sterkere?

Innlandet er en region med et næringsliv som betyr noe langt utenfor egne fylkesgrenser. Her finnes industri i verdensklasse, en stor skog- og trenæring, næringsmiddelindustri, bygg og anlegg, reiseliv og opplevelsesnæringer, teknologimiljøer og tusenvis av små og mellomstore bedrifter som skaper arbeidsplasser i hele Innlandet. Det er disse bedriftene vi jobber for.

NHO er Norges største interesseorganisasjon for bedrifter, med 10 regionkontor rundt om i hele landet. Regionkontorenes oppgave er å være næringslivets stemme, påvirke lokale og nasjonale myndigheter og yte service til medlemmene. NHO Innlandet har 2 600 medlemsbedrifter med 36 000 årsverk, og vi samarbeider tett med resten av NHO-fellesskapet.

Nå søker vi en rådgiver som skal ta hovedansvaret for markedsarbeid, medlemspleie og medlemsvekst i regionen. Kjernen i rollen er å utvikle møteplassene våre, styrke relasjonene til medlemsbedriftene og bygge partnerskap som gir merverdi, slik at medlemmene opplever NHO som tilgjengelig, relevant og til stede for dem. Du får en arbeidshverdag tett på bedriftene som skaper verdier og arbeidsplasser i hele Innlandet.

Dette er en rolle du vil få stor frihet til å forme sammen med oss.

Ansvar og oppgaver

  • Planlegge, utvikle og gjennomføre konferanser, medlemsmøter, webinarer og andre aktiviteter i regionen. Du vil få ansvar fra ide til ferdig konsept, både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre.
  • Utvikle nye møteplasser og arenaer, og videreutvikle partnerskap og samarbeid med blant annet næringsforeninger og andre aktører i regionen
  • Relasjonsbygging og medlemspleie og være en ambassadør for NHO
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre medlemsturneer og bedriftsbesøk, og jobbe datadrevet med prioritering og oppfølging
  • Ansvarlig for vårt CRM-arbeidet i regionen, herunder jobbe strukturert og datadrevet med medlemspleie, medlemsinformasjon og verving av nye medlemmer
  • Markedsføring og kommunikasjon av NHOs initiativer
  • Verving av nye medlemsbedrifter i nært samarbeid med NHO markedsavdeling og NHOs lands- og bransjeforeninger
  • Bidra inn i løpende oppgaver og prosjekter ved regionkontoret

Stillingen rapporterer til regiondirektør, som du vil samarbeide tett med. Arbeidsfeltet dekker hele Innlandet, og rollen krever lett reisefot.

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Høyere utdanning og minimum 5 års relevant erfaring
  • Vi tror rette vedkommende kan ha ulike bakgrunner, men vi ser gjerne at du har erfaringer fra organisasjonslivet, politikk, eller kommersielle virksomheter med viktige samfunnsroller
  • Erfaring med å utvikle og gjennomføre arrangementer, møteplasser eller konsepter
  • God kommersiell forståelse og erfaring med å bygge og forvalte relasjoner og partnerskap
  • Kjennskap og interesse for nærings- og arbeidsliv, samfunnsliv og partssamarbeidet i Norge
  • Erfaring med markedsføring og sosiale medier, og god digital forståelse. Interesse for hvordan teknologi og KI kan brukes i praksis
  • Erfaring med CRM eller andre systemer for systematisk relasjonsarbeid er nyttig
  • God skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som har drivkraft og evne til å få ting til å skje. Du tar initiativ, jobber systematisk og strukturert, og legger lista høyt for gjennomføring. Du er samfunnsengasjert, trives med å skape nettverk, og er trygg i møte med andre.

Du arbeider godt selvstendig, men er samtidig en lagspiller som løfter de rundt deg. Godt humør og en positiv innstilling betyr mye hos oss.

Hva vi tilbyr

  • En viktig og synlig rolle i en region med et betydningsfullt næringsliv. Får et stort regionalt nettverk og får jobbe tett på bedrifter og beslutningstagere
  • Stor frihet til å forme både rollen og arbeidshverdagen din
  • Et kunnskapsrikt fagmiljø med utstrakt samarbeid på tvers av NHO-fellesskapet, og gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Et arbeidsmiljø preget av godt samarbeid, korte beslutningsveier og en del av et stort nasjonalt fagmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Du lykkes i rollen når medlemsbedriftene opplever god oppfølging, møteplassene skaper verdi, og vi når ut til flere bedrifter som vil ha nytte av NHO-medlemskapet.

In-office Perk Such As

  • Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
  • Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

We’re a diverse team with great people from across the world. This position is available both as a hybrid position in Marbella (Spain) or as a fully remote position from inside the EU.

We are advancing aviation, engineering integrated defense systems, and developing next-generation technology solutions and manufacturing to help global customers address their most critical challenges. Make a difference with a career at Pratt & Whitney.

This is an exciting opportunity as a Senior Backend Engineer, supporting the continued growth and evolution of Pratt & Whitney's AI-powered digital inspection solutions. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems and APIs that power our cutting-edge jet engine inspection platform across the global aftermarket network. If you are passionate about transforming complex engineering challenges into intuitive, high-performance digital experiences through data-driven development and emerging AI technologies, this may be the opportunity you've been looking for.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and AI teams, as well as business stakeholders to design and deliver scalable digital solutions. This is a critical role supporting the continued growth of Pratt & Whitney's digital product portfolio by improving system reliability, accelerating solution delivery, and delivering exceptional customer experiences through user-centered architecture and continuous innovation.

What You Will Do

  • Build state-of-the-art AI products that solve real-world customer problems.
  • Implement, enhance, and maintain core backend features using Python, FastAPI, and MongoDB on Azure.
  • Work in an international, high-ownership team that's hungry for growth with Agile, iterative, data-driven development.
  • Collaborate closely with software, Product, and AI teams to ship AI-assisted engine inspection solutions for aviation professionals globally.
  • Optimize backend performance and API responsiveness for reliability and scale.
  • Help shape the tech stack and level up our backend systems.
  • Contribute to quality assurance guidelines, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and developer tooling.
  • Apply software development best practices to ensure high-quality code, maintainable architectures, and adherence to security and coding standards.
  • Proactively surface and resolve performance bottlenecks and architectural risks.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • You, be yourself, we value the diversity you bring to the team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in Python backend development for SaaS platforms, with hands-on experience with FastAPI, MongoDB and Azure Cloud.
  • You have strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset to identify and address challenges to provide our customers with an outstanding experience.
  • A track record of clean, maintainable, secure code and thoughtful architecture (you favor KISS over cleverness).
  • You are curious, eager to learn, and committed to continuously expanding your knowledge within software development.
  • Deep grasp of backend performance and API optimization. You can explain and defend your design choices.
  • You are a team player who actively contributes ideas, gives and receives feedback regularly, and communicates early about issues, uncertainties, risks, and opportunities.
  • Self-directed, proactive, and reliable at managing your own time and deadlines.
  • You are familiar with an Agile/Kanban environment and embody an agile mindset and lean principles.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Familiarity with Redis.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, specifically AKS.
  • Experience with enterprise or aviation software products.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams.

What We Offer

  • Employee scholarship program for further education.
  • Comprehensive health, medical and dental benefits.
  • On-the-job training and in-house/external certifications.
  • Competitive remuneration package.
  • Allowance and overtime benefits where applicable.
  • Company transport provided.

title: Controller
description:
At AeroFlow Technologies, we specialize in creating complex tube and duct assemblies using high-performance materials capable of withstanding extreme pressure, temperature, and chemical interactions. You can even find our products aboard NASA’s Space Launch System and in the F-35 fighter jets. That’s the level of quality and innovation you’ll be part of when you join our team.

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Controller to lead the Finance and Accounting function for our Cookeville, TN operations and support our Flagstaff, AZ facility. As the senior accounting leader for the business, you will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of all financial reporting while maintaining strong internal controls and compliance with corporate standards, local statutory requirements, and U.S. GAAP. This key leadership role oversees all aspects of accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow management, and financial analysis. Working closely with the Vice President of Finance and cross-functional business leaders, you will provide financial insight and strategic decision support, lead the annual budgeting and forecasting processes, manage external audits, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across finance processes and controls. The successful candidate will be a collaborative leader with a proven ability to develop high-performing teams, influence business decisions, and contribute to the organization's long-term financial success. Occasional travel between facilities is required.

So, what will you be doing as a Controller?

  • Lead the full scope of accounting processes for a branch or collection of branches.
  • Lead the financial close and reconciliation process, accountable for accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure that local statutory reporting and tax authority requirements are met.
  • Ensure that policy and procedures adhere to a system of internal controls and serve as the lead for internal and external audit requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact with Corporate Accounting, addressing questions and reporting needs.
  • Lead, develop, and coach local accounting team.
  • Key role in the financial planning cycle - providing various inputs and performing reviews in the areas of revenue, material, headcount, plant expenses, and working capital (following standard financial planning process flows).

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Experience in financial close, internal controls, internal and external audit management, ad hoc analysis, management reporting, accounting standards (GAAP, IFRS), taxation, treasury, working capital, cash flow management, costing and financial planning
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint). Excellent skill level in Excel required.
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize work
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and leadership abilities, employee development experience
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint). Excellent skill level in Excel required.
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize work
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and leadership abilities, employee development experience
  • 7+ years of finance and accounting experience in a manufacturing environment (aerospace preferred), with at least 3 years of managerial experience

Reasons You’ll Love It Here

We offer a full suite of employee benefits such as medical, dental, and vision insurance; as well as paid vacation, paid personal time, and various opportunities to give back to your local community. We also strongly encourage and provide opportunities for learning and professional development. Our Learning & Development team has put together in-house training on subjects like front-line supervisor essentials, how to manage conflict in the workplace, and many others.

What to Do Next

Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Commitment to You

We’re proud of the fact that we are strongly rooted in being an inclusive, people-focused organization. Our company culture reflects values like integrity, ownership, and authenticity. We take these to heart, and if you do as well, you’ll fit right in.

AeroFlow Technologies is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, AeroFlow. will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations.

AeroFlow Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including status as a protected veteran or an individual with a disability.

title: Buyer
description:
Established in 1969, Testek is the leader in Aerospace and Aircraft Component Test Equipment. Testek is a small company with approximately 150 team members, with the headquarters located in Wixom, Michigan. We pride ourselves in a family-like work environment that includes a diverse team of talented and enthusiastic people.

Testek designs, manufactures, supports and services diversified products including custom test equipment/products and standard test equipment/products. Our wide-ranging capability includes simple manual to complex automatic machinery. Testek offers innovative and competitive solutions to various sectors including aerospace, aircraft, and industrial.

We invite you to explore our website at for more information about our company and our products.

Testek Solutions is currently seeking a Buyer.

Our goal is to purchase quality materials with required delivery at the most-economical price.

Materials cost is the #1 cost to Testek. It is one of the most-important elements in the cost of the products we sell. Therefore, the role of Buyer is extremely important.

Position Summary

Sources and purchases Fab & Machine parts, raw material, tools, services, packaging materials, and/or supplies necessary for operation of an organization. Reviews proposals, negotiates prices, selects or recommends suppliers, follows up orders placed, verifies delivery and maintains necessary records.

General Requirements

  • Highly organized
  • Self-motivated and determined to meet defined goals/deadlines
  • Extremely Accurate

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

1. Review and coordinate procurement activities for company.

2. Confer with suppliers for product or service price, availability, and delivery schedules, to include supplier conformance with drawing and specification requirements.

3. Prepare purchase orders; Provide supplier status on POs as required.

4. Maintain orderly reports including electronic filing systems.

5. Work cooperatively as part of procurement team and with Functional areas as required.

6. Perform other duties as assigned.

Purchasing:
  1. Purchase the following items:
    1. Main SO (shop order) related items (various). This includes cataloged items, machining/fabrication details, and any items that are part of the BOM, etc.
    2. Electronic components from Mouser, Newark, Digi-key, etc. (under guidance from Purchasing Team).
    3. Shop-related items from requisitions (fittings, fasteners, paint-related supplies, raw steel, wires/cables, electrical items, etc. under guidance from Purchasing Team).
    4. Work with Receiving department to pull inventory parts.
    5. Routine follow-up on open items for various s.o. #’s.
  2. For the above items (item a):
  3. Evaluate all purchase requisitions and purchase orders on a daily basis and develop implementation strategies.
  4. Maintain timely communication with suppliers and Testek team (follow up with suppliers for shipment status, resolve all purchase issues, coordinate with accounts payable to process all invoices, keep Testek team informed of status as required). Communication with both the supplier and the Testek team is essential.
  5. Maintain records of all purchase orders and associated documents for all processes.
  6. Identify cost-cutting initiatives
  7. Returns
    1. Overall co-ordination with Supplier, Receiving department, Engineering department, Accounting department, Trucking company (UPS, FedEx, YRC) for Supplier related returns for parts that are incorrect or not per specification or not per drawing requirements or not per Purchase order.
    2. Tracking of Supplier returned material till it is received in our Database.
  8. Maintain Supplier ISO certificates, filing supplier ISO non-conforming reports, Add new Supplier/Remove old Supplier from Approved vendor list and keep data available on quarterly basis.
  9. EPICOR experience is preferred
  10. No employee (or member of their families) shall solicit, accept or provide any gratuity or kickback in connection with any Company transaction. This policy applies to gifts and favors of any kind and to both customers and suppliers of the Company. All Testek employees will abide by the Testek Anti-Corruption Compliance Policy.

EOE – Equal Opportunity Employer. People of color, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. (Compliant with the new VEVRAA and Section 503 rules)

title: Intern
description:
INTERN

Team. Improvement. Excellence. Service.

Area

  • Internship

Relationships

  • Direct Report – Assigned Manager
  • Reports: N/A

Role Purpose

As a commercial contractor, Thomas Construction Group is responsible for taking a client’s vision and making it a stunning, structurally sound reality. This takes experience, problem-solving and leadership, but only through our dedicated team can we ensure project success. We’re looking for individuals who share our work ethic and company ethos to learn and grow in our PAID internship program on the North Carolina coast.

Our summer 2026 internship opportunities are in the following areas of specialization:

  • Project Management Track
  • Superintendent Track
  • Estimating Track
  • Marketing
  • HR
  • Accounting

Key Responsibilities

  • The Project Manager Intern will work on an assigned job in various stages of construction. In the past, interns have been responsible for assisting with anything from job progress reports to organizing monthly meetings to general site labor. The main goal for this internship is learning the daily responsibilities of a Project Manager and understanding how this role affects the outcome of a project.
  • The Superintendent Intern will work on an assigned job in various stages of construction. In the past, interns have been responsible for assisting with anything from with trailer set-up to monitoring subcontractor work to general site labor. The main goal for this internship role is to learn the daily responsibilities of a Superintendent and understand how this role affects the outcome of a project.
  • The Estimating Intern will be responsible for learning the TCG estimation system, understanding the bid administration process, following up with subcontractors regarding proposals and other assignments as the Estimating team sees fit. The main goal for this internship is to learn the ins and outs of Estimating and its systems and understand the important role it plays in the construction process.
  • The Marketing Intern will assist with social media, company events, marketing materials, and other department initiatives while learning how Marketing supports TCG’s brand and growth.
  • The Human Resources Intern will assist with recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement, and other HR initiatives while learning how HR supports TCG’s employees and culture.
  • The Accounting Intern will assist with invoices, financial documentation, reporting, and other accounting tasks while learning the basics of construction accounting.


Qualifications

  • Intern candidates are current junior/senior year students pursuing their undergraduate degree, preferably in Building Science, Construction Management, or a major aligned with internship roles. Experience working on multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced environment is essential. A sense of urgency partnered with attention to detail is a must!


Living Thomas Culture

The Intern will embody Thomas Construction Group’s core values: Team, Improvement, Excellence, and Service (TIES). These values are not just ideals - they are guiding principles that shape decisions, interactions, and outcomes. In addition, the Intern is expected to embody the traits of an Ideal Team Player by being Humble, Hungry, and Smart.

Together, these principles form the foundation of our OneThomas culture, and the Intern will actively foster this culture through daily actions, communication, and leadership, serving as a consistent model of what it means to lead at Thomas.

The Location

Thomas Construction Group is located in Wilmington, NC, nominated year-over-year as one of Southern Living’s best southern towns. Wilmington is the cultural, medical, educational, and economic center of this region.

Today, the Wilmington area is experiencing substantial growth, as both tourists and potential residents discover the desirability of vacationing and living in the area.

The city holds the distinction of being the cultural center not only for its corner of the state, but also for the whole North Carolina coastline. Writers, artists, and musicians are evident in abundance. The film industry lends an exciting opportunity for spotting the occasional celebrity or just watching the process of making movies. Since the first movie filmed here in 1983, Wilmington has been home to more than 300 movies and many television series.

Our office is centrally located in Wilmington, so commuting, dining or getting to the beach are all easy to do.

Why Should You Apply?

  • We’re a Top Workplace! Thomas Construction Group was recognized as a Top Workplace in Wilmington, NC, reflecting our commitment to creating a strong culture where our people can grow and succeed.
  • We’re winning awards! ABC National Safety Excellence STEP Platinum & Diamond Safety Awards: 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021. OSHA Gold: 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013 and 2014, OSHA Silver: 2012, 2015, North Carolina Department of Labor 2014 Certificate of Safety Achievement, North Carolina Department of Labor 2018 Certificate of Safety Achievement, First Year Silver Opportunities for on-the-job training, Wilmington Treatment Center PHC and Patient Dorms, 2019 ABC Carolinas Excellence in Construction Honorable Mention, Carolina Bay Continuing Care Retirement Community, 2017 ABC Carolinas Excellence in Construction Eagle Award, Carolina Bay Continuing Care Retirement Community, 2017 ABC Carolinas Excellence in Construction Green Award.
  • We have a culture of belonging and teamwork and we're right at the beach. Come join us!

title: Director, Operations & Financial Management
description:

United States by making complex programs easier to understand. We succeed by centering the experience of the people we work with and by continuously seeking to improve in all that we do.


Here at BeneLynk, our mission is to improve lives and positively impact health barriers by providing our healthcare partners with the information they need and people with the

advocacy they deserve.


WHO WE ARE


BeneLynk is built on compassionate service and innovative improvement. We innovate by bringing new solutions to problems. We show compassion by making human to human

connections, understanding challenges, and building the best possible solution. Every day, we are relentless in helping people who need essential resources to make their lives easier and healthier. The people we serve call us "miracles," "kind," "professional," "human," and "compassionate," and all with "service that gets the job done." We pride ourselves on creating a healthy environment for our employees to thrive and grow.


DIRECTOR, FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT SERVICES (FMS) – SELF-DIRECTED CARE (VDC) POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Financial Management Services (FMS) – Self-Directed Care (Veteran-Directed Care preferred) is a senior operational leader responsible for building, optimizing, and managing the tactical and administrative infrastructure of an FMS operation. This role

ensures seamless integration across payroll, compliance, onboarding, vendor management, and participant support within self-directed care programs.


The Director translates strategic vision into scalable, compliant, and high-performing operational execution across multi-state or multi-program environments.


This individual must possess deep expertise in FMS/Fiscal Intermediary (FI) models, including Vendor Fiscal/Employer Agent (VF/EA) structures, and a comprehensive

understanding of how all functional components—payroll, tax compliance, budgeting, reporting, and participant services—interconnect to support self-directed care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Operational Leadership & Execution
  • Lead the day-to-day operations of FMS functions, including payroll processing, timesheet management, EVV, onboarding, and service delivery workflows.
  • Build and scale operational processes that support self-directed care programs
  • Translate VP-level strategic initiatives into detailed operational plans, workflows, and KPIs.
  • Ensure efficient coordination across intake, customer service, payroll, compliance, and reporting teams.
  1. Compliance & Regulatory Oversight
  • Ensure full compliance with applicable federal, state, and program regulations including:
    • IRS employer-agent (Section 3504) requirements
    • VA Veteran-Directed Care (VDC) guidelines
    • Department of Labor and State Labor Laws
  • Oversee internal audit readiness, documentation standards, and continuous compliance monitoring.
  • Oversee program integrity functions, including timely review and escalation of fraud, waste, abuse, neglect, and exploitation reports.
  • Partner with Legal/Compliance teams to maintain policies, SOPs, and controls.
  1. Financial & Payroll Operations
  • Oversee multi-EIN payroll operations supporting participants as common-law employers.
  • Ensure proper processing of:
    • Payroll, tax withholdings, unemployment insurance
    • Vendor payments and reimbursements
    • Worker eligibility and background checks
  • Maintain integrity of participant-level budgets and financial reporting.
  • Oversee accurate and timely processing of participant budgets, spending plans, authorizations, and direct care worker pay rate changes.
  1. Program & Participant Experience
  • Ensure timely, compliant delivery of a high-quality participant and caregiver experience across onboarding, training, and ongoing support.
  • Implement scalable service models that support participants acting as employers (Employer Authority and/or Budget Authority).
  • Partner with care teams, case managers, and external stakeholders to support person-centered outcomes.
  1. Vendor & Technology Management
  • Manage relationships with payroll providers, EVV systems, and FMS technology platforms.
  • Lead implementation and optimization of systems including:
  • Timekeeping and EVV
  • Payroll engines
  • Participant portals
  • Ensure seamless integrations and data integrity across systems.
  1. People Leadership
  • Lead and develop cross-functional teams (payroll, compliance, onboarding, customer support).
  • Establish performance metrics, training programs, and accountability standards.
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  1. Strategic Partnership with VP, FMS Operations
  • Serve as the primary operational partner to the VP, contributing to:
    • Growth strategy and new implementation of program
    • RFP responses and program launches
    • Operational scaling across regions or populations
  • Provide data-driven insights on performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support transformation initiatives (e.g., startup-to-scale transitions).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Administration, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and progressive leadership experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 2-4+ years of progressive leadership experience in one or more of the following:
    • Financial Management Services (FMS)

title: Field Technician, Meter Reader
description:
Meter Reader Field Technician

Entry-Level | Full-Time | Paid Training Provided

Heath Consultants Incorporated | Protecting Communities since 1933


Since 1933, Heath Consultants has been a trusted leader in protecting communities through natural gas safety services. We are hiring motivated individuals to join our team as Meter Reader Technicians.

No prior experience is required — we provide paid training and industry-recognized certifications.

If you’re dependable, enjoy working outdoors, and want a stable career with purpose, this could be a great fit.


⭐Why Heath?

💵

Weekly Pay — Including Your Vehicle Allowance

You are paid weekly, and your vehicle allowance is paid weekly right alongside it. No waiting for a monthly deposit.


🎓

Paid Training & Industry Certifications

We will train you from day one. No experience needed — just dependability and a safety-first mindset.


🛡️

Work That Matters

Your work directly protects life, property, and the environment in the communities we serve.


🔍Position Overview

As a Meter Reader Technician you safely and accurately record customer gas meter readings, inspect meters for damage or leaks, and report equipment issues.

Meter Reader Technicians have assigned routes each day. The meter reader will pick up a handheld device from the local office, which has the route for the day. At the end of the day the handheld device is turned in.

Our “mobile office” approach to work means that you will never have the same day twice. Our technicians work from their personal vehicle utilizing the handheld devices to ensure clear and complete services.


What You’ll Do

  • Read Meters: Walk or drive assigned routes to read gas meters accurately using a handheld electronic device.
  • Inspect Equipment: Check meters, piping, and regulators for visible damage, corrosion, tampering, or leaks.
  • Report Issues: Document broken seals, stuck dials, hazardous conditions, or suspected gas leaks immediately to dispatch.
  • Customer Service: Answer basic customer questions politely and direct complex billing or service inquiries to the main office.
  • Access Properties: Open meter boxes, clear minor debris or vegetation blocking access, and secure gates or property boundaries when leaving.
  • Follow strict safety protocols and federal and local regulations.
  • Communicate professionally with homeowners and members of the public.


Work Outdoors & Stay Active

This role is ideal for individuals who prefer being active rather than sitting behind a desk. You will:

  • Walk approximately 4–7 miles per day
  • Bend, kneel, and lift up to 25 pounds
  • Work in a variety of weather conditions
  • Remain on your feet for extended periods


Operate Specialized Equipment

You will use industry-leading gas detection technology to identify potential leaks. Heath provides comprehensive paid training and certifications to ensure you are fully prepared and confident in the field.


📋Job Requirements

Required

• High school diploma or GED

• Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record

• Ability to pass a DOT drug screen and background check

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, and stoop on varying terrain, and to lift heavy items

• Ability to walk 4–7 miles per day in all weather conditions

• Strong reliability and accountability

• Proficient using technology (smartphone, tablet)

• Ability to use simple hand tools

• Ability to read and understand utility maps

• Works well within a group as well as individually


Preferred — But Not Required

• Customer service experience

• No industry experience necessary — we value work ethic, dependability, and a safety-first mindset


🎯What Success Looks Like

Our strongest technicians consistently demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, and technical competence with field equipment. They are customer-focused, detail-oriented, and trustworthy — with strong prioritization, communication, and time-management skills.




🚗Vehicle Program — Personal Vehicle Use

At Heath, we support our team members who are on the move. Employees in this role participate in Heath’s Personally Owned Vehicle (POV) Program, which provides meaningful financial support for local travel.


💰 What the POV Program Provides


💵

Weekly Vehicle Allowance — Approximately $185 per Week

Paid every week alongside your regular paycheck (approximately $9,600 annually). Non-taxable for this position.


⛽

$300 Monthly Fuel Card

A Company fuel card for qualifying business fuel purchases. Your card is issued on your first day and activates automatically about three weeks after you start — no paperwork required.


📡

Telematics Device Provided at No Cost

Heath provides a small, non-camera GPS device that installs in your vehicle to verify business mileage.


Program Qualifications

To participate in the POV Program, employees will need to meet a few standard qualifications:


  • Active auto insurance — minimum $100,000/$300,000/$100,000 coverage or $300,000 combined single limit
  • Proof of insurance provided before your first day and at each policy renewal
  • A vehicle that meets Heath’s standards — 4-door, backup camera, hands-free capability, and professional appearance
  • Willingness to have a Heath-provided telematics device installed in your vehicle


Full program details are shared upon hire, and a complete POV Program Candidate Summary is provided with your offer.


🎁Benefits & Compensation

Pay & Financial

• Weekly pay

• Weekly vehicle allowance (~$185/week)

• $300 monthly fuel card

• Monthly phone allowance up to $40

• 401(k) with company match

• $1,500 employee referral bonus


Health & Time Off

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Paid company holidays

• Paid training and industry certifications

• Overtime eligibility (non-exempt position)


📈Career Growth

Many of our technicians advance into senior technician, field leadership, and safety management roles. Heath is committed to developing long-term careers — not just filling positions.


Ready to Build a Career That Makes a Difference?


If you are dependable, safety-minded, and ready to protect the communities we serve in, we encourage you to apply.


Heath Consultants Incorporated is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Software Tester
description:
Jouw functie

Vanuit jouw gedegen pensioenkennis help je mee met de realisatie van nieuwe gebruikers- en klantwensen in de Rule Engine en test je de door anderen gemodelleerde nieuwe functionaliteit op juistheid en volledigheid. Dit doe je door testen voor te bereiden samen met materiedeskundigen (gebruikers) en voert deze testen samen uit. Bij het opleveren van functionaliteiten stel jij de testscenario’s op en zorg je dat teststandaarden worden nageleefd. Jij snapt en denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en weet klantwensen om te zetten in testscenario’s.

Naarmate je meer kennis krijgt van de Rule Engine applicatie en de wijze waarop daarin nieuwe gebruikers- en klantwensen worden gemodelleerd, ga je zelf ook in kleine stappen nieuwe functionaliteit modelleren. Op deze wijze ontwikkel je jezelf tot een allround Rule Engine-medewerker.

Jouw afdeling

PGGM is als pensioenuitvoeringsorganisatie werkzaam voor verschillende pensioenfondsen. Het pensioenstelsel is volop in beweging. De veranderingen leiden onder meer tot aanpassingen in de pensioentechnische systemen van PGGM. Eén van deze systemen is de Rule Engine. Dit is een functiegeoriënteerde applicatie en bevat de functies en rekenregels van de pensioenreglementen van vier klanten. De Rule Engine is dé centrale rekenapplicatie voor alle reglementaire pensioenberekeningen. Alle communicatie-uitingen richting de deelnemers van deze klanten maken gebruik van de berekeningen van de Rule Engine.

De Rule Engine teams bestaan uit ca. 25 gedreven, analytisch sterke en trotse professionals. Deze Scrumteams zijn in hoge mate zelfsturend en gezamenlijk verantwoordelijk voor het resultaat en elkaars functioneren. Er heerst een open en eerlijke sfeer. Qua techniek, maar ook qua samenwerking is het team binnen PGGM vooruitstrevend. Het werkt volledig Agile, waarbij in sprints van twee weken nieuwe en/of aangepaste diensten worden opgeleverd naar productie. De multidisciplinaire teams werken aan de implementatie van nieuwe features. Voor het verder verkorten van de time-to-market en verhogen van de flexibiliteit werken we Agile, vanuit de DevOps gedachte, Continuous Delivery, vergaande testautomatisering en ATDD.

Jouw achtergrond

Wij zoeken een nieuw teamlid, die het volgende met zich meebrengt:

  • minimaal HBO denk- en werkniveau
  • opleiding in een bèta-richting (wiskunde, actuariaat, econometrie, informatica e.d.)
  • goede analytische vaardigheden en affiniteit met IT
  • kennis en ervaring met testen (en testautomatisering) is een pre
  • kennis en ervaring met Agile en Scrum is een pre
  • een gedegen pensioenkennis is een pré;
  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een resultaatgerichte mentaliteit en ben je een teamplayeeen drive om voortdurend te verbeteren en daarmee ruimte creëren voor innovatie.

Wij bieden

Bij PGGM zijn we trots op onze kernwaarden: vertrouwen, teamwork en innovatie. Deze waarden zijn ontstaan uit de ‘best stories’ van onze collega's, momenten waarop zij op hun best waren. We geloven dat die momenten ontstaan wanneer je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Bij PGGM waarderen we de unieke combinatie van jouw persoonlijke en professionele eigenschappen. Want wat echt telt bij PGGM zijn mensen, honderd procent! Bij PGGM mag jij rekenen op:

  • Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Zeist/Den Haag en vanaf medio 2028 in hartje Utrecht.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris, in schaal schaal 15, tussen € 4.101,- en € 5.859,- op basis van 36 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling als deelnemer van pensioenfonds PFZW (71% betaald door PGGM, 29% door de medewerker).
  • Jaarlijks een Fit for the Future budget van € 300,- netto welke je kunt inzetten voor het verbeteren van de mentale, fysieke of financiële fitheid.
  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget voor interne en externe trainingen of opleidingen.
  • Ruim 26 vakantiedagen (medewerkers hebben de keuze om maximaal twee nationale christelijke feestdagen te ruilen met een voor hen belangrijke (feest)dag).
  • Flexibiliteit in werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden.
  • Een netto internetvergoeding van € 45,- per maand (€ 540,- per jaar).
  • Collectiviteitskorting op de aanvullende zorgverzekeringen.
  • Een thuiswerkregeling met een vergoeding van max. € 900,- incl. btw om je thuiswerkplek arbo-proof in te richten.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen lees je hier: link

Meer weten?

Is dit jouw nieuwe baan bij PGGM?

Wil jij samen met ons de verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor een goed pensioen van ruim 5,6 miljoen pensioendeelnemers? Solliciteer dan op deze vacature. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met recruiter … via …@pggm.nl.

Informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure vind je terug op onze website: Onze sollicitatieprocedure. | PGGM.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Voor deze vacature gebruikt PGGM tijdens de screening een assessment. Alle sollicitanten voor de vacature van software tester zullen een link ontvangen om een assessment te maken. Nadat wij de resultaten van jouw assessment hebben ontvangen, zullen we de procedure vervolgen. Uiteraard ontvang jij als deelnemer van het assessment ook de resultaten.

Meer weten? Neem dan contact met ons op!

PGGM en hybride werken

Bij PGGM hebben we een hybride werkomgeving gecreëerd die ons in staat stelt om flexibiliteit en samenwerking te combineren. Onze medewerkers hebben de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als op afstand te werken, afhankelijk van hun persoonlijke voorkeuren en de aard van hun werk. Door hybride werken aan te bieden, willen we onze medewerkers de vrijheid geven om hun eigen werkstijl te ontwikkelen, maar tegelijkertijd de voordelen van een gezamenlijke werkplek behouden.

Behandeling sollicitatie

Na ontvangst van jouw sollicitatie gaan wij via een aantal stappen kijken of jij bij ons past en wij bij jou. Bij de procedure voor de werving en selectie van nieuwe medewerkers verzamelt en verwerkt PGGM persoonsgegevens, hierbij kan ook naar sociale media gekeken worden. PGGM vindt het belangrijk dat dit zorgvuldig, vertrouwelijk, transparant en met in achtneming van de algemene verordening gegevensbescherming en aanverwante wet-en regelgeving plaatsvindt. Lees in dit document wat er gebeurt met je persoonsgegevens.

Aan intermediairs

We weten dat er veel partijen zijn die graag met ons mee willen zoeken of hun diensten willen aanbieden voor deze vacature, maar bij PGGM werven we nieuwe collega’s zelf. Acquisitie naar een werving & selectie-opdracht of onaangekondigde aanbiedingen van CV's stellen we dan ook niet op prijs en nemen wij niet in behandeling. Mochten we er niet uitkomen, dan bellen we jou.

Wij communiceren te allen tijde via officiële PGGM e-mail adressen (@). Bent u benaderd door een derde partij en/of twijfelt u of contact daadwerkelijk in opdracht is van PGGM? Check dan gerust of er daadwerkelijk een legitieme samenwerking is met derde partijen door ons te mailen of bellen.

title: Backend Developer Senior
description:
H3RE è un'agenzia PropTech che integra marketing, progettazione visiva e sviluppo software per operatori del settore immobiliare. Accanto all'attività di servizio, l'azienda sviluppa prodotti proprietari: la presente ricerca riguarda una posizione dedicata al prodotto, non alle commesse cliente. Il progetto La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo backend di una piattaforma di marketing intelligence per il real estate, concepita per collegare la spesa pubblicitaria all'intero funnel di vendita, dall'impression al contratto firmato. Il prototipo e le specifiche funzionali sono già definiti; l'interfaccia è in fase avanzata di progettazione interna. In una seconda fase, la stessa figura contribuirà all'infrastruttura di un ulteriore prodotto proprietario in ambito assicurativo, attualmente in fase di prototipazione, destinato a un'utenza professionale enterprise.

Responsabilità

  • Progettazione e sviluppo delle API e del modello dati della piattaforma, in architettura multi-tenant e multilingua (IT/EN)
  • Integrazione delle sorgenti dati: Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, portali immobiliari e CRM dei clienti
  • Realizzazione delle pipeline di ingestion e dei processi di sincronizzazione, con gestione di rate limit, retry e dati parziali o incoerenti
  • Implementazione della logica di attribuzione lungo il funnel: lead, visita, trattativa, rogito
  • Gestione di autenticazione, ruoli, permessi e isolamento dei dati per cliente
  • Deployment, monitoraggio e ottimizzazione delle performance sulle query analitiche
  • Definizione e manutenzione della documentazione tecnica dell'infrastruttura

Requisiti

  • Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo backend, di cui almeno un progetto nel quale si sia definita in prima persona l'architettura, dalla fase iniziale fino alla messa in produzione, senza subentrare a un sistema già impostato da terzi
  • Esperienza con clienti enterprise o in contesti regolamentati: audit trail, tracciabilità delle operazioni, gestione dei dati personali in conformità al GDPR
  • Solida competenza su database relazionali (PostgreSQL) e sulla progettazione di schemi per carichi analitici
  • Esperienza documentabile di integrazione con API di terze parti, inclusi flussi di autenticazione OAuth
  • Padronanza di containerizzazione e pipeline CI/CD
  • Capacità di lavorare a partire da specifiche di prodotto, con l'autonomia necessaria a segnalarne i limiti quando presenti
  • Italiano fluente; inglese tecnico

Stack tecnologico

Non è previsto un vincolo tecnologico predeterminato. Si richiede padronanza effettiva di un ecosistema backend moderno e diffuso - Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, Java/Kotlin o C# - unita alla capacità di argomentare in sede di colloquio perché la tecnologia proposta risulti la più adeguata a questo specifico caso d'uso. PostgreSQL è assunto come base di partenza sul fronte dati.

Requisiti preferenziali

  • Esperienza su piattaforme di advertising o su dati di marketing

title: Senior Data Engineer - murcia
description:
If you enjoy working alongside positive people, in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing is part of the culture and everyone is happy to help each other grow, keep reading, we're pretty sure you'll love idealista. 😉


The challenge

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to rebuild the data layer of one of idealista's core verticals from the ground up. This isn't maintenance work: it means redesigning data models, analytics, domain objects, and integrations on a modern architecture. You'll work within an established team, with real technical ownership over data decisions.


About the team

You'll join the Seeker segment, a group of multidisciplinary teams working together to shape one of idealista's most strategic products. Your day-to-day will involve close collaboration with engineers, product managers, and other specialists across multiple teams, contributing to shared technical decisions and driving initiatives that go beyond the scope of a single squad. Together, you'll help build the next generation of our platform, with the scale, ambition, and impact of one of Europe's leading proptech companies.


What you'll do

  • Redesign the vertical's data model: entities, relationships, events, and metrics. Think in terms of domain, not just tables.
  • Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and serving pipelines using dbt and columnar/OLAP databases.
  • Define and enforce data governance practices: ownership, lineage, asset cataloging, naming standards, and quality policies (freshness, completeness, accuracy).
  • Integrate heterogeneous sources (APIs, relational databases, events) by designing clear data contracts between teams.
  • Collaborate with product and backend teams to understand what data they need and why, and translate that into robust models and pipelines.
  • Document from day one: modeling decisions, contracts, standards.


What you need

  • Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, query optimization over large volumes. This is your primary tool.
  • Experience with transformation frameworks like dbt or equivalent.
  • Data modeling: dimensional, Data Vault, or both. You can articulate when to use which approach.
  • Familiarity with modern data architectures: lakehouse, medallion, ELT. You understand the \"why\", not just the \"how\".
  • Python or JVM (Java/Kotlin) for pipeline or data service development.
  • Git and comfort with the command line.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles.
  • Experience working alongside product/backend teams, not only within data silos.


Nice to have

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other columnar/OLAP databases.
  • Familiarity with Oracle as an operational database.
  • Experience with object storage (S3 or equivalent).
  • Hands-on use of metadata catalog tools such as DataHub or similar.
  • Experience with data observability tools and practices.
  • Event-driven architectures (Kafka or equivalent).
  • Domain knowledge in marketplaces or real estate.


Skills we value

  • You know how to do technical discovery with business and product stakeholders: understanding what they need and why, not just taking requirements at face value.
  • You communicate modeling decisions to non-technical audiences without losing rigor.
  • You spot repetitive tasks and automate them.
  • You have a documentation mindset: if it's not written down, it doesn't exist.


What we offer

  • This is a fully remote position, but if you enjoy working from the office, you'll always be welcome at our headquarters in the heart of Madrid or at one of our collaborative workspaces.
  • You'll keep learning—we mean it. Our platform is constantly evolving, generating plenty of opportunities for internal tech talks, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • We'll support your professional growth with the training you need to continue developing your skills.
  • We're active members of the tech community: we sponsor events, attend conferences, and regularly host meetups in our offices. We believe learning is important, but sharing knowledge with others is just as valuable.
  • In addition to your salary, you'll have access to a flexible compensation plan from day one, including benefits such as public transport, meal vouchers, and private health insurance.
  • Free language classes in English, Italian, and Portuguese.
  • Your wellbeing matters to us. That's why we offer a comprehensive wellness package, including physiotherapy, yoga, and psychotherapy sessions.
  • We also know that work is about more than just delivering great products. Throughout the year, we celebrate together with themed events, seasonal parties, and plenty of opportunities to connect with your colleagues.
  • Regular team-building activities—and much more!


And something more about us…


Since we began this adventure in the year 2000, idealista has been much more than a company.

It is a culture, a way of doing and understanding things that sets us apart. Respect, tolerance, integrity, and transparency are part of our DNA.

We have a team of people representing more than 20 different nationalities, with diverse languages, profiles, cultures, and backgrounds. We value differences and learning from others; different beliefs and ways of thinking enrich us.

idealista promotes equality in all areas, carrying out awareness and visibility actions for the LGTB+ community among employees, in advertising, and in the community in general.

We are committed to creating environments and spaces where people feel safe, protected, free from discrimination, and where equal opportunities are a priority.

Likewise, gender equality is another foundation of our commitment to our team. We are dedicated to developing measures that promote equality and support work–life balance, maternity, and paternity.


Do you see yourself in this? Take the challenge! :)


We’re waiting for you.

title: Security Officer
description:
Regional West Health Services is seeking a dedicated and professional Security Officer to help ensure the safety and security of our patients, staff, visitors, and facilities. In this role, you will respond to emergencies, monitor hospital grounds, and provide essential support in maintaining a safe healthcare environment.

This position is ideal for individuals who are calm under pressure, committed to service, and ready to make a meaningful impact every day.

A Day in the Life

Your day begins with a walkthrough of your assigned areas, conducting routine interior and exterior patrols to ensure the hospital environment is safe and secure. As you move through the facility, you stay alert—observing for anything unusual, addressing potential safety concerns, and making your presence known to staff and visitors.

Throughout your shift, you respond quickly to calls for assistance. Whether it’s a patient situation, a fire alarm, or a larger emergency, you assess the situation calmly and take appropriate action. No two calls are the same, and your ability to remain composed and think clearly is critical.

You’re often the first point of contact during security incidents. When situations arise, you investigate thoroughly, gather facts, and document everything accurately. From minor concerns to more serious events, your attention to detail ensures proper follow-up and accountability.

You also play a key role in maintaining order across campus—assisting with traffic control, supporting access points, and helping enforce facility policies in a fair and respectful manner. When needed, you coordinate with local law enforcement to ensure appropriate response and support.

In addition, you help manage secure access throughout the facility, assisting staff with badge access and ensuring only authorized individuals are in designated areas.

A large part of your day centers around people. You interact with patients, visitors, and employees, offering direction, support, and reassurance. Whether helping someone find their way or stepping into a tense situation, you deliver excellent customer service while maintaining professionalism.

When conflicts arise, you rely on your training to de-escalate situations and promote a safe, respectful environment. Your presence helps create a sense of calm and security for everyone in the hospital.

At the end of your shift, you leave knowing you’ve made a meaningful impact—protecting others, supporting your team, and helping ensure a safe place for care.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required

Experience

  • 1–2 years of security experience preferred

Licensure & Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license required

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong observation and decision-making skills in high-pressure situations
  • Ability to quickly assess situations and respond appropriately
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills for reporting and coordination
  • Skilled in de-escalation and maintaining professionalism during conflict
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with diverse populations

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods (up to 12-hour shifts)
  • Capable of lifting, pushing, or intervening with individuals when necessary
  • Work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Exposure to potential hazards, including biohazards and high-stress environments

Why Regional West?

  • Make a meaningful impact on the patient experience
  • Critical role in patient, staff, and visitor safety
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package

title: Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician
description:
Join Us as a Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician!

About Kooner Fleet Management Solutions

Kooner Fleet Management Solutions is one of the fastest-growing national providers of on-site fleet maintenance, preventative service, and mobile repair solutions. With nearly a decade of industry experience, Kooner FMS helps fleets reduce downtime, extend vehicle life, and simplify operations through proactive maintenance programs and advanced technology.

As a family-founded and field-first company, we take pride in delivering trusted partnerships, exceptional service, and innovative fleet management solutions that keep America’s trucks and trailers road-ready.

Why You’ll Love Joining Our Team

  • Earn What You Deserve: Competitive pay starting at $32-38/hr. based on experience.
  • Weekly Paydays: Get paid every Friday – no waiting around!
  • Take the Wheel: Enjoy a fully equipped company-provided service truck you can take home.
  • Fueled for Success: Enjoy a company-paid fuel card so you never pay out-of-pocket at the pump.
  • Stay Connected: Cell phone allowance included.
  • Invest in Your Future: 401(k) with company match.
  • Health Benefits that Kick in Fast: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage after just 30 Days!
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy paid vacation time, paid sick time, and paid holidays to rest, recharge, and take care of what matters most.
  • We’ve Got You Covered: Life & Disability Insurance for added peace of mind – because we take care of our team on and off the job.
  • We’re Here for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program for support when you need it most – we've got your back.
  • Bring a Friend, Get Rewarded: Refer great talent and earn $500 per successful hire – no limits on how many bonuses you can earn!
  • Grow With Us: Big Career Growth Opportunities in a rapidly expanding, forward-thinking organization.

About the Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician Role

As a Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Technician, you’ll be the expert our customers rely on to keep their fleets on the road. This field-based role is perfect for skilled technicians who enjoy independence and variety in their work. You’ll be responsible for performing preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers, including emergency roadside service when needed.

Geared up with your own, fully equipped company service truck, top-tier tools, and a supportive team that values your skill, drive and dedication, you’ll tackle new challenges every day and take pride in delivering safe, reliable and efficient service that keeps America moving.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

  • Perform onsite preventative maintenance, DOT inspections and follow up repairs on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers in a mobile field environment.
  • Handle emergency road service calls with confidence and urgency.
  • Respond to dispatch requests for scheduled and unscheduled service or maintenance.
  • Diagnose and repair electrical, brake, cooling, and air systems - everything that keeps a fleet running strong.
  • Use advanced diagnostic tools, including handheld computers and precision instruments, to identify and fix issues fast.
  • Put your expertise to work using hand tools, power tools, and welding equipment to get the job done right.
  • Road test vehicles to ensure every repair meets top-quality standards.
  • Stay productive and efficient, meeting or beating industry-standard repair times.
  • Work with trusted vendors to source parts and keep operations moving.
  • Take ownership of a company-issued service truck, perform maintenance and pre- and post-trip inspections, and ensuring safety compliance.
  • Jump in wherever needed – we're a team that supports each other.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • At least 3 years of hands-on diesel tech experience working on Class 6-8 trucks and trailers.
  • DOT inspection and air brake repair expertise that keeps fleets rolling safely.
  • Strong communication skills – you know how to connect and communicate with customers and drivers alike.
  • Comfortable using mobile apps, navigation systems and digital tools to stay organized and document repairs.
  • Ready for the outdoors – rain or shine at customer yards.
  • Independent, dependable, and self-motivated – you take pride in getting the job done right.
  • A positive attitude and safety-first mindset.
  • Must be 23+ with a clean driving record and a valid driver’s license.
  • Bring your own hand tools and we’ll supply everything else.

Work Environment

  • Work in dynamic, high-traffic areas – safety and precision are key.
  • Expect exposure to dust, diesel fumes, and noise typical of a shop or yard environment.
  • Safely handle chemicals, oils, and grease as part of repair work.
  • Be ready to lift, move, and position heavy equipment or components.
  • Stay active – you'll bend, kneel, crawl, and crouch to access vehicle components.
  • Work outdoors in all weather conditions – rain or shine, our team gets it done.

title: Junior Adviseur Zakelijk Buitendienst
description:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, leg je makkelijk nieuwe contacten en wil je jezelf ontwikkelen tot een sterke gesprekspartner voor ondernemers? Als Junior Adviseur Zakelijk Buitendienst krijg je de kans om het verzekeringsvak in de praktijk te leren én direct te bouwen aan je eigen netwerk en klantenportefeuille. Een mooie volgende stap voor commercieel talent met ambitie!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Adviseur Zakelijk Buitendienst werk je met een bestaande portefeuille van interessante mkb-relaties en ga je tegelijkertijd actief op zoek naar nieuwe zakelijke kansen. Je bent veel in contact met ondernemers, verdiept je in hun bedrijf en adviseert hen over risico's, verzekeringen en bedrijfscontinuïteit.

Je hoeft nog geen ervaren verzekeringsspecialist te zijn. Ervaren collega's begeleiden je en helpen je om zowel inhoudelijk als commercieel steeds sterker te worden.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het actief benaderen van potentiële nieuwe zakelijke relaties en genereren van new business;
  • Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van relaties met bestaande mkb-klanten;
  • Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en deze vertalen naar concrete resultaten;
  • Het adviseren van ondernemers over risico's, verzekeringen en bedrijfscontinuïteit;
  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een relevant zakelijk netwerk in de regio;
  • Het samenwerken met collega's om klanten zo goed mogelijk te adviseren en bedienen;
  • Het verder ontwikkelen van jouw commerciële en adviesvaardigheden.

Daarnaast neem je deel aan een internationaal salesontwikkelingsprogramma. Samen met de begeleiding van ervaren adviseurs krijg je daarmee volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien naar een zelfstandige rol als Adviseur Zakelijk.

Wat bieden ze jou?

Naast een commerciële functie waarin je veel kunt leren en jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen, kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto salaris tot € 4.675,- per maand, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring;
  • Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur;
  • Een leaseauto;
  • 28 vakantiedagen;
  • Een goede premievrije pensioenregeling;
  • Opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen die voor je worden betaald;
  • Deelname aan een professioneel salesontwikkelingsprogramma;
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Adviseur Zakelijk en Senior Adviseur Zakelijk;
  • Flexibele werktijden en aandacht voor een gezonde werk-privébalans;
  • Een modern kantoor en een informele werksfeer.

Waar kom je terecht?

Onze opdrachtgever is een grote en veelzijdige financiële dienstverlener gespecialiseerd in verzekeringen en risicobeheer voor particuliere en zakelijke klanten. Vanuit de vestiging in Aalsmeer werken ongeveer 50 collega's dagelijks aan passende oplossingen voor de financiële wensen en risico's van hun klanten.

De vestiging maakt onderdeel uit van een landelijke organisatie met ongeveer 800 medewerkers. Ondanks de omvang van de organisatie is er lokaal sprake van een persoonlijke en informele werksfeer. Je krijgt veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, initiatief te nemen en samen met ervaren collega's verder te groeien binnen het vak.

Presteren en plezier gaan hier hand in hand. Voor jou betekent dat een professionele omgeving waarin je kunt leren van ervaren collega's, maar tegelijkertijd de vrijheid krijgt om zelf commerciële kansen te creëren en aan jouw carrière te bouwen.

Wat verwachten ze?

Voor deze functie zoeken we vooral iemand met commerciële drive, ambitie en de wil om zichzelf te ontwikkelen. Ervaring in de verzekeringsbranche is daarom geen harde eis.

Wel herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over mbo- of hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van contact met klanten en ondernemers;
  • Je neemt initiatief en durft actief nieuwe contacten te leggen;
  • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet op een natuurlijke manier vertrouwen op te bouwen;
  • Je bent resultaatgericht en ziet commerciële kansen;
  • Je vindt het leuk om zichtbaar te zijn in de regio en een zakelijk netwerk op te bouwen;
  • Je wilt jezelf zowel persoonlijk als professioneel blijven ontwikkelen;
  • Je beschikt over Wft Basis, Wft Schade Particulier, Wft Schade Zakelijk en Wft Inkomen, óf bent bereid deze diploma's te behalen.

Heb je al ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening of verzekeringsbranche? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen. Veel belangrijker zijn jouw commerciële talent, motivatie en ambitie om uit te groeien tot een succesvolle zakelijk adviseur.

Klaar om jouw commerciële talent in te zetten voor ondernemers én tegelijkertijd flink te investeren in je eigen ontwikkeling? Dan is dit een mooie kans om jouw carrière als Zakelijk Adviseur te starten.
