title: Lead Electrical Instructor-STVT
location: STVT - Arlington TX, Arlington, TX, US
description:
Job Summary

A Lead Instructor is responsible for teaching courses and assumes the administrative responsibilities of a Lead Instructor. A Lead Instructor is responsible for program effectiveness, including outcomes, organization, administration, continuous review, planning and development. In situations where a program is being newly implemented or taught out and/or the student population does not warrant a Program Director, the Lead Instructor provides leadership and oversight to the program. Similarly, when two schools in close proximity are both offering the same program, a Program Director may be physically located at one campus while a Lead Instructor is physically located at the other. Finally, there may be situations where a program is large enough where both a Program Director and a Lead Instructor are necessary to provide adequate oversight to the faculty and students in a program.


Reporting to the Director of Education, the Lead Instructor provides subject matter expertise and actively

participates in curriculum development, revision and implementation process. As the subject matter expert in a particular program, the Lead Instructor provides face to face product knowledge training to the Admissions group, utilizing materials generated via the centralized curriculum development process. The Lead Instructor is responsive to the Admissions staff when asked to engage with potential students and actively participates in new student orientation. The Lead Instructor is responsible for hiring, assigning, orienting, developing, evaluating and recognizing instructors within the program of study. The Lead Instructor will convene meetings with faculty on a regular basis.


The Lead Instructor is also responsible for monitoring and supporting the student population within his/her program of study. The Lead Instructor plays an active role in the student advising process, including advising students during the provisional period, meeting with students who initiate a complaint, advising students who have career-oriented questions, and consulting with students whose engagement and/or academic progress is in question. The Lead Instructor analyzes student population data, working with faculty and staff to identify students who may be at risk, and contacting students to identify barriers to success and to provide support and information concerning student services. The Lead Instructor is responsible for continuous improvement of the program. Actively engaged in the development and maintenance of the campus effectiveness plan, the Lead Instructor collects data for purposes of analyzing program performance. The Lead Instructor shares responsibility with Career Services for the identification of local advisory board members, for establishing an agenda for those meetings, hosting the meetings, and documenting the outcomes of the advisory board meetings. Program performance data and feedback from the local advisory board is shared with the CRC Academic team for purposes of (centralized) continuous improvement of the curriculum.


Finally, the Lead Instructor is responsible for working collaboratively with Career Services staff to develop relationships with employers who are willing to provide opportunities for students to participate in externships, internships, and/or obtain clinical and practicum experiences at their worksite. The Lead Instructor is responsible for hiring the instructor of record for the externship, internship, clinical and practicum courses that award credit and/or contact hours and holding that individual responsible for following Delta’s policies and procedures associated with the management of externships.

Key Responsibilities

I

  • Provides Services to Students

  • Meets with each first term student during the drop/add period to answer any questions and to provide students with the opportunity to validate their choice of school and program.

  • Advises students on scheduling and provides program-specific guidance.

  • Supplements Instructor advisement for students receiving failing mid-term reports.

  • Provides academic advising as needed to students. Provides referrals to outside resources when needs go beyond the scope of the school. Provides or arranges for student tutoring when needed.

  • Leads student retention initiatives for students in the program who experience barriers to success.

  • Maintains regular contact with all students within program area and responds to their questions and/or concerns in a timely manner. Posts office hours for students.

  • Refers students to appropriate staff for non-academic problem resolution.

  • Participates in each term’s New Student Orientation Program; orients re-entering students returning to school.

  • Contacts students who miss two consecutive days from class or whose absence during the week

results in more than four absences during the term.

  • Maintains records of interactions and correspondence with students (i.e. phone calls, emails, mail) in the Student Information System (CampusVue).

  • Monitors contact, and results of contact, from instructors to students in assigned program area(s).

  • Makes calls weekly to students who (a) were not called or could not be reached; (b) did not return as promised; or (c) did not offer plans to return by a specific date. Offers appropriate academic advice and demonstrates genuine interest in students.

  • May serve as a sponsor for a student club related to the program area and encourages student participation in professional organizations within their field.

  • Monitors extracurricular student activities related to the assigned program of study.

  • Identifies students needing tutoring and provides instructors and/or peers for tutoring where required.

II

  • Assists in ensuring Instructional Materials, Equipment, and Facilities are available and maintained.

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding academic curriculum for program area.

  • Actively participates in the curriculum development/revision process led by the Ancora Academics team.

  • Provides leadership in the implementation of new and revised curriculum.

  • Assists with preparation for PAC meetings and assists with the presentations.

  • Monitors classroom instructional materials including equipment in the classrooms and laboratories,

  • bulletin boards, and supplemental teaching aids.

  • Provides input into creating the master schedule regarding course sequencing, offerings, room

  • assignments, and instructor teaching assignments.

  • Assists in the management of externship, student clinic, practicum, and/or related programs.

III

  • Oversees Faculty Performance and Development

  • Assists the Director of Education in the recruitment, interviewing and hiring of faculty for program of study.

  • Evaluates the transcript of faculty to determine course assignments.

  • Orients, monitors, supervises, mentors, and assists new instructors.

  • Ensures that all program area Instructors adhere to required administrative and classroom delivery duties and requirements as outlined in the job description for Instructor.

  • Ensures completeness of faculty files and documentation of official transcripts, professional development, observations, and performance reviews.

  • Provides leadership and support to full-time and part-time day and evening instructors and supervises their instructional and program needs.

  • Observes classes within program area and coaches instructors to continually improve instructional presentation and classroom management skills.

  • Conduct performance appraisals of department faculty members including areas of strength and recommendations for improvement and future skill set development.

  • Conducts regular day and evening faculty meetings. Meeting topics may include improvement of course offerings, methods of instructional delivery, selection of texts, and such other purposes which serve to improve the quality of the instructional program. Documents all meetings.

  • Provides departmental product knowledge training to Admissions and Career Services personnel as requested.

  • Provides information to all departments as trends and changes in program specialty areas occur.

  • Assists Admissions personnel with student recruitment as requested.

  • Promotes faculty participation and provides leadership in the professional development activities of program faculty members and the documentation of those activities.

  • Participates actively in a minimum of one professional organization within the community.

  • Attends faculty meetings and in-service programs. Maintains a record of professional development activities.

  • Maintains current personal knowledge of federal, state, institutional regulations, and accreditation standards related to program area.

  • Participates in preparation of government and accreditation reports and ensure their timely submission and accuracy.

  • Assists the Director of Education in evaluating data collected from student questionnaires and conducts faculty conferences when necessary to discuss the results and provides recommendations for improvement.

  • Maintains regular office hours each week to ensure consistency between day and evening policies, procedures and instructions.

  • Collaborates with peers and associates to ensure coordination of interdepartmental activities.

  • Intervenes in and works to resolve any personnel issues that arise among program area instructors.

  • Assists the Director of Education in planning program budgetary needs.

  • Performs all duties of a full-time Instructor. Teaches up to five classes depending on program size and other responsibilities beyond this job description.

IV

  • Leads and Develops Others

  • Provides clearly defined roles and objectives for faculty, monitors performance, provides feedback, and meets regularly to discuss priorities.

  • Resolves individual and group performance opportunities in a timely manner to motivate and foster teamwork.

  • Identifies opportunities to involve others in new and challenging work assignments that advance the skills and capabilities of individuals and the organization.

V

  • Fulfills All Functions Required by Instructors

  • Promotes and maintains a positive learning environment.

  • Accurately and completely fulfills administrative responsibilities for the classroom.

  • Manages the classroom/laboratory setting.

  • Effectively delivers instruction.

  • Utilizes Faculty Portal, Canvas, and other resources as appropriate.


Experience and Education Required

  • At least 5 years industry experience within the last 10 years.

  • Degree, or equivalent work experience in the field of instruction.

  • Industry certification in field of instruction if required by industry, or demonstrated knowledge equivalent to the certification.

  • 2 years of experience in academic instruction in a post-secondary environment

  • 2 years of industry experience in the field of instruction.

  • Knowledge regarding faculty development, including requirements, delivery methods and reporting.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace applications and database programs (CampusVue preferred).

  • Ability to develop and use collaborative relationships for the purpose of accomplishing work objectives; developing relationships with other individuals by listening, sharing ideas, and appreciating others' efforts.

  • Interpersonal relationship skills necessary for positive interactions with students, alumni, faculty and employers.

  • Excellent creative and problem-solving skills in dealing with students, alumni, employers, faculty and staff.

  • Knowledge of the federal Department of Education, state, local and accreditation standards.


Experience and Education Preferred

  • Master’s Degree

  • 5 years of experience in academic instruction in a post-secondary environment

  • 10 years of experience in the field of instruction

  • Working knowledge of federal/state government education regulations

  • 3 years of experience in a management or supervisory role

title: Power Delivery and Power Integrity Architect
location: Santa Clara, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm Data Center team is developing High performance, Energy efficient server solution for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, teamwork-oriented individuals for our cutting-edge technology work!

Our Mission
We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation server/compute platforms. By joining our team, you’ll collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative server solutions that push the limits of performance, energy efficiency, and scalability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm's Snapdragon SoC, delivering a comprehensive solution that includes hardware, software, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and more.

Position: Power Delivery and Power Integrity Architect

As an experienced Power delivery and power Integrity Architect (individual contributor), you will work closely with the platform team and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software, firmware, circuit-design, packaging, platform engineering, memory vendors, product management, and component suppliers. You will lead the definition, analysis, simulation, and verification of end-to-end power delivery and power integrity (PI) solutions from die to system level—establishing droop targets, resonance phenomenon, designing and implementing the power distribution network (PDN), and validating PDN quality through lab measurements. Expected to define technical roadmaps, influence cross-organizational strategy, and serve as a subject matter expert for Power Delivery across Qualcomm Data Center platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with SoC, firmware/software, memory vendors, component suppliers, packaging, platform engineering, and system design teams to define and implement power architectures that meet internal and customer requirements.
  • Lead voltage regulator (VR) design specification, selection, and co-development with VR suppliers
  • Develop E2E VR + PDN simulation flows to reduce time to market
  • Perform PDN modeling, simulation, and characterization for SoC, package, PCB, VRs, and LDOs.
  • Provide PI-driven feedback to SoC design teams to influence decap, package, and power rail architecture.
  • Create Power maps, Power tree and power-flow diagrams, power budgets from die- to system-level.
  • Develop and provide implementation and system efficiency guidelines.
  • Conduct IR Drop, AC, and transient simulations and provide model-to-hardware correlations.
  • Define module interfaces and formats for simulation and customer guidelines.
  • Lead PI model creation, end-to-end PI simulations (thermal-aware), and final design development taking into account effects of heat sinks and temperature effects.
  • Leverage ML/AI-assisted simulation techniques to streamline and automate design and analysis workflows from die to regulators."
  • Prepare and present technical documentation and reports to stakeholders, including engineering teams, senior management, customers, and suppliers.
  • Engage with customers and OEM partners to provide power delivery architecture guidance, PDN design guidelines, and bring-up support.
  • Troubleshoot system performance and identify areas for improvements

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; experience in Power Delivery preferred
  • Strong experience in Power Integrity (PI).
  • 8+ years of experience in Power delivery, board level VR design, PI analysis, simulation, and PDN measurements.
  • Strong understanding of PI fundamentals, power supply architectures, voltage regulator technologies, chip supply design, and PDNs.
  • Experience developing PI methodologies and PDN modeling from die to system, with model correlation and lab validation.
  • Experience with server, HPC, or data center platform power delivery preferred.
  • Experience with multi-phase VR design/selection
  • Proficiency in PI simulation tools (e.g., Simplis/Simetrix, ADS, ANSYS SIwave, HFSS and Cadence Sigrity PowerDC/PowerSI).
  • Hands-on experience creating complex PI models and simulations.
  • Proficiency with Unix/Linux environments and EDA tools using scripting.
  • Knowledge of packaging and PCB technologies, design, and manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of resonances, droops, IR Drop, cooling, temperature effects, and power consumptions.
  • Familiarity with 2.5D/3D packaging technologies, including CoWoS, InFo, EMIB, and RDL.
  • Strong experience in VR lab validation
  • Experience with electrical validation and compliance testing tools (VNAs, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, TDR, differential probes).
  • Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.
  • Strong technical documentation skills and excellent written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Electrical or Computer Engineering, specializing in Power Delivery.
  • 10+ years of experience in Power conversion, PI analysis, simulation, and PDN measurements.
  • Experience with AI/ML-accelerated computing platforms and their unique power delivery challenges (e.g., large transient currents, high-bandwidth memory power integrity).
  • Strong knowledge of voltage regulator (VR) design principles and system-level performance.
  • Familiarity with open compute / hyperscale server reference designs
  • Expertise in PDN related EM analysis.
  • Experience with package and PCB design tools (e.g., Cadence Allegro, Sip).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (MATLAB, Perl, Python).

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

title: Staff/Senior Java Engineer, OKX Web3 Wallet
description:
Who We Are

OKX Wallet is OKX's self-custody wallet, built for users worldwide to securely and conveniently store, manage, and use their on-chain assets. The wallet backend operates in a multi-chain, multi-asset, high-concurrency environment shaped by on-chain state uncertainty and strict fund-security requirements — combining the complex-systems challenges of traditional internet backends with the transaction, signing, and on-chain interaction problems unique to blockchain.

We're looking for a Senior Java Engineer with roughly 5–10 years of backend experience: someone with strong engineering fundamentals who can independently own core modules, exercise sound judgment on complex problems, and proactively coordinate across upstream and downstream teams to drive work to completion.

What You'll Do

  • Own core wallet backend modules. Build and continuously improve address management, asset synchronization, transaction construction, broadcasting, on-chain confirmation, gas estimation, nonce management, and transaction-state tracking. Understand each module's role in the full wallet flow, and keep stability, performance, and maintainability front of mind. For complex requirements, break the problem down before choosing an implementation rather than stacking code or reusing old designs.
  • Build transaction and on-chain interaction scenarios. Work on transfers, token approvals, contract interactions, cross-chain, swaps, DApp connections, and signature-request handling. Understand a transaction's full lifecycle — from initiation through construction, signing, broadcasting, on-chain confirmation, and final state update — and diagnose issues like stuck transactions, duplicate submissions, state inconsistencies, and on-chain success that isn't reflected in the business system, using logs, on-chain data, and call traces.
  • Support multi-chain and new-chain integration. We already support EVM, Tron, and Solana, and continuously onboard new public chains, Layer 2 networks, and asset standards. Contribute to technical research, integration design, and feature development, accounting for differences in address models, account systems, transaction structures, signing methods, fees, and confirmation mechanisms — as well as node stability, asset sync, exception compensation, monitoring, and security boundaries.
  • Ensure stable operation. Contribute to day-to-day stability work — monitoring, alerting, rate limiting, graceful degradation, retries, compensation, data reconciliation, and troubleshooting. When incidents occur, help investigate, narrow scope, and fix root causes; for recurring issues, drive systemic fixes such as added monitoring, stronger fallbacks, or design improvements.
  • Drive your projects to delivery. Take ownership of the modules and projects you're responsible for. On work spanning product, QA, frontend, infrastructure, or other backend teams, proactively sync information, surface dependencies and risks, and drive issues to resolution. When requirements are unclear or opinions diverge, lay out the context, offer your own judgment, and help build consensus.
  • Continuously raise engineering quality. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and system optimization. Spot unreasonable designs, duplicated logic, and latent risks, and propose actionable improvements. Document technical decisions, post-incident learnings, and best practices, and help less‑experienced teammates.
  • Apply AI in daily development. Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to assist with code comprehension, scaffolding, unit tests, code review, troubleshooting, refactoring, and documentation — validating AI output for correctness, project conventions, performance, and security rather than using it unchecked.

What We're Looking For

  • Solid Java backend fundamentals. ~5–10 years of Java backend experience with a strong grasp of collections, concurrency, thread pools, the JVM, network communication, and common performance issues. Proficient with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MyBatis, or comparable stacks, able to independently design and build medium-to-large backend modules and reason about the mechanics behind the frameworks you use.
  • Strong system design ability. Experience with complex or high-concurrency systems; comfortable with idempotency, retries, compensation, caching, message queues, distributed locks, data consistency, rate limiting, and service degradation. Able to own module- or service-level design and clearly explain the core flow, failure scenarios, and key trade-offs.
  • Cognitive ability and judgment. Able to understand context and goals on ambiguous problems, separate symptom from root cause, and choose a fitting solution based on business value, user experience, stability, cost, and security — rather than reflexively adding complexity.
  • Drive and ownership. Able to independently own a module or project end to end, from design through development, testing, and launch. Proactively communicates and resolves dependencies, risks, and blockers, and follows through on launch outcomes rather than stopping at code merge.
  • Blockchain or wallet experience. Experience with wallets, blockchain, trading platforms, on‑chain data services, or related systems. Understands addresses, public/private keys, mnemonics, transaction signing, broadcasting, on‑chain confirmation, gas, and nonce; familiar with the transaction mechanics of at least one of EVM, Tron, or Solana, and with token standards such as ERC‑20 and TRC‑20. (Strong backend fundamentals and fast learning can offset gaps in blockchain coverage.)
  • High security awareness. Sensitive to private-key, signing, permission, and user-asset security; familiar with replay protection, API authentication, tamper resistance, sensitive‑data protection, and least‑privilege principles. Actively considers malformed input, duplicate requests, privilege bypass, and data‑leak risks when building transaction features.
  • Independent production troubleshooting. Able to diagnose live issues via log analysis, metrics monitoring, distributed tracing, and thread/memory analysis; can form hypotheses and narrow scope even with incomplete information. Hands‑on experience with performance degradation, timeouts, message backlogs, data inconsistencies, memory issues, or unstable third‑party services.
  • Engineering in the AI era. Willing to use AI coding tools to improve daily efficiency and able to judge whether AI output meets real business requirements before shipping it. Has a basic understanding of prompts, context management, RAG, AI agents, and MCP, or a genuine willingness to keep learning — treating AI as an engineering tool, not requiring an algorithm/model-training background.

Nice to Have

  • Integration work on new public chains, new asset standards, or cross-chain protocols
  • Familiarity with WalletConnect, DApp Browser, or signature-request handling
  • Knowledge of MPC, multisig, hardware wallets, or TEE-based key-security schemes
  • Experience with Swap, staking, cross-chain bridges, or DeFi aggregation
  • Address risk detection, allow/deny lists, anti-fraud, or wallet risk-control experience
  • High-concurrency transaction systems, blockchain node services, on-chain data indexing, or transaction-state-tracking systems
  • Familiarity with RPC calls, block scanning, chain reorgs, transaction compensation, and reconciliation mechanisms
  • JVM performance tuning, stability governance, or complex production-incident experience
  • Cross-team collaboration with a track record of driving projects to delivery
  • Real projects built with AI — e.g. AI code review, development agents, MCP servers, intelligent troubleshooting, or knowledge bases
  • Follows developments in AI coding assistants and LLM applications and shares practical takeaways with the team

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation
  • Comprehensive insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • More benefits to be discussed after you join

title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail
description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Medewerker Pensioenbeheer StiPP – Werkgeverszaken
description:
Jouw functie

Bij PGGM hechten we grote waarde aan de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers en het klaarstomen voor de toekomst. Wil jij jouw carrière verder vormgeven en je verdiepen in uiteenlopende expertisegebieden zoals klantbediening, klantanalyse, datagedreven werken, digital smart of teamontwikkeling? Dan ben jij de persoon die wij zoeken!

Als Medewerker Pensioenbeheer StiPP Werkgeverszaken ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het pensioenbeheer van StiPP op werkgeversniveau. Je hebt een breed takenpakket, waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is! Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren en verwerken van uitval van dienstlijnen.
  • Het factureren van premies.
  • Het verwerken van afsluitingen van werkgevers, bijvoorbeeld bij faillissementen.
  • Het beheren van mutaties in de werkgeversadministratie en de Basisregistratie.
  • Het uitvoeren van gebruikerstesten en het beoordelen van nieuwe systeemfunctionaliteiten.
  • Dagelijks contact met werkgevers (en deelnemers), zowel per e-mail als telefonisch.

Uiteraard valt er nog veel meer te vertellen over de vacature, dat doen we graag tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek.

Jouw afdeling

Bij StiPP werk je in een dynamisch en innovatief team, waar we dagelijks streven naar het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening voor werkgevers en deelnemers. Door onze open overlegcultuur en focus op Agile werken, krijg je volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en je vakkennis verder te ontwikkelen. Wij geloven dat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt als je je kunt specialiseren en tegelijkertijd kunt bijdragen aan de gezamenlijke doelen van ons team.

Binnen PGGM hechten wij bovendien grote waarde aan het klaarstomen van onze medewerkers voor de toekomst. Daarom bieden we verschillende expertisegebieden waar jij je verder in kunt specialiseren, zoals klantbediening, klantanalyse, datagedreven werken, digital smart en teamontwikkeling. Zo krijg jij de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen op een manier die het beste bij jou past.

Jouw achtergrond

Wij zoeken een medewerker die:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau met 5-7 jaar ervaring of HBO werk- en denkniveau heeft met 1 tot 3 jaar relevante ervaring.
  • Zelfstandig en met overzicht kan werken, en goed prioriteiten kan stellen.
  • Energiek is, goed in een team kan werken en een positieve instelling heeft.
  • Initiatief toont, communicatief sterk is (zowel schriftelijk als verbaal) en doorzettingsvermogen heeft.
  • Bereid is zich continu te ontwikkelen en zich verder te specialiseren in een van de volgende expertisegebieden: klantbediening, klantanalyse, datagedreven werken, digital smart of teamontwikkeling.
  • Kennis heeft van Excel en administratieve processen.

Wij bieden

Bij PGGM zijn we trots op onze kernwaarden: vertrouwen, teamwork en innovatie. Deze waarden zijn ontstaan uit de ‘best stories’ van onze collega's, momenten waarop zij op hun best waren. We geloven dat die momenten ontstaan wanneer je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Bij PGGM waarderen we de unieke combinatie van jouw persoonlijke en professionele eigenschappen. Want wat echt telt bij PGGM zijn mensen, honderd procent! Bij PGGM mag jij rekenen op:

  • Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Zeist/Den Haag en vanaf medio 2028 in hartje Utrecht.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris, in schaal schaal 13, tussen € 3.145,- en € 4.493,- op basis van 36 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling als deelnemer van pensioenfonds PFZW (71% betaald door PGGM, 29% door de medewerker).
  • Jaarlijks een Fit for the Future budget van € 300,- netto welke je kunt inzetten voor het verbeteren van de mentale, fysieke of financiële fitheid.
  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget voor interne en externe trainingen of opleidingen.
  • Ruim 26 vakantiedagen (medewerkers hebben de keuze om maximaal twee nationale christelijke feestdagen te ruilen met een voor hen belangrijke (feest)dag).
  • Flexibiliteit in werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden.
  • Een netto internetvergoeding van € 45,- per maand (€ 540,- per jaar).
  • Collectiviteitskorting op de aanvullende zorgverzekeringen.
  • Een thuiswerkregeling met een vergoeding van max. € 900,- incl. btw om je thuiswerkplek arbo-proof in te richten.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen lees je hier: link

Meer weten?

Is dit jouw nieuwe baan bij PGGM?

Wil jij samen met ons de verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor een goed pensioen van ruim 5,6 miljoen pensioendeelnemers? Solliciteer dan op deze vacature. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met recruiter Daphne Maasland via daphne.maasland@pggm.nl.

Informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure vind je terug op onze website: Onze sollicitatieprocedure. | PGGM.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Voor deze vacature gebruikt PGGM tijdens de screening een assessment. Alle sollicitanten voor de vacature van Medewerker Pensioenbeheer StiPP zullen een link ontvangen om een assessment te maken. Nadat wij de resultaten van jouw assessment hebben ontvangen, zullen we de procedure vervolgen. Uiteraard ontvang jij als deelnemer van het assessment ook de resultaten.

Meer weten? Neem dan contact met ons op!

PGGM en hybride werken

Bij PGGM hebben we een hybride werkomgeving gecreëerd die ons in staat stelt om flexibiliteit en samenwerking te combineren. Onze medewerkers hebben de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als op afstand te werken, afhankelijk van hun persoonlijke voorkeuren en de aard van hun werk. Door hybride werken aan te bieden, willen we onze medewerkers de vrijheid geven om hun eigen werkstijl te ontwikkelen, maar tegelijkertijd de voordelen van een gezamenlijke werkplek behouden.

Behandeling sollicitatie

Na ontvangst van jouw sollicitatie gaan wij via een aantal stappen kijken of jij bij ons past en wij bij jou. Bij de procedure voor de werving en selectie van nieuwe medewerkers verzamelt en verwerkt PGGM persoonsgegevens, hierbij kan ook naar sociale media gekeken worden. PGGM vindt het belangrijk dat dit zorgvuldig, vertrouwelijk, transparant en met in achtneming van de algemene verordening gegevensbescherming en aanverwante wet-en regelgeving plaatsvindt. Lees in dit document wat er gebeurt met je persoonsgegevens.

Aan intermediairs

We weten dat er veel partijen zijn die graag met ons mee willen zoeken of hun diensten willen aanbieden voor deze vacature, maar bij PGGM werven we nieuwe collega’s zelf. Acquisitie naar een werving & selectie-opdracht of onaangekondigde aanbiedingen van CV's stellen we dan ook niet op prijs en nemen wij niet in behandeling. Mochten we er niet uitkomen, dan bellen we jou.

Wij communiceren te allen tijde via officiële PGGM e-mail adressen (@). Bent u benaderd door een derde partij en/of twijfelt u of contact daadwerkelijk in opdracht is van PGGM? Check dan gerust of er daadwerkelijk een legitieme samenwerking is met derde partijen door ons te mailen of bellen.

title: Promovendus diagnostische kwaliteit in de bloedstolling
description:
Functie

Wil jij bijdragen aan de diagnostiek van stollingsstoornissen en tegelijkertijd de toekomst van kwaliteitscontrole in laboratoriumgeneeskunde vormgeven? Dan zoeken wij jou als promovendus voor een innovatief onderzoeksproject op het grensvlak van klinische- en laboratoriumdiagnostiek, artificial intelligence en kwaliteitsverbetering.

Functieomschrijving
Diagnostische kwaliteit in de laboratoriumgeneeskunde wordt traditioneel beoordeeld vanuit analytische prestaties van individuele testen. Voor patiënten is echter vooral van belang of de juiste diagnose tijdig wordt gesteld. Binnen dit promotieonderzoek ontwikkel je nieuwe methoden voor diagnostische kwaliteitscontrole binnen de hemostase. Je onderzoekt hoe externe kwaliteitscontrole kan worden vernieuwd zodat deze beter aansluit bij de klinische werkelijkheid en de behoeften van zorgprofessionals en patiënten. Je richt je daarbij op het gehele diagnostische traject. Middels data analyse ontdek je verbeterkansen. Daarbij maak je gebruik van innovatieve benaderingen en simulatiemodellen.

Onderzoeksvragen
Binnen het project onderzoek je onder andere:

  • In hoeverre huidige laboratoriumtesten adequaat zijn voor het stellen van de juiste diagnose.
  • In welke mate richtlijnen worden gevolgd en hoe implementatie kan worden verbeterd.
  • Welke relatie er bestaat tussen analytische kwaliteit en diagnostische kwaliteit.
  • Hoe pre-analytische fouten kunnen worden voorkomen en welke invloed deze hebben op diagnostische uitkomsten.

Daarbij bekijk je welke rol virtual reality kan spelen in kwaliteitscontrole en hoe artificial intelligence kan bijdragen aan innovatieve kwaliteitscontroleprogramma's.

Jouw werkzaamheden
Als promovendus ga je een systematische literatuurstudie uitvoeren naar de huidige stand van zaken van externe kwaliteitscontrole binnen de hemostase. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe concepten voor diagnostische kwaliteitscontrole over de volledige diagnostische keten. Casus-gebaseerde simulatiemodellen zet je op om diagnostische besluitvorming te onderzoeken. Verbeterstrategieën ontwikkel je en pas je toe voor ziektebeelden zoals: hemofilie; ziekte van Von Willebrand; antifosfolipidensyndroom; trombopathieën en trombotische microangiopathieën.

Je onderzoekt daarnaast hoe referentiewaarden, algoritmen en diagnostische routes de kwaliteit van zorg beïnvloeden. Wetenschappelijke resultaten mag je presenteren op (inter)nationale congressen en publiceren in peer-reviewed tijdschriften.

Wij bieden jou:

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, cursussen en trainingen.
  • Deelname aan nationale en internationale congressen.
  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving waarin wetenschappelijke kwaliteit, samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan.

Jouw werkplek

Je werkt voornamelijk in het Radboudumc in Nijmegen en zult met enige regelmaat naar Voorschoten gaan. Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair onderzoeksverband tussen het Radboudumc, Maastricht UMC+ en stichting ECAT, een internationaal toonaangevende organisatie op het gebied van externe kwaliteitscontrole voor trombose- en hemostasediagnostiek. Je wordt aangesteld bij stichting ECAT.

Jouw begeleidingsteam heeft ruime expertise op het gebied van hemostase diagnostiek en kwaliteitsbewaking. Ook ga je samenwerken met artsen, ICT experts en ben je onderdeel van een team van promovendi en klinisch chemici in opleiding met focus op hemostase.

Profiel

Jij bent een enthousiaste en ambitieuze kandidaat die graag wetenschappelijk onderzoek combineert met innovatie en maatschappelijke impact.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde universitaire opleiding in medische informatiekunde, klinische technologie, (technische) geneeskunde, data wetenschappen, health informatics, biomedische wetenschappen, scheikunde, farmacie of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.
  • Aantoonbare interesse in klinisch diagnostisch onderzoek.
  • Affiniteit met statistische methoden en software programma’s, data-analyse en innovatieve technologieën zoals AI.
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Zelfstandigheid en een proactieve werkhouding.
  • Het vermogen om effectief samen te werken in een multidisciplinair team.

Goed om te weten

  • Aanstelling vindt plaats bij de stichting ECAT.
  • Salarisschaal 10 (stichting ECAT) is van toepassing, € 3706 – 4251 bruto per maand.
  • Je ontvangt vakantietoeslag, een eindejaarsuitkering en uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 20 oktober 2026. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Collection Advisor
description:

STATUS: Full-Time / Non-Exempt

LOCATION: Corporate Office

HOURS: 37.5 hours per week

COMPENSATION: The starting hourly wage for this position is expected to be $22.50 per hour. The actual hourly wage will be determined based on experience and other-job related factors, consistent with applicable law.

The primary function of a Collector Advisor is to recover money owed to the Summit for delinquent loan and share accounts. The objective is to collect payment from members by determining the appropriate contact method. All member contact must remain professional and comply with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act. The Collector should make recommendations to the Senior Collector for referrals to third party vendors and utilize all available resources to effectively collect. Additionally, the collector is to be resourceful within the job duties assigned, to minimize The Summit’s exposure to delinquent obligations.


Essential Functions

• Identify the reason for delinquency by contact with members.

• Attempt to cure delinquency by assisting member with payment arrangements.

• Recover funds owed to The Summit through all legal voluntary and involuntary means.

• Follow up daily on broken payment arrangement.

• Handle incoming phone calls and provide member service.

• Possess knowledge of the Credit Unions products and services.

• Document all conversations and actions accurately.

• Build relationships with members through cross selling when appropriate.

• Refer accounts to repossession agencies, attorneys, collection agencies, and reporting agencies, as appropriate.

• Contact other creditors to gain information about delinquent members (Skip Tracing).

• Counsel members with financial issues and refer to Balance when appropriate.

• Respond to ACDV and complete AUD via E-Oscar in a timely manner.

• Timely filing of notice of claims for deceased.

Other

• Maintain Fair Credit Reporting

• Maintain daily call volumes as assigned by management.

• Other duties which may be assigned by management.

• Flexible positive attitude with the desire to do the right thing for our members

• High School Diploma/Equivalency required.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office products.

• Basic knowledge of Bankruptcy

• Knowledge of Federal & State Laws

• Experience working with an adding machine.

• Possess knowledge of FDR (visa database), Symitar/Epysis and Report2Chex software applications.

• Experience collecting on consumer loan products

Skills

• Excellent written communication skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Effective communication skills with members, vendors, coworkers and supervisors

• Possess organizational skills which are necessary to maintain accurate information.

• Problem solves payment problem and research as needed.

Abilities

• Ability to work in a team environment.

• Ability to work evenings and weekends at management’s request.

• Ability to handle stressful situations and maintain composure.

• Ability to adapt to different software applications as needed.

• Perform mathematical calculations


Working Environment

• Be able to sit for an extended period of time.

• Must be able to utilize/view a monitor for an extended period of time.

• Must frequently use a keyboard to enter data.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: The Summit Federal Credit Union is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

title: Data and programming engineer - Renewable energy
description:
Trama TecnoAmbiental (TTA) , headquartered in Barcelona (Spain), is an international engineering and consulting firm established in 1986 and specializing in renewable energies, distributed generation, and energy access for development .

Our multidisciplinary team combines technical and management expertise, with extensive experience delivering projects all over the world.

TTA has been a pioneer of renewable energy-based microgrids , 100% and/or hybrid, from concept development, design, and engineering to deployment and dissemination, driven by a strong commitment to sustainability and social responsibility .

Further detailed information at:

2- Job description and responsibilities

TTA is seeking a Data and programming engineer to join the Knowledge and Innovation (KI) Unit of TTA , supporting R+D Project Managers, and taking on programming and documentation activities. The nature of projects will be related to the monitoring of distributed renewable energy (DRE)-based solutions.

TTA has developed an open-source digital platform for remote monitoring DRE solar installations. The system has two main components: remote data collection (hardware) and data reception and processing (software), integrated to facilitate data flow. Each component has its own architecture.

The Data and programming engineer will work mainly on the following tasks:

  • Programming IoT platforms: working with open-source code and frameworks, understanding their architecture, contributing to their development, and prototyping. Develop and deploy code for embedded systems, cloud platforms, and communication protocols relevant to IoT.
  • Technical documentation: develop documentation and consolidate TTA’s technical knowledge through the development of the digital remote monitoring platform for DRE. This includes the architecture at both software and hardware levels and contributing to the overall technical knowledge base within TTA for this platform as well as other ongoing R&D initiatives.
  • Integration support: assess and support the integration of DRE and solar mini-grids with the monitoring platform, including connections, communication protocols and monitored variables.
  • Data analysis: conduct analysis of data gathered by different monitoring platforms, including performance metrics, error logs, and sensor readings. Extract actionable insights to inform decision-making and contribute to the enhancement of the platform's functionalities for the overall efficiency of solar installations. Lead the development of a database of monitored projects from different platforms. This analysis will also inform broader R&D efforts and identify areas for innovation in DRE systems.
  • R&D project participation : actively participate in other assigned R&D projects, contribute to research, development, testing and documentation for new technologies, systems, or methodologies within TTA's scope of work in renewable energy and control systems.

The R&D Industrial Engineer Analyst will also:

  • Give support to project management activities .
  • Travel to project sites when required (less than 10% of field work expected). Projects of the KI team may take place in Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, Africa, and the Asia-Pacific region.

3- Profile

The ideal candidate for this position must have the following competencies*:

  • Educational background. A degree in Electrical, Electronic, Industrial, Computer Science, Telecommunications engineering, or a similar field is required. A master’s degree is desirable but NOT mandatory.
  • Previous work experience . 1 to 4 years of experience in digital platforms, software development, IoT systems, monitoring systems or similar. Experience in digital solutions projects involving renewable energies desirable.
  • Languages. Fluency in Catalan and English , especially written skills, is required.
  • Technical skills:
  • Knowledge of IoT platforms, data acquisition devices, and familiarity with communication protocols.
  • Knowledge in hardware development (processing units, sensors, communication modules).
  • Experience with database manipulation, ensuring structured data handling for efficient information management and access.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Nonverbal communication includes the capacity to project positive body language and facial expressions. Written communication refers to your skillfulness in composing text messages, reports, and other types of documents. Visual communication involves your ability to relay information using pictures and other visual aids. Active listening should also be considered a key communication soft skill because it helps you listen to and actually hear what others say. You need to be able to listen to understand how to best communicate with someone.

title: DIVISION PRESIDENT, OPERATIONS
description:
Division President, Operations

ABA Centers | New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Delaware Markets

ABOUT ICBD

ICBD is a robust single-family office focused on private investment and business development, supporting exceptional companies in healthcare, technology, and beyond.

We own and operate a growing portfolio of high-performance businesses united by a shared commitment to people, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. We are not just building businesses. We are building a legacy of leadership, innovation, and purpose.

Joining ICBD means becoming part of the team behind some of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare, technology, and business services. We are proudly self-funded, committed to sustainable growth, and led by visionary thought leaders, including our CEO and Founder, winner of the 2024 Ernst & Young U.S. Entrepreneur of the Year® National Overall Award.

Our most visible success is ABA Centers, a revolutionary leader in autism care and diagnostics, ranked #5 on the 2024 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

The ICBD Portfolio

Our portfolio organizations are united by strategic vision, operational expertise, and an unwavering commitment to excellence:

  • ABA Centers: The leading provider of autism care in the U.S., with 13 regional brands and more than 70 operating areas.
  • GateHouse Treatment: A comprehensive network of substance use disorder programs addressing the full spectrum of recovery needs, from medical treatment to supportive housing and respite services.
  • Marquis MD: A concierge medicine concept redefining healthcare by prioritizing convenience, connection, and care powered by advanced technology.
  • Exact Billing Solutions: Innovative revenue cycle management and advanced billing support systems for healthcare providers.
  • The Christopher M. Barnett Family Foundation: The philanthropic heart of ICBD, advancing programs that address autism care, food insecurity, homelessness, women’s empowerment, and underserved children.

ABOUT ABA CENTERS

We are the nation’s fastest-growing provider of autism care, delivering high-quality Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy across a rapidly expanding footprint. Since our founding in 2020, we have scaled from a single clinic to nearly 70 operating areas in more than a dozen states, supported by a high-performance corporate infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.

Recognized as the #5 fastest-growing private company in America by Inc. magazine, ABA Centers of America is a self-funded, founder-led organization, a rarity in today’s healthcare landscape. We have achieved this growth without private equity, relying instead on operational discipline, smart capital allocation, and a relentless focus on outcomes.

Our corporate team plays a mission-critical role in that success by developing scalable systems, managing risk, and driving the analytics that power our growth. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment, we offer a rare opportunity to help shape the future of autism care while building on a legacy of operational excellence.

Recognition and Awards

Our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned our company and our leaders national recognition, including:

  • Inc. 5000: 5th fastest-growing private company in America (2024)
  • Financial Times: #1 on The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies
  • EY Entrepreneur of the Year®, U.S. Overall
  • South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies
  • Florida Trend magazine’s 500 Most Influential Business Leaders
  • Inc. Best in Business, Health Services

THE ROLE

Overview

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer of ABA Centers, the Division President, Operations (DP) is the senior operating leader accountable for a defined territory spanning New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Delaware. The DP owns performance across people, service delivery, clinical quality, growth, financial results, and family experience.

The role pairs full P&L accountability with hands-on leadership of market teams and close partnership with clinical leadership to deliver consistent, high-quality care. The DP is the primary operator for all assigned markets, translating enterprise strategy into disciplined, repeatable execution at the division, market, and service area level.

Scope and Structure

  • Direct reports: Regional Directors
  • Territory: New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Delaware
  • Accountability: Full divisional P&L, census and utilization growth, clinical quality and compliance, and workforce stability across all assigned markets

The responsibilities below are not an exhaustive list. Reasonable accommodation may be provided.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Divisional Operations and P&L Ownership

  • Own and operate the full divisional P&L across all assigned ABA markets, including revenue performance, expense management, productivity, and margin.
  • Develop and execute market-level business plans aligned to enterprise strategy, including growth targets, financial objectives, and disenrollment reduction.
  • Drive performance so that every market meets census, utilization, retention, productivity, and operational maturity expectations.
  • Ensure consistent execution of operational standards in all markets, in alignment with the organization’s mission, vision, and values.
  • Make disciplined, data-driven decisions that improve service delivery, scalability, and financial performance.
  • Review and manage divisional and market-level KPIs, including:
    • Recruitment, retention, and staffing stability
    • New client intake, authorization velocity, and access to care
    • Scheduled versus delivered hours and missed services
    • RBT and BCBA billable hours and productivity
    • Disenrollment, retention, and utilization trends
    • Cost control and operational efficiency

Leadership of Regional Directors, Directors of Operations, and Clinical Directors

  • Directly lead, coach, and hold Regional Directors, Directors of Operations, and Clinical Directors accountable for operational, people, clinical, and market outcomes.
  • Establish clear expectations, scorecard ownership, and execution standards for each direct report within the assigned division.
  • Track and communicate KPI and scorecard results to reinforce accountability and drive performance.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and leadership development planning.
  • Ensure direct reports effectively manage performance, accountability processes, and corrective action within their markets.

Growth and Strategic Execution

  • Execute market-level growth strategies across the division, including:
    • New market launches and ramp optimization
    • Capacity expansion and access-to-care initiatives
    • Disenrollment mitigation and retention improvement
    • Market-level operational improvements
  • Partner with the Chief Operating Officer, Admissions and Business Development, Centers of Excellence, and other functional leaders to translate strategic direction into consistent execution in every market.
  • Maintain awareness of market dynamics and the competitive landscape so that markets deliver a differentiated, family-centered experience.

Clinical Quality, Compliance, and Controls

  • Partner with Clinical Directors and enterprise clinical leadership to ensure clinical quality, ethical care, and compliance with all regulatory and payer requirements.
  • Monitor clinical quality metrics, outcomes, and program effectiveness in collaboration with clinical leadership.
  • Support clinical teams with operational solutions that improve scheduling, utilization, and family experience without compromising care standards.
  • Ensure all markets meet and maintain regulatory, licensing, accreditation, and payer requirements.
  • Conduct regular site visits to evaluate safety, cleanliness, documentation accuracy, and operational integrity.
  • Ensure operational, clinical, and billing documentation is accurate, timely, and compliant.

People Leadership and Talent Development

  • Drive leadership development across the division in collaboration with Training and Professional Development.
  • Mentor Regional Directors and Directors of Operations toward increased responsibility and succession readiness.
  • Ensure strong hiring, onboarding, engagement, and retention practices in all markets to strengthen culture and reduce turnover.

title: Chief Aviation Officer
description:
Job Summary
Under the direction of the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Aviation Officer (CAO) provides collaborative strategic leadership and executive oversight of Boston MedFlight’s aviation business unit which includes flight operations, maintenance, and aviation safety. The CAO ensures the safety, efficiency, and regulatory compliance of aviation operations and respects and preserves the regulatory, airworthiness, and operational authority of the Director of Aviation Operations (DO), Director of Maintenance (DOM) and Chief Pilor (CP) while aligning performance with the organization’s mission and goals.


Key Responsibilities

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain the highest standards of safety, performance, and compliance for Boston MedFlight's aviation business unit under applicable FAA regulations and CAMTS accreditation standards.
  • Oversee the Director of Aviation Operations, Director of Aviation Maintenance, and Aviation Safety Manager, ensuring coordinated and safe aviation operations. The Director of Aviation Safety maintains a direct line of communication to the CEO as Accountable Executive.
  • Ensure aviation departments have the resources and support necessary to maintain required documentation and records in accordance with regulations, accreditation standards, manufacturers, and organizational requirements.
  • Support aviation quality functions, including internal compliance audits, corrective action tracking, and oversight of safety data programs (FOQA, ASAP, MSAP).
  • Maintain executive oversight of flight operations and maintenance quality programs and ensure significant findings, trends, and resource needs are communicated to the senior leadership team.
  • Serve as a member of the senior leadership team and participate in strategic planning discussions and initiatives.
  • Serve as a key aviation advisor to the CEO and Board of Trustees, contributing aviation expertise to strategic decision-making, industry partnerships, fleet planning initiatives, and presentations to the Board on business unit updates, key aviation initiatives, and challenges.
  • Represent Boston MedFlight in matters related to aviation with consortium and community hospitals, trade organizations, the FAA, state or municipal aviation bodies, airport management, community organizations, and contract agencies.
  • Develop and manage aircraft fleet replacement strategy and capital expenditures, including ongoing assessment of fleet size, type, and equipment against patient care requirements and suitability.
  • In coordination with finance, prepare and manage the annual aviation budget, including forecasting expenses and capital needs.
  • Authorize expenditures within defined organizational limits.
  • Monitor the aviation budget and provide variance analysis with recommendations.
  • Submit monthly readiness and performance reports to executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with Human Resources to define staffing needs, qualifications, compensation, performance evaluation, employment policies, and workforce and succession planning for aviation team members.
  • Ensure aviation departments have appropriate resources and support for education and training of aviation programs for personnel including pilots and mechanics, and aviation specific training for clinicians and communication specialists.
  • Conduct performance evaluations of direct reports and support leadership development and accountability.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing culture that supports cross-functional teamwork, communication, and shared accountability across the aviation business unit.
  • Collaborate with Clinical leadership to support patient care needs within applicable aviation safety, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements. .
  • Provide executive level support and oversight of vendor and OEM relationships to support fleet performance and reliability.
  • Support community outreach, education, and development/marketing initiatives.


Oversight Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior executive aviation resource to organizational leadership while leveraging the technical expertise and regulatory authority of aviation department leaders.
  • Champion a Just Culture and open safety-reporting environment across the aviation business unit, ensuring event findings drive systemic improvement rather than individual blame.
  • Develop and implement aviation policies and Safety Management System (SMS) processes that prioritize risk mitigation, operational safety, and regulatory excellence, in coordination with the Accountable Executive.
  • Define and refine operational standards to promote safety, efficiency, and mission readiness while operational and technical standards remain under the authority of the DO/DOM.
  • Support facilitating coordination between flight operations and maintenance to support safe and sustainable readiness recognizing airworthiness, staffing, fatigue, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify safety concerns, recommend corrective actions, and ensure resolution plans are communicated across the organization.
  • Maintain high standards of customer service throughout the organization’s transport systems.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field or relevant equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of aviation leadership experience preferably in air medical transport.
  • 5+ years in senior or executive aviation leadership with direct supervisory experience.
  • Valid FAA Airframe & Powerplant or Commercial Pilot Certificate (Rotorcraft/Helicopter – Instrument). This is a non-flying position; current medical certificate and currency are not required.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as an A&P or PIC for an HAA organization
  • Proven ability to develop, implement, and continuously improve aviation policies and procedures.
  • Strong interpersonal, listening, writing, and public speaking skills, with the ability to work independently and lead cross-functionally.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, problem-solving, and team-building ability
  • Working knowledge of aviation regulations, policies, best practices.
  • Demonstrated financial and budget management expertise.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for organizational representation and meetings.
  • Must have reliable weekday scheduling capability.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in aviation, business administration, or a related field
  • Experience in stand-alone / non-vendor, multi-base air medical operations
  • Familiarity with CAMTS accreditation standards and the healthcare/EMS regulatory environment
  • Prior experience as or working directly with a Part 119 management position such as a DO, DOM, or CP under Part 135
  • Experience developing aviation leaders and succession plans

title: Hardware Development Associate
description:
Hardware Development Associate

Location: Vancouver, BC
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: VP of Innovation & Operations

About Keycafe

Keycafe builds smart key-management systems used by organizations around the world. Our products combine custom hardware, electronics, cloud software, and mobile applications to help customers securely manage physical keys and assets.

We are looking for a capable, curious, and hands-on Hardware Development Associate to join our Vancouver team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career professional who wants broad exposure to physical product development. You will contribute across mechanical design, prototyping, testing, assembly, product documentation, and supplier coordination. As you develop product and operational knowledge, the role offers a path toward increased responsibility for manufacturing and supply-chain operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with mechanical design and product-development work for Keycafe hardware products.
  • Build, modify, and evaluate prototypes and early production units.
  • Support product testing, troubleshooting, validation, and design improvements.
  • Assist with hands-on assembly, functional checks, quality inspection, and packaging of hardware products.
  • Help develop and improve assembly instructions, test procedures, inspection criteria, and related documentation.
  • Coordinate prototype parts, production components, packaging, and samples with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Learn and use Keycafe’s internal ordering and production platform to support purchasing, inventory, production records, and operational planning.
  • Help maintain relationships and day-to-day communication with hardware, manufacturing, and logistics suppliers.
  • Support practical investigations into product quality, component fit, manufacturability, cost, shipping, and supply availability.
  • Take on a broad range of technical and operational projects as the company and product line evolve.

Growth Opportunity

This role is intended for a strong early-career generalist who wants to develop broad skills in hardware development and operations.

Over time, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of supplier coordination, purchasing, inventory, production planning, and manufacturing operations. The role has a potential growth path toward a Manufacturing Lead position.

Why Join Keycafe

  • Work on real, globally deployed physical products..
  • Gain exposure across the full product lifecycle: design, prototyping, testing, assembly, manufacturing, and supply chain.
  • Take on meaningful responsibility early and grow alongside an expanding hardware business.
  • Work closely with an experienced team in a practical, fast-moving environment.

Keycafe is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • A related degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Design.
  • Strong practical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Interest in physical products, mechanical systems, electronics, and hardware development.
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on environment and willing to build, test, inspect, and troubleshoot physical products directly.
  • Able to organize work independently, follow through on details, and operate effectively in an evolving environment.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Comfortable using spreadsheets and learning new internal systems and software tools.
  • Able to work collaboratively with engineers, operations staff, suppliers, and external manufacturing partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working for a company developing and shipping a hardware or electronic device.
  • Experience building or testing prototypes, working in a lab or workshop, or assembling electro-mechanical products.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes, supplier communication, purchasing, inventory, quality control, or shipping.
  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a hardware, product-development, manufacturing, or related technical role.
  • Experience using SolidWorks or another CAD/drafting package.

Benefits

  • Work Equipment: We provide an Apple MacBook for work use, as well as a monitor, keyboard, and mouse
  • Music Streaming: We cover your subscription for Spotify, Apple Music, or another major provider
  • Cell Phone Plan: We cover typical single-person plans
  • Wellness Budget: Enjoy an annual budget for physical or mental wellness expenses, such as a local sports league, gym membership, fitness classes, mental health apps, counseling, etc
  • Career Development Budget: Enjoy an annual budget for career development courses, programs, or activities
  • Paid Time Off: 18 days of PTO annually for holiday or sick days, in addition to all of your local statutory holidays
  • Birthday Off: Celebrate your special day with an extra day off
  • 2 Year Sabbatical: After 2 years at Keycafe, enjoy 2 extra weeks of PTO in your 3rd year
  • 5 Year Sabbatical: After 5 years at Keycafe, enjoy 5 extra weeks of PTO in your 6th year. Recurs every 5 years
  • Maternity / Paternity Leave: 4-week paid parental leave for both mothers and fathers, with flexible usage within the first year of the child's arrival

Note: Eligibility for benefits begins upon successful completion of a 3- or 6-month probationary period.

title: Säljchef – Svenska Advokater
description:
Om Svenska Advokater


Svenska Advokater är en nystartad, nätbaserad katalog som hjälper advokater att synas för potentiella klienter.


Vi söker en säljchef som vill bygga upp och leda ett säljteam från grunden – med full provisionsbaserad uppsida och stort mandat.


Detta är ett rent provisionsuppdrag – läs innan du söker


Det finns ingen fast grundlön.


Du är egenanställd via egenanställningsföretag och din ersättning baseras helt på ditt teams säljresultat.


Arbetet sker på distans, med digitala avstämningar (Meet/Zoom).


Dina arbetsuppgifter


1. Rekrytera och introducera säljare.


2. Sätta mätbara och tidsatta ekonomiska mål och coacha säljteamet löpande att nå målen.


3. Säkerställa att säljarna arbetar enligt vår modell.


4. Rapportera ekonomiskt resultat till ägaren.


Vad du får betalt


5 % av den omsättning ditt säljteam genererar – nyförsäljning och förnyelser som säljarna själva aktivt säkerställer. Årspriset för abonnemang är 4 900 kr exkl. moms.


Så här kan det se ut per månad, beroende på teamets omsättning:


200 000 kr i omsättning ger 10 000 kr.


500 000 kr i omsättning ger 25 000 kr.


1 000 000 kr i omsättning ger 50 000 kr.


2 000 000 kr i omsättning ger 100 000 kr.


Din ersättning växer linjärt med teamets försäljning.


Vad du INTE får betalt för


Ingen ersättning på självbetjäningsförsäljning.


Inget färdigt team – du rekryterar ditt team själv genom platsannonser och andra kanaler.


Vad du INTE får


Ingen fast lön eller grundlön.


Ingen ersättning för telefon, resor, bil, dator, internet eller andra omkostnader.


Inget traktamente (ersättning för resor och övernattning).


Ingen representation (inga kundluncher, middagar eller evenemang).


Ingen ersättning för utbildningar – du står själv för eventuella kompetenshöjande insatser.


Ingen tjänstepension.


Inget friskvårdsbidrag.


Vem vi tror passar


Du är trygg med en roll utan fast lön, där din inkomst styrs av teamets ekonomiska resultat.


Du har erfarenhet av att leda och coacha säljteam mot mätbara ekonomiska mål.


Du är trygg med att rekrytera, sätta utmanande krav och avsluta samarbeten som inte fungerar.


Du talar och skriver svenska obehindrat, gärna även annat nordiskt språk.


Du kan sätta dig in i Stripe och använder Googles ekosystem (Gmail, Kalender, Drive, Docs, Meet) samt AI i ditt arbete.


Anställningsform


Uppdraget inleds med en prövoperiod på 1–3 månader. Prövotiden är till för att båda parter ska kunna utvärdera samarbetet.


Ansökan


Skicka:


1. Ditt CV.


2. Ett brev (max ca 200 ord) där du konkret beskriver hur du under dina första 60 dagar skulle rekrytera och sätta igång ett säljteam på 3–5 personer.


Observera att ansökningar med enbart CV, eller med brev som inte besvarar frågan ovan, inte kommer att behandlas.


Sista ansökningsdag: 2 oktober 2026.


Skicka till: kontakt@svenskaadvokater.se
