title: Fullstackutvecklare – bygg verktygen bakom framtidens public service
description:
Vill du utveckla teknik som används i ett av Sveriges viktigaste medieuppdrag? Sveriges Radio når miljontals människor varje vecka med trovärdig kunskap, fördjupning, sällskap och förströelse. Som fullstackutvecklare blir du en del av det korsfunktionella team som bygger och vidareutvecklar våra produkter och tjänster – bland annat Sveriges Radios arkiv, sök/research och lösningar för transkribering – så att journalistiken når publiken, varje dag.

Teamet består av utvecklare, UX-designer och produktägare som arbetar nära användarna och varandra. Vi delar kunskap och tar gemensamt ansvar från idé till stabil lösning i produktion.

Om tjänsten och dina ansvarsområden

  • Utveckla produkter som gör vardagen enklare för Sveriges Radios journalister och andra interna användare.
  • Förbättra användarupplevelsen tillsammans med UX och teamets övriga kompetenser.
  • Förvalta och vidareutveckla lösningar med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet, skalbarhet och förändringsbarhet.
  • Arbeta tillsammans genom bland annat mobb- och parprogrammering, kodgranskning, workshops och demos.
  • Samarbeta med andra team kring gemensamma flöden, plattformar och tekniska vägval.
  • Bidra till moderna arbetssätt, god kodkvalitet och minskad teknisk skuld.
  • Använda AI som en naturlig del av arbetet, till exempel AI-assisterad kodning, för att bli effektivare och bygga smartare lösningar.

Teknik vi arbetar med

Vår miljö är bred och utvecklas över tid. I dag arbetar vi bland annat med:

  • TypeScript, C#, .NET, Python, Vue, HTML och CSS
  • PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis och RabbitMQ
  • Kubernetes, Argo CD och GitHub Actions
  • Grafana och OpenTelemetry
  • AI-relaterade lösningar för bland annat transkribering, vektorisering, metadataextrahering och textgenerering
  • Drift i både interna miljöer och molntjänster, utifrån behov

Vem vi tror att du är

  • Flera års erfarenhet av backend- och frontendutveckling, med goda kunskaper i .NET (krav). Problemlösning och helhetssyn väger tyngre än exakt vilka andra språk eller ramverk du använt.
  • Skriver tydlig, testbar kod och har erfarenhet av moderna arkitekturer.
  • Erfarenhet av sök- och arkivlösningar (t.ex. Elasticsearch, dokumentdatabaser) samt av att använda AI i det dagliga arbetet, till exempel AI-assisterad kodning.
  • Van att jobba i agila team, har god Scrum-förståelse (gärna som Scrum Master), och vågar fatta beslut med blick för helheten.
  • Delar gärna kunskap, diskuterar lösningsalternativ och gillar att lära nytt tillsammans med teamet.
  • Social och trygg samarbetspartner, bekväm med att prata inför grupp – och gillar att skapa gemenskap i en annars lugn, fokuserad arbetsmiljö.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • erfarenhet av Vue eller andra moderna frontendramverk
  • arbetat med Docker, Kubernetes eller GitHub/Git-baserade arbetsflöden
  • byggt lösningar med exempelvis AI-agenter, RAG eller stora språkmodeller
  • erfarenhet från större organisationer eller komplexa systemmiljöer
  • erfarenhet av att jobba med UX-design

Det här erbjuder vi

Hos Sveriges Radio får du arbeta med teknik som gör skillnad på riktigt, i ett team som har roligt ihop och håller högt i tak. Du får kunniga kollegor, eget ägandeskap för dina produkter och möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik och AI. Vi satsar på din utveckling genom fortbildning, mobb- och parprogrammering och demos, och erbjuder bland annat friskvårdsbidrag samt tillgång till gym, kör och olika sporter. Sveriges Radio är en värdegrundsstyrd organisation – läs mer om vår värdegrund på vår karriärsida.

Frågor och kontaktuppgifter

Tillsvidareanställning med inledande sex månaders provanställning och tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Sveriges Radio krigsplacerar personal med anställning som överstiger 6 månader. Placering är i Radiohuset i Stockholm – vi tror på det som händer när vi möts och jobbar därför minst tre dagar i veckan på plats, något som längre fram kan bli fyra. Känner du igen dig och vill vara med och utveckla teknik för public service? Vill du komma i kontakt med facket så hittar du alla fackliga kontakter här.

title: Varehusmedarbeider 60% Vikariat
description:
Er du en serviceinnstilt problemløser som trives med tempo og varierte dager?

Da kan det være deg vi ser etter!

Hos oss er hverdagen aktiv og variert – ingen dager er helt like. Du jobber både i kassen og ute i butikken, der du møter kundene med et smil og bidrar til at varehuset er ryddig, påfylt og inspirerende. Én dag hjelper du en kunde med å finne riktig produkt, en annen dag er du med på å bygge om en avdeling. Variasjonen er en del av det som gjør jobben spennende.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Analytics Engineer - Underwriting


Please note, this role is 5 Days a week in the office


We’re looking for a passionate Analytics Engineer to join our Actuarial and Underwriting Analytics team. This team leverages technical expertise in actuarial modelling, statistical analysis, and risk management solutions to support a high-impact team of 90+ underwriters. The Actuarial team works seamlessly with Underwriting to help the company stay ahead in the ever-changing insurance market.


In this commercial role, you will own and develop a forward-thinking analytics suite to elevate the Actuarial and Underwriting teams and help answer Fidelis’ most difficult business challenges. You will work closely with the Data team as the company implements a new data architecture.


Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Be a strategic partner to the Underwriting team: Helping to identify critical analytical problems and find innovative solutions with data.
  • Bring fresh insight into a progressing space, identifying the key issue to solve for, and how to unearth the metrics that will inform key business decisions.
  • Understand and take ownership of our business processes, and recommend improvements in data management, error identification, quality control, or process automation.
  • Ensure best practice and process documents are created to support training across the team
  • Collaborate with Actuaries, Underwriters, Data Engineers and Data Analysts to conduct analyses and apply statistics to answer specific day-to-day questions or support larger initiatives.
  • Develop data-driven stories to answer some of the toughest questions in insurance through data visualization and the summarizing of insights in verbal and written form.


Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Strong knowledge of insurance processes and KPIs e.g. Pricing, Reserving and Underwriting practices
  • Experience in Insurance Accounting, or familiarity with London Market specialty business lines for Insurance coverages and data.
  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field or relevant industry experience.
  • Expert programming and data manipulation skills using SQL and Python
  • Strong data visualization skills and experience with Power BI is necessary
  • Ability to develop relationships with key stakeholders both internal and externally across the Company.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive with minimal oversight and process. You connect the dots across business needs and independently drive projects forward.
  • Experience building data modelling, building data pipelines and working with job scheduling systems is a bonus.
  • Experience working with 3rd party APIs for data ingestion is a plus.


FIDELIS ETHOS

Our culture is defined by our ethos. It is the foundation of who we are and the core of

everything we do.

  • • Results – We want to be the best at the things we care about, so we focus on
  • profitability over volume, with responsive decision-making and clear prioritised
  • accountability.
  • • Innovate – We aspire to lead the market in providing the services and products our
  • clients need, and to drive change in the broader impact our industry has on human
  • rights, society, and environmental sustainability.
  • • Include – We create an environment where employees can bring their whole self to
  • work, with open communication where everyone, irrespective of gender, ethnicity,
  • sexual orientation or background, feels able to contribute ideas and be recognised and
  • rewarded for their contribution.
  • • Unite – We operate as team of individual talents that actively seeks to reflect the
  • diversity of the societies in which we operate, giving our business the widest range of
  • inputs and perspectives.
  • • Respond – We work in a business exposed to sudden shocks and changes –
  • elemental, political, economic and human – so we remain nimble and ready for
  • change.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Our vision is for a workplace culture where differences are valued and where diversity of

background, experience and thought are welcomed. We believe that developing and

maintaining a diverse and inclusive organisation is critical to our success. Our hiring,

assessment and selection process must be fair, free from bias and one which ensures we

select the right person for the job, based on merit.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. To ensure that all candidates have a

fair opportunity to show their abilities during the recruitment process, adjustments may be

required. If your physical or mental health or disability may necessitate an adjustment, please

contact James.Lochrie@avenciaconsulting.com to discuss. All information relating to your

health or disability will be treated in accordance with our data protection policy.

title: Wireless Survey & Network Specialist
description:
Network Controls and Electric Inc. has an immediate need for an experienced Wireless Survey & Fortinet Network Specialist. This role performs on-site Wi-Fi heat mapping and surveys using Ekahau, designs wireless networks to support accurate quoting of new jobs, and configures and maintains Fortinet FortiGate infrastructure, including site-to-site IPsec VPN tunnels.

The specialist will also serve as the company's go-to resource for customer Wi-Fi connectivity issues - dispatched onsite to test, analyze, and resolve wireless problems for business, school, and other clients. The specialist will work closely with our estimating and field teams, and at times will participate in installations or assist in training other technicians. Some travel may be required on a case-by-case basis. This is an hourly position with overtime potential and shift differential pay when work is required outside of the standard schedule.

Position Responsibilities

Wireless Surveys & Design:

· Perform on-site Wi-Fi heat mapping and predictive surveys using the Ekahau platform (AI Pro) and compatible survey hardware

· Analyze survey results to identify coverage gaps, interference, and performance issues at existing customer sites

· Design wireless network layouts - including access point placement and channel/power planning - to support accurate quoting of new jobs

· Work with estimators to translate wireless designs into scope and materials, and support field teams during implementation

· Participate in wireless installations and assist in training other technicians on wireless survey and installation best practices

Wireless Troubleshooting & Support:

· Serve as the company's go-to specialist when business, school, and other customers experience Wi-Fi connectivity issues

· Be dispatched onsite to test, analyze, and investigate reported wireless problems

· Resolve issues in the field whenever possible; when issues cannot be immediately resolved, document findings and report back so a corrective plan can be put in place

Wireless Platforms:

· Configure, support, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless platforms, including Fortinet FortiAP, Ruckus, and Aruba

· Adapt to additional wireless platforms as customer needs arise

Fortinet / Network Security:

· Configure and troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPN tunnels on Fortinet FortiGate equipment

· Configure and maintain firewall policies and NAT

· Assist with Fortinet SD-WAN deployments

· Work within FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer environments for centralized management, logging, and reporting

General:

· Communicate findings and job status clearly via email and company reporting systems

· Interface with customers and assigned Project Managers throughout each engagement

· Document survey results, network configurations, and as-built information

· Additional responsibilities/duties as required

title: Instrumentation Control Technician
description:
Job Description


About the job

The Role

This position will report to: Bottling Maintenance Manager

Travel Requirements: Based on Business needs 7-10%

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Shift:1

Employment Category: Full-Time Regular

Pay Range: $24.45 to $34.80

Onsite Position


Bronco Wine Company founded in 1973, our family-owned company strives to continue and improve upon being vertically integrated, from the vineyard to the table, focusing on crafting quality wines for every table. Our family’s resilience and sustained growth will continue to be fostered through stewardship of family, valued employees, respected partners, and future generations.


JOB STATEMENT:

The Instrumentation & Controls Technician’s (ICT) supports a safe and sound maintenance, engineering and related maintenance program for the Bronco Manufacturing Network, consisting of sites in Ceres, Napa Valley, and Santa Rosa, California. Under minimal supervision, the ICT’s primary responsibility is to troubleshoot, test, monitor, repair and maintain the bottling halls and all related support and facility equipment, keeping production lines and related systems operating safely and efficiently. The ICT is a key member of the maintenance team and participates daily in Continuous Improvement (CI) activities in the network. Additional responsibilities may include general mechanical maintenance, documentation and record keeping, working directly with the cellar, quality, winemaking, safety, and other departments; preventative maintenance program management, technical library management, ordering parts and interfacing with suppliers, and performing other duties as assigned and/or required.

Essential Duties:


  • Primarily responsible for maintaining bottling, processing, and support equipment in various halls and other areas around Bronco facilities.
  • Troubleshoot and repair control loops (0–10 VDC and 4–20 mA), electrical/electronic systems, and process instruments such as load cells, temperature, flow rate, and pressure transmitters and other I/O devices.
  • Be familiar with the use of DVMs, ohm meters, oscilloscopes, current loop analyzers.
  • Interpret and work from P&ID diagrams and electrical blueprints for process equipment.
  • Perform preventive electrical and mechanical maintenance on diverse process equipment.
  • Be proficient using standard hand tools and be familiar with mechanical systems such as belt drives, pulleys, motors, conveyance, etc.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and follow SOPs/BOMs.
  • Understand and comply with all ISO 9001, HACCP and GMP requirements and processes.
  • Trains and mentors team members hands on, where the work is at in the production spaces.
  • Working knowledge of Lock Out, Tag Out (LOTO) and safe operation of all site equipment.
  • Advanced knowledge of electricity and the safe operation of electrical testing equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, electronic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems.
  • Works with industry standard PLC platforms (Rockwell, Siemens, GE Fanuc) and HMI/SCADA systems (Intouch, WINcc, Inductive Automation, ControlLogix).
  • Works with networked and PC-based logic controls
  • Draft, develop, update and maintain technical documentation, training materials, and troubleshooting guides
  • Interface with the network’s CMMS and dashboard databases
  • Operate material handling equipment, battery equipment, moving machinery, and other powered equipment
  • Utilize TCP/IP as a troubleshooting and setup tool
  • Acts as a key participant in CI meetings and activities


JOB REQUIREMENTS:


Education/Experience:

  • Two-year associate’s degree or Certificate in an automotive, aviation, marine, electrical or other technical field with a focus on industrial electrical systems and programming.
  • At least ten (10) years’ experience with demonstrated increase in responsibility and scope at a journey or Senior level in a plant manufacturing environment, with preference for high-speed beverage manufacturing of sodas, wine, beer, juice or dairy products with at least 2MM units of production annually.
  • OR
  • At least fourteen (14) years’ experience with demonstrated increase in responsibility and scope at a journey or Senior level in a plant manufacturing environment, with preference for high-speed beverage manufacturing of sodas, wine, beer, juice or dairy. Successful experience working in multiple sites is highly desired with a combined volume of at least 4MM units annually.
  • CPR Certification and first aid mandatory


ADVANCE KNOWLEDGE OF:

  • Processing and packaging equipment operation.
  • Instrumentation, control systems, programming and SCADA
  • Preventive maintenance schedules and CMMS.
  • Equipment manuals, specifications, drawings and Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID) s.
  • Engineering design methods in beverage manufacturing.
  • Continuous Improvement (CI) tools, programs, and methods.


ABILITY TO:

  • Travel throughout the Northern California area between Ceres and Santa Rosa.
  • Interact effectively with Bronco Team Members.
  • Work at various heights and awkward positions, as needed.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Occasional stair climb.
  • Frequent walking.
  • Work in awkward positions (kneeling, lying down or squatting).


WORK ENVIROMENT:

  • Moving machinery.
  • Occasionally high noise level.
  • Exposure to solvents/chemicals.
  • Frequently working in outdoor climate.


HOURS AND WORKDAYS

1st Shift 7:00 am - 3:30 pm, Monday through Friday, weekends and holiday may be mandatory based on business needs.


PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED:

  • Side shield safety glasses, safety vest, head/ear protection, and proper footwear when in production facility


WHAT WE OFFER

At Broco Wine Company, we understand that our success is driven by our talented committed workforce. We value the contributions each employee makes to our achievements, and our aim is to offer a comprehensive benefits program that is competitive, helping us attract and retain top talent. Our Benefits are crafted to support the needs of our employees and their families, ensuring the package is simple to understand, easy to access, and affordable for all.

title: Engineer I
company: St. Johns River Water Management District
description:
Engineer I

Division of Regulatory Services


The St. Johns River Water Management District is an environmental regulatory agency whose work is focused on ensuring a long-term supply of drinking water, and to protect and restore the health of water bodies in the district’s 18 counties in northeast and east-central Florida. Become a member of our team to help protect our natural resources while enjoying work/life balance in a professional culture with competitive pay and benefits.

Job Summary:

Entry level engineering work reviewing permit applications and preparing technical reports of findings, assisting in permit compliance or engineering analysis, planning, design, and management of engineering construction, maintenance, and operation projects.


Job duties:

  • Reviews the engineering portion of smaller and/or less complex applications for Environmental Resource Permits. Responsibilities include review of construction plans/drawings, calculations, data, legal documents, and hydrologic modeling to determine if projects meet the District criteria for water quality and flood protection; preparing technical staff reports and letters; conducting pre-application meetings including meeting to assist consultants in developing and completing their application through the design review process; coordinating the review of projects with other review team members and supervisors, as necessary; documenting project actions, activities, and pertinent information.
  • Assists, as needed, the Compliance Team in the review of the engineering portion of the smaller and/or less complex compliance and enforcement projects, to evaluate conformance with District rules and issued permits. Responsibilities include conducting periodic site inspections during and upon completion of project construction/implementation to monitor system conditions; evaluating compliance submittals; reviewing and evaluating monitoring reports; responding to complaints and public information requests pertaining to rule violations; facilitating resolutions to non-compliance issues; performing permit determinations; writing technical reports and enforcement actions; reviewing legal documents and coordinating with legal staff; coordinating with other compliance team members and supervisors, as necessary; documenting compliance actions, activities and pertinent information; communicating regularly with the supervisor on compliance matters of heightened concern.

Minimum Qualifications:

A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in environmental, civil, hydraulic, agricultural or water resource engineering or a closely related engineering field.


Physical Requirements/Working Environment:

Mostly in an office environment, sitting at a desk and operating a personal computer to produce work products with some field visits as required.


Periodic field visits:

The applicant must have the ability to endure outdoor environments in uncomfortable temperatures, inclement weather, and remote locations.


Licenses:

Valid State of Florida Driver’s License.


Additional Details:

Starting Salary Range: $61,318.40 - $76,648.00

Starting salary is based on qualifications and experience.


Benefits include Florida Retirement System, health insurance, paid parental leave, dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability, paid leave and holidays, professional development, wellness program, and eligible for public service student loan forgiveness program.

Your application will receive careful consideration, and if selected for an interview, you will be contacted to schedule an appointment. Claims and Remittances Supervisor

It is our goal to provide the finest Orthopaedic care possible. This philosophy requires that all office staff and providers be sensitive and responsive to patients’ needs and preferences. To ensure that we hire and retain the quality of staff needed for implementing our philosophy of service, we have adopted the following job description for this position.


The position is a non-exempt position. Workdays are typically scheduled withing a five-day workweek. Hours and days may vary based on operational needs. All scheduling complies with applicable California wage-and-hour-laws.

Many of the responsibilities require that you have a working knowledge of computers and the ability to make proper use of the programs utilized in this office, or those that may be necessary to meet the needs of the practice.


BASIC FUNCTION:

Under the supervision of the Director of Revenue Cycle, the Claims and Remittances Supervisor shall provide all responsibilities necessary for the successful operation of the Arrowhead Orthopaedics business office.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Claims and Remittances Supervisor is responsible for providing leadership oversight of all claim’s submissions, remittance processing, payment posting, and reconciliation activities to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and timely reimbursement. The duties of the Claims and Remittances Supervisor are of high volume, and the quality of duties performed need to be at a high level. The employee will come into contact daily with confidential patient and physician files. The Claims and Remittances Manager must be able to handle this information with the highest degree of privacy, discretion, and professionalism.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all electronic claims transmission and clearinghouse operations, ensuring claim errors and rejections are researched, resolved, and resubmitted within established service levels.
  • Serve as the primary operational resource for clearinghouse functionality, ERA/EFT processing, system-related issues, and claim transmission troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate closely with the Finance Department to reconcile all incoming payments, electronic funds transfers (EFTs), remittances, and deposits while ensuring the Practice Management System accurately reflects all financial activity.
  • Ensure daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of payment batches, bank deposits, remittance files, and practice management system balances to maintain financial integrity.
  • Direct the preparation, balancing, and reconciliation of incoming payment batches while assigning workload and monitoring productivity across the payment posting team.
  • Oversee the accurate posting and allocation of insurance and patient payments, including electronic remittance advice (ERA), manual explanation of benefits (EOB), and explanation of remittance (EOR) processing.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve payment posting discrepancies, reconciliation variances, and system inconsistencies in collaboration with Finance and Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Maintain the accuracy of payer fee schedules, reimbursement tables, and related system configuration within the practice management system.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve payment posting and reconciliation workflows to enhance operational efficiency and reduce payment variance.
  • Monitor departmental performance metrics, productivity, accuracy, and aging trends.
  • Communicate operational updates, process improvements, and organizational changes to ensure consistency across the department.
  • Partner with leadership on system implementations, upgrades, audits, and special revenue cycle initiatives.
  • Perform special projects and other responsibilities, tasks, or duties as requested by the Director of Revenue Cycle.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Hire, train, coach and supervise following positions in Business Office (Claims & Remittances Positions)
  • Monitor and develop employee’s performance to include, but not limited to, providing supervision, scheduling, conducting counseling and performance evaluations and delivering recognition and reward.
  • Monitoring and assessing service and satisfaction trends, evaluating and addressing issues, making improvements accordingly.
  • Ensuring a high standard of appearance, patient experience, and service in employees.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who takes quality seriously, integrates well into a team, and doesn't need close supervision to deliver. Your work will directly power Epassi's B2C consumer and B2B merchant platforms.

  • Build and maintain Java-based microservices that power both the B2C and B2B platforms, following API-first principles

title: Full Stack Engineer - Intermediate
description:
Jora New Zealand will close on 16th September 2026. Thank you for being with us, we are cheering you on as you continue your career journey.

Crescent Recruitment – Christchurch, South Island

XE are growing their Christchurch technology team and are looking for a couple of Full Stack Developers to join a global business working at the centre of cross-border payments, foreign exchange, and financial technology.
These roles are open to strong upper intermediate developers who are progressing toward senior level, as well as established senior developers who are ready to take ownership of more complex technical work.
XE helps consumers and businesses collect, convert, hold, and send money across international markets. Each year, hundreds of millions of people use XE for currency information, and hundreds of thousands use XE to send money overseas.
Backed by Euronet Worldwide, XE has the scale of a global financial services group, while the Christchurch team remains small enough for developers to have real ownership, direct input, and visible impact.

The role
These are hands-on full stack development roles working across modern web applications, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing product features.
You will be joining XE at a significant point in its technology journey. The business is rebuilding and modernising the platform layer behind its corporate and consumer payments products, and the Christchurch team is expanding to increase its local full stack capability.
You will work in a product-focused squad alongside developers, QA, product owners, team leads, and wider global technology teams. This is not a heavily client-facing role, but you will need to be comfortable communicating clearly within a team and contributing to technical discussions.
XE is also moving strongly into AI-assisted development. GitHub Copilot and other AI coding tools are already part of how the team builds, tests, documents, and ships software. These roles will suit developers who are genuinely interested in using AI well as part of their everyday engineering workflow.

What you’ll be doing
Depending on your level of experience, you’ll be involved in:

  • Building and shipping full stack features across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases
  • Working on products that support payments, FX, onboarding, settlement, KYC/KYB, and multi-currency services
  • Developing frontend features using Vue.js or another modern JavaScript framework
  • Building backend services using C#/.NET and related technologies
  • Working with SQL and relational databases
  • Supporting services in production, including reliability, observability, and incident response
  • Using AWS services and modern deployment practices
  • Writing and maintaining tests as part of your development process
  • Using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot as part of your workflow
  • Helping modernise legacy systems into XE’s modern platform stack
  • Contributing to technical design discussions and, at senior level, helping mentor others and shape delivery within your domain

What we’re looking for
You do not need to tick every box, but you will likely bring:

  • Strong experience building production web applications
  • Solid hands-on experience across both frontend and backend development
  • Strong capability with C#/.NET, or another object-oriented backend language such as Java, Kotlin, or Go
  • Experience with Vue.js, React, or a similar modern JavaScript framework
  • Good SQL and relational database fundamentals
  • Exposure to AWS or cloud-based development
  • An understanding of APIs, CI/CD, testing, and modern software delivery
  • A practical, team-focused approach to solving technical problems
  • Genuine interest in using AI tools to improve how software is built

For upper intermediate developers, XE will be looking for strong technical foundations, clear growth potential, and the ability to take ownership of meaningful work.
For senior developers, XE will be looking for deeper technical ownership, stronger system design capability, confidence contributing to architecture and design discussions, and the ability to support or mentor other developers.
Experience in payments, banking, foreign exchange, insurance, fintech, or another regulated environment would be useful, but it is not essential.

Why these roles are worth considering
These are good opportunities for full stack developers who want exposure to:

  • Global-scale payments and financial technology products
  • Full stack product development rather than narrow feature work
  • AI-first engineering practices
  • Modernisation of complex platforms
  • A Christchurch-based team with international reach
  • A supportive environment where upper intermediate developers can continue progressing
  • Senior-level ownership for developers ready to influence technical direction and delivery

Working arrangement
The roles are based in XE’s Christchurch CBD office with a hybrid model. You will need to be in the office at least three days per week.
The team is pragmatic and flexible around normal life commitments, including school drop-offs and pickups. There may occasionally be calls with overseas teams due to XE’s global footprint.

Benefits
XE offers:

  • Health insurance for employees
  • Discounted family health insurance
  • Birthday day off
  • Additional annual leave for each year of service, up to five extra days
  • Employee share programme
  • Staff rate on XE currency exchange
  • Charity day
  • Office snacks, fruit, drinks, and coffee
  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

Jouw werkzaamheden als logopedist binnen het team Volwassenen zullen primair bestaan uit patiëntenzorg. Hierbij staan het diagnosticeren en behandelen van slik-, spraak- en taalstoornissen bij klinisch opgenomen volwassen patiënten op verschillende afdelingen centraal, met name Neurologie, Neurochirurgie, Geriatrie en Revalidatie.

Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team en hebt veelvuldig contact met artsen, verpleegkundigen, diëtisten en andere paramedici.

Afhankelijk van je werkervaring en wensen kan bijdragen aan onderwijs en/of onderzoek ook een onderdeel zijn van je werkzaamheden, bijvoorbeeld in het verzamelen van data voor onderzoek of het geven van onderwijs aan artsen of verpleegkundigen.

Jouw werkplek

De afdeling Logopedie maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Revalidatie van het Radboudumc. De missie van de afdeling is: ‘To have a significant impact on people’s daily life’. Binnen het team Volwassenen geven wij invulling aan deze missie door een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan patiëntenzorg, onderzoek en onderwijs.

Wij bieden persoonsgerichte zorg binnen vrijwel alle centra van het Radboudumc. Het totale team bestaat uit 24 logopedisten, die samen verantwoordelijk zijn voor de logopedische zorg aan alle kinderen en volwassenen binnen het Radboudumc, met uitzondering van de logopedische zorg binnen het Audiologisch Centrum.

Het team waarin jij komt te werken is het team Volwassenen. Dit team bestaat uit 17 logopedisten met verschillende expertisegebieden. Door intensief samen te werken en van én met elkaar te leren, blijven we ons voortdurend ontwikkelen en de kwaliteit van onze zorg verbeteren.

Profiel

Je bent een enthousiaste logopedist met affiniteit voor slik-, spraak- en taalstoornissen als gevolg van neurologische aandoeningen. Ervaring binnen een ziekenhuissetting is een pré.

Je komt te werken in een groot team binnen een academisch ziekenhuis. Dat vraagt van jou flexibiliteit, assertiviteit en een proactieve houding. Samenwerken en overleggen gaan je van nature goed af. Daarnaast voel jij je thuis in een omgeving waarin je voortdurend nieuwe dingen leert en complexe casuïstiek ziet als een uitdaging.

Goed om te weten

  • Vanwege de samenstelling van het team en de inzetbaarheid binnen de patiëntenzorg ben je in ieder geval beschikbaar op maandag en woensdag.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 13 oktober 2026. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Inschaling in schaal 8M of 9M is afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

Technical Skills

title: Myyjä (12 h/vko) K-Citymarket Varkaus
description:
Olet sitten kokenut asiakkaiden hurmaaja tai hyvällä palveluasenteella varustettu tulevaisuuden osaaja - Tervetuloa tekijöiden taloon!

Haemme nyt myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen K-Citymarket Varkauden kassaosastolle.

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä on työporukka, jossa viihdytään oikeasti – ei vaan puheen tasolla vaan se myös näkyy arjessa ja henkilöstötutkimus osoittaa, että meillä on hyvä tehdä töitä. Yhdessä tuumin jaetaan onnistumiset ja ratkotaan haasteet. Me huolehdimme, että pääset porukkaan ja sujuvasti alkuun. Sinä tuot asenteen ja me perehdytämme. Esihenkilösi onkin aidosti arjessa läsnä. Hän sparraa, kuuntelee ja tukee kehittymistäsi. Palkitsemme myös säännöllisesti tekijöitämme ja tiimejämme.

Olet avainasemassa kaupan menestyksessä.

Työssäsi kassalla usein juuri sinä olet viimeinen, jonka asiakas kohtaa. Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että mukaan tarttuu hyvä fiilis ja ilahduttava muistijälki - siksi juuri sinun roolisi on erityisen merkityksellinen ja pääset vaikuttamaan asiakkaidemme arkeen. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asiakkaiden huomiointi ja tervehtiminen, sekä ostosten ja maksutapahtumien käsittely sujuvasti ja huolellisesti linja- tai itsepalvelukassalla. Huolehdit, että asiakas saa kaikki edut, tuotteet ovat siististi esillä ja kaupassa on viihtyisää.

Meille on tärkeää, että teemme kaupassa tiivistä yhteistyötä yli osastorajojen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että osastotyöstä riennetään apuun kassalle ruuhka-aikana ja kassalta autetaan taas osastotyötä tekeviä, jotta saamme pikaisesti upeat uutuudet esiin kuormasta ilahduttamaan asiakkaitamme.

Nämä taidot tukevat onnistumistasi

  • Sydämesi sykkii asiakaspalvelulle -haluat tarjota parhaan mahdollisen asiointikokemuksen jokaiselle asiakkaalle
  • Asiakasmäärämme ovat ajoittain suuria, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, huolellisuutta ja reipasta työotetta
  • Olet valmis käärimään hihat ja oppimaan uutta. Aiempi kokemus samankaltaisista tehtävistä on plussaa
  • Pystyt työskentelemään kaupan aukioloaikoina ja olet vähintään 18 vuotta
  • Kykenet työskentelemään suomeksi

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta .

Mitä saat meiltä?

  • Mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön, joka auttaa ja tukee arjessa
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä oman kummi KAMU:n, joka auttaa sinua ja huolehtii, että pääset osaksi porukkaamme ja työssäsi hyvin alkuun
  • Monipuolisia kaupan eri tehtäviä. Meillä voit rakentaa pitkänkin uran ja tuemme sinua osaamisesi kehittämisessä
  • Kaupan TES:n mukaisen palkan + ilta- ja viikonloppulisät
  • Sinulla on mahdollisuus vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon sekä palkitsemme säännöllisesti erilaisista hyvistä suorituksista pienemmillä palkinnoilla
  • Suomen Aktiivisimpana työpaikkana tarjoamme HeiaHeia-hyvinvointiapin ja erilaisia liikuntahaasteita
  • Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten henkilökunnan ostoedun K-ryhmän ketjuihin, ePassin, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Kattava työterveys pitää sinusta huolta.

title: Private Practice Therapist - Inspire Counseling Center (Evanston)
description:
Are you looking to be part of a connected team that invests in you, clinically and personally, and is dedicated to making a difference in their client's lives? If so, we'd love to meet you! Inspire is a special place that values therapists happiness. We know life is short, and want work to be fun and meaningful. We also have boundaries to protect your work-life balance, so you can enjoy your life outside the office. Our teams are connected, warm & fun. We laugh, we love what we do, we provide excellent client service, have fun company and team outings.


We're looking for a therapist or social worker to be part of the Evanston team, willing to see a minimum of 20 clients a week. We'll work with you to set your schedule and you'll have a dedicated, beautiful, office each week. Inspire serves a wide variety of clients, including kids, adolescents, adults, families and couples.


With four locations (Northbrook, Kenilworth, Lake Forest & Evanston), you get the benefits of a big practice with stability, support, compensation and perks. You also get the cozy, chill vibe of a smaller boutique office. We strive to take excellent care of our therapists with beautiful, spa-like offices, talented professionals and-- best of all -- a positive, open and kind culture.


As part of a large practice, you get a strong administrative team who takes care of you, so you can focus on your clients. We handle all intake calls, new client paperwork, scheduling, billing, insurance, credit card processing, marketing, office management, and more. You also get health insurance (medical, dental & vision), 401k, Paid Time Off (PTO), Free Supervision, Free In-House Trainings, CEU Stipends, beautiful offices, team outings, paid speaking opportunities, paid leadership opportunities, access to our Psychiatry Team for medical-related questions, and cutting-edge marketing to provide you a steady stream of clients.


For therapists new to private practice, we provide weekly individual supervision, in addition to group supervision, to empower you in your confidence and counseling skills. For all therapists, we have weekly group supervision and individual supervision available as-needed. For all new hires, we provide a paid New Hire Orientation to ensure you are equipped and comfortable in your career at Inspire (and have a warm welcome to the team!).


One of our BIGGEST priorities is our warm, considerate and open-minded culture. We are looking for humans who are kind, vulnerable, humble, down-to-earth, affirming and accepting of everyone's different journey, loving and people who take responsibility and ownership for their success. While we value clinical education and skills, we have found that one of the most important things for our work culture, and client's growth, is being a kind, loving person. We care about you as a person, as well as a therapist. We value personal time, family and a healthy work-life balance. We don't think of ourselves as “therapists” helping “clients.” We are "people" supporting "people." We honor that every person is whole and complete. We want every client (and therapist) to be growing and striving to be their best. Candidate must have a like-minded attitude.


We'd love to have you be part of this movement that is helping people to live their best lives!!


We provide:

  • W2 Employee status
  • Competitive compensation (percentage based on income received)
  • Health Insurance (medical, vision & dental) BCBS PPO
  • 401k for retirement savings
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) 40 hours/year
  • Beautiful, spa-like offices
  • Weekly clinical supervision
  • In-House Trainings & CEU stipends
  • Steady stream of client referrals
  • Legal Counsel
  • Professional Liability Insurance & Workman's Comp
  • Psychiatry Team-- available for medication referrals & consultation
  • Intake Team--manages all intake calls, schedules and physical office space
  • Billing Team--manages all medical billing, benefits/eligibility, submits claims, denials, credentialing
  • Community Relations Team--manages outreach in the community for awareness and new clients
  • Marketing Support -- Professional Marketing team keeping Inspire recognized in the community
  • Office parties & Company Meetings (with fun "swag!")

  • Supportive, positive and fun team environment
  • Most of all, we provide a real opportunity to make an impact on people's lives!

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
As one of Canada’s largest and fastest growing cryptocurrency trading platforms, Ndax has set the bar high for the country’s fintech industry and is constantly leading the way in terms of security and innovation. We are on a mission to empower more Canadians to unlock the full potential of digital finance.

To address the various needs in the Canadian cryptocurrency space, Ndax has assembled a multidisciplinary team with diverse backgrounds, including finance, technology, engineering, compliance, marketing, and more.

We are proud to have been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work®

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative and user-focused UI/UX Designer to craft intuitive and visually compelling digital experiences. In this role, you will be responsible for designing user interfaces, conducting user research, and creating wireframes and prototypes that align with customer needs and business objectives. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and marketing to deliver designs that enhance usability and engagement.

Requirements

User Research & Analysis

  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and analyze feedback to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Benchmark design patterns and user experiences against industry standards and competitors.
  • Provide insights to guide design decisions and improve overall user satisfaction.

Design Strategy & Development

  • Define and maintain design systems, style guides, and UI components for consistency.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups that align with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to ensure feasibility and alignment with technical requirements.

Interaction Design & Visual Craft

  • Design intuitive navigation flows and interactive elements that enhance usability.
  • Apply best practices in typography, color theory, and layout for visually appealing interfaces.
  • Ensure accessibility compliance and responsive design across devices.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver designs on time and within scope.
  • Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback from stakeholders.
  • Support development teams during implementation to maintain design integrity.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on UI/UX trends, tools, and emerging technologies.
  • Contribute to team success by sharing knowledge and mentoring junior designers.
  • Continuously iterate designs based on user feedback and performance metrics.

Must Haves

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably in fintech, SaaS, or technology.
  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and usability testing.
  • Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and marketing teams.
  • Excellent visual design skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for fintech, cryptocurrency, or blockchain platforms, with an understanding of complex financial workflows.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to ensure seamless collaboration with developers.
  • Strong knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design principles for inclusive user experiences.
  • Ability to create and maintain design systems for consistency across multiple products.
  • Experience with data visualization and designing interfaces for financial dashboards.
  • Motion design or micro-interaction expertise to enhance user engagement.
  • Understanding of security and compliance considerations in financial services UX.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Potential Equity or Stock Option Plan
  • Training & Development Opportunities
  • Bonus - Awards - Gifts
  • Collaborative, fast-paced culture with a passionate team dedicated to shaping the future of crypto trading
  • Modern offices with cutting-edge technology (or remote options for qualified candidates)
  • Free bicycle parking and access to the building gym

  • Design, develop and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes and data processing solutions for structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop and optimise data models, data warehouses and data integration solutions.
  • Work with data scientists and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and support analytics and modelling initiatives.
  • Handle data from different sources and processing requirements, including batch, real-time and near-real-time data.
  • Monitor data pipelines and ensure that data solutions meet agreed performance, reliability and service requirements.
  • Implement data quality checks and practices to improve the accuracy, consistency and reliability of data.
  • Apply appropriate data security, governance and management practices when developing data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise existing data pipelines and processing workflows.
  • Prepare technical documentation relating to data models, pipelines and data processing solutions.
  • Support data-related solution design, proposal activities and implementation initiatives when required.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
  • Experience data engineering, data integration, ETL development or related areas.
  • Hands-on experience developing and optimising data pipelines, ETL processes and data platforms .
  • Experience with ETL / data integration technologies such as Informatica, Talend or similar tools .
  • Good understanding of SQL, relational databases and DBMS .
  • Programming experience in Python .
  • Knowledge of data structures, data transformation, metadata and workload/dependency management.
  • Familiarity with Big Data technologies , such as Apache Spark, Hadoop or Hive.
  • Experience working with data from multiple sources and formats is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with different stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:
  • Power BI / Data Visualisation
  • PostgreSQL, SAP or other enterprise databases
  • Flat files and unstructured data such as documents, images, audio or video
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker / Podman
  • Microservices architecture
  • DevSecOps practices
  • Microsoft Access and SharePoint

What We Offer

  • Permanent employment opportunity
  • Exposure to enterprise-level data engineering projects
  • Opportunities to work with modern data technologies and platforms
  • Collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth
  • Exposure to both technical delivery and solution development initiatives

title: Contract Licensed Psychologist 1099/ Board Certified Behavior Analyst / BCBA
description:
Contract Psychologist 1099 / Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) – ABA Centers

1099 Independent Contractor | Remote

When providing services as a BCBA: $70–$110 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

When providing services as a Licensed Psychologist: $80–$150 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

Who We Are

We are the nation’s fastest-growing provider of autism care, delivering high-quality Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy across a rapidly expanding footprint. Since our founding in 2020, we’ve scaled from a single clinic to nearly 70 operating areas in more than a dozen states, supported by a high-performance corporate infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.

Recognized as the #5 fastest-growing private company in America by Inc. magazine, ABA Centers is a self-funded, founder-led organization—a rarity in today’s healthcare landscape. We’ve achieved this growth without private equity, relying instead on operational discipline, smart capital allocation, and a relentless focus on outcomes.

Our Origin Story

ABA Centers was founded by a father whose personal journey navigating autism care for his daughter revealed deep gaps in access, consistency, and quality across the system. Determined to disrupt the status quo in the autism care field and eliminate the unacceptably long wait lists for treatment, he built a company rooted in compassion, clinical excellence, and a relentless commitment to care that makes a difference.

Recognition & Awards

Our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned our company and leadership national recognition from trusted sources, including:

  • Inc. 5000 – 5th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America
  • Financial Times – #1 on "The Americas' Fastest Growing Companies"
  • EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® U.S. Overall
  • South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies
  • Florida Trend Magazine's 500 Most Influential Business Leaders
  • Inc. Best in Business, Health Services

POSITION SUMMARY & PURPOSE

ABA Centers of America provides year-round therapeutic intervention for children, adolescents, and adults with autism spectrum disorder using the science of applied behavior analysis (ABA). Services are delivered in clinic, home, and community settings.

This dual-role 1099 contractor position combines the clinical responsibilities of a Licensed Psychologist (under the Director of the Diagnostic Services Department) with those of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst. The contractor will complete psychological/neuropsychological evaluations, review and sign reports, supervise and train diagnostic staff, and also maintain a caseload of 6–9 learners receiving insurance-funded or private-pay ABA services. The principal functions identified shall not be considered a complete description of all work requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

POSITION ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

As Psychologist / Diagnostic Services

  • Provide comprehensive neuropsychological, psychological, and/or psychoeducational evaluations of clients with referral concerns related to learning, behavioral, emotional, and/or social difficulties.
  • Conduct in-person and/or virtual evaluations.
  • Provide written and oral feedback to clients (or legal guardians) regarding results, diagnostic impressions, and recommendations.
  • Compile written reports detailing evaluation findings, diagnosis(es), and recommendations for the medical record and sharing with patients/guardians and referral sources (in accordance with HIPAA).
  • Ensure timely documentation upload per departmental policy.
  • Provide direct supervision (individual/group) and training of Neuropsychological Testing/Assessment to Diagnostic Specialists (Psychometrists/Technicians).
  • Participate in weekly Regional Clinical Training Meetings and present at Weekly Psychology Assessment Didactic Seminars (PADS).
  • Remain current in the field and pursue continuing education related to pediatric psychological/neuropsychological testing.
  • Maintain an active license and good standing with the state board of psychology.
  • Comply with ABA Centers of America’s HIPAA privacy and security policies.

As Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)

  • Design, implement, and monitor skill-acquisition and behavior-reduction programs.
  • Research literature related to specific learners’ programs.
  • Oversee the implementation of behavior-analytic programs by RBTs and caregivers.
  • Conduct assessments related to the need for behavioral intervention (e.g., preference assessments, functional assessments,
  • staff performance assessments).
  • Analyze and summarize assessment results and graph data as needed.
  • Write 6-month progress reports to secure insurance funding.
  • Provide staff and caregiver training.
  • Facilitate team meetings for each learner every other week.
  • Create goals for skill generalization and update program sheets as skills meet criteria.
  • Create or update data collection systems.
  • Be available to answer questions from technicians and caregivers; follow up to ensure generalization of objectives.
  • Complete and submit documentation in a timely manner to the billing agency.
  • Oversee the restricted hours of 1–2 Apprentices.
  • Oversee a maximum of 3 trainees seeking supervision toward Supervised Fieldwork experience (weekly 1-hour meetings,
  • documentation review, and competency development using BTS in program writing, training, assessments, parent training,
  • treatment plans, and other analytical tasks).
  • Delegate case management tasks to competent trainees and provide feedback.
  • Be willing and able to supervise others seeking BCBA certification weekly.
  • Shared / Collaborative Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers in the child’s community.
  • Collaborate with all team members to facilitate the mission of ABA Centers of America, including attending routine
  • departmental and general staff meetings.
  • Actively seek supervision when needed.

Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements

Psychologist track: Doctoral Degree in Clinical Psychology or Developmental Psychology (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) with specific training in assessment of pediatric and adolescent neurodevelopmental disorders, including specific learning disorders, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability. Prior training and experience with administration, scoring, and interpretation of neuropsychological tests required. Experience administering measures of Intellectual Functioning, Development, Autism Spectrum Disorder (including the ADOS-2), Social Communication, and Emotional and Behavioral Functioning.

BCBA track: Minimum of a Master’s Degree in Applied Behavior Analysis (required) and current BCBA certification/licensure.

Two years’ experience in the ABA field preferred. Excellent report-writing skills.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers.
  • Effective organizational, time-management, prioritization, communication, interpersonal, and team skills.
  • Ability to pass background and drug screens.
  • Willingness to sign company NDA and any revisions thereafter.
  • Maintain clean background/drug screenings and driving record (required).
  • English proficiency required; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Technology / Equipment Used

  • Computer/Laptop
  • Fax/Copy/Scanner Machine
  • Telephone System
  • Calculator

Work Environment / Physical & Mental Demands

Most work (approximately 95%) is performed indoors in a temperature-controlled environment. Potential exposures to workplace violence and hazards are low. Physical and mental demands are consistent with the requirements of providing clinical evaluations and ABA services in clinic, home, and community settings (standing, walking, bending, crouching, carrying, sitting, reading, light lifting, moderate mental stress, and high collaboration with others).

Benefits

Compensation and Contractor Status

  • 1099 Independent Contractor role.
  • Rates as listed above based on the type of service provided and the contractor’s experience/qualifications.
  • Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, licensure, and professional liability coverage.
  • No employee benefits are provided.

title: ServiceNow UI/UX Designer
description:
ServiceNow UI/UX Designer


At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!


Job Summary


B&A is looking for a talented and experienced ServiceNow UI/UX Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and experience in designing and developing user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile applications.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and design user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile applications.
  • Design and develop wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs that meet business needs and user requirements.
  • Develop front-end code using modern web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
  • Ensure that user interfaces and experiences are optimized for performance, accessibility, and usability.
  • Collaborate with back-end developers to ensure seamless integration of front-end code with back-end systems.
  • Participate in user testing and feedback sessions to continuously improve user interfaces and experiences.
  • Keep up-to-date with new UI/UX trends and technologies and provide recommendations for enhancements to existing systems.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, graphic design, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in designing and developing user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile applications.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles and best practices.
  • Working knowledge and experience coding in Java.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Experience with Kendo UI
  • Experience with wireframing and prototyping tools such as Sketch, Adobe XD, and Figma.
  • Experience with front-end web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
  • Knowledge of back-end development technologies such as Node.js and Express is a plus.
  • Understanding of performance optimization, accessibility, and usability best practices.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Security Clearance

  • Eligible to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.


More About B&A:

Notable Clients
B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.


Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

  • The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
  • A formal mentorship program
  • Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
  • Brand Ambassador program
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
  • Monthly teambuilding events
  • B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.


EEO


B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.
